Fiverr Enterprise (Clients: Features & programs)

Fiverr Enterprise is a Freelance Management System (FMS) that enables businesses to source, hire, onboard, manage, and pay their external workforce more effectively while ensuring legal and tax compliance. Unlike a typical freelance marketplace, Fiverr Enterprise is a system that helps businesses find and manage freelance talent within their own ecosystem. While Fiverr Pro focuses on individual client connections, Fiverr Enterprise acts as a matchmaker, connecting freelancers with relevant job opportunities within large organizations.

Overview

Fiverr Enterprise provides a centralized solution for high-level management of external workforces.

Why it’s useful:

  • Streamlined management: Centralizes engagements, work descriptions, and payment tracking.
  • Compliance: Ensures all engagements meet legal and tax compliance requirements.
  • Project variety: Handles hourly, fixed, or retainer-based projects, with a specific focus on long-term engagements.

Who it’s for:

  • Clients: Typically big tech companies and digital agencies.

How it works for Freelancers

The process is designed to be automated and non-intrusive:

  • Invitation: You will receive an email asking if you are interested in offering your freelance talent on Fiverr Enterprise.
  • Profile activation: You will receive a notification via email when your profile becomes visible to potential clients.
  • Job offers: If a client wishes to use your services, you will be notified of the job offer via email.
  • Decision: You can review the work descriptions and choose to accept or decline the offer.

Note: You are under no obligation to accept work. Declining an offer will not affect your Fiverr Pro metrics.

How it works for Clients

To be a part of Fiverr Enterprise, visit the Fiverr Enterprise page and book a demo with the team.

FAQs

  • Fiverr Enterprise uses public information from your Fiverr Pro profile, including your profile image, home country, education, skills, and display name.
  • It creates a profile visible to all Fiverr Enterprise clients, allowing them to reach out to you for job offers and potential collaborations. This includes your username and email address.
  • The platform features hourly, fixed, or retainer-based projects, focusing primarily on long-term work. Clients are generally digital agencies and big tech companies.
  • All engagements are managed via the Fiverr Enterprise solution, where you can accept or decline offers and track your earnings.

Fiverr Pro satisfaction guarantee (Clients: Features & programs)

Order with confidence

At Fiverr Pro, we trust our Pro freelancers’ ability to deliver excellent work and prioritize your satisfaction above all. Our satisfaction guarantee ensures you can collaborate with top-tier talent with total peace of mind, offering a full money-back guarantee on eligible orders on every service provided by our Managed services on Fiverr Pro.

What’s covered?

Satisfaction guarantee applies to the following Fiverr Pro services:

  • Services provided by vetted Pro freelancers.
  • Project manager and project planning services.
  • Sourcing by domain expert, including both the service payment and orders placed with recommended freelancers.

How it works

  • Cancellation timeframe: You must submit a cancellation request to Fiverr’s Customer Support Team within 14 days of order completion.
  • Refund process: The refund amount is limited to the amount of the order and approved refunds are credited to your Fiverr Pro Balance for future orders.
  • Usage rights: If an order is canceled and refunded, you may not use any part of the delivered work. The freelancer retains all rights to the canceled delivery.
  • Exclusions: Satisfaction guarantee does not apply to hourly orders.

Fiverr reserves the right to determine orders’ eligibility, to exclude instances of abuse, fraud, or any other inappropriate activity, and to withdraw, cancel, or amend this offer, without prior notice, at Fiverr’s sole discretion. All Fiverr Pro Terms of Service apply.

Best practices

  • While our support team is here to help, we recommend communicating your concerns with your freelancer first. Often, a quick revision or clarification can align the project with your expectations without needing a cancellation.
  • Since there is a 14-day window for guarantee claims, make it a habit to review all delivered files as soon as they are received. This ensures you have ample time to request adjustments or contact support if the work does not meet the agreed-upon requirements.
  • To get the most out of the satisfaction guarantee, ensure your initial brief is detailed. Having clear, documented requirements makes it easier for our team to evaluate your claim if the final delivery doesn’t match the project scope.

Summary

The Fiverr Pro satisfaction guarantee is our commitment to quality, allowing you to hire with confidence. By understanding the eligibility requirements and maintaining clear communication with your freelancers, you can ensure every project contributes to your business success.

Fiverr Shopify Store Builder

The Fiverr Shopify Store Builder is a free AI powered tool. It’s designed to help users, whether new or experienced, set up a store quickly and easily, without needing technical skills. This article walks you through each step of the setup process, from selecting a niche to connecting your Shopify account, installing the necessary app, and publishing your store.

What do you get with the Fiverr Shopify Store Builder?

By using this tool, you’ll receive a ready-to-sell Shopify store built for your selected niche. No design, coding, or setup experience required. Your store includes:

  • A professional theme designed to convert visitors into customers.
  • Preloaded, high-performing products based on your selected industry.
  • Built-in pages like homepage, product pages, and legal templates.
  • Optional dropshipping setup with 30 days free access to AutoDS.
  • The ability to fully customize and manage your store after launch.

Once your store is published, it’s yours to own, grow, and scale. You can continue editing directly in Shopify or hire Fiverr freelancers to help with marketing, design, or store management.

How do I build my Shopify Store with Fiverr?

  • To start building a Shopify store with Fiverr store builder, you can either browse the navigation bar and look for the ‘Shopify’ category under “Programming & Tech”, or search for relevant keywords via the search bar.
  • Select the industry or type of store that you want to build. You also have the option to choose “I’m not sure”.
  • Adding images for your store’s homepage.
    • If you’re new to Fiverr, you’ll need to sign up. If you already have an account, simply sign in to continue.
    • The banners shown are based on your niche selection. If you are unsure about your niche, the ‘Electronics’ banners will be chosen by default.
    • Please be aware that you are unable to upload your own images.
    • A registration pop-up will appear and the ‘Next’ button will be disabled until your registration is complete.
  • There are 2 options
    • Products I buy or make myself
    • Dropshipping products
    • Click on “Sign up”. This will open your registration page in a new tab.
    • Select “Skip customized setup” to bypass onboarding on Shopify.
    • Clicking on “Access Shopify” will open your store page in a new tab.
    • Return to Fiverr and paste your Shopify admin store’s URL. This will verify the URL. If an incorrect URL is entered, an error message will be displayed.
    • Clicking on “Install app” will open Shopify’s Fiverr Store Builder app
    • Install the app to allow Fiverr to connect to your Shopify store and bring in your selected niche and banners.
    • You will be redirected automatically back to the Fiverr tab.
    • Clicking on “Continue to Shopify” will open the Shopify payment page.
    • The ‘Basic’ plan is selected by default, but you’re free to choose any pricing plan that suits your needs.
    • Return to Fiverr and click on the “Create my store” button. This will verify the Shopify subscription. If there is an issue, an error message will be displayed.
  • A ‘Preview store’ button will link you directly to the Shopify “Themes” section to view your new store on Shopify.
  • For dropshippers only, you also get a special offer to register to AutoDS and get 30-days for free. Subscription to AutoDS is optional and can be skipped.
    • Clicking on “Publish my store” will open the Shopify store settings page, where you publish your store.
    • The ‘Done’ button on Fiverr will be enabled regardless of whether you publish the store immediately or wait until a later time. This will exit the store builder and take you back to the Fiverr homepage.

How can I purchase & manage Google Workspace on Fiverr? (Clients: Features & programs)

What is Google Workspace?

Google Workspace is a cloud-based suite for professional communication, collaboration, and productivity.

It includes:

  • Gmail, Calendar, Meet & Chat for communication
  • Google Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides & Forms for creation and storage
  • Admin controls, security tools, and AI-powered features

When you purchase through Fiverr, you can:

  • Manage subscriptions in one place
  • Access exclusive discounts (50% off for new users, 20% off transfers)
  • Enjoy simplified setup and management

What plans are available on Fiverr?

Fiverr offers two subscription plans: Business Starter and Business Premium.

Both plans include:

  • Unlimited devices, cross-platform compatibility
  • Smart Canvas, real-time collaboration, advanced scheduling
  • Gemini AI Premium plan
  • Security: SSO, 2-step verification, password monitoring, spam/virus/phishing protection
  • Migration tools from free @gmail.com to your domain email
Additional benefits per package:
  • 30GB of pooled storage.
    • 2TB of pooled storage
    • Personalized email campaigns
    • Meeting recordings
    • Shared drives

New to Google Workspace? You can receive 50% off your first subscription by visiting: Fiverr Google Workspace and clicking “Claim your Discount.”

If you already have an active GWS subscription, you can transfer it to Fiverr and receive a 20% discount on your subscription payments. Click here.

What should I know before I purchase?

  • You must own the domain you register with.
  • If you already have Workspace, you can’t buy a new one for the same domain; You must modify the existing subscription instead.
  • Annual commitment plans can’t be downgraded or partially canceled.
  • Taxes are applied at checkout based on billing details.
  • Purchases are non-refundable.

How do I purchase Google Workspace on Fiverr?

  • Go to the Google Workspace page on Fiverr.
  • On the product card, enter your product key from a freelancer, or click “Skip.”
  • Choose your plan: Business Starter or Business Premium.
  • Enter your domain: Use an existing domain, or buy a new domain from the dropdown list.
  • Complete contact and business info.
  • Review your order:
    • Set number of seats
    • View discounts
    • Add payment details
    • Enable or disable auto-renewal
  • Agree to the terms and click “Confirm.”

What happens after I purchase?

After completing your order, you’ll receive confirmation emails from both Fiverr and Google.

- Sign in to the Google admin console within 24 hours using the activation link (the link expires after 24 hours). If the link expires, contact Fiverr support.
- Accept the Google product agreement.
- Activate your license.
- You’ll receive a purchase receipt and invoice.
- Once your account is verified, you’ll have full access to Gmail and all other Google Workspace tools.

How do I manage my Workspace subscription on Fiverr?

In the Fiverr admin console, you can:

  • Create users and set access rights
  • Add secondary domains
  • Personalize the dashboard
  • Adjust settings and billing

Tip: Adding seats is done in the GWS subscription console, not in your Google admin console.

Common actions

- Log in to your [GWS Subscription Console](http://fiverr-manage.gsubscriptions.com/) using the same email address and password as your Google Workspace account. If the login field is pre-filled with a domain name, delete it before entering your full email address.
- Access the 'Subscriptions' tab.
- Select the Subscription you want to modify by clicking on the "Subscription name" to open it.
- Select "Edit" on the subscription.
- Choose to apply changes now or on a custom date.
- Adjust the seat count and click "Save."

- Scroll to the bottom of your subscription page (if upgrades are available).
- Click "Upgrade."
- Complete the form and click "Save."
- In the subscription view, click "Edit."
- Go to the 'Details' tab and check or uncheck auto-renewal.
- Save changes immediately or set a custom date.
- Sign in to the Google admin console.
- Go to account > Domains > Manage domain.
- Add and verify your new domain.

- Check the box to agree to theTerms and Conditions and click "Generate transfer authorization."
- Click "Close."
- To complete the transfer, email support@fiverr.com and provide your domain or Cloud ID associated with your Google Workspace account.

Managing your freelance network (Clients: Features & programs)

The freelance network is a feature that helps you manage and rehire freelancers and agencies you have worked with in the past. Use it to access past hires and organize freelancers and services into lists, all in one place.

How the freelance network works

The freelance network gives you three core capabilities:

  • Centralization: Access and organize freelancers or agencies you have hired, saved, or viewed, all in one place.
  • Organized lists: Categorize freelancers using lists for efficient management. You and your team can collaboratively create a shortlist of freelancers.
  • Team insights: For Pro clients, view your team’s insights on each freelancer, including reviews and orders.

Key benefits include:

  • Increased efficiency: Easily access and maintain a network of freelancers for future projects.
  • Reduced time-to-hire: Quickly find and hire trusted freelancers with a proven track record.
  • Cross-team transparency: For Pro clients, gain insights into your company’s hires, projects, and collaborations.

How to access the freelance network

To access the freelance network, go to either:

  • Your homepage, under Freelance network.
  • The heart icon in the top-right corner of the page.
  • Your avatar drop-down menu, and select the appropriate Freelance network.

Page overview

The page features a left navigation panel that controls the content displayed. The panel includes two sections:

Based on your activity:

  • All hires: Displays freelancers previously hired by the organization.
  • Recently viewed: Displays freelancers or services you have recently viewed. Fiverr Pro clients can view freelancers recently viewed by their team members as well.

Your lists: Displays all lists you have access to. For Pro clients, there are two types of lists:

  • Shareable lists: Visible and editable by everyone on the account.
  • Private lists: Visible only to the creator.

How to view your network

The All hires tab is where you can see your past freelancer collaborations. Each freelancer card shows a summary of your collaboration, including the number of orders, services provided, reviews, and more.

To rehire a freelancer, click the Contact button on their card.

You can use the following filters to narrow down the list:

  • Hired more than once: View freelancers who have worked with you more than once.
  • Provided service: View freelancers that provided a selected service in at least one order.
  • Hired by: For Pro team accounts, view freelancers hired by a selected team member. For individual accounts, this filter appears as Hired by you.

To view in-depth information and access previous work, click on a freelancer’s card to open the Activity panel:

  • Collaboration summary: Get a deeper look at their work.
  • Reviews: Read the feedback you provided.
  • Activity timeline: View the orders the freelancer has worked on, and click on delivered work files to preview or download them.
  • Contact: Send a direct message to the freelancer.

For Pro clients, the All hires view provides a broader picture of your team’s freelancer collaborations. In addition to your own hires, you can see freelancers hired by other team members, the projects and services they worked on, and feedback from your team, giving you better context on each freelancer’s experience and overall collaboration with your organization.

Using lists for potential hires

Lists are part of the freelance network page. Lists allow you to organize freelancers and services you are interested in, making them easy to find for future projects. When you save a service, the freelancer’s profile will appear in your list with the saved service nested within their card.

How to create a list
  • Click the + icon on the left side of the freelance network page.
  • Enter a list name.

For Pro clients: Select whether it is a private list (visible only to you) or a shared list (visible to the entire account).

How to save freelancers to a list
  • From the Gig results: Click the heart icon on the Gig, then choose an existing list or create a new one with the + icon.
  • From the freelancer profile: Click the heart icon in the top-right corner of the freelancer profile, then choose an existing list or create a new one with the + icon.

When viewing saved items in a list:

  • Saved services: When you save a service, it is displayed under the freelancer who provides it rather than as a separate service card.
  • Multiple services from the same freelancer: If you save more than one service from the same freelancer, the freelancer appears only once in the list, with the saved services grouped under their card.
How to access your lists
  • From the header: Select the heart icon to access a specific list from the dropdown.
  • From the freelance network page: Click a list name in the left panel to see all saved freelancers, including your team’s shared lists.
How to manage lists

Edit list:

  • From the freelance network page, click on the list you wish to update on the left.
  • Click on the three dots in the top-right corner and select Edit list, where you can rename the list, add a description to provide more context, or, for Pro clients, set the list as private to restrict access to yourself only.

Delete list: Remove lists you no longer need.

Share list: Share a list with others by clicking the Share icon in the top-right corner of the list. You can copy the list link or share it through the available social platforms.

Referring friends on Fiverr (Clients: Features & programs)

Fiverr’s referral program lets you invite friends to join Fiverr through your personal referral link. When your friend signs up and completes their first qualifying order, we give your friend a discount on that order and reward you with Fiverr Credits. Referring friends is a simple way to earn credits toward your future orders while introducing people you know to Fiverr.

Before you begin

  • Before you refer a friend, make sure you have an active Fiverr account.
  • Your friends must sign up through your referral link. The referral won’t work if your friend already has a Fiverr account or signs up without using the link.
  • You can refer friends from the Fiverr website, iOS app, or Android app.
  • The referral program isn’t available to Fiverr Pro clients.

How the referral program works

  • When you refer a friend, they receive 10% off their first qualifying order, and you receive a reward once that order is completed. Your friend’s first order must total $100 or more to qualify, and they cannot combine the referral discount with a promo code.
  • You earn 10% of your friend’s order amount in Fiverr Credits, up to $100 per referral. We add the credit to your Fiverr Balance within 24 hours of your friend’s order being marked complete. You can earn up to $500 in Fiverr Credits in total through the program.

Fiverr Credits expire three months after we add them to your account. Use your credits before they expire.

If your friend cancels their first order, you do not receive a reward for that order. Your friend must complete a new order for you to earn the credit.

How to use the referral program

- Select your profile picture, then select Refer a friend.
- On the referral page, enter your friend's email address, or copy your personal referral link.
- Share the referral link through email, social media, or another channel.
- Your friend signs up for Fiverr using your referral link. Their account links to yours only if they sign up this way.
- Your friend places a first order of $100 or more. We apply the 10% discount automatically at checkout.
- Your friend completes the order without using a promo code, since they can't combine the referral discount with a promo code.

All orders must be legitimate. Any attempt to manipulate or exploit the referral program may result in an account suspension. Read the Referral Program Terms & Conditions here.

Troubleshooting

  • If your friend’s account doesn’t link to yours, confirm they signed up using your referral link and not another method. We cannot add or change this association after signup.
  • If your friend’s order is canceled, you will not receive a reward for that order. Ask your friend to complete a new order so you can earn the credit.

FAQs

  • You can earn up to $500 in Fiverr Credits by referring friends. Each qualifying referral earns you 10% of your friend’s first order amount, up to $100.
  • We add the credit to your Fiverr Balance within 24 hours after your friend’s order is marked complete.
  • You do not receive a reward. Your friend must complete a new order for you to earn the credit.
  • The referral doesn’t work. Your friend must sign up for Fiverr through your referral link as a new user for you to earn a reward.
  • Fiverr Credits expire three months after we add them to your account.
  • No. Your friend cannot combine the referral discount with a promo code.
  • Select your profile picture, then select Refer a friend. Your personal referral link is on the referral page.
  • No, the referral program isn’t available to Fiverr Pro clients.

Using Logo Maker as a freelancer (Clients: Features & programs)

Logo Maker lets clients purchase a ready-to-use logo built from a design you create, then edit it themselves with no extra work from you. Once a client buys one of your designs, we give them tools to customize it, and you continue earning from that design over time.

Before you begin

This article is for freelancers who already have a Logo Maker account. Logo Maker is currently closed to new freelancers.

There are two levels of access within Logo Maker:

  • All current Logo Maker freelancers can edit, track, and earn from their published designs.
  • Only a limited number of eligible freelancers can add new logos at this time. If you become eligible, we’ll notify you.

If we reopen the program to new freelancers, or expand upload access, we’ll let you know.

To access Logo Maker, log in, switch to selling, and go to My Business > Logo Maker.

How Logo Maker works

Clients can purchase a logo without any extra effort from you. After a client buys your design, they can:

  • Enter their brand name, slogan, design, and branding preferences into Logo Maker’s Brief Wizard. They see a personalized, real-time catalog of logos that best match their brand name and slogan.
  • Edit the logo and adjust typography, colors, and layout using the Editor tool.

There is no communication between you and the client for Logo Maker orders. You cannot make revisions, and you do not influence the client’s design choices.

Customizations & packages

If a client wants specific customization from you, they can order a custom service directly from you.

After a client purchases a logo, they can upgrade the logo package or buy additional logo variations. This generates more revenue for you, since 20% of every additional order goes to you, with no extra effort required.

  • If a client purchased the basic package, they can upgrade to the professional package for $30 USD within the first 72 hours, or for $45 USD after that. Clients can also purchase additional logo variations, such as font, layout, and color, for $15 USD per variation.

Logo statuses

Each logo design you publish has a status:

  • Pending: the logo stays in pending mode for up to four days before it turns active.
  • Draft: the design is unfinished. Finalize publishing to change its status to active.
  • Paused: the design is published but not offered for sale, so clients cannot see it. Your design switches to paused if you reach your limit of active logos.
  • Active: the design is published and offered for sale.

We occasionally review accounts that reach their limit of active logos and notify you if you’re eligible to increase that limit; however, you can’t currently request an increase on your own.

Tracking your performance with the Logo Maker dashboard

The Logo Maker dashboard gives you general and in-depth information about your logos, statistics, and ways to improve as a freelancer.

To access the dashboard, go to My Business > Logo Maker, then select the Overview, My logos, or Insights tab.

  • In the Overview tab, you can view:
    • Your metrics bar (earnings this month, total earnings, completed orders, clicks, favorites, and impressions)
    • Your performance chart, filterable by earnings, orders, clicks, impressions, and time range
    • Your top logos, filterable by impressions, clicks, orders, and earnings
    • Your recent activity, including recent sales and designs added to favorites
    • Your current earnings share and how close you are to the next tier
    • News and tips
  • At the top of the My logos tab, you can view the number of logos in each status: active, pending, paused, drafts, denied, and total.
  • Below the status overview, you can view the metrics table for a detailed breakdown of each logo design’s performance. You can:
    • Switch between a gallery or list display
    • Search and filter by logo name, industry, or status
    • Click a logo to open a side panel showing its performance data, variations, metadata, and recent orders
  • If a client has already purchased a design, you cannot delete it.
  • The metrics table displays detailed stats of each individual logo design:
    • Status: whether the design is pending, draft, paused, or active.
    • Earnings: the total amount you’ve earned from that design so far.
    • Click rate (CR): how often clients who see the design go on to click it.
    • Orders: the number of times that design has been purchased.
    • Clicks: how many times a client clicked the design.
    • Favorites: how many times clients added the design to their favorites.
    • Impressions: how many times the design was shown to a client.
    • Last order: the date of the design’s most recent order.
    • Actions: the options available for that design, including pausing it, sharing it, editing it, viewing it as a client would see it, or deleting it.
  • The Insights tab shows Logo Maker trends, including top searched industries, top converting industries, top picks by industry and tag, and industries with low logo supply.

The earliest date you can view data in the dashboard is January 1, 2022. Activity and metrics from before this date, including “Total” and “all time” data, are not shown.

Earnings tier model

Your earnings share, the percentage of each sale you keep, is based on your total Logo Maker sales over the last 12 months. The higher your sales, the higher your earnings share.

  • Entry-level freelancers start at a 20% earnings share.
  • We recalculate your tier on the first day of every month.
  • Your earnings share applies as a fixed percentage regardless of which package a client purchased.

Sales amount (last 12 months)

Earnings share per sale

$1 USD–$499 USD

20%

$500 USD–$2,499 USD

25%

$2,500 USD–$9,999 USD

30%

$10,000 USD–$19,999 USD

35%

$20,000 USD–$29,999 USD

40%

$30,000 USD–$49,999 USD

45%

$50,000 USD+

50%

The tier-based earnings model took effect on March 1, 2023. It applies to Logo Maker packages (Essential, Professional, and Unlimited), package upgrades, and new paid variations ($15 USD each). It does not apply to other products or services you sell outside Logo Maker.

How to use the Logo Maker dashboard

  • Go to My Business.
  • Select Logo Maker.
  • Choose the Overview, My logos, or Insights tab.
  • Check your current earnings tier and share it under the Overview tab.

Best practices for creating logos

This section is relevant for those freelancers who can upload new logos to Logo Maker.

  • Keep logos simple: favor minimal, focused designs over complex ones, and center each logo around one or two emotions.
  • Design for versatility: use single-letter monograms and leave room for both short and long business names.
  • Avoid duplicate uploads: add real variations in color, layout, or font instead of uploading near-identical designs.
  • Build out variations: aim for four to five varied typography, color, and layout options per logo.
  • Cover different layouts: design for both vertical and horizontal formats, such as social media, business cards, and merchandise.
  • Tag accurately: use simple, element-specific tags based on what’s visually in the logo.
  • Pick a specific industry: choose the most specific sub-industry rather than a broad category.
  • Use color palettes thoughtfully: vary hue, saturation, and value across variations, and avoid gradients.
  • Set up typography and layers first: layering is fixed (text, symbol, shape), so arrange and crop your symbol before uploading.
  • Keep your active lineup strong: swap out lower-performing designs for higher-quality ones over time.

FAQs

  • The new tier-based earnings model took effect on March 1, 2023, and it applies to all Logo Maker packages and new paid variations; however, it doesn’t apply to orders outside of Logo Maker.
  • We reevaluate your earnings tier placement on the first day of each month.
  • The monthly calculation works the same way, with fewer months to review. We reevaluate your placement on the first day of each month, starting from the month you began selling logos. Once you’ve sold for 12 or more months, we recalculate your placement based on your total sales in the last 12 months.
  • Yes. If your sales decrease, we may downgrade your earnings tier, since we calculate it based on your last 12 months of sales.

Using the Fiverr mobile app (Clients: Features & programs)

The Fiverr mobile app lets you manage your Fiverr account from anywhere. Whether you are a client searching for services or a freelancer tracking orders and earnings, the app gives you access to the most important Fiverr features from your phone.

Before you begin

The app is available on iOS and Android devices. Some features are only available on the PC, including starting the process to become a freelancer, and changing your email address.

Navigating the app

The Fiverr mobile app has five main menus. The content in each menu changes based on whether you are using a client or freelancer account:

  • Inbox
  • Search
  • Manage orders
  • Account

Home

Functionality for clients and freelancers
  • The Home screen gives clients quick access to services, popular categories, and Fiverr updates.
    • Services search: Search for services on Fiverr, select Gigs, and place orders.
    • Most popular services: Browse popular services by category and save categories as your interests in the Interests tab.
    • What’s new on Fiverr: Read recent news and posts from Fiverr.
    • Recently viewed & more: Return to past Gigs and refer friends to Fiverr through Fiverr’s Refer a Friend program.
  • The Home screen gives freelancers a summary of their performance and activity.
    • Level and Success Score: View information about your current level and Success Score.
    • Orders: See the total number of orders you have received.
    • Unique clients: See how many unique clients you have worked with on the platform.
    • Total lifetime earnings: View the total earnings you have made on Fiverr.
    • New briefs: See all new briefs you have matched with and can respond to.
    • Earnings: View detailed information about your earnings.
    • To-dos: See a list of action items, including:
      • Number of unread messages
      • Number of upcoming deliveries
      • Number of revision requests
      • Number of new orders
    • My Gigs: View analytics for your Gigs over the last seven days, including:
      • Number of impressions
      • Clicks
      • Conversion percentage
  • Learn more about briefs and Success Score with the following articles:
    • Personalized offers (Briefs) for freelancers
    • Success Score

Inbox

The Inbox works the same way for both clients and freelancers. You can view all your conversations, reply to messages, and filter your inbox.

Learn more with Using your inbox effectively.

Search

Search is available to both clients and freelancers, allowing you to find services and browse Gigs. If you are a freelancer and use the Search menu, you will be automatically switched to the client profile.

Learn more with Searching freelancers and services on Fiverr: A guide.

Manage orders

The Manage orders menu is available to both clients and freelancers. From here you can:

  • View all your orders.
  • Message the other party about an order.
  • Send or accept a delivery.
  • Request revisions.
  • Access the Resolution Center and send a request.

Learn more with the following articles:

  • The complete guide to your Fiverr order: Statuses and process
  • Managing your orders: A freelancer’s guide to the Fiverr order process
  • Using the Resolution Center

Account

The Account menu includes options for all users, as well as options specific to clients and freelancers.

Shared functionality

The following features are available to both clients and freelancers:

  • Tap the bell icon to view all notifications you have received.
  • Tap your profile picture to set or update it.
  • Refer a friend and receive a reward through Fiverr’s refer-a-friend program via Invite friends.
  • Manage the following preferences:
    • Notifications: Manage your notification settings and choose which types you want to receive.
    • Security: Enable or disable multi-factor authentication, view the devices connected to your account, and disconnect them.
    • Language: Change the app’s language.
    • Appearance: Switch between Light and Dark mode.
    • Currency: Set the currency you want to pay in.
    • Online status: Set your online status to show other users whether you are online or offline.
  • Account info
    • Username and email: View your Fiverr username and the email address linked to your account. Usernames cannot be changed. To change your email address, go to Fiverr on the web.
    • Personal balance: View your Fiverr balance, including:
      • Balance from canceled orders
      • Total balance
      • Fiverr Credits
  • Account management
    • Deactivation and deletion: Deactivate your account or delete it entirely. Note: Once an account is deleted, it cannot be restored.
    • Privacy: Read Fiverr’s Privacy Policy and request to opt out of sharing your information.

  • Support
  • Tap Support to open the Fiverr Help Center, where you can browse articles or contact Customer Support.

    • Blog: Visit the Fiverr blog for helpful information and tips.

Clients: Find a freelancer

About data science and data related services

As data becomes central to how businesses make decisions, Fiverr has expanded its marketplace with dedicated categories for data-related services. Whether you need help storing information, cleaning a spreadsheet, visualizing trends, or building a predictive model, this category structure makes it easier to find the right freelancer for the job. This article will explain the different offerings in this category.

Data subcategories

The Data vertical is made up of the following subcategories:

  • Databases
  • Data Processing
  • Data Analytics
  • Data Visualization
  • Data Science
  • Data Entry
  • Other
What each subcategory covers
  • Databases covers the planning and design of data storage solutions, including the integrity and optimization of data structure and architecture.
    • Writing and improving database queries (SQL, NoSQL, and others)
    • Cloud storage solutions
    • Database administration
    • Queries and consultations
  • Data Processing covers data collection through web scraping and mining, along with the tools used to clean and prepare data for use.
    • Data manipulation and transformation (ETL)
    • Automations
    • Formula and macro creation in spreadsheets (Excel, Google Sheets), VBA, and script editor code snippets
  • Data Analytics covers data-driven decision-making based on business data analysis, using statistical and business intelligence techniques across business functions such as sales, inventory, and forecasting.
    • Marketing and Sales
    • Product and UX
    • Surveys and Research
    • Business and Financial fields
    • Planning and Supply Chain
    • Consultation
  • Data Visualization covers turning data into a visual format that’s easier to understand and act on.
    • Graphs and charts
    • Interactive dashboards
    • Reports based on business information
    • Geographical information systems (map-based views)
  • Data Science covers the use of machine learning and advanced AI techniques to extract business insights, including deriving information from unstructured text and natural language.
    • Finding similarities and objects within images and video, and adjusting images automatically
    • Ranking search results and generating personalized recommendations
    • Analyzing information based on historical data
    • Deep learning, KNN algorithms, and artificial neural networks
  • Data Entry covers manual data capturing, typing, and virtual assistance tasks such as inserting, uploading, deleting, fixing formats, verifying, tagging, aggregating, collecting, cleaning, and processing data records, as well as copy-paste work.
  • Data is a fast-growing field, and new types of data services are constantly emerging. This subcategory covers data-related services that don’t yet have a dedicated home. As demand grows, Fiverr continues to expand this category structure.
What this means if you’ve used data services before

Some Gigs that were previously listed under Programming & Tech have moved into these new, more specific subcategories:

  • Optimization & Design, Queries, and Help/Consultation Gigs moved to Databases
  • VBA/Macros and Data Mining/Scraping Gigs moved to Data Processing
  • Modeling and Consultation Gigs moved to Data Analytics
  • Visualization Gigs moved to Data Visualization
  • Machine Learning Gigs moved to Data Science

If you previously bookmarked or ordered a data-related Gig and can’t find it in its old category, check the corresponding subcategory above because it’s likely been reorganized rather than removed.

FAQs

  • Yes. All existing data-related offerings are still available, they’ve been reorganized into the new subcategories described above, alongside additional new options.
  • If your need doesn’t clearly fit Databases, Data Processing, Data Analytics, Data Visualization, Data Science, or Data Entry, check the Other subcategory, or reach out to a freelancer directly to discuss your project.
  • Data Analytics focuses on using existing business data and statistical techniques to guide decisions, such as forecasting, marketing analysis, or financial planning. Data Science focuses more on machine learning and AI-driven techniques, such as predictive modeling and deep learning.
  • As the Data vertical expanded, Fiverr moved several existing Gig types into more specific data-related subcategories so they would be easier for clients to find.
  • It’s possible. Data services are a fast-growing field, and Fiverr continues to expand this category structure as new types of data-related work emerge.

Blocking a user from messaging you (Clients: Find a freelancer)

If you want to stop receiving messages from a specific user on Fiverr, you can block them directly from your inbox. Blocking prevents the user from contacting you and limits their ability to place new orders or send offers. Both freelancers and clients can block users, and you can unblock anyone at any time.

What blocking does

When you block a user on Fiverr, the following restrictions apply:

  • They cannot send you messages.
  • They cannot place new orders with you (if you are a freelancer).
  • They cannot send you offers (if you are a client).

You can unblock a user at any time by going to the same blocking feature and clicking Unblock.

You can only block users you have had a prior interaction with, such as a message exchange before or after an order.

How to block a user from your inbox

- In your inbox, hover over a message from the user you want to block.
- Click the action ellipsis (...).
- Click Report.
- Select a reason for the report.
- Select the option to block the user.
- Open your inbox.
- Long-tap on a message from the user you want to block.
- Tap Report Spam.
- The user is automatically blocked.

Reporting a message & marking spam

From the same action ellipsis (…) menu, you can also:

  • Report: flags the message for a policy violation. You will be asked to select a reason. You also have the option to block the user.
  • Mark as spam: moves the message to your Spam folder.

To report any behavior that violates Fiverr’s Community Standards, see Reporting content or behavior on Fiverr.

What to do when you have an active order

If you encounter an issue with another user while an order is ongoing, contact Fiverr Customer Support immediately for assistance. Once the order is completed, you can block the user from your inbox.

FAQs

  • If you encounter an issue with another user while an order is active, contact Fiverr Customer Support immediately for assistance. You can block the user once the order is completed.
  • After you block a client, they cannot place new orders with you.
  • After you block a freelancer, they cannot send you offers.

Consultations for clients (Clients: Find a freelancer)

Consultations let you book a paid video call with a freelancer before placing an order. It’s a chance to discuss your project in detail, understand exactly what the freelancer offers, and make sure you’re choosing the right person before committing to a full order. This article will outline the full consultation process.

How to find a freelancer offering consultations

Consultations are only available on profiles of eligible freelancers (Level 2, Top Rated, Pro, and Agencies). Booking is available on the Fiverr website only, not on the iOS or Android apps.

You can find freelancers who offer consultations in two ways:

  • Search filter: When browsing search results, click Service options and look for the consultation option in the dropdown.
  • Freelancer profile: Look for the Book a consultation button on a freelancer’s profile or service page, or inside the Contact me dropdown. Read the freelancer’s consultation description to understand what to expect from the call.

How to book a consultation

  • Click Book a consultation on the freelancer’s profile or service page.
  • Choose how long you’d like to meet, either 30 or 60 minutes. The freelancer sets which options are available.
  • Select a date and time. All available slots are shown in your local time.
  • Click Continue to reserve your slot.
  • Enter your payment details and complete payment. You have up to 1 hour to pay. If you miss this window, your slot will be released and you’ll need to choose a new time.

After payment is confirmed, you’ll receive a confirmation email with your consultation details. A reminder email will be sent 15–45 minutes before the call.

Filling in your consultation requirements

Once payment is complete, you’ll be asked to fill in a short requirements form so the freelancer can prepare for your call. These questions are set by Fiverr. Some fields are optional, but the more detail you provide, the more productive your consultation will be.

Include any relevant project files or context that will help the freelancer understand your needs before the meeting. Once done, click Submit requirements.

Joining the call & after the consultation

  • When it’s time for your consultation, click the Join button to start the video call. You can find it on your Orders page or in the reminder email.
  • If you need to reschedule, return to the order chat and let the freelancer know. The freelancer will need to initiate the call in that case; it won’t start automatically.
  • After the consultation you have the following options:
    • Recording: The call is recorded and available to you for 30 days via the order’s page.
    • Written summary: The freelancer will write up a summary of your consultation. This is the order’s delivery and should arrive within 10 days of the order date. If it’s not delivered within 10 days, it is considered late.
    • Review: Once the summary is delivered, you can leave a review for the freelancer, just like a regular order.

Cancellations & rescheduling

Cancellations and refunds follow the same process as any regular order. You can cancel via the Resolution Center.

  • If the freelancer misses the call: This is treated the same as an undelivered order.
  • If you miss the call: We recommend reaching out to the freelancer to reschedule before cancelling.
  • To reschedule: Cancel the original consultation and place a new one at a different time. If you arrange a new time without cancelling first, your reminder emails will still reflect the original booking date and time.

Frequently asked questions

  • Use the Service options filter in search results, or look for the Book a consultation button directly on a freelancer’s profile or service page.
  • All available time slots are displayed in your local time.
  • Freelancers can specify the languages available for their consultations in their consultation description.
  • Consultations are currently offered in 30 or 60-minute slots. More options may be added in the future.
  • Yes. Promo codes can be applied to paid consultations during checkout.
  • Yes. A consultation creates an order on your dashboard, follows the same cancellation and review process, and affects the freelancer’s order statistics.
  • No. A consultation is designed for discussion and alignment, not for placing an order or receiving work. Any follow-on project would be a separate order.
  • Yes. All calls are recorded for safety. The recording is available to you for 30 days via the order page. If you encounter any behavior that violates Fiverr’s Community Standards or Terms of Service, you can report it using the Report feature.

Finding talent with Mira (Clients: Find a freelancer)

Mira introduces Fiverr’s new hiring experience, helping clients find the right qualified talent through a more guided and curated recruiting process, while helping talent focus on opportunities that are a better fit for their skills.

Before you begin

Mira is Fiverr’s AI headhunter. Clients describe what they need, Mira builds a job description, and finds talent that fits, so you spend less time searching and more time choosing. If you’re a talent, Mira sends you job descriptions that match your skills. Both sides spend less time filtering and more time focusing on the right match. Make sure the services you request comply with Fiverr’s Community Standards.

Mira is currently rolling out gradually, so not all users have access yet. If Mira isn’t available to you, it will be soon. You can use Mira on desktop and mobile web; it is not available yet on the iOS or Android apps.

How Mira works

  • As a client, you receive a curated shortlist of talent instead of managing unsolicited outreach.
  • When you start a conversation with Mira, it pulls context from your Fiverr order history and other profile information such as name, currency and timezone, and asks follow-up questions to build a complete job description.
  • Once the job description is ready and you approve it, Mira sends it to eligible talent and asks questions to ensure they are the right fit for you.
  • Mira presents a carefully curated shortlist of top talent cards with recommendations.
  • If your budget is under $250, Mira doesn’t send your job description to talent. Instead, you receive a filtered list of talent based on your job description details.

Generating a job description with Mira

Clients can generate a job description to receive a curated list of hand-picked talent.

  • Go to the home screen or the main menu click on Post a job description using Mira .
  • Start a conversation with Mira in your preferred language and describe the service you need.
  • The job description is always generated in English, even if you chat with Mira in another language.
  • Mira asks follow-up questions until all required fields are complete. It also suggests optional fields to improve your results. Required fields include:
    • Understanding the need
    • Business name
    • Project goals
    • Budget
    • Timeline
    • Search preferences (time zone, location, availability, experience, or language)
  • Other required and optional fields vary by service type. The job description progress bar shows which fields remain.
  • Once all required fields are complete, you can review and edit your job description. You can edit it manually or by asking Mira in the chat.
  • When your job description is ready, you can:
    • Click Let Mira take it from here to send the job description to suitable talent.
    • Click Export to download the job description as a PDF or open it in HTML.

Once you send your job description, you cannot edit or pause it.

Managing your job description

Your job description page shows real-time status updates as talents engage with your job description. Once you receive the curated shortlist of talent, you can:

  • See why each talent is a good fit for your project.
  • Click Compare talent to review all talent side by side.
  • Click Message {talent name} to start a conversation with a talent through the inbox. Your inbox shows a summary of the job description and the full job description as a PDF.

If you are not satisfied with the options you received, click Search Fiverr instead to open Fiverr’s filtered search results based on your job description.

To start a new job description, go to mira.fiverr.com and type your description for Mira to start creating your brief. There is no limit on the number of job descriptions you can send at the same time.

To switch between projects or delete a project:

  • Click your profile image.
  • Choose Your projects.
  • Click the project you want to view, or click Delete (Trash icon) next to the project name to remove it.
Your projects dashboard

When you open Mira, your home screen shows your Suggested projects, Drafts, and Ready projects. To see all your projects in one place, click your profile image and choose Your projects. You can filter by All, In progress, Ready, or Drafts, or use Search projects to find a specific one.

Each project card shows its current status:

  • Draft: A job description you haven’t finished. Open it and answer Mira’s questions to continue.
  • In progress: Mira is searching for talent for your project.
  • Ready: Mira has vetted talent for your project. Click Review talent to see your shortlist. If you’ve already messaged talent, click Open messages to continue the conversation.

Managing your profile

Mira uses information from your Fiverr account such as orders, currency and timezone as well as your profile information on Mira, and previous chats with Mira to personalize your experience. You can view and edit your profile information on Mira at any time.

  • Click your profile image.
  • Choose Your profile.
  • Edit any of the following sections:
    • Personal details: Display name, company, industry, and website.
    • Professional background: Your job title, experience, and the way you approach projects and decisions.
    • About your business: What your business does, who your customers are, and anything that helps freelancers understand your world.
    • Brand and voice: Tone, audience, references, and stylistic preferences, what good work looks like to you.
    • Additional context: Anything else freelancers should know, including past projects, sensitivities, or other context.
    • Your projects with Mira: Once a project’s matches are ready, Mira adds a short summary of it here, so she knows what you have worked on before.
Delete your conversations

To delete all your projects and chat history from Mira:

  • Click your profile image.
  • Choose Your profile.
  • Under Privacy & data, click Delete your conversations.

This will permanently delete your Mira conversation history, including all job descriptions, files, and shortlists. This cannot be undone.

Deleting your Mira data does not delete your Fiverr account or any other information on Fiverr. You can delete a specific project without deleting your account through the Your projects section.

Get notified by SMS

While Mira searches for talent, you can choose to provide your phone number to receive an SMS when your shortlist is ready or when talent sends you a proposal or a question about your brief. Your number is stored separately and used only for Mira updates related to your search.

How this option works

Mira is Fiverr’s AI hiring assistant. When you opt in, we send you text messages about your hiring projects on Mira. For example, we text you when a talent asks you a question or sends you an offer. We also text you a one-time code to confirm your number. We do not send marketing messages through this Program.

  • Where to find this option: Select Get text alerts on Mira’s live search page while a search is in progress. On desktop, the button appears at the bottom center of the page. On mobile browsers, it appears in the search controls menu, next to Stop Mira. This option is not available in the Fiverr mobile apps.
  • How you opt in: On the Mira web app, enter your mobile number, check the consent box, then enter the six-digit code we text to you. Consent is not a condition of any purchase.
  • Message frequency: Message frequency varies depending on your activity in your hiring projects.
  • Cost: Message and data rates may apply. For details about your text plan, contact your wireless carrier.
  • How to stop messages: Reply STOP to any message at any time. We send one message to confirm that you opted out. After that, we send no more messages. To opt in again, reply START.
  • Help: Reply HELP to any message for help, or contact customer support.
  • Carrier liability: Carriers and Fiverr are not liable for any delayed or undelivered messages.
  • Your mobile number: You confirm that you are the account holder of the number you give us, or that you have the account holder’s permission.

These terms and behavior are subject to change.

Privacy

We handle your information carefully and use your phone number only to let you know when your shortlist is ready or when a talent sends you a proposal or the freelancer has a question about your brief. This section explains what information we collect, for what purpose, and how long we keep it.

  • When you opt in, we collect:
    • Your mobile phone number.
    • Your time zone.
    • The date, time, and method of your consent.
    • The consent wording you agreed to.
    • The delivery status of each message we send to you.
  • We use this information only for the purposes of confirming your number, sending you the alerts you asked for, answering your HELP and STOP replies, and keeping a record of your consent. We use your time zone so that we do not text you at night.
  • Your phone number will be deleted within 30 days after you opt in or the last message we send you, whichever happens later. After that, you must opt in again to get text alerts. Record of your consent will be retained for a longer period, as required by applicable laws.
  • We share your phone number only with the SMS provider that delivers the messages for us. The provider cannot use your number for any other purpose.
  • We do not sell or share your SMS opt-in data or personal information with third parties for marketing purposes.
  • No mobile information will be shared with third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes. Text messaging originator opt-in data and consent will not be shared with any third parties.
  • Reply STOP to any message, or turn off text alerts in Mira.
  • To ask us to delete your number now, contact support.

FAQs

  • No. Once you send your job description, you cannot edit or pause it. You can edit your profile information in Mira to update the data used for future job descriptions.
  • Yes. To delete a job description, click your profile image, choose Your projects, then click Delete next to the project name.
  • No. Each job description is built specifically for the project by Mira and cannot be duplicated. You can start a new conversation with Mira to create a new job description.
  • Yes. You can chat with Mira in your preferred language, but the job description is always generated in English.
  • Yes. A budget description is required for your job description to be published. You can provide Mira with a fixed budget, a budget range, or ask Mira to keep the budget flexible. Any of these options is acceptable, as long as the budget details are documented.
  • If you’re unable to approve the final step of creating your job description with Mira, check the following:
    • Make sure all required information is included. This includes the budget and timeline. If either is missing, provide the details in your conversation with Mira so they can be added to your job description.
    • Ask Mira what’s missing. If you’re still unable to publish your job description, ask Mira to identify any missing information or issues preventing publication.
    • Contact Customer Support if needed. If Mira indicates that the issue is on its end, contact Customer Support and explain where you are in the job description creation process, including any error messages you received.
  • With See my shortlist, you’ll instantly receive a list of matching freelancers whose profiles you can review and contact directly. This is a good option if you want to begin reaching out right away.
  • If you have a few hours, we recommend selecting Let Mira start. Mira will contact relevant freelancers, confirm their interest, availability, pricing, and fit for your project, then provide up to three curated recommendations for you to review.
  • You can choose to receive your shortlist within 2, 4, or 12 hours. Selecting a longer timeframe gives Mira more time to search and may result in stronger matches. You can monitor the progress on your job description page in Mira, and you’ll receive an email notification once your shortlist is ready.
  • No. Mira job descriptions cannot be managed through the Brief management page. You can manage your job descriptions directly in Mira. After you post your job description, you receive a confirmation email containing a link to your personal project management page in Mira. You can also go to Mira and click on the top right side to access Your Projects, there you will see the Job descriptions you created with Mira.
  • If you are not satisfied with your shortlist, click Search Fiverr instead below the shortlist. This opens Fiverr’s filtered search results based on your job description so that you can find talent on your own.
  • Not currently. Each account member can only access job descriptions they created. Job descriptions created by other members are not visible to you.
  • Mira’s live dashboard shows each stage of the search. When Mira starts speaking with a freelancer, you can click their profile bubble to take over the conversation at any time, or let Mira continue. Taking over opens a new conversation with that freelancer in your Fiverr Inbox. Mira’s earlier messages won’t appear in the new conversation.
  • You can view matches as they appear in the Talent shortlisted stage. Once the headhunt is complete, Mira will also send you a list of its chosen freelancers so you can compare them side by side. If you take over all the conversations before then, there may be no additional freelancers to move to Talent shortlisted.
  • Even near the end of the search, the dashboard may appear to show Mira still headhunting. Check Talent shortlisted for available matches. Once you’re satisfied with your options, you can click Stop in the bottom left corner.
  • Mira may still appear to be headhunting after your selected timeframe, even when your shortlist is ready. Check the Talent shortlisted stage of the live dashboard to see the freelancers Mira has selected. You can review these matches and compare them side by side.
  • Once you’re satisfied with the shortlist, click Stop in the bottom left corner to officially end the headhunt. If the selected timeframe has passed and you still don’t see a shortlist in the Talent shortlisted stage, contact Customer Support so we can check the search.

How Mira works for freelancers

  • As talent, you’re matched to job descriptions based on multiple criteria such as previous projects completed on Fiverr and experience level, to find the most suitable fit for each project.
  • You’re notified through the inbox when a job description matching your skills and experience starts, prompting you to respond.
  • When you receive a job description, Mira explains why you’re a good fit and asks you a few questions.
  • Your answers help Mira highlight your expertise when presenting you to the client. Be sure to respond to Mira’s first message within 24 hours to ensure your response rate is not affected.
  • If you have questions about the project, Mira answers based on what it knows about the service and the client. If Mira can’t answer, it sends your question to the client.
  • Once you get a response, reply to Mira to accept or decline being offered to the client; if you decline, Mira may invite another talent.
  • When the job description closes, Mira notifies the relevant talent.
  • Each job description opens a new conversation with Mira in your inbox, rather than appearing on your Brief management page.

No setup required: You don’t need to create a Mira profile, change any settings, or take any action. If you’re a good match for a project, Mira will automatically reach out to you through your Fiverr Inbox when a relevant opportunity becomes available. If you prefer not to receive these messages, simply reply to Mira and ask to opt out.

Fiverr Pro services to help manage your project (Clients: Find a freelancer)

Whether you are a solopreneur or part of a large business, finding the right freelancer or managing complex projects requires time, expertise, and the right team. Fiverr Pro offers dedicated services to assist you with sourcing and vetting freelancers, strategizing and planning, or managing your entire project from end to end.

Available Services

Fiverr Pro offers two distinct services depending on your needs: Freelancer Sourcing and End-to-End Project Management.

You must have a Fiverr Pro client account to access these services. If you’re not yet a Pro client, you can upgrade at pro.fiverr.com.

Freelancer Sourcing by Domain Experts

A Fiverr Pro expert with specialized experience in your field will source and screen freelance talent for you to hire.

  • Purchase: Acquire the service for only $199.
  • Consultation: You meet with a domain expert to define the required skills and expertise.
  • Vetting: The expert gathers freelancers or agencies that meet your needs.
  • Delivery: You receive a comparison report with two carefully selected candidates, including availability and price ranges.
  • Revision: You have one opportunity to replace a candidate on the list if they do not meet your needs.

To get started and book a call, visit our Landing Page.

End-to-End Project Management

This service provides end-to-end project planning and execution, making it ideal for clients who need help defining requirements and managing the entire process through final delivery. It’s best suited for complex, multi-freelancer projects across any Fiverr category, with a minimum project budget of $3,000. The service includes:

  • Scoping and Planning: A certified project manager defines your project’s scope, goals, timeline, and estimated budget.

  • Team Building: The manager identifies, screens, and interviews the right freelance talent to assemble a team tailored to your specific requirements.

  • Full Execution: Your business partner handles day-to-day communication with freelancers and collects deliveries on your behalf.

  • Progress Updates: They provide ongoing updates to you and ensure the project stays on timeline and budget.

  • Quality Control: They facilitate project delivery, ensuring high-quality results that only require your final approval.

  • For End-to-End Project Management, the process follows these five steps:

    • Discovery Call: A meeting to outline your project scope, goals, preferences, and requirements.
    • Provide as many project details as possible to the project manager during your call.
    • Team Building: The project manager creates a brief for you to fill out. Once approved, they assemble a team of highly qualified freelancers.
    • Project Planning: The project manager will create a work plan with complete transparency regarding budgets, timelines, and expectations.
    • Execution: Your project manager handles daily communication with the freelancers and provides progress updates via your team account.
    • Completion: We facilitate the final delivery, ensuring the results meet your standards before you approve them.

  • The cost of project management services is a one-time, project-based fee calculated based on your total budget.

    • Discovery call: Free of charge.
    • Initial Fee: After the discovery call, a fixed price is charged for the planning phase. This initial fee is deducted from the total service fee.
    • Service Fee Model: The fee percentage decreases as the budget increases.

To get started and book a call, visit our Landing Page.

Satisfaction Guarantee for Fiverr Pro services

Fiverr Pro’s Satisfaction Guarantee (Money-back guarantee) ensures you’re fully protected when working with our vetted experts. If you’re not satisfied with the work delivered, whether it comes from a Pro freelancer, a project manager guiding your project from planning to delivery, or a domain expert sourcing the right freelancers, we’ll refund your full service payment and any associated work. This guarantee covers all eligible orders, including project management and freelancer-sourcing services, giving you complete confidence and peace of mind throughout your project.

Learn more about our Fiverr Pro satisfaction guarantee for clients.

Fiverr’s search and recommendation system (Clients: Find a freelancer)

Fiverr’s search system connects clients with freelancers by focusing on relevance, client satisfaction, and personalization. Understanding how the system works helps clients find the right talent and helps freelancers understand how their listings are surfaced on the platform. We use a combination of ranking factors, special listing types, and behavioral data to ensure the most relevant results appear for every search.

How search works on Fiverr

Clients can find freelancers in two ways:

  • Category pages: Browse listings organized by service category. These pages show all available services in a specific area of Fiverr’s catalog.
  • Search engine: Enter a text query to see the most relevant matches. The system reads your query, interprets your intent, and shows listings from freelancers whose services match.

Both the Category pages and the Search results page show only listings from freelancers who are currently available to take orders.

Clients can also refine search results using filters, including freelancer language and service-specific requirements.

How search rankings work

Relevancy is the most important ranking factor. The system measures how well a listing’s description matches your search query.

  • Additional ranking factors include:
    • Historical appeal: how attractive the listing has been to clients with similar needs, based on past searches and transactions
    • Client satisfaction: satisfaction scores from completed orders on a particular service
    • Machine learning models, review scores, pricing, availability, and freelancer responsiveness
  • These factors work together to ensure the listings you see are relevant and high quality.
  • Special listing types that may also appear in search results:
    • Fiverr’s Choice: We award this badge to select services in recognition of outstanding quality and client satisfaction.
    • Pro freelancers: The Fiverr Pro team vets these freelancers for quality and expertise. Learn more with How to become a Fiverr Pro freelancer.
    • Fiverr Ads promoted listings: These are Gigs from freelancers who have opted for paid exposure. We verify their relevance and quality before they appear. These Gigs show an ad badge. Learn more with Promoting your Gigs with Fiverr Ads.
    • Pricing diversity: We aim to show a range of pricing options so clients can compare choices.

How we personalize your results

We analyze client behavior and preferences to tailor search results to individual needs. Personalization includes:

  • Adjusting results to match the languages spoken by clients.
  • Prioritizing freelancers who can deliver services quickly when we detect urgency.
  • Using data analytics to align results with individual client behavior on the platform.

If you want to influence the recommendations shown to you, you can block a listing so it no longer appears in your results. This option is available on the platform.

FAQs

  • Yes. You can use Fiverr’s search filters to refine results by freelancer language, service-specific requirements, and more.
  • We award the Fiverr’s Choice badge to select services that demonstrate outstanding quality and client satisfaction.
  • You can block a listing so it no longer appears in your search results or recommendations. This option is available on the platform.
  • Relevancy is the most important factor, determined by how well your listing description matches a client’s search query. Additional factors include historical client interest in similar listings, client satisfaction scores, review scores, pricing, your availability, and your responsiveness.
  • The Fiverr Pro team vets Pro freelancers for quality and expertise. Pro status can influence search ranking.
  • Promoted listings are Gigs from freelancers who have opted for paid exposure. We verify their relevance and quality before they appear. They show an ad badge in search results.
