How Fiverr works for clients

Fiverr is an online marketplace where you can find and hire talented freelancers for a wide range of digital services. Freelancers offer their services through Gigs, where you can browse their skills, packages, and reviews before placing an order. This article walks you through the full journey of using Fiverr, from creating your account to placing and completing your first order.

All users must be at least 18 years of age to use Fiverr. Users under 18 and at least 13 years of age are permitted to use the site only through an account owned by their parent or legal guardian with their appropriate permission.

Setting up your account

To get started, create a free account on Fiverr.com. Once registered, you can browse services, contact freelancers, and place orders right away.

With your account ready, you can start searching for the right freelancer.

Finding a freelancer

There are several ways to find the right freelancer or service on Fiverr.

  • Enter keywords in the search bar on the homepage and click Search. Fiverr suggests popular searches as you type to help refine your query.
  • Use the navigation bar to browse by category and subcategory. This is useful if you are exploring options rather than searching for something specific.
  • Once you see search results, use the filters to narrow them down. Available filters include:
    • Service options: Filter by language, subscription services, paid video consultations, and other service types.
    • Freelancer details: Filter by freelancer tier, availability, and spoken language.
    • Seller type: Filter to find an agency rather than an individual freelancer. Agencies are currently available in the Digital Marketing, Programming and Tech, Graphics & Design, and Video and Animation categories, with more categories being added over time.
    • Budget: Set a price range to match your project budget.
    • Delivery time: Filter by how quickly you need the work delivered.
  • You can also post a project brief to receive tailored offers from relevant freelancers. Fiverr uses AI to help you generate a professional brief based on your project goals.
  • Learn more: Personalized offers for clients

Once you have found a freelancer you like, take a moment to review their profile before placing an order.

Understanding freelancer profiles

Before placing an order, review a freelancer’s profile to make sure they are the right fit for your project.

  • Profile: Includes location, languages, response times, bio, skills, and certifications.
  • Packages: Most freelancers offer Basic, Standard, and Premium packages. Each package outlines what is included and at what price.
  • Reviews and ratings: Read feedback from other clients to understand the quality and reliability of a freelancer’s work.

Freelancers are independent contractors, not Fiverr employees. They offer their services through Gigs on the platform. If you are hiring for long-term or ongoing work, some business accounts have access to worker classification tools to help assess contractor vs. employee status for compliance purposes.

Working with agencies

Alongside individual freelancers, you can also hire an agency on Fiverr. An agency provides professional services under one entity, bringing together diverse skills and experience to offer a broad range of services and solutions. Unlike a single freelancer, an agency can manage multiple high-scale projects and clients at the same time, giving you the ability to scale up as your needs grow.

How to identify an agency

Fiverr offers several ways to recognize and explore agencies:

  • Agency card: When you search or browse for a service, you may see an agency card in the listings. It is about twice the size of a regular Gig card and leads to the agency’s page. You can also spot an agency quickly by the “We are” prefix in the provider’s name.
  • Agency page: Each agency has a dedicated page with detailed information to help you make an informed decision, including insights into the agency’s team, employees, values, expertise, and past projects.
  • Entry points: You can find agencies through dedicated entry points in the navigation bar and on category pages, which are built into the search and browsing experience.
  • Seller type filter: Use the Seller type filter in your search results to find an agency that aligns with your project requirements.
Benefits of working with an agency

Choosing an agency on Fiverr brings several advantages:

  • Access to a range of services under one entity and the ability to handle large-scale projects.
  • A vetting process: Agencies undergo a thorough vetting process to maintain service quality and foster a trustworthy environment.
  • The flexibility to choose: Agencies are an additional option, not a replacement. You can still work with the best individual freelancer for your needs whenever that is the better fit.
  • The option to book a meeting: Because agencies often work on larger projects, you can book a free video meeting to align before the project starts. We encourage you to communicate with the agency beforehand.

When you are ready to move forward, you can place your order directly from the Gig page or ask the freelancer to send you a custom offer.

Placing an order

Before you confirm, it helps to know that Fiverr adds a service fee at checkout, 5.5% on all orders, plus an additional $3.00 USD for orders under $100 USD. The fee applies to all payments within the order, including add-ons, Gig extras, and tips.

Request to order

On some Gigs, a freelancer may require you to send a Request to Order before you can place your order. This feature gives you the opportunity to discuss your project’s specific requirements, confirm the right package, and align on details and timelines before committing.

Note: Request to Order is not available for all Gigs.

If you see a Request to Order button on a Gig, here is what to do:

  • Click the Request to Order button on the Gig page.
  • Write a message describing your project and attach any relevant files.
  • Submit your request. You will receive a confirmation and be able to see the freelancer’s average response time.
  • Go to your Inbox to view the request and continue the conversation with the freelancer.
  • If both parties agree to proceed, the freelancer may send you a Custom Offer to place your order.

Repeat clients may be able to place orders directly without sending a Request to Order, as may clients who have already received a Custom Offer from the freelancer.

How to place an order:

  • Find the Gig you want and click on it.
  • Select a package: Basic, Standard, or Premium. Alternatively, request a custom offer directly from the freelancer.
  • Add any Gig extras if needed.
  • Review the order total, including the service fee, then confirm your payment method and click Confirm & Pay.

Learn more about payment methods: Payment, save, and remove your payment method

Once your order is placed, the freelancer gets to work. Here is what to expect when they deliver.

Completing your order

When the freelancer delivers the work, you can review it and take action from your Orders page.

How to accept or request changes on a delivery:

  • Go to your Orders section and open the relevant order.
  • Find the delivery in the Delivery tab or by scrolling down the order page.
  • Select one of the following options: accept the delivery, request revisions, or request more time.
  • Optionally, rate your experience.

The order status updates automatically as you and the freelancer take action. You can track progress on the order page at any time.

Don’t complete an order unless you are satisfied with the delivery.

Learn about all order statuses: The complete guide to your Fiverr order statuses and process

Once you accept the delivery, the order is complete, and payment is released to the freelancer.

Payment release

Once you accept the delivery and the order is marked complete, the freelancer receives their earnings. If you do not take action for 72 hours after delivery, the order completes automatically based on Fiverr’s order completion timeline.

If you need to cancel or request a refund: Refunds and cancellations

After your order is complete, you can share your experience by leaving a review.

Reviews & ratings

After an order is complete, you can leave a review for the freelancer. Reviews help other clients make informed decisions and give freelancers feedback on their work. Fiverr’s review system is built on transparency and accountability, so your feedback matters.

Learn more about how the review system works: Reviews and ratings for freelancers

Best practices for hiring on Fiverr

Once you know how the platform works, a few habits can help you get better results from every project.

  • Before browsing Gigs, take a moment to think through what you actually need. For example, the tone, style, or outcome you’re going for, and any must-haves for your project. Having this clear in advance makes it much easier to filter through options and recognize the right fit when you see it.
  • Don’t stop at the first Gig that looks promising. Compare portfolios, past work samples, and reviews across a few freelancers so you can get a feel for different styles and skill levels before committing. This is especially useful for creative work, where fit and style matter as much as skill.
  • If you’re planning a bigger project or an ongoing working relationship, consider starting with a smaller order first. This lets you evaluate quality, communication, and reliability before scaling up.
  • If you expect to work with a freelancer over weeks or months, ask about their availability upfront. This helps avoid the disappointment of starting a project only to find out your freelancer can’t support your timeline.
  • A freelancer’s rate can tell you a lot because competitive, industry-aligned pricing is often a sign of experience. When comparing packages, look at what’s included as much as the price itself.
  • If you expect to need similar work again, it’s worth thinking about long-term fit, not just your immediate task. Many clients build ongoing relationships with freelancers whose style and communication they trust, which can save time on every future project.
  • Beyond one-off projects, many clients find ongoing value in delegating recurring tasks to freelancers. From content creation and social media management to data entry, design, or customer service. If a task is taking up significant time each week, it may be worth exploring whether a freelancer could take it on.

FAQs

  • Yes. When you register, a client account is created by default. To also offer services as a freelancer, create a Gig from the same account. Switching to a freelancer profile does not affect your client account. Learn more with How Fiverr works for freelancers.
  • You can use the search bar, browse categories and subcategories, apply filters, or post a brief to receive tailored offers from relevant freelancers.
  • A freelancer is an individual provider, while an agency operates as a single entity with a team offering a broad range of services. Agencies can handle larger, multi-project workloads and offer the option to book a free alignment meeting before starting. Both are valid options, so you can choose whichever best fits your project.
  • You can accept the delivery, request revisions, or ask for more time from your Orders page. Once you accept, the order is marked complete, and the freelancer receives their earnings.
  • Fiverr has a refund process for cancelled orders. Learn more: Refunds and cancellations
  • Some freelancers require you to send a Request to Order before placing your order. Click the button, describe your project, and attach any relevant files. Once the freelancer reviews your request, they may send you a Custom Offer to proceed. You can track the conversation in your Inbox.

Post a project brief: get tailored offers for your project (Clients: Find a freelancer)

Mira AI Headhunter has fully replaced this Briefs feature. You can still access your previously created project briefs through the Your Briefs entry points from the Avatar menu for the time being. To learn how create a new job description, visit Finding talent with Mira.

Easily generate a professional project brief with the help of our AI assistant. This process ensures all your goals, requirements, and key specifications are clearly articulated and never overlooked. Once your refined brief is ready, simply post it to effortlessly receive tailored offers from the most relevant, qualified freelancers on our platform.

Getting started

This feature is for clients who want to easily find qualified freelancers by posting a project brief. The AI refines your brief, and then a shortlist of matching freelancers is created. You receive tailored offers directly from relevant freelancers, which you can evaluate and choose from.

  • This feature is available on desktop and mobile web, but not on the mobile app.
  • Briefs can only be generated in English. Using other languages will result in an error message.
How to post a brief & get offers?

  • Click Post a brief from the header of your homepage when logged in.

  • Write a short project description, including your timeline & budget. These fields are mandatory.

  • Click Generate brief. AI will convert your description into a professional brief.

  • Review your brief and add any additional information, such as whether it’s a one-time request or an ongoing project, details about the ideal candidate, and screening questions.

  • Now, you have two options:

  • Click Source for me so Fiverr can find and share your brief with the top relevant freelancers. The freelancers that fit your brief’s description, requirements, & budget range will receive your brief, and the results will show you freelancers who either perfectly or partially match your preferences.

  • Alternatively, click Invite freelancers to view a curated list of freelancers who match your request and send the brief yourself.

    • Review the freelancer’s profile for details on their past work and skills. You will see how well the freelancer matches your brief’s requirements.
    • Click Send invitation to request an offer.
    • We recommend inviting several freelancers to increase your chances of receiving tailored offers faster.
Best practices
  • Include recommended details: Adding details attracts the right freelancers, ensures they understand your needs, & leads to a smoother project.
  • Adhere to policies: Your brief and any attached files must comply with Fiverr’s policies and Terms of Service.
  • Avoid sharing sensitive information: Never include contact details, passwords, credit card numbers, Social Security Numbers (SSN), or national identification card numbers.
  • Avoid objectionable content: Never use adult content, hate speech, discrimination, harassment, or any abusive behavior.
How to view your briefs?

Access your briefs by clicking on your profile icon in the top right corner > Your Briefs.

  • This page shows your brief’s title, status, a summary of offers, and the action you can take (e.g., view offers, invite freelancers, or view orders).
  • All offers appear in the Offers tab for your review, so you can easily compare them. You can expect to receive up to 5 tailored offers.
  • Clicking View offer lets you review the details, including a short introduction from the freelancer, pricing, timeline, and included services.
  • If a freelancer needs more details to personalize their offer, you can review their questions and reply directly from the offer page.

Once you select an offer, accept it directly from the offer page. You can accept multiple offers and hire more than one freelancer for your project.

How to edit your briefs?

Once you locate the brief you would like to edit, you can edit the brief by:

  • Select the three-dot (…) menu
  • Choose edit
  • Edit the brief with new information
  • Select “Update brief”

If your brief had no offers, any freelancers who are sent the brief will see the updated version. If the brief had offers, you will need to choose whether you want the updated brief to be sent to other freelancers or not. Once the brief has been approved, your brief will appear in your Briefs page with an “Edited” tag.

- Live - The brief is ready to receive offers from freelancers.
- Inactive - The brief was inactive for 30 days & no freelancers were hired. Once inactive, you cannot send new invitations or receive offers.
- Hired - At least one freelancer was hired for the project.
- Rejected - Your brief was not approved because it violated Fiverr’s Community Standards.
- No invites sent - You received a curated list of freelancers to invite, but haven’t sent any invitations yet.

FAQs

  • It may take freelancers a few hours to review your brief and create a tailored offer. Freelancers receive invites that are valid for 72 hours. After that, they will not be able to respond to your brief.
  • Briefs can get up to 5 tailored offers. This number is influenced by your brief’s details, the freelancer’s availability, the project scope, and whether you invite freelancers.
  • If you’re not getting responses, try submitting a new brief and make sure to follow the AI suggestions to refine your project scope, budget, and timeline. This helps match you with freelancers who are the right fit. You can also contact Customer Support for additional assistance.
  • Yes, you can duplicate an approved brief by going to your Briefs page, locating the brief you’d like to duplicate, choosing the three dots on the right-hand side, and choosing “Duplicate”. Once the brief has been duplicated, you will need to input the budget and timeline before submitting it for review.

Searching freelancers and services on Fiverr: A Guide (Clients: Find a freelancer)

With thousands of services available, you can find exactly what you need on Fiverr in just a few steps. Our search engine helps you narrow your options by category, budget, and delivery time, so you reach the right freelancer faster. If you cannot find a match, you can post a project brief and receive tailored offers, or request a custom quote directly from a freelancer. This guide is for clients who want to search for services and get a quote that fits their project.

Searching for a service

  • Mira is Fiverr’s AI headhunter, designed to create a more guided and curated hiring experience. You describe your project needs, and Mira builds a job description, identifies suitable talent, and presents a shortlist of qualified matches, helping you spend less time searching and focus on choosing the right talent for your project.
  • Learn more about Mira.
    • Enter keywords in the search bar at the top of the homepage and click Search.
    • Even if you are just visiting Fiverr, you can enter the service you are looking for and search without the need to log in.
    • Fiverr suggests popular searches to help you refine your query (e.g., searching “logo” might suggest “logo design”).
  • Categories and subcategories: Use the navigation bar to browse through categories and subcategories related to your project. This helps narrow down your results and find relevant freelancers.
  • Filters: Once you have your search results, use the filters at the top of the page to refine them further. This allows you to filter by factors like budget, delivery time, freelancer level, and more.
  • As you apply filters, you will see them listed above the marketplace. Click the (X) to remove.

Search filters

  • Tailor your Fiverr experience to your liking. Choose your preferred language, explore service options from subscriptions to paid video consultations, and utilize various tools to specify what exactly you want included in your chosen service.
  • Connect with the perfect freelancer. Filter by freelancer tiers reflecting experience, availability, and even spoken language based on their location. Find someone who aligns with your needs and, perhaps, your time zone.
  • Decide your asking price right away. You can set a range based on your specific price point and have the flexibility to adjust it later for specific projects.
  • Whether you need express delivery in 24 hours or a timeline tailored to your project’s complexity, find freelancers who guarantee on-time completion.

More ways to find talent

  • Hire domain experts to source, vet, and interview top freelancers on your behalf, delivering a comparison report of the best candidates for a flat fee.
  • Get started by visiting the Domain Expert Sourcing Landing Page.

Your most important and urgent projects require time, industry skills, and the right team of freelancers. The goal of our project management service is to help your team or business plan and execute a project end-to-end effortlessly.
  • Learn more about our project management service here.

I found a freelancer I like, what happens next?

We recommend communicating with the freelancer before the purchase, to ensure that all questions, requirements, and concerns are addressed prior to any transaction taking place.

Connect directly with your chosen freelancer to kickstart your project:

  • Get a quote: Communicate with freelancers about your specific delivery timeframe. This helps them provide a tailored quote directly to your inbox.
  • Ask a question: Ask your potential freelancer a question or share your project details (requirements, timeline, budget, scope). The more questions you ask to gather all information, the better suited you’ll be to choose the right freelancer for the job.
  • Book a consultation: Schedule a call with potential freelancers before hiring to align on project goals and specific needs for a smooth collaboration. Learn more about booking a consultation here.

Best practices

  • Communicate with the freelancer before you order to confirm questions, requirements, and concerns. You can click Contact me to send the freelancer a message.
  • Use filters such as budget and delivery time to narrow your results and find the right match faster.
  • If you cannot find the right service, post a project brief to receive tailored offers from relevant freelancers.

FAQs

  • Yes. You can search for services on the homepage even if you are not logged in to Fiverr.
  • No. After a freelancer replies with a quote, you can decline it or continue to order.
  • Apply the filters at the top of your results page. You can set your preferred budget, delivery time, language, location, and other freelancer details to refine your results. Filters vary depending on the Gig category or subcategory.

Using Fiverr Answers (Clients: Find a freelancer)

Fiverr Answers is a public content hub where a select group of invited freelancers share their expertise by answering questions about their professional fields. Answers are visible to everyone and can help clients make more informed decisions when looking for services. If you have been invited to contribute, participating can increase your visibility and direct more potential clients to your Fiverr profile.

Fiverr Answers was discontinued

As of Nov 11, 2026 Fiverr Answers was discontinued.

answers.fiverr.com is no longer accessible, and you can’t log in or interact with the platform.

Your Fiverr account wasn’t affected by this change.

What Fiverr Answers is

Fiverr Answers is designed to provide helpful information for clients and freelancers on topics related to professional projects, deliveries, and communication. Questions are generated using AI based on recurring topics across the broader online landscape.

The hub is public, meaning anyone can read the questions and answers. To post an answer, upvote, downvote, or report content, users must be logged in.

Fiverr Answers is not:

  • A how-to guide or Help Center replacement.
  • A marketing tool for freelancers.
  • A forum for creating conversation threads.

Eligibility and access

Participation in Fiverr Answers is invite-only. Only hand-picked freelancers receive invitations to answer questions. If you have not received an invitation, you will not be able to post answers.

Fiverr Answers is available on desktop only. It is not available on iOS or Android.

How questions are assigned

Fiverr posts the questions, and they are assigned to freelancers based on the professional area in which they have their strongest services. Each freelancer can contribute one answer per question, and answers must be at least 30 words long. Freelancers can hide or delete their answers at any time.

Benefits for freelancers

When you answer a question on Fiverr Answers, your username is linked directly to your Fiverr profile. Clients reading your answer can click on your username and be redirected to your profile page. Answers are also indexed by search engines, which means your expertise can reach people searching for answers beyond the Fiverr platform.

Fiverr Answers ranks and badges are displayed on your public Fiverr Answers profile only. They do not appear on your main Fiverr profile page.

Tips from top-tier talent

For users who are not logged into Fiverr and are browsing services, the most popular Fiverr Answers from a given subcategory may appear at the bottom of the search results page. These tips help potential clients understand what to look for in a freelancer or what tools are commonly used for a service. This feature applies to select subcategories only, not all of them. If you would like your tip removed from the search results, contact our Customer Support team.

Content guidelines

All answers must follow the Fiverr Answers Community Guidelines. When posting, keep the following rules in mind:

  • AI-generated content is not allowed. If a high percentage of AI is detected in your answer, you may receive an educational warning.
  • Links to any other sites, including Fiverr, are not allowed in answers.
  • Both questions and answers can be reported by any logged-in user for review.

Warnings issued on your Answers account are educational and have no penalty effect on your Fiverr account or your Answers account standing.

Content moderation

After you submit an answer, it goes through a moderation review before it is published. Moderation is typically completed within 24 hours of submission. Reviews may take longer over weekends. If your answer has been pending for an extended period, contact our Customer Support team.

Ranks and badges

When you actively participate on Fiverr Answers, you earn points and unlock recognition through two types of awards: Badges and Ranks. Both are shown on your public profile within Fiverr Answers. To view them, click on your username from any page on the platform.

To improve your rank and earn additional badges, log in regularly and engage with the platform by posting answers, upvoting other users’ answers, and participating in discussions.

Your Fiverr Answers account

You sign in to Fiverr Answers using your Fiverr login details. Your Fiverr Answers account is separate from your main Fiverr account. Closing or deleting your Fiverr Answers account will not affect your Fiverr account.

When you sign in to Fiverr Answers, you are automatically added to the Fiverr Answers mailing list. Emails from the platform are sent from noreply@invisioncloudcommunity.com.

Some freelancers may find that a Fiverr Answers account was created on their behalf when they were enrolled in the platform. This is expected behavior and does not affect your Fiverr account in any way.

Troubleshooting

If you are experiencing trouble signing in to Fiverr Answers, try the following steps:

  • Make sure you are using the same login credentials as your Fiverr account.
  • Try signing in from a different browser or an incognito window.
  • If the issue continues, contact our Customer Support team for help.

If you are invited but cannot see the option to post answers, make sure you are signed in. If you are signed in and still cannot answer questions, contact our Customer Support team.

If one of your professions is not showing on Fiverr Answers, this may be a technical issue. Contact our Customer Support team and include a screenshot showing the missing profession.

Using Fiverr MCP in your AI agent

Find the right freelancer without leaving your AI chat. The Fiverr Model Context Protocol (MCP) server lets your AI agent search Fiverr’s marketplace, compare freelancers, and scope a project with Mira directly in your conversation. Clients find freelancers faster, and freelancers gain another way to be found. Anyone can add it as a connector for free.

Before you begin

You do not need a Fiverr account, login, or API key to search with Fiverr MCP. It works the same way logged-out browsing works on Fiverr. You need to add Fiverr MCP to your AI app before you can use it. You sign in or sign up on Fiverr only when you take a brief to Fiverr or when we redirect you to Fiverr.

Fiverr MCP works with these AI apps:

  • ChatGPT
  • Claude (Desktop, web, and Claude Code)
  • Gemini is coming soon, starting with Gemini Enterprise.

Visit the Fiverr MCP Server page to see how the connector looks. Read the Fiverr MCP documentation for setup steps, example prompts, and technical details.

Fiverr MCP search functionality

How the search works

You ask your AI agent in your own words, and the agent searches Fiverr for you. Your agent picks the right tool from your request, so you never need to name a tool yourself. You need to describe what you are looking for in your prompt.

If your prompt is general, such as “Find me a freelancer,” the AI agent asks for specifics. For example, it asks what kind of freelancer you want and what you need the freelancer to do. Better briefs return better matches.

Search results & filters

The AI agent shows up to five freelancer cards per search. Each card shows the freelancer’s name, photo, and key details. The profiles are the same profiles that appear in on-site search. Fiverr MCP is a new way in, not a separate pool of talent.

You can ask your AI agent to refine results by:

  • Budget
  • Delivery time
  • Level
  • Language
  • Location

You can also ask your agent to compare freelancers or read their reviews.

Available Fiverr MCP tools

Fiverr MCP has the following tools:

  • find_freelancers searches for freelancers based on a project description. You describe the work in plain language and can add filters.
  • Get additional freelancer information
    • get_seller_profile shows the background, location, and languages of a named freelancer. You provide the freelancer’s Fiverr username.
    • list_seller_gigs shows the services a freelancer currently has published, with prices.
    • get_seller_reviews_summary shows a freelancer’s overall rating and review count.
    • list_seller_reviews shows the text of what past clients wrote, newest first or ranked by relevance.

Cost

Connecting and searching are free. Standard Fiverr fees apply only if you place an order with a matched freelancer, at that freelancer’s listed price.

Viewing a profile & ordering

When you click View Profile, we redirect you to the Fiverr website. There, you continue with the standard process of contacting the freelancer or placing an order.

Fiverr MCP search is read-only. Your AI agent can search, compare, and scope, but it cannot hire or pay a freelancer for you. You place the order and pay on Fiverr.

Fiverr MCP for freelancers

Fiverr MCP gives freelancers a new way to be found by clients who start their search inside an AI app. It has no extra cost and needs no setup.

Mira in Fiverr MCP

Fiverr MCP includes two Mira capabilities. Mira is the headhunter you use when you want help with the hiring itself, such as what kind of talent you need, what it could cost, or how to write the brief.

  • Talk_to_mira runs the conversation. Mira asks you a few questions, and your answers go back to her. She builds a brief with you. Each conversation covers one hiring need. If you need a second, unrelated role, start a new conversation.
  • Take_brief_to_mira hands off your brief. When your brief is ready, it returns a link to sign in or sign up for Fiverr, and your brief moves into your account. Mira opens it there, ready to go. You see matches, get quotes, and hire freelancers on Fiverr, not in the chat.

Learn more about Mira in the Finding talent with Mira article.

How to use Fiverr MCP

Follow these quick and easy steps to install Fiverr MCP in ChatGPT or Claude.

- Open ChatGPT and go to Plugins.
- Search for Fiverr.
- Click the + icon to install the integration.
- Click Try now and start using Fiverr through ChatGPT.
  • You can add Fiverr from the Claude directory:
    • Go to claude.ai or open Settings → Connectors in the desktop app.
    • Search for Fiverr and click Connect.

Example prompts

Copy any of these prompts into your AI agent after you connect Fiverr.

You are

Try asking

A founder or startup

Find me a logo designer under $200 for my launch.

A marketer or small team

Compare 3 freelancers for landing page design and flag any red flags in their reviews.

An agency or ops lead

For each of these client projects, find two video editors who can deliver in 5 days.

Not sure where to start

I need a video for my app but I don’t know where to begin. Help me scope it.

FAQs

  • Fiverr MCP is Fiverr’s official integration for AI agents. It uses the Model Context Protocol (MCP), an open standard that lets AI apps connect to outside services. After you add it, your AI agent can search Fiverr’s marketplace, compare freelancers, read reviews, and scope a project with Mira, without you leaving the chat.
  • Yes. Fiverr builds and hosts Fiverr MCP. The only official endpoint is mcp.fiverr.com.
  • Yes. It is free to connect and to search. Hiring a freelancer happens on Fiverr, at that freelancer’s listed price. Standard Fiverr fees apply only if you place an order.
  • No. You can search without a Fiverr account. You do not share passwords or API keys with your AI app. You sign in or sign up on Fiverr only when you take a brief to Fiverr, or when we redirect you to Fiverr.
  • Claude (Desktop, web, and Claude Code), ChatGPT. Gemini is coming soon, starting with Gemini Enterprise.
  • You can find freelancers for a project, compare them, check a freelancer’s profile, services, and reviews, and scope a project with Mira.
  • No. Your AI agent can search, compare, and scope, but you always take the final step. You message freelancers, get quotes, order, and pay on Fiverr.
  • Mira is Fiverr’s headhunter. She asks a few questions about your project and builds a brief with you. When the brief is ready, you can take it to Fiverr in one click. Learn more in the Finding talent with Mira article.

  • Check that the URL is exactly mcp.fiverr.com, restart your AI app, and make sure Fiverr is enabled for the chat. If it still fails, disconnect and reconnect Fiverr MCP. See Troubleshooting above for more fixes.

Using your inbox effectively (Clients: Find a freelancer)

The Inbox is your central hub for sending, receiving, and managing all communication with users on Fiverr. It brings together conversations from every stage of the Fiverr experience, including inquiries, Custom Offers, and order-related messages, so you can easily stay on top of your workflow.

How to access your Inbox?

You can easily access the Inbox from your Fiverr account:

  • Click the envelope/message icon at the top-right of the page.
  • To view all your messages, click See all in Inbox.

What you can see in a conversation

Within a conversation, the right side of the screen displays useful information about the user you’re speaking with.

  • As a client, the following information is displayed about the freelancer:
    • Location
    • Seniority
    • Spoken languages and their level
    • Freelancer level
    • Response rate
    • Rating
    • Hourly rate availability: Learn more with Hourly orders for clients.
    • Order history
  • As a freelancer, the following information is displayed about the client:
    • Location
    • Seniority
    • Spoken languages and their level
  • If you’re subscribed to Seller Plus, you can also view:
    • Number of completed orders
    • Average rating given
    • Average order price
    • Order completion rate
    • Date of last order
    • Preferred service
  • If you’re just starting your journey on Fiverr, learn more with Seller Plus Kickstart: Start your freelance journey strong.
  • If your freelancer level is 1 and up, learn more with Seller Plus Standard and Premium: Advanced tools for business growth.

Managing your conversations

You can take actions on conversations and individual messages directly from your Inbox.

Conversation actions

From the All messages list, you can take the following actions on any conversation:

  • Star/Unstar (star icon): Highlight specific users, conversations, or services.
  • Apply labels (tag icon): Organize your Inbox and highlight specific conversations. You can rename a label by clicking the Edit icon next to the label, or remove it by clicking the Delete icon.

Click the ellipsis (…) for more options:

  • Mark as read/Unread: Keep track of your conversations, and answer when convenient.
  • Archive: Declutter your Inbox but keep relevant conversations on hand.
  • Delete: Remove the conversation entirely. If you delete a conversation by mistake, you can always search for the user with the All messages filter.
Message actions

Hover over any message and click the ellipsis (…) to access the following actions:

  • Reply: Reply directly to a specific message or file.
  • Edit: Correct a recently sent message within 15 minutes of sending. All active participants will see the update in real time. Supported on web only.
  • Save message: Save important messages in a separate Saved tab, located next to the Messages tab. Delivery messages can’t be saved.
  • Delete: Remove a recently sent message within 15 minutes of sending. All active participants will see the update in real time. Supported on web only.
  • Mark as spam: Flag the message as spam. Learn how to protect your account and stay safe with Avoiding spam and staying safe on Fiverr.
  • Report: Report the message to Fiverr. Learn more with Reporting content or behavior on Fiverr.
Message toolbar

At the bottom of the message area, a toolbar gives you quick access to the following options:

  • Attachment: Attach a file to your message. You can send files up to 1 GB in size.
  • Emoji: Add an emoji to your message.
  • Video call (camera): Start a Zoom-based video call. Only freelancers can initiate video calls. Some freelancers will also have the option to book a consultation. Learn more with Video calls (Zoom calls).
  • Add person: Add another participant to the conversation. Available for Team Account and Fiverr Pro users only.
  • Refer a freelancer: Recommend a freelancer you worked with before who best fits the client’s needs. Learn more with Refer fellow freelancers for client projects.
Filtering your Inbox

Use the magnifying glass icon to search for a specific conversation, or go to All messages and activate a filter. You can also create your own labels when filtering conversations.

  • All conversations: View all your inbox conversations.
  • Unread: View unread conversations.
  • Starred: View conversations you’ve marked with the star icon.
  • Archived: View conversations you’ve stored in your history.
  • Spam: View conversations flagged as spam.
  • Custom offers: View conversations where you’ve received custom offers.
  • Requests: View conversations with your requested quotes from other freelancers.
  • Follow-up: View conversations you marked with the Follow-up label.

Inbox features

The Inbox includes several features to help you communicate more effectively.

  • When you receive a message in any language, there is an option to translate it into English right from your Inbox, eliminating language barriers and delays.
  • You can customize how the Enter key functions in your Inbox. Click the up arrow to choose between starting a new line or sending the message.
  • Before an order is placed, if a client is communicating with a freelancer, the system may detect a mismatch between the client’s needs and what the freelancer is providing. The system will find a potential match on budget, availability, and time requirements that will be shared with the client.

Freelancer tools

As a freelancer, you have access to additional tools directly from your Inbox.

  • Freelancers can set up an auto-reply, a message sent automatically to a client when they reach out for the first time. Quick responses are pre-written sentences that make follow-up communication much quicker.
  • Learn more with Auto-replies & quick responses
  • Send a Custom Offer to a client to proactively offer your services in a customized way.
  • Learn more with Custom offers.

Order-specific messages

If a message is attached to an order, it will have an icon you can hover over to see the corresponding order number. Click the order number to go directly to the order page. You can also access and respond to conversations directly from the orders page.

Where to find your order messages
  • All related messages remain available in the order chat.
  • All order-related communication now appears directly in your Inbox for a more streamlined workflow.

Searching past activity

You can search and see all your past activity on Fiverr, including orders, messages, and interactions with other users.

  • Within your Inbox, click the search icon next to All messages and type the name of the user you would like to find.
  • Click the search icon; all communication with that username will appear.
  • Click any item in the results to view more information.

Messaging limits

To ensure a secure and positive experience, Fiverr sets limits on message activity to minimize excessive or unwanted communication and reduce spam.

  • If you reach your messaging limit, you’ll receive a notification and will need to wait 60 minutes before sending messages to users who are not already in your contact list.
  • During this period, you can still message existing contacts, and other users can initiate conversations with you.
  • If you continue to exceed the limit, you will receive a warning notification informing you that further violations may result in an account suspension.
  • Continued violations will lead to a permanent suspension of your account for spamming.

File management

  • Attachments that haven’t been accessed in two years are automatically archived. If you try to download an archived attachment, the download will initially fail, triggering a 12-hour restoration process. After this process is completed, you’ll be able to download the attachment. If the file remains unavailable after 12 hours, contact Customer Support.
  • Attachments are automatically deleted three years after they are sent. Fiverr cannot retrieve these files as they are permanently removed from the system. Files that are part of a delivery message may also be deleted.
  • Users can send files up to 1 GB in size. If you need to send a larger file, upload it to a cloud service such as Google Drive and share the link with the user. Ensure the user you’re sharing with has access to the file only.

Using the Inbox on the mobile app

Similar to the web or desktop experience, you’ll find the same filtering and action options on the mobile app by tapping the filter icon at the top right of your main Inbox screen or by tapping the ellipsis (…) in the upper right corner within an individual conversation.

  • From the main menu, tap the envelope icon for your Inbox.
  • Tap any conversation from the list to open it. Once inside, you can see the user’s status at the top of the screen (online or away).

Video calls (Zoom calls) (Clients: Find a freelancer)

Video calls on Fiverr let you connect face-to-face with a client or freelancer before or after an order is placed. Fiverr hosts all calls through Zoom and covers the associated costs. Use Zoom calls to align on project details, set clear expectations, and build a stronger working relationship.

Before you begin

  • Only freelancers can initiate Zoom video calls. Clients can request a Zoom video call from an eligible freelancer’s profile page.
  • Fiverr hosts all calls through Zoom. You do not need your own Zoom account.
  • All calls are automatically recorded and saved for 30 days, so both parties can review them.

Eligibility for freelancers

Freelancers can initiate calls from two places: an order page or an inbox conversation. Each location has different requirements.

  • Available to all freelancers.
  • How to access: Open the inbox with the user by clicking Message [username] under the user’s name.
  • To initiate a call from the inbox, you must have at least one order (any status) in the last 60 days, and meet at least one of the following requirements:
    • Be an Agency.
    • Be in a conversation with a Fiverr Pro customer.
    • Be a Level 1 freelancer with an Average Selling Price (ASP) of $50 or above.
  • The ASP on your Earnings page includes tips and extras, but the ASP used to determine Zoom eligibility does not. Therefore, you can’t use the ASP from the Earnings page to check if you’re eligible.

Agencies: scheduling a future meeting

In addition to starting an immediate call, Agencies can invite a client to schedule a meeting at a future time based on the Agency’s availability.

Using Zoom calls

Call time limits

The maximum length of a call depends on whether an order has been placed:

  • Before an order is placed: up to 30 minutes.
  • After an order is placed: up to one hour.
Transcripts

Every call is automatically recorded by Fiverr. After the call ends:

  • Both the freelancer and client can view the recording and transcript by clicking Watch Recording.
  • A dedicated Zoom page will open where both parties can download the recording.
Joining with multiple participants

If your client is a Fiverr Pro user, multiple team members can join the call. The call link is only available during the session and cannot be shared in advance.

Reporting a call

After any call, both the freelancer and the client can report the meeting to Fiverr using the Report the incident option, or directly to Customer Support if the client/freelancer acted unprofessionally regarding the order (e.g., by asking for personal or payment details).

  • In your inbox, go to the meeting card and click Report the incident.
  • In the Report a video meetup window, select the reason for your report:
    • They asked to pay/communicate outside of Fiverr.
    • They behaved/spoke inappropriately.
    • Other.
  • In the Incident occurred at field, enter the timestamp when the incident took place.
  • Click Report.
  • Click Got it to close the confirmation window.

Your report will not be shared with the other person. Fiverr’s Trust & Safety team will review your report.

How to start a Zoom call

  • Clients cannot initiate a Zoom video call. You can request one from an eligible freelancer’s profile page. If the freelancer is not eligible, you will see only the option to contact them.
    • Go to the freelancer’s profile page.
    • Click Ask to schedule an intro Zoom meeting.
    • The request appears in your inbox along with the freelancer’s response when they reply.
    • Open the inbox conversation or the order page.
    • Click the video icon in the message box.
    • A Zoom call is created. Both you and your client can join.
    • You will see a pop-up confirming that the account owner is Fiverr.
  • When a client sends a Zoom video call request from your profile:
    • Open your inbox.
    • Accept or decline the request.
    • If you accept, suggest time slots for the meeting.
    • Open the inbox conversation or the order page.
    • Click the video meeting icon in the message box.
    • Select the option to invite the client to book a future meeting.
    • The client receives an invitation to schedule a meeting based on your availability.

Video call policies

Zoom video calls are designed to provide the best possible ordering experience and ensure freelancers are aligned with their clients’ needs. Freelancers and clients are expected to act professionally at all times and to adhere to our Community Standards.

By joining a Fiverr Zoom video call, you agree to abstain from using:

  • Inappropriate language.
  • Offensive comments related to gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, disability, mental illness, physical appearance, body size, race, religion, accent, dialect, or national origin, etc.
  • Hate speech or harassment.
  • Adult content, nudity, or sexual activity, including sexual attention of any kind.
  • Threats of violence.
  • Prohibited Services on Fiverr, both offering and asking for said services.
  • Any attempts to move business off of Fiverr.

We recommend that the summary of the order’s requirements discussed on the call be written down in the order to avoid any misunderstandings that may arise.

Best practices for freelancers

  • Before creating a meeting, contact your client to confirm they are available and to account for any time zone differences.
  • After the call, send your client a written summary of the main points and any agreements you reached. This helps prevent misunderstandings.
What to avoid
  • Don’t share any sensitive personal information. This includes passwords, credit card information, SSN, national identification card numbers, or any other private information.
  • Don’t click on any links or attachments you may receive unless the context is absolutely clear. We recommend that you always use an antivirus on your own device as extra security.
  • Avoid remote access tools. Refrain from using tools such as TeamViewer and AnyDesk that allow a second party to potentially take control of your computer. If you do need to use such a tool, make sure not to allow any operations, as these may damage your computer if accessed by another party.
  • Don’t engage in any conversation that makes you feel uncomfortable. Remember, you can report your Zoom video call by clicking Report the incident or by contacting Customer Support.

FAQs

  • All freelancers can start a Zoom video call from a conversation in the order page. To start calls from an inbox conversation, you need to meet specific eligibility criteria.
  • Your Average Selling Price (ASP) for Zoom eligibility must be $50 or above if you are a Level 1 freelancer. This ASP does not include tips or extras and can’t be used to determine your eligibility.
  • Before an order is placed, the call can last up to 30 minutes. After an order is placed, the call can last up to one hour.
  • After the call, click the recording button in your inbox to go to the Zoom page. You can view the transcript and download the recording and transcript files. Recordings are available for 30 days.
  • You will receive the request in your inbox. You can accept or decline. If you accept, you then suggest time slots for the meeting.
  • Clients cannot initiate Zoom video calls directly. You can request one by clicking Ask to schedule an intro Zoom meeting on an eligible freelancer’s profile page.
  • If the freelancer is not eligible for Zoom, you will see only the option to contact them. The Zoom video call request option will not appear.
  • Yes. Every call is automatically recorded by Fiverr. You can view and download the recording and transcript for up to 30 days after the call.
  • Before an order is placed, the call can last up to 30 minutes. After an order is placed, the call can last up to one hour.
  • No. Calls are hosted by Fiverr through Zoom. When you join, you will see a pop-up confirming that the account owner is Fiverr.

Clients: Order management

The complete guide to your Fiverr order: Statuses and process (Clients: Order management)

Understanding your order’s status helps you keep track of where a project stands, from the moment it’s placed until it’s officially completed. By checking the status through the order page, you can ensure timely delivery and clear communication with your freelancer.

Order process overview

After you place an order, you need to submit the requirements to the freelancer. Once you submit the requirements, the order process starts, and the freelancer is expected to deliver the work within the specified timeframe.

Once the freelancer delivers, review the delivery and accept it to complete the order. If you have feedback and require changes, you can reject the delivery and request revisions. The freelancer will then re-deliver the revised work.

Before an order is delivered

Before the freelancer sends their first delivery, your order will have one of two statuses:

  • To begin your order, submit the necessary requirements. You’ll see an orange banner on the order page prompting you to reply. The status will show Requirements Needed until you submit.
  • You have 14 days to submit the requirements before the order gets automatically canceled. The orange banner will show the due date for submitting the requirements.
  • If the order gets canceled, you will be refunded to your Fiverr balance.
  • Note: If the freelancer already has enough information to get started, they can skip the requirements step. The status will then move to In Progress automatically.
  • Once you provide the requirements, the order moves to In Progress status. The freelancer is expected to deliver within the specified timeframe, which is visible on the order page.

Order Timeline

Some freelancers use Order Timeline to share a step-by-step plan of their work directly on the order page. When your freelancer sets up a timeline, you can see exactly where the project stands at any point during the order.

What you’ll see

If your freelancer has set up an Order Timeline, you’ll find it in two places on the order page:

  • The timeline section on the right side of the order page, showing all steps and their target dates at a glance.
  • The Activity tab, where each step appears as it’s created or updated.

Each step has a title, description, and target date. As the freelancer progresses through their work, they mark steps as done. The timeline gives you real-time visibility into what’s been completed and what’s coming next.

If a step is delayed

If a step passes its target date without being marked as done, it will be flagged as delayed. You can click Ask for an update next to the delayed step to request a progress update from your freelancer.

Mobile

Order Timeline is view-only on the Fiverr mobile app. You can see the steps but cannot interact with them from mobile.

Reviewing a draft

Before the freelancer sends their final delivery, they may share a draft, a work-in-progress preview that gives you an early look at the project. This is an opportunity to provide feedback and make sure you’re both aligned before the final submission.

When a freelancer shares a draft, you’ll receive a notification and an email. Click View Draft in the email to go directly to the draft.

You can reply to the draft from the order page or your inbox. Clicking Reply from the order page will take you to your inbox. A message will clearly indicate that what you’re viewing is a draft, not the final delivery.

Tip: Drafts don’t change the order status. Files and images shared as a draft are protected with a Fiverr watermark.

After an order has been delivered

Once the freelancer submits their work, the order status updates to Delivered. Their submission is now ready for your review. You have three days to take one of the following actions:

  • Accept the delivery
  • Request revisions
  • Extend the review timeframe

Note: If no action is taken within three days of delivery, the system will automatically complete the order. For Gigs that require shipping, auto-completion takes 14 days.

Accepting the delivery
  • Log in and click Orders.
  • Click on the order title to open the order page.
  • Go to the Delivery tab or scroll down to find the delivery message.
  • Answer the question: Are you pleased with the delivery, and are you ready to accept it?
  • Click Yes to approve the final delivery.
  • Click No, I’m not ready yet if you need a revision or more time to review.
Requesting revisions

If you’re not satisfied with the delivery, click No, I’m not ready yet on the order page. The order status will change to In Revision, indicating you’ve rejected the delivery and the freelancer needs to resubmit based on your feedback.

Once the freelancer resubmits, the status will change from In Revision back to In Progress, and you’ll receive a new delivery to review.

Tip: Communicate the changes you need as clearly as possible. This helps the freelancer understand exactly what’s required and deliver a version that meets your expectations.

Extending the review timeframe

If you need more time to review the delivery, click No, I’m not ready yet and select I need more time to review. You can extend the review period by up to 5 days. The order will remain in Delivered status, and the freelancer won’t need to re-deliver. This is not a revision request.

You can extend the review period more than once. If the delivery isn’t accepted, rejected, or extended further, the system will automatically complete the order once the updated timeframe ends.

Orders requiring attention

If an order runs into issues or a dispute, it will be reflected in the order status. The Fiverr Resolution Center is designed to help you address and resolve disputes independently.

  • The Resolution Center was used to request one of the following: a mutual cancellation, a delivery date extension (submitted by the freelancer), or an update request (submitted by you).
  • The freelancer missed the expected delivery time. You are entitled to cancel your order if there’s no further response from the freelancer.
  • 24 hours have passed since the order was marked as Late. You can cancel the order immediately through the Resolution Center.
  • Your freelancer has 30 days to submit a delivery from the day you placed an order if it’s very late; otherwise, the order will be automatically canceled, and you will be refunded to your Fiverr balance.
  • On the 15th day of this timeframe, you will receive an email with the number of days left.

Learn more with Using the Resolution Center.

A completed order

An order is marked as Complete once the freelancer delivers the work and you accept it. If no action is taken within three days of delivery, the system will automatically complete the order. Once an order is completed, its status cannot be changed or canceled via the Resolution Center.

After accepting the delivery, you can also:

  • Leave a review for the freelancer and the work they did. Learn more with Leaving and managing reviews on Fiverr.
  • Leave a tip as a gesture of appreciation. Visit How do I tip my freelancer? article to learn more.

Viewing & managing orders

You can view and manage your orders on both web and mobile through the Manage orders page. Use the tabs at the top to filter orders by status:

  • ​
    • Active: Active orders where the freelancer works on the delivery.
    • Missing details: Orders where you need to submit the requirements for the freelancer to start the order.
    • Delivered: Delivered orders waiting for you to accept the delivery, or ask for a revision.
    • Completed: Orders that have been delivered by the freelancer and accepted by you.
    • Cancelled: All canceled orders, either by Customer Support or mutually canceled orders.
    • All: Orders in all statuses.
  • ​
    • Updates: Orders with new messages or notifications.
    • Waiting for details: Orders where you need to submit the requirements to the freelancer to start the order.
    • Late deliveries: Late or Very Late orders where the freelancer didn’t deliver on time.
    • Revision requested: Orders where you declined delivery and requested revisions.
    • Completed: Orders that have been delivered by the freelancer and accepted by you.
    • Waiting for rating: Orders where you need to review the delivery.
    • Cancelled: All canceled orders, either by Customer Support or mutually canceled orders.

Extracting delivered files

Delivered files are packaged in a .zip file, which consolidates all deliverables into a single organized folder.

Note: Some mobile devices can’t open .zip files. Please use a computer to unzip them.

- Open the folder where you downloaded the .zip file (typically your Downloads folder).
- Double-click the .zip file. It will automatically decompress into the same folder.
- Open the folder where you downloaded the .zip file (usually your Downloads folder).
- Right-click the .zip file.
- From the menu, select Extract all.
- Select a destination folder and click Extract.

Best practices

  • Review your delivery promptly. The order auto-completes three days after delivery if no action is taken.
  • Use the draft feature to align with your freelancer early, and share feedback before the final delivery to avoid unnecessary revisions.
  • Be specific when requesting revisions. Clear, detailed feedback helps the freelancer deliver exactly what you need.
  • Extend the review period if you need more time, rather than letting the order auto-complete.
  • Communicate through the order page to keep a clear record of all discussions and deliveries.

FAQs

  • The system will automatically complete the order three days after delivery. For Gigs that require shipping, auto-completion takes 14 days.
  • If a step has passed its target date, you’ll see it flagged as delayed on the order page. Click Ask for an update next to the delayed step to request a progress update from your freelancer.
  • No. Once an order is marked as Complete, its status cannot be changed or canceled via the Resolution Center.
  • A draft is a work-in-progress preview shared by the freelancer before the final delivery. It gives you an early look at the project so you can provide feedback. Drafts don’t affect the order status or the freelancer’s stats.
  • Extending the review period gives you more time to evaluate the existing delivery without requiring the freelancer to resubmit. Requesting a revision rejects the current delivery and asks the freelancer to make changes and re-deliver.
  • A Dispute status means the Resolution Center was used, either for a mutual cancellation request, a delivery date extension request from the freelancer, or an update request from you.
  • If your order is Late, you’re entitled to cancel if there’s no further response from the freelancer. If it’s Very Late (24+ hours past Late), you can cancel immediately through the Resolution Center.

Hourly orders for clients (Clients: Order management)

Hourly Orders let you pay for work based on the actual time a freelancer spends on your project. This feature gives you greater flexibility and control, especially for evolving or long-term projects.

Overview

The Hourly Work model is suitable for:

  • Projects with evolving or hard-to-define scopes.
  • Long-term or ongoing projects.
  • Projects requiring at least 8 hours of work.

Hourly work is priced based on the actual hours worked, which offers fair payment according to the time and effort put into your project. You can set a weekly hour limit with your freelancer as part of the custom offer, and this limit can be changed or removed anytime from the order page.

Before you begin

  • Search for the service you need in the search bar and then go to the Seller details and filter freelancers by “offer Hourly rate” to compare options.
  • Discuss your project details and agree on a weekly hour limit with your freelancer. The offer, sent to your inbox, will include the service description, the agreed weekly hour limit, and the freelancer’s time estimation for the entire project.
  • Once you accept the custom offer, you will pay a $5 order initiation fee (tax not included), and the freelancer can begin working.

Weekly work & payment process

Your freelancer will log their weekly hours, and you will receive a report for review.

How your freelancer logs hours

Your freelancer must log their weekly hours worked by Sunday (23:59 UTC). For each session of hours added, they are required to provide a detailed description or a supporting file (or both). The supporting file can be the completed work, a screenshot, or a detailed Hourly report from a tracking app.

When you are charged

You are charged every Monday, based on the hours the freelancer logged. Your payment is then securely held in escrow until you approve the report.

Suspended orders

Hourly orders can be suspended if your payment method did not go through. This can occur for various reasons, such as an expired card, insufficient funds, and payment authorization failure. To resolve this, update or replace your payment method in the Billing and Payments section of your account and pay the pending charge by clicking on the Pay Amount Due on the same page or on the Hourly order page. Your Hourly order will then resume.

How to approve the weekly report

By default, the Hourly work approval process is manual. You’ll receive the previous week’s report for review every Monday.

  • You have 7 days to review and manually approve the report after being charged (from Monday to Monday). If no action is taken within 7 days, the report will be auto-approved, and payment will be released to the freelancer. However, the order status will remain paused until you choose to activate it. Until the report is approved, freelancers cannot log new hours for the order. This manual approval is required for the first weekly report of any Hourly order.
  • From the second weekly report onward, you have the option to choose automatic approval. If you select this, you’ll have a 3-day period (Monday to Thursday) for opening a dispute; if it’s not disputed in this window, the week will auto-complete.

Disputing a weekly report

If the work detailed in the weekly report does not meet your expectations, you can dispute it.

  • If your approval process is manual, you have 7 days (Monday to Monday) to open a dispute.

  • If your approval process is automatic, you have a 3-day period (72 hours) (Monday to Thursday) to open a dispute.

  • ​

    • Go to the order page.
    • Click on More actions at the bottom of the order page.
    • Click on Open a dispute.

  • Once you ask for a refund, the freelancer will have up to 48 hours to accept or decline the request.

  • If the freelancer accepts the request or doesn’t respond within 48 hours, you will get the funds immediately. Refunds are added to your Fiverr Balance, or Fiverr Pro Balance if you’re a Pro client, ready for future orders.

  • The cancellation only affects the week, not the whole order: if you wish to receive a refund and stop the order, you need to end the order as well.

  • If you wish to continue working with the freelancer and request a refund only for a week, you can dispute that week without ending the order.

  • See more information on the refund process.

Managing your Hourly order

You have control over your Hourly order at any time from the order page:

  • Change the weekly hour limit.
  • Pause the order with 24 hours’ notice.
  • End the order with 24 hours’ notice.

You can make these changes by clicking the ellipsis button at the top right corner of the order page. If you choose to pause or end the order, the freelancer will have an additional 24 hours to report any final hours worked.

In-progress order feedback

You can leave a review for your freelancer during an in-progress Hourly order if these two conditions are met:

  • At least four weeks of work have been done.
  • The freelancer has reported at least 10 hours of work.

Once you submit a mid-order review, the cycle will begin again. Tips and private feedback are only available when the entire Hourly order is completed.

  • ​
    • All Fiverr Pro Terms of Service and Payment Terms apply.
    • Disputes may only address the hours reported in a weekly report. Fiverr does not guarantee the quality of work and Fiverr’s Customer Support will not accept disputes regarding the quality of services.
    • The refund amount is limited to the number of hours reported by the freelancer.
    • Weekly reports are auto-completed if you don’t ask for a refund within 72 hours from the weekly payment or within 7 days if the Hourly order is in manual approval mode.
    • Clients are strictly prohibited from using a canceled delivery. The freelancer retains all rights to the canceled order.
    • Fiverr reserves the right to determine which orders are eligible, and to exclude instances of abuse, fraud, or any other inappropriate activity.

FAQs

  • Fixed-price projects are ideal for well-defined services with clear deliverables. Hourly work is suitable for projects of at least 8 hours of work, long-term hiring, ongoing projects with evolving scopes, or for projects whose scope is hard to define at the beginning.
  • Yes, in the Hourly model, you pay based on the actual hours worked, providing flexibility and fair billing according to the time and effort put into your project.
  • Yes, the hours logged and progress made.
  • Yes, when discussing your needs with the freelancer you can set a weekly hour limit as part of the custom offer. You can change or remove this limit at any time from the order page.
  • Once a freelancer logs their hours and work, you’ll receive an email and a notification. You can then review and approve the report directly from the Hourly order page. After approval, the freelancer will be paid and can continue logging hours for the next week.
  • You can choose between two approval methods for each Hourly contract:
    • Manual approval (default): You’ll have 7 days to review and manually approve each report after submission.
    • Automatic approval: Reports are automatically approved within 3 days of submission. You can always dispute a report if needed, regardless of the approval method.
  • By default, all Hourly contracts are set to manual approval. To switch to automatic approval, go to the Hourly order page, click on the “Actions” menu in the top-right corner, and update your report approval settings.
  • Freelancers provide detailed descriptions and can add attachments of their work each week, ensuring you have visibility into their progress. The reporting always occurs before Sunday, 23:59 UTC each week, and you will be charged for the work the following Monday, before the time you need to pay for the work.
  • Yes, you can pause the project if the freelancer’s services are temporarily not required. Discuss this with your freelancer to ensure a smooth pause and resume process. You can also end the project at any time from your order page. Keep in mind that the freelancer will have an additional 24 hours from the moment you pause or end the project to log hours.
  • If the weekly report isn’t what you expected, or if you have any issues, the dispute window depends on your order’s approval mode:
    • Manual approval mode: You have 7 days to dispute the report.
    • Automatic approval mode: You have 72 hours to dispute the report.

How order disputes work for clients (Clients: Order management)

Managing order disputes is an important part of using Fiverr. You can request to cancel an active order through the Resolution Center when issues arise. This article explains the types of order disputes, how to cancel an order, and what happens after a cancellation. Our goal is to help you complete your project, so whenever possible we look for ways to move your order forward.

Before you begin

  • You can access the Resolution Center from the right side of the order page.
  • The Resolution Center is used for orders that have not yet been completed. If you need to cancel a completed order, contact Customer Support.

Ways to avoid order disputes

An order dispute is a cancellation request you send through the Resolution Center when you want to cancel an order.

Preparation and communication help prevent order disputes:

  • Before placing an order, make sure your project brief is detailed and complete. Discuss everything with the freelancer so they fully understand your needs before work begins.
  • If your needs change during the order, let the freelancer know right away. Clear and timely communication helps avoid misunderstandings and keeps the project on track.
  • Custom Offers allow you to go beyond the packages offered with Gigs and let your freelancer tailor the order to your specific needs. That way, you and the freelancer know what to expect.
  • Revisions can help resolve concerns you may have with the delivery and allow the freelancer to fix them.
  • If your freelancer shares a draft before the final delivery, review it and send your feedback early. A draft is work in progress, and your silence does not mean you approve it.
  • This option removes the pressure to accept the delivery or request a revision within three days. Take as much time as you need to make sure the delivery is what you paid for.
  • Review all delivered files carefully before accepting. If something is not right, request a revision. Accept the delivery only when you are sure it meets your requirements.
  • Partial refunds let you keep your delivery and reach an agreement with the freelancer. Ask the freelancer to send you a request for a partial refund.

Reach out to Customer Support if you need any advice or help with your order.

Learn more with the following articles:

  • The complete guide to your Fiverr order: Statuses and process
  • Partial refunds

Types of order disputes

Fiverr has several types of order disputes, depending on who initiates the request and when.

  • You can request to cancel an active order at any time through the Resolution Center. Once you submit the request, the freelancer has 48 hours to accept or decline. If they do not respond, we cancel the order automatically.
  • If a freelancer requests to cancel, you have 48 hours to respond. If you do not respond within 48 hours, we cancel the order automatically.
  • In some situations, you can cancel an order without approval from the freelancer:
    • Before submitting project requirements: If you placed an order and have not yet submitted your project requirements, you can cancel immediately through the Resolution Center. This option is available only on the Fiverr website, not in the app.
    • Very late delivery: If the freelancer has not delivered and you did not both agree to extend the delivery date, you can cancel without approval after 24 hours past the expected delivery date.

We can cancel an active order when we confirm a violation of our Terms of Service, such as fraud, a fake identity, stolen or non-original work, harassment or discrimination, a false or empty delivery, or a prohibited service.

How to cancel an active order

To access the Resolution Center:

  • Go to your Orders page and select the order you want to resolve, then click View.
  • Click Resolution Center, located on the right side of the page.
  • Select Cancel Order and fill in the reason.
  • Click Send Request.

Learn more with Cancel an order with the Resolution Center.

Canceling an order with an open request

If you want to cancel an order with an open Resolution Center request, you need to withdraw the request first on the Orders page. After withdrawing the request, you can submit a cancellation request.

You cannot open a new dispute request while any of the following actions are in progress:

  • Get an order update.
  • Cancel order.
  • Extend delivery date request (requested by freelancers only).

If you cannot resolve the issue together, contact Customer Support.

Canceling a completed order

If the order is in Completed status, you cannot use the Resolution Center to cancel it. Contact Customer Support for help.

When you contact Customer Support about a completed order, we review the full case before we decide. We start from the position that a completed order is valid, and we look at the original requirements, the delivery, and your conversation with the freelancer. We may contact you and the freelancer to try to resolve the issue first, and we may suggest a partial refund. The more time passes after an order is completed, the more carefully we review the request.

We can cancel an order when there is clear evidence, such as:

  • Missing requirements
  • Corrupted or unusable files
  • A plagiarism report
  • A clear mismatch between the delivery and the Gig or custom offer
  • A violation of our Terms of Service

After your order is canceled

Once your order is successfully canceled, here are a few options to help you move forward:

  • Pick a different freelancer from a personalized recommendations list: We provide you with a personalized list of freelancer recommendations on your Orders page to help you complete your project.
  • Get personalized offers by posting a project brief: Post your project brief and receive tailored offers from relevant freelancers. Review your offers, choose the best fit, and get the results you need.

Keep these points in mind after a cancellation:

  • Delivered work: When an order is canceled, you lose the rights to the delivered work, so you cannot use it.
  • Shared access: If you gave the freelancer access to your accounts, such as your email, website, content management system, or payment details, change your passwords and remove their access.

Fiverr Pro satisfaction guarantee

Fiverr Pro managed services come with a full money-back satisfaction guarantee on eligible orders. If the final delivery does not meet your expectations, you can contact Customer Support to request a refund, if you do so within 14 days of order completion. We credit approved refunds to your Fiverr Pro balance for future orders.

The guarantee covers:

  • Services provided by vetted Pro freelancers
  • Project manager and project planning services
  • Sourcing by a domain expert

It does not apply to hourly orders.

Learn more with Fiverr Pro satisfaction guarantee.

FAQs

  • Go to your Orders page, select the order, and click Resolution Center. Click Cancel order, enter a message, select a reason, and click Send Request. The freelancer has 48 hours to accept or decline. If they do not respond, we cancel the order automatically.
  • Yes, in two situations: if you have not yet submitted your project requirements, or if the order is very late (24 or more hours past the delivery deadline). The option to cancel before submitting requirements is available on the Fiverr website only, not in the app.
  • You need to withdraw the open request first from your Orders page. Once you withdraw it, you can submit a cancellation request.
  • You cannot cancel a completed order through the Resolution Center. Contact Customer Support for help.

Leaving and managing reviews on Fiverr (Clients: Order management)

Reviews and ratings are the foundation of a trusted marketplace. They give clients confidence when choosing a freelancer, and help freelancers showcase their work and build a strong reputation. Fiverr uses a two-way feedback system: both the client and the freelancer can leave a review after an order is completed. Reviews are visible to the public only after both parties submit their feedback, or once the review window closes.

Types of reviews

The review system has two types of reviews:

  • Public review: A star rating plus written feedback that appears on the freelancer’s Gig page and profile page, and on the client’s profile page.
