Prohibited services on Fiverr (Clients: Trust & Safety)

At Fiverr, we are committed to maintaining a safe, fair, and trusted marketplace for all users. To support that goal, certain services may not be offered, requested, delivered, or otherwise facilitated through the platform if they could cause harm, violate applicable laws or third-party rights, or undermine the trust and safety of our marketplace.

This article provides a detailed overview of the types of services that are prohibited on Fiverr. Attempts to offer, request, or deliver prohibited services, including by disguising them under misleading titles, descriptions, or categories, may result in action on your account.

The categories below are intended to provide a general overview of the kinds of services that may be considered prohibited, rather than a complete list of every possible case. Please note that prohibited services may change over time, and this article is therefore not exhaustive.

Why certain services are prohibited

Some services are prohibited because they create risks that are incompatible with a trusted digital marketplace. In general, Fiverr does not allow services that:

  • Put users or third parties at risk
  • Facilitate illegal, fraudulent, deceptive, or abusive conduct
  • Undermine integrity, authenticity, or fair competition
  • Misuse personal data, identities, or technologies
  • Violate intellectual property rights or other legal rights

These restrictions help Fiverr remain a platform users can trust.

Prohibited services

Violence, dangerous goods, & harmful conduct

Services that promote or facilitate violence, the trade of dangerous goods, or actions intended to cause serious harm to people, property, or systems are not allowed. This includes services involving any of the following:

  • Weapon development, trafficking, or related facilitation
  • Promoting prohibited or potentially dangerous goods, or encouraging others to make, use, or trade them, including firearms, ammunition, drugs, and controlled substances
  • The promotion, coordination, or delivery of violent, extremist, or terror-related content or services
  • Hate speech, hate-related services, or content that targets individuals or groups based on protected characteristics
  • Services intended to cause damage, disruption, or harm to people, property, or systems
  • Content related to the glorification of violence, incitement to violence, or other harmful behavior toward an individual, group, or animals
Services involving harm, abuse, or exploitation

To protect the Fiverr community, Fiverr does not allow services that harm, exploit, endanger, or create serious risks to individuals, groups, property, animals, or the broader public. This includes:

  • Any form of abuse, human exploitation, sexual exploitation, or human trafficking
  • Services involving minors that may create safety, consent, exploitation, or legal concerns, including:
    • Modeling services involving minors
    • Exploiting or misusing a minor’s identity, image, likeness, age, or perceived age
    • Creating sexualized, exploitative, or otherwise inappropriate content involving minors, whether real or depicted through artistic, digital, or AI-generated content
    • Any other service that places minors at risk. For more information about our policy and practical guidance, see our Help Center article and Community Standards.
Medical, therapy, & psychological services

Fiverr does not allow services that provide medical treatment or advice, sell or supply pharmaceutical products, or offer similar health-related services. This applies to both physical and mental health-related services.

Prohibited services in this category include:

  • Medical treatment or advice relating to a medical condition
  • Pharmaceutical advice
  • Supply of medical drugs, pharmaceuticals, medical equipment, or pharmaceutical supplies
  • Creating or providing documentation or other evidence intended to fraudulently misrepresent a person’s medical status, such as falsified test results
  • Services claiming to heal, prevent, or treat cancer, diabetes, eating disorders, depression, COVID-19, or any other disease or medical condition, including emotional therapy
Forged, altered, or fraudulent document services

Fiverr does not allow services that create, modify, sell, or provide forged, altered, counterfeit, or otherwise fraudulent documents. This includes documents that may be used to misrepresent a person’s identity, eligibility, qualifications, financial status, legal status, or other official information.

Prohibited services in this category include:

  • Creating or modifying government-issued documents, such as IDs, passports, visas, or driver’s licenses
  • Creating or altering official records, such as birth certificates, death certificates, or marriage certificates
  • Creating or modifying financial documents, such as bank statements, pay slips, tax forms, or proof of income
  • Creating or altering educational, professional, or licensing documents, such as diplomas, transcripts, certificates, or licenses
Unlicensed professional services

Some services require professional qualifications, licenses, certifications, or legal authorization. Fiverr does not allow users to offer professional services without the credentials required to provide them lawfully or responsibly. This helps protect users from legal, financial, health, and other personal risks that may result from unqualified professional advice, services, or representation.

Prohibited services in this category include:

  • Providing legal services without the required authorization
  • Providing tax, accounting, investment, insurance, or financial advice where professional credentials are required
  • Providing engineering or architectural services where professional licensing, certification, or authorization is required
  • Offering regulated professional services while falsely claiming or implying licensing, certification, or official professional status

Where a service requires professional credentials, sellers must accurately represent their qualifications and may not provide services they are not authorized to offer.

Hacking, unauthorized access, & malicious software services

Fiverr does not allow services that attempt to gain unauthorized access to accounts, profiles, devices, networks, websites, platforms, or other systems. Services that damage, disrupt, bypass protections, compromise security, or expose sensitive personal, financial, business, or governmental information are prohibited.

Prohibited services in this category include:

  • Hacking, cracking, or attempting to access accounts, profiles, devices, websites, networks, or other systems without authorization
  • Bypassing passwords, two-factor authentication, access controls, paywalls, or other security protections
  • Phishing, credential theft, account takeover, social engineering, malware, spyware, ransomware, or similar malicious activity
  • Creating, contributing to, or facilitating information security risks that may disrupt, disable, interfere with, or harm individuals, businesses, online services, platforms, systems, or governmental institutions, including DDoS attacks, doxxing, impersonation, malware distribution, phishing, and other hacking techniques
Deepfakes & non-consensual manipulated content services

AI can be a powerful tool, but it must be used responsibly. Fiverr does not allow AI-generated services that deceive, impersonate, violate consent, or otherwise cause harm. Services that use AI in ways that mislead users, exploit identifiable individuals, or conceal deception are prohibited.

This includes services involving:

  • Using AI to impersonate real individuals or falsely represent identity, affiliation, or endorsement
  • Creating synthetic audio, images, or video of identifiable individuals without appropriate authorization, especially where the content may mislead, exploit, or harm
  • Generating deepfakes or other manipulated media intended to deceive, harass, defame, or misrepresent real people or events
  • Using AI in ways that conceal deception or mislead others about what is real, authentic, or independently created
Services involving personal data or privacy violations

Fiverr does not allow services that involve the unauthorized collection, sharing, sale, or misuse of personal information. Services that expose individuals to privacy violations, spam, identity misuse, or other forms of harm through the use of personal data are prohibited.

This includes services involving:

  • Sharing personal data of individuals, such as email addresses, phone numbers, or similar contact details
  • Premade lists containing personal data of individuals
  • Scraping social media platforms to obtain information about others
  • Sharing confidential personal information, such as social security numbers, identification cards, credit card details, or physical addresses
  • Using personal data to support identity misuse, impersonation, phishing, scams, spam, or other deceptive outreach

To help protect privacy rights, any information provided through permitted services must be unique to each order and limited to business-related data only.

Services involving financial risks

Fiverr takes the financial safety of users seriously and does not allow services that may expose users to fraud, misuse of financial information, or unsafe financial activity. Services that require access to another person’s sensitive financial information, involve high-risk financial conduct, or are offered on a profit-sharing basis, are prohibited.

This includes services involving:

  • Opening, managing, or making changes to a financial account of any kind
  • Providing a loan, buying or selling currency or cryptocurrency, trading binary options, or trading other financial instruments
  • Mining cryptocurrency
  • Removing negative remarks from a credit score or credit history, or other credit repair-related services
  • Creation of trading signals, indicators, or pre-made trading strategies
Misleading guarantees & unverifiable outcome services

Fiverr does not allow services that promise specific results or outcomes that are not within a seller’s control. This includes exaggerated or misleading claims about what buyers may achieve through a service.

This includes guarantees or promises related to:

  • Restoring access to suspended accounts on third-party platforms, such as Amazon, Facebook, or eBay
  • Specific monetary earnings, investment returns, or profit rates
  • Wins, levels, in-game currency, or profits in any game or app
  • Healing, treating, or curing any medical condition

Freelancers may present their services using promotional or persuasive marketing language, but this must not cross into guaranteeing specific, measurable results or outcomes that are not reasonably within their control.

Services that may violate third-party terms of service

Fiverr requires users to respect the terms of service of any third-party platform, tool, or service involved in delivering or requesting a service on Fiverr. Services that violate, or create a significant risk of violating, a third party’s terms of service are prohibited.

This includes services that involve:

  • Automating actions on platforms that explicitly prohibit automation
  • Bypassing restrictions, paywalls, or account limitations imposed by third-party platforms
  • Reselling or redistributing third-party services or content in ways not permitted by the provider
  • Creating tools or workarounds designed to circumvent another platform’s rules

Before offering or requesting a service, users should review the terms of any third party involved. Fiverr reserves the right to take action where a service exposes users to legal, contractual, or platform-related risks, including in response to third-party reports when the conduct also conflicts with Fiverr’s policies, values, or marketplace standards.

Fake engagement, reviews, & traffic services

Fiverr does not allow services that create fake reviews or use deceptive methods to generate artificial engagement, traffic, or performance signals on third-party platforms. These services distort trust, mislead users and third parties, and undermine fair competition on those platforms.

This includes:

  • Fake reviews of any kind, positive, negative, or neutral, written or video-based, that do not reflect a genuine experience of a product, service, or business
  • Artificial followers, likes, views, shares, or other engagement signals generated through bots, click farms, or similar techniques
  • Inflated website traffic, app downloads, or other performance metrics through illegitimate means
  • Tools or services that enable others to generate fake engagement at scale
Academic & job-related dishonesty services

Fiverr strictly prohibits services that support academic cheating or dishonest job-related conduct. Fiverr does not allow services that complete work on behalf of a person in situations where independent effort, truthful representation, or compliance with institutional or workplace rules is expected.

This includes services that involve:

  • Undertaking homework
  • Completing exams or tests
  • Completing job application assignments
  • Completing any other assignment expected to be completed without outside assistance

Users are expected to follow the honor code, internal rules, and applicable conduct policies of their academic institution or workplace when requesting academic or employment-related services. Fiverr is committed to protecting authenticity, honesty, and integrity in academic and professional contexts.

Read more about Academic and workplace dishonesty services.

Services outside the Fiverr catalog

Fiverr’s catalog evolves in response to changes in the digital environment and user demand. From time to time, Fiverr may restructure the catalog and discontinue certain service types. Where a service is no longer supported in the catalog, Fiverr may remove the relevant Gig.

For more information, please visit the Fiverr Forum and review our dedicated article for guidance and resources on creating high-performing Gigs that appeal to clients.

How to stay compliant

To help make sure your services comply with Fiverr’s policies:

  • Offer only legitimate services and do not rely on deception, abuse, or unauthorized activity
  • Do not attempt to relist prohibited services under different names, categories, wording, or bundled offerings in order to avoid detection
  • Review Fiverr’s Terms of Service, Community Standards, and related Help Center resources before publishing, ordering, or accepting a service

If you are still unsure whether a service is allowed after reviewing those resources, or if you are approached with a specific request that raises concerns, contact Customer Support for guidance.

If you come across any content that violates our policies, please report it to us.

Learn more about our policies and enforcement:

  • Fiverr’s Terms of Service
  • Fiverr’s Community Standards
  • Policy enforcements Help Center article

Reporting content or behavior on Fiverr (Clients: Trust & Safety)

We value every member of our community and aim to create a respectful, inclusive, and safe space for all. If you encounter any problematic content that violates Fiverr’s Community Standards, we encourage you to report it so we can keep the platform secure.

Overview

This feature allows you to flag specific content that doesn’t belong on Fiverr. You can report messages, Gigs, video calls, or briefs that may violate our policies.

You can also report individual attachments within a freelancer’s Portfolio projects and Work Samples in Live Portfolio.

  • What the feature does: Sends specific content to our Trust & Safety team for manual review.
  • Why it’s useful: Helps maintain a professional environment and protects users from scams, harassment, or inappropriate content.
  • Who it’s for: All Fiverr users, including freelancers and clients.

Important: Reporting tools are for policy violations only. They cannot be used for order disputes or dissatisfaction with services. For help with orders, please contact Customer Support.

Before you begin

  • To report content, you must be a registered, email-verified Fiverr user. If not, you’ll be prompted to complete those steps before your report can be submitted. Exception: EU residents may report certain serious violations confidentially without logging in.
  • Reporting is available on both desktop and the Fiverr mobile app.
  • You can report specific content, including Gigs, messages, Zoom calls, and briefs. If your concern is about a user’s account rather than specific content (for example, suspicious behavior or identity issues), you can still submit a report through any available reporting option by adding details in the open text field.
  • You can also report individual portfolio attachments and Work Samples in Live Portfolio. Please note that this specific feature is currently available on desktop (web) only; mobile is not yet supported.
  • Misuse of reporting tools, such as submitting false reports, can lead to account sanctions.

How to submit a report

  • If you find a service that violates our Terms of Service or Community Standards, follow these steps:
    • On the Gig page, click the ellipsis (…) icon.
    • Select Report an issue.
    • Choose a reason from the list and click Next.
    • Provide any additional details and click Submit.
  • You can report messages directly from your Inbox.
    • Open the message you wish to flag.
    • Click the ellipsis (…) icon and select Report.
    • Select a reason from the dropdown and click Next. If your specific concern isn’t listed in the dropdown, choose Other and provide details in the text box.
    • Optional: Check the box to Block this user if you want to prevent further interaction.
    • Click Submit.
  • Important: Messages cannot be reported through the inbox drawer within the order page.
  • After submitting, a red flag indicates the message is reported. If you blocked the user, a notification will confirm they can no longer contact you.
  • Once a video call ends, a recording link and call details appear in your Inbox.
    • Find the call recording in your messages.
    • Click Report the Incident next to the flag icon.
    • Select a reason and add the specific timestamp where the violation occurs in the recording. You can watch the video from the pop-up to locate the exact time.
  • After submitting the report, you will see a red flag indicating the call has been reported.
  • If you receive a brief that is inappropriate or spam:
    • Open the brief, and click the ellipsis (…) icon.
    • Select Report an issue.
    • Choose a reason from the list and click Next.
    • Provide any additional details and click Submit.
  • After submitting the report, you will see a pop-up confirmation and you will receive an email with the details of the report.
  • If you find a work sample that violates our Terms of Service or Community Standards, follow these steps:
    • Open the freelancer’s Gig page and locate the relevant image within the gallery.
    • Hover over an image within a portfolio project and click the ellipsis (…) icon.
    • Select Report an issue.
    • Choose a reason from the list and click Next.
    • Provide any additional details and click Submit.
  • After submitting the report, you will see a pop-up confirmation and you will receive an email with the details of the report.
  • If you find a portfolio project that violates our Terms of Service or Community Standards, follow these steps:
    • Open the freelancer’s Portfolio within the Gig page.
    • Hover over an image within a portfolio project and click the ellipsis (…) icon.
    • Select Report an issue.
    • Choose a reason from the list and click Next.
    • Provide any additional details and click Submit.
  • After submitting the report, you will see a pop-up confirmation and you will receive an email with the details of the report.
  • If the Report option isn’t visible, check the following:
    • You’re not logged in. You must be signed into your Fiverr account to report content. Log in and try again.
    • The page needs a refresh. Try reloading the page or clearing your browser cache. If the button still doesn’t appear, try a different browser.
    • If none of the above resolves the issue: contact Customer Support and include the URL of the content you want to report. An agent can help log the report on your behalf.

What happens after you submit a report?

When you submit a report, Fiverr’s Trust & Safety team manually reviews it against our policies.

  • If a violation is found: We will take appropriate action, which may include removing content or issuing account sanctions to the user.
  • If no violation is found: No action will be taken.
Review timelines

Reports are reviewed manually. You will receive an email notification once a verdict has been issued. You do not need to follow up while your report is under review.

If you submitted a report and have not received any response after an extended period, contact Customer Support and reference your Report ID (included in your confirmation email). This allows the support team to locate your case and provide a status update.

Enforcement actions

Depending on the severity and nature of the violation, Fiverr may take one or more of the following actions against the reported account:

  • Content removal (Gig, message, portfolio project, or Work Sample)
  • Account warning
  • Temporary account suspension
  • Permanent account suspension
How to appeal a decision

Whether you submitted a report or your account was the one reported, you have the right to appeal our decision within 6 months.

To submit an appeal

  • Contact Customer Support using your account’s registered email.
  • Provide the Report ID (found in your email confirmation) or the Support Ticket number where you originally submitted the report.
  • Explain why you believe the decision should be overturned.

We do not accept evidence from third-party platforms (like screenshots of conversations outside of Fiverr) during the appeal process.

Appeals outcomes

  • If your appeal is successful, we will adjust the action associated with the decision you appealed, as appropriate.
  • If you reported content and the decision changes after an appeal, we will notify both you and the account holder.
  • If your appeal is not successful, the original decision will be final and cannot be appealed again on Fiverr.

Reporting and privacy

Unless required by law, the individual being reported will not be informed of who submitted the report.

Reporting for EU residents

In accordance with EU laws, you have specific options when reporting serious violations such as child sexual abuse material (CSAM), human trafficking, or adult content.

  • Confidentiality: You can choose to keep your report confidential when reporting these specific categories.
  • Investigation: Our team thoroughly investigates every report. You will receive a personal response regarding the outcome of our review.
  • Appeals: If you disagree with a decision, you can appeal as described above.
Intimate Content Reports

Intimate images and videos are not permitted on Fiverr.

Fiverr complies with the TAKE IT DOWN Act and has policies and mechanisms in place to review and remove reported non-consensual intimate images or videos.

Fiverr’s standards go beyond what’s legally required under the TAKE IT DOWN Act - content may be removed under our own policies even if it doesn’t meet the legal threshold for removal.

If you’ve encountered content of this kind - including non-consensual intimate imagery - you can report it for removal. A Fiverr account is not required to submit a TAKE IT DOWN Act removal request. Fiverr reviews these reports promptly and removes content that violates our policies and applicable law within 48 hours of receiving a valid request

How we define misuse of reporting tools

We take action against content and accounts that breach our policies. However, the integrity of our platform depends on honest reporting. Before submitting a report, you will see a disclaimer outlining appropriate use.

Misusing these tools - especially by falsely categorizing reports as CSAM, sexual exploitation, or terrorism or similar - undermines safety efforts. In these cases, the report will not be processed, and the reporter account may face permanent suspension.

Enforcement actions for misuse

If the reporting system is misused, we may take the following measures:

Account warning Users who frequently submit reports that violate this policy may receive a warning. We reserve the right to review and process reports at our discretion.

Account suspension Severe or repeated misuse may result in account suspension. We make these decisions on a case-by-case basis.

Examples of severe violations

The following actions are considered serious breaches of our reporting policy:

  • Falsely categorizing reports as terrorism, sexual exploitation, or CSAM
  • Submitting repeated false reports after receiving warnings
  • Intentionally targeting specific users with false reports
  • Mass reporting content without valid reasons to manipulate enforcement or by making false allegations
  • Submitting reports with fabricated or misleading proof
  • Exploiting the reporting system for competitive advantage (e.g., reporting a competitor’s Gig to harm their business)
  • Using multiple accounts or automation to evade these policies

By following these guidelines, you help us ensure Fiverr remains a professional and secure marketplace.

Learn more about How we enforce our policies.

Stay protected: Fiverr’s off-platform policy (Clients: Trust & Safety)

Conducting business on Fiverr increases your visibility and credibility as a freelancer. By using Fiverr’s tools, you can build long-term relationships with repeat clients and secure larger, higher-value orders. To support seamless communication, Fiverr offers built-in tools like video calls, which help freelancers align with their clients’ needs and provide the best possible order experience.

This article outlines best practices for communication and payments on Fiverr. Review the full policy on Fiverr’s community standards.

Communication best practices

Effective communication is essential for creating a positive experience on Fiverr. Conducting all interactions through Fiverr’s communication tools ensures transparency, supports professionalism, and allows Fiverr to assist in any disputes or issues.

Communication through third-party tools is permitted only after an order has been placed.

  • Use respectful, professional language. Avoid inappropriate language, harassment, or discrimination.
  • Use Fiverr’s platform exclusively and avoid sharing personal or sensitive details like passwords or credit card information.
  • Leverage Fiverr’s video call feature to speak directly with clients and freelancers and streamline discussions. This ensures that all project-related communication is documented and secure. Learn more about this feature here.
  • If you communicate through third-party tools, document your conversations (notes, summaries, etc.) and share them on the platform. This keeps all records transparent and accessible for both parties in case of disagreements.
  • If you encounter anything unusual, report it. Submitted reports will go directly to Fiverr’s Trust and Safety team for a thorough review.
  • Avoid sharing social security numbers, payment details, or other sensitive personal information.
  • Only interact with secure links, avoiding those from unknown sources.
  • Do not allow others control over your device through tools like TeamViewer, AnyDesk, etc.
  • If someone makes you uncomfortable, discontinue the conversation and report it.

Secure payments on Fiverr

Conducting all transactions on Fiverr provides several protections:

  • Engaging outside of Fiverr exposes users to the risk of scams and fraudulent activity, which Fiverr cannot protect against.
  • Fiverr protects both clients and freelancers with secure, seamless payment processing, keeping sensitive information safe.
  • If something goes wrong while working on the platform, Fiverr can step in to help resolve disputes.
  • Completing orders on Fiverr boosts a freelancer’s profile and increases visibility for future clients.
  • Freelancers can build relationships with repeat clients and benefit from larger, higher-value orders.

Sample responses

If someone asks you to move payments or communication outside of Fiverr, here are some suggested replies to help you politely decline while educating the user and protecting your account.

- "Unfortunately, moving payments off of Fiverr means we both lose important protections and support from the platform. It’s also against Fiverr's Terms of Service, which could lead to our accounts being suspended."
- "I value my ability to use Fiverr for future projects. Taking payments off-platform is against the terms and could risk both of us losing access to Fiverr permanently."
- "Let’s keep our discussions here on Fiverr to ensure we have everything documented and can receive support if needed."
- "I’m excited to start working with you! To keep things secure, let’s make sure we communicate on Fiverr. Once the order is placed, we’ll be able to use Fiverr’s video call feature to connect.”
- “Once the order is in progress, we can use Fiverr’s video call feature to speak directly with each other, coordinate, and align on expectations.”
Violating Fiverr’s off-platform policy may result in:
  • Warnings are issued to educate users about our policies in an effort to prevent future violations.
  • Repeated and/or severe violations may result in account suspension.
  • Users who engage in off-platform transactions will lose Fiverr’s protections, such as secure payments and dispute resolution.

For more information about actions on accounts, see How we enforce policies.

Tax Regulations for Canada, Australia, and the European Union (Clients: Trust & Safety)

The tax regulations for Canada and Australia, and the DAC7(Directive on Administrative Cooperation in the Field of Taxation) rules in the European Union require online platforms to collect and report information about our freelancers for tax purposes. To comply with this, all Fiverr freelancers who are residents in one of the EU member states, Canada and Australia must update the required DAC7 form. The information will be reported to the relevant tax authorities.

Note: Freelancers who are residents in one of the European Union member states must complete the DAC7 form within 60 days of receiving the notification. Residents in Canada and Australia must complete the DAC7 form within 67 days of receiving the notification. Failing to complete the DAC7 form may result in an account suspension and the withdrawal of funds will be blocked.

If you aren’t a resident of the EU, Canada, or Australia, but your billing address or country flag is located in the EU, Canada or Australia, contact our Customer Support team to change your location.

Data collection and reporting (or Data Privacy and Security)

When you fill in the DAC7 form, you will be required to provide your personal information, such as your full name, address, date of birth (for individuals), and your Tax Identification Number, also known as TIN. The information will be used for reporting to the relevant tax authorities and as further required by applicable laws.

You are responsible for verifying the accuracy of all information provided. Once submitted, the information cannot be edited.

Learn more with Fiverr’s Privacy Policy.

FAQs

  • A ‘Financial documents tab’ is located within your Earnings page. You will need to select ‘Edit information’ under the DAC7 document.
  • To verify that your TIN number is valid and in the correct format, please use the online checker here.
  • To continue selling on Fiverr, all EU freelancers must update the required information within 60 days of receiving the notification. Canadian and Australian freelancers will have 67 days of receiving the notification.
  • Freelancers will be notified by email, a top banner notification, and pin flash.
  • After you submit your updated information, the internal team will review it and update your status accordingly. You will be notified whether your information has been approved or rejected.
  • Freelancers residing outside the EU do not have to complete the DAC7 form.
  • Yes, if you are an EU, Canadian, or Australian resident, whether you are an individual, a business, or employed by a company, you are still required to fill out the form. If you are part of a company, fill out the form with the company’s information.
  • Individuals who don’t have a TIN can fill out their country and city of birth. Otherwise, we advise you to contact your local tax authorities for more information.
  • The information provided when filling out the DAC7 and your earnings will be reported to the relevant EU, Canadian, and Australian tax authorities.
  • It will be money earned. Fiverr considers the money earned at the time the funds have cleared and become available to withdraw.
  • The information will be reported to the relevant EU, Canadian, and Australian tax authorities.

Tips for safe face-to-face meetups (Clients: Trust & Safety)

Fiverr hosts both online and offline services. Here are some safety tips for Gigs that need face-to-face meetings.

These safety tips are suggestions. The use of local services is at your own risk. Fiverr is not responsible or liable for customer/freelancer behavior. See our Terms of Service.

Something to report?

If you have encountered unprofessional behavior from a customer or freelancer during a meeting, such as inappropriate requests for personal or payment details related to the order, please report it to Fiverr’s Customer Support team using the Contact us tab at the bottom of the page.

Before & after meeting

Here are some points to consider before (and after) meeting a customer/freelancer.

  • Make sure you only message using your Fiverr Inbox, don’t use your personal email (potential malware or virus issues) or any social networking profiles.
  • Think about the following:
    • Have the online communications been polite and professional?
    • Did they ask for personal details, payment, or something else?
    • Did they ask overly personal questions?
  • Try not to share your personal home/mobile phone number.
  • Check if your region has a free voice account similar to Google Voice.

Private information

Do not share the following info:

  • Identification: National ID, social security number, driver’s license, passport, etc.
  • Address: Home or work
  • Phone number: Home, work, mobile
  • Bank or payment details
  • Per our Terms of Service, payments are only made via Fiverr
    • When you pay via Fiverr, our Customer Support specialists can help if there is a payment issue.

Getting ready to meet

Keep a few safety measures in mind when meeting a customer/freelancer in person.

  • Did you try to learn something about the other person?
  • Search the internet, try LinkedIn, etc.
  • Is there a profile picture? You can do a reverse online search
  • Tell a trusted person the meeting address and start/end times
  • Charge your phone and maybe add a tracking app
  • Arrange your own transportation
  • Try to meet in a public place
  • Unfamiliar with the meeting locale?
  • Search for info about the neighborhood
  • Arrive early to look around
  • Meeting at a private address? If it concerns you…
  • Ask about pets, ex. Large dogs!
  • Ask if there will be disturbances, ex. children

Arrive at the meeting

  • If you are uncomfortable with the meeting location or conditions
  • If you feel uncomfortable with the conversation
  • If you think a participant is under the influence of alcohol or drugs

If the meeting goes ahead, keep in mind that you should always keep your food and/or drink in view at all times.

UGC video service guidelines (Clients: Trust & Safety)

Fiverr offers a dedicated UGC Videos section within our Video & Animation category.

Under this section, we provide two main types of services: Human UGC and AI UGC, giving buyers clear options to choose the style that best suits their needs.

UGC (User-Generated Content) videos help brands connect with audiences through content that feels native, personal, and engaging. Whether created by real people or generated with AI, UGC builds trust, boosts performance, and scales across platforms like TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.

Fiverr now offers two types of UGC services: Human UGC and AI UGC. Human UGC features real people on camera, often speaking casually or showing products in everyday settings. These videos feel natural and relatable, and are great for product demos, testimonials, and lifestyle content.

AI UGC uses tools like avatars or synthetic voiceovers to create UGC-style videos without a human on camera. It’s useful for brands that need consistency, multilingual delivery, or quick production at scale.

This structure helps buyers find the right fit for their goals and makes it easier for sellers to describe their services clearly. Whether human or AI, what matters is being transparent about how the content is made and delivering something that feels real to the viewer.

We recognize that UGC videos have become a well-established and impactful format in the digital landscape. When creating or purchasing UGC video services, follow these dos and don’ts to help maintain a fair, transparent, and trustworthy marketplace:

- [Be transparent](https://help.fiverr.com/hc/en-us/articles/34998793899665-Using-AI-on-Fiverr-guidelines-for-freelancers-and-clients#h_01JTJN5YFJN0QSSDYRT1NPTDPY) about Human vs AI production and tools used (e.g., avatar/voice model).
- Offer clear packages: number of concepts, hooks, cutdowns, ratios, captions/subtitles, revisions, raw footage (if available).
- Define turnaround & revision policy (what’s a revision vs a reshoot).
- State usage rights and upsells: paid ads, whitelisting, exclusivity, duration/territories.
- For Human UGC: secure model/talent release; confirm on-camera talent look & language.
- For AI UGC: confirm tool licenses, voice/avatar permissions, and any likeness approvals.
- Add quality bar: good lighting, clean audio, steady framing; platform-native pacing.
- If you are sharing UGC videos on social media platforms, make sure to follow each platform’s guidelines and rules for paid partnerships and promotions, including adding any relevant disclaimers and commercial disclosures.
- Promise performance results (CTR/ROAS) or make unverifiable claims.
- Use copyrighted materials such as music, fonts, or footage without a license.
- Use a person's private image, voice or other personal attributes without explicit consent.
- Avoid presenting yourself in a way that could mislead others about your qualifications or credentials. For example, do not wear clothing or use props (such as a lab coat) that might cause someone to believe you hold a professional license or certification if you do not.

For additional information about Fiverr’s services and policies, please review our Community Standards.

Using AI on Fiverr: Guidelines for freelancers and clients (Clients: Trust & Safety)

As artificial intelligence continues to shape how we work, Fiverr allows its responsible use to help freelancers deliver better results and assist clients more effectively. AI tools are now a part of many professional workflows - from writing assistants to image generation, automation, and data analysis - and Fiverr supports these tools when they are used responsibly and in line with Fiverr’s standards.

This article outlines Fiverr’s guidelines on AI usage for both clients and freelancers, focusing on expectations, communication, and the authorized practices in accordance with Fiverr’s policies.

Fiverr’s approach to AI integration

AI tools can enhance creativity, improve productivity, and streamline processes. Fiverr permits the use of AI across all service categories. Whether you’re delivering a logo, writing content, analyzing data, or building a website, AI can be part of your toolkit, like any other professional tool.

AI use is encouraged, as long as it’s:

  • Responsible and appropriate for the service being provided.
  • Compliant with laws and platform standards.
  • Used to support the freelancer’s own skill and effort, not as a replacement for them, while delivering high-quality, customized work tailored to the client’s needs.

Fiverr supports the innovative use of AI while maintaining standards that protect the trust, quality, and integrity of the marketplace. Misuse of AI that infringes on privacy, deceives others, or manipulates reality, regardless of intent, is not tolerated on the platform.

AI use expectations for freelancers

Freelancers using AI are expected to adhere to Fiverr’s Community Standards on AI-generated Content, ensuring that their use of AI tools is ethical, legal, and transparent.

AI tools may be used to assist freelancers in completing their work, but they are not a substitute for freelancers’ own skill and effort. Freelancers are fully accountable for the final work they deliver. Any AI-generated or AI-assisted work must be high-quality, original, and meaningfully refined and customized to the client’s specific requirements. Generic, unmodified, or reused AI output does not meet Fiverr’s quality standards.

Freelancers must also honor a client’s explicit request for non-AI work. When a client specifies this preference, before or at the start of an order, freelancers are expected to disclose their intended workflow and align accordingly.

The role of communication: Set expectations early

For clients

If you do not want AI used in your order, it’s essential to say so clearly, either before placing the order or immediately after. Freelancers do not necessarily disclose all the tools they use in their Gigs, so early communication ensures alignment.

For freelancers

You are encouraged to:

  • Ask about client preferences during the order discussion.
  • Clarify your workflow when needed.
  • Stay transparent and responsive, especially if AI use might affect the creative direction or output style.

Strong communication leads to better outcomes and fewer misunderstandings.

Prohibited AI uses: What’s not allowed on Fiverr

  • Deceptive synthetic and manipulated media (Deepfakes): Creating or using AI-generated videos, images, or voices that mimic real individuals without their consent, particularly for deceptive or malicious purposes.
  • Unauthorized use of voice or likeness: Using someone’s voice, image, or likeness without proper authorization or rights.
  • Fraudulent activities: Generating or editing content to falsify documents, identities, or affiliations.
  • Misrepresentation: Designing avatars, images, or content intended to mislead others about a person’s true identity, role, or intent.
  • Harmful or inappropriate content: Producing AI-generated material that violates privacy, promotes violence, hate speech, or discrimination, or spreads misinformation.
  • Manipulating public perception: Using AI to create or alter images, videos, or content in a way that distorts reality or influences public opinion under false pretenses, especially in sensitive areas such as politics or current events.

The use of AI for these prohibited activities is strictly forbidden to ensure responsible, ethical, and legal use while maintaining trust, professionalism, and safety.

What happens if there’s a dispute?

If a concern is raised about AI use after an order is delivered, Fiverr reviews the full context of the order rather than focusing on AI use alone. The following factors are taken into account:

  • Whether the client clearly communicated their expectations regarding AI use before or at the start of the order.
  • Whether the delivery is of good quality, accurate, free from clear mistakes or AI-generated hallucinations, and tailored to the client’s specific needs, rather than appearing generic or templated.
  • Whether the delivery reflects the freelancer’s own professional effort and meaningful input, rather than merely raw AI-generated output.
  • Whether both parties communicated professionally and responsively throughout the order.

If we identify a trust breach, including deception about how work was delivered, misrepresentation of AI usage, or failure to meet the platform’s quality standards, the order may be cancelled, the client may receive a full refund, and the freelancer’s account may be permanently suspended.

Our focus is on the overall service experience and the quality of the final delivery. The same standards apply to all work delivered on Fiverr, whether or not AI tools were used.

W-9 collection (Clients: Trust & Safety)

Defining a freelancer on Fiverr as a “U.S. person” (as defined by the IRS) requires W-9 collection.

The W-9 form will be collected from all relevant freelancers; U.S. tax authorities may request the W-9, 1099K form, and information regarding your activity on Fiverr.

Data privacy and security

When you will fill in the W-9 form, you will be required to provide your personal information, such as your full name, address, and social security number.

In certain circumstances, we may disclose the data in your W-9 form, and other tax forms (such as 1099K form), as well as other information related to your use of Fiverr (such as your earnings on Fiverr), with applicable U.S. tax authorities, or as otherwise required by applicable law. We also share such information with service providers we use to collect and process your information. We will not use the information included in the W-9 form for any other purpose. We will retain the information listed on the W-9 form for as long as required by applicable laws.

We use strict procedures and security features to prevent unauthorized access to the data included in the W-9 form, and the transmission of your data is also protected by SSL encryption. Once you have filled out your W-9 form, we will automatically activate Two-factor Authentication (2FA) on your next login.

Learn more with Fiverr’s Privacy Policy.
