  • Fiverr is legally obligated to retain W-9 forms for freelancers and potential freelancers. The information is used solely for tax purposes. If a user is ineligible to sell and has no selling history on Fiverr, the W-9 form can be removed upon request.

Freelancers: Account settings & security

Account access troubleshooting guide (Freelancers: Account settings & security)

If you’re having trouble accessing your account, this article walks you through the most common reasons and how to resolve them. Each section covers a specific scenario, so you can find the one that matches your situation and follow the steps to get back in.

Before you begin

This article applies to all Fiverr users. If you need to complete phone verification as part of any of the steps below, use a desktop browser. Phone verification is not available on the Fiverr mobile app.

Forgot your password or not receiving the reset email

If you forgot your password, you can reset it from the login page.

  • Go to Fiverr.com and click Sign in.
  • Select Continue with username/email.
  • Click Forgot password?
  • Enter your email address and click Reset password.
  • Check your inbox for the reset email and follow the link.

If you’re not receiving the reset email or the link isn’t working, try the following:

  • Clear your browser’s cache and cookies.
  • Check that the email address you entered is correct and has no typos.
  • Check all folders in your inbox, including spam and junk.
  • If your email is on a private domain, confirm that no additional filters are blocking messages from Fiverr.
  • Temporarily disable password and saving add-ons like LastPass.
  • If you’ve been locked out after too many incorrect attempts, wait 24 hours before trying again.
  • If you don’t have access to your registered email address, contact our Customer Support team.

For more information on managing your password, security question, and two-factor authentication, see Password, security question, and two-factor authentication.

Not receiving your email verification code

If you’re not receiving a verification code sent to your email, try the following:

  • Check your spam and junk folders.
  • If your email is on a private domain, confirm that no additional filters are blocking messages from Fiverr.
  • Verification codes expire after 10 minutes. If your code expired, request a new one and enter it right away.
  • Only the most recent code is valid. If you requested multiple codes, use the latest one.
  • If the issue persists after trying these steps, contact our Customer Support team.

Not receiving your SMS verification code

If your account is phone-verified and you’re not receiving the SMS code, try the following:

  • Make sure your phone has a signal and can receive international messages.
  • Only the most recent code is valid. If you requested multiple codes, use the latest one.
  • Verification codes expire after 10 minutes. If your code expired, request a new one and enter it right away.
  • Some carriers and regions have limitations on receiving SMS from international senders. Check with your provider if restrictions apply.
  • If the issue persists, contact our Customer Support team to verify ownership of your account and update your number.

Automatically logged out due to suspicious activity

If we detect suspicious activity on your account, we automatically log you out of all devices and require you to reset your password before you can log back in. This is a security measure to protect your account.

To regain access:

  • Go to Fiverr.com and click Sign in.
  • Click Forgot password? and follow the reset steps.

Once you’re back in, we strongly recommend you:

  • Enable two-factor authentication (2FA).
  • Review your connected devices and remove any you don’t recognize.
  • Run an antivirus scan on your device.

Can’t reset your password or forgot your email or username

If you’re unable to reset your password because you’ve lost access to your registered email, or you’ve forgotten your email or username, our Customer Support team can help after verifying that you own the account.

To help us verify your ownership, have the following ready:

As a freelancer:

  • The answer to your security question.
  • Your full registered phone number.
  • Your Payoneer ID or PayPal email address used for withdrawals.

As a client:

  • The first six and last four digits of your credit card, along with the expiration date.

Once we verify your ownership, we can update your email, reset your phone number, or reset your security question. Note that we can only update one security detail per 24 hours. After your email is updated, you can reset your password from the login page.

Security question is blocking you

Your security question is required to change your phone number or update your security question itself. If the system isn’t accepting your answer, check the following before contacting us:

  • The answer field is case-sensitive. Make sure you’re using the correct upper and lower case letters.
  • Do not add spaces before or after your answer.

Security question answers are limited to 20 characters; the system won’t accept longer answers even if correct. If your answer isn’t working or you’ve forgotten it, contact our Customer Support team. After we verify your ownership, we can reset your security question so you can set a new one.

For setup instructions, see Password, security question, and two-factor authentication.

Lost access to your registered email or phone number

If you no longer have access to the email address or phone number on your account, contact our Customer Support team. After we verify your ownership, we can update your email address or reset your phone number.

To help us verify your ownership, provide the following:

  • Your Fiverr username.
  • The registered email address or phone number on the account, even if you no longer have access to it.
  • The new email address you’d like to use.

As a freelancer, also provide:

  • Your Payoneer ID or PayPal email address used for withdrawals.

As a client, also provide:

  • The first six and last four digits of the last card used on the account, along with the expiration date.

Once we confirm your ownership, we update your email address so you can regain access.

If you can contact us from your registered email address, that’s the fastest way to verify ownership.

Restoring a closed account

If you previously closed your account and want to restore it, contact our Customer Support team.

  • Contact us using the email address registered on the account. If you can’t, provide your username and email address.
  • Our Customer Support team will review your request and confirm whether reactivation is possible.
  • Once reactivated, log in using your existing credentials. If you don’t remember your password, reset it from the login page.
  • After logging in, make sure your email address, phone number, and security question are up to date.

If your account was closed for more than a year, it may have been automatically deleted and cannot be restored. For more information, see How to deactivate or permanently delete your account.

Account disabled or restricted

If your account has been disabled or restricted, the steps below can help you resolve it. Common reasons include violations of our Terms of Service or Community Standards, payment disputes, pending ID verification, or missing financial documents such as tax forms or DAC7.

To resolve your restriction:

  • Review our Terms of Service and Community Standards to understand what may have triggered it.
  • Complete any pending ID verification or submit any required financial documents.
  • Contact our Customer Support team from your registered email address at support@fiverr.com for further assistance.

A few things to know while your account is restricted:

  • Your balance stays in your account. You can withdraw your funds after 90 days.
  • Creating a new account after yours has been disabled is not allowed.
  • You have the right to appeal by contacting our support team, as stated in our Terms of Service.

For help completing ID verification, see Verify your identity or Verifying your identity as a new freelancer.

FAQs

  • Yes. After we verify your ownership, we can temporarily disable 2FA or clear the old phone number so you can add a new one. Contact our Customer Support team to start this process.
  • We automatically log you out if our system detects suspicious activity on your account. This protects your account from unauthorized access. You’ll need to reset your password to log back in. If you didn’t trigger this yourself, we recommend running an antivirus scan and enabling 2FA after regaining access.
  • This can happen if a new verification requirement was added after your previous one completed, or if the restriction is related to a policy issue rather than verification. Sign out and back in, then check your account settings. If you’re still restricted, contact our Customer Support team with a screenshot of what you see so we can review and reset the flow if needed.

Creating your Fiverr account (Freelancers: Account settings & security)

Your Fiverr account is your starting point for everything you do on Fiverr, whether you want to order services or offer your own. Every account begins as a client account, and you can activate a freelancer account whenever you are ready to offer services. This article explains the account types and walks you through creating a client account and activating a freelancer account.

Before you begin

All users must be at least 18 years of age and of legal age to form a binding contract. Users under 18 and at least 13 years of age may use Fiverr only through an account owned by their parent or legal guardian, with permission. Users under the age of 13 are not permitted to use Fiverr.

  • Activating a freelancer account is only available on desktop.
  • Creating a Gig is only available on desktop.
  • All freelancers are reviewed during sign-up and Gig creation, and are subject to approval by Fiverr. Learn more with our Terms of Service.

Types of accounts

All Fiverr accounts are client accounts by default. A client account becomes a freelancer account only when you choose to offer services on Fiverr. The table below shows what each account type lets you do.

Account type

What you can do

Client

Order services (Gigs) from freelancers on Fiverr. Every Fiverr account starts as a client account by default.

Freelancer

Offer your services through Gigs to clients. A client account becomes a freelancer account when you choose to offer services.

Fiverr Pro client

Order from freelancers with enhanced capabilities, at no additional cost. This account keeps your freelance work organized in one central place. Fiverr Pro accounts are for ordering only and cannot be converted to a freelancer account. Learn more with Fiverr Pro: Creating your account.

Creating a client account

Follow these steps to create your client account.

  • Go to Fiverr’s homepage and click Join at the top of the page.
  • Click Continue with Email, then enter your email address and password.
    • You can also join with Facebook, Google Connect, or Apple Connect.
  • Choose a username to start your profile.
  • Activate your account.
    • Open your email inbox and copy the verification code.
    • Enter the code in the Fiverr window to complete activation.
    • After activating your account, you can contact freelancers or place your first order.
  • Personalize your experience by answering a few quick questions.
  • Your account is now created. You can now create your freelancer account.

Activating your freelancer account

Before you activate your freelancer account, make sure the email address on your Fiverr account is correct and is the one you want to use as a freelancer. If it is not correct, or if you want to use a different email to offer services, you can change your email or contact Support for help.

  • Log in to your Fiverr account, click your profile picture, then select Become a Seller from the dropdown menu.
  • On the next page, click Become a Seller again to start onboarding. This includes watching three videos on how to use Fiverr as a freelancer.
  • After the videos, review Fiverr’s tips on what makes a successful profile and what to avoid as a freelancer, then click Continue.
  • Complete the mandatory fields, marked with an asterisk. Use only truthful and accurate information about your training, work experience, and skills.
  • Verify your account using your phone. Learn more with Verifying your account using your phone.
  • Create your first Gig to offer your services as a freelancer. Learn more with Creating a Gig.

Note: The more accurate and detailed the information you add, the stronger your freelancer profile will be.

FAQs

  • No. You may only have one freelancer account on Fiverr.
  • No. Activating a freelancer account and creating a Gig are only available on desktop.
  • No. Your username cannot be changed once your account is created. You can edit your display name. Learn more with Managing your display name.
  • No. Every Fiverr account is a client account by default, so you can order services as soon as you activate your account.
  • A Fiverr Pro client account lets you order from freelancers with enhanced capabilities, at no additional cost, and keeps your freelance work organized in one place. Fiverr Pro accounts are for ordering only and cannot be converted to a freelancer account. Learn more with Fiverr Pro: Creating your account.
  • Open your email inbox, copy the verification code, and enter it in the Fiverr window to complete activation.

How to deactivate or permanently delete your account (Freelancers: Account settings & security)

Choosing the right option matters. Deactivating pauses your account and is reversible for 12 months. Permanently deleting erases your access to invoices, orders, and messages. This article helps you pick the right option and walks you through it on desktop web, iOS, and Android.

Before you begin

This applies to any Fiverr account, client or freelancer, on desktop web, iOS, or Android. The following account type restrictions apply to both deactivating and deleting:

  • Fiverr Marketplace (client or freelancer): Deactivate or delete your account yourself, on desktop web or in the app.
  • Locked out or can’t log in: Contact support.
  • Restricted account: Contact support using your account’s registered email address.
  • Fiverr Pro admin: Downgrade to Fiverr Marketplace first, then deactivate or delete.
  • Fiverr Pro member: Ask your admin to remove you from the team first.

Deactivate vs. delete: which is right for you?

Deactivate

Permanently delete

What it does

Hides your profile and pauses your account. You can log back in and reactivate anytime within 12 months.

Removes your account and its data. Cannot be reversed.

How long it takes

Immediate.

Up to 30 days after you confirm.

Reversible?

Yes, within 12 months.

No.

What happens to your reviews and messages

They stay on Fiverr while you’re deactivated.

Messages or files you’ve sent to others, and ratings and reviews you’ve published, will not be deleted if the recipient’s account is still active, as they’re part of other users’ order history. They will appear anonymized (your identifying information will be removed).

Best for

Taking a break, or being unsure if you’ll come back.

Being certain you no longer want a Fiverr account.

If you’re not sure, deactivate first. You can always come back and delete later.

How to deactivate your Fiverr account?

After 12 months of deactivation, your account is deleted automatically and cannot be reactivated.

  • To deactivate your account on desktop web, follow these steps:
    • Click your profile picture (top right) and select Account settings.
    • Click Personal information.
    • Click Deactivate account.
    • Select a reason from the dropdown.
    • Click Deactivate account.
  • To deactivate your account in the Fiverr iOS or Android app, make sure your app is on the latest version, then follow these steps:
    • Tap your profile icon.
    • Under Settings, tap Account → Account management.
    • Tap Deactivation and deletion → Deactivate account.
    • Continue to Account deactivation.
    • Select a reason from the dropdown.
    • Tap Deactivate account.
How to reactivate a deactivated account?

If you change your mind within 12 months, contact support, and we’ll reactivate your account.

How to permanently delete your Fiverr account?

Deleting your account is irreversible. Once you confirm deletion, your account cannot be reactivated, and the deletion can’t be undone. Download anything you need first, including invoices, order files, and messages, because you won’t be able to access them afterward, and they cannot be retrieved.

What to sort out before deleting?

Before you delete permanently, resolve anything that applies to your account:

  • Active orders: Cancel or complete any open orders where you’re the client or the freelancer.
  • Available balance: Withdraw your earnings, or refund any refundable balance to your payment method.
  • Outstanding debt: Pay off any debt on your account.
  • Active subscription: Cancel it yourself. Deleting your account won’t cancel it for you.
  • Non-withdrawable Fiverr Credits: Use these before you delete. Unused credits are forfeited automatically.
  • Earnings waiting clearance: Wait for these to clear before deleting.
How to delete your account?
  • To delete your account, follow these steps:
    • Click your profile picture (top right) and select Account settings.
    • Click Personal information.
    • Click Deactivate account.
    • Select a reason from the dropdown.
    • Click Deactivate account.
    • Click Contact support to request the account’s deletion.
  • To delete your account in the Fiverr iOS or Android app, make sure your app is on the latest version, then follow these steps:
    • Tap your profile icon.
    • Under Settings, tap Account → Account management.
    • Tap Deactivation and deletion → Delete account.
    • Continue to Account deletion.
    • Select a reason from the dropdown.
    • Tap Delete account.

Both the mobile app and contacting support produce the same result. The only difference is where you start.

What happens next?
  • Your account is deactivated immediately.
  • Full erasure completes within 30 days.
  • You will not receive a confirmation email when erasure finishes.
What if you can’t delete your account yourself?

Some accounts can’t use the self-service flow, for example, if your account is restricted or permanently disabled. In these cases, contact Support for help.

What happens to your data when you delete?

Once deleted, your account can’t be restored. Your personal data will be deleted from Fiverr, but some information may be retained for purposes such as record-keeping, security, fraud prevention, and complying with applicable laws.

  • Billing information, invoices, files, and deliveries: You’ll lose access to your billing information, invoices, and files associated with your account. We recommend downloading them before proceeding.
  • Messages, ratings, and reviews: Any messages or files you’ve sent to others, or ratings and reviews you’ve published, will not be deleted if the recipient’s account is still active, but will appear anonymized.
  • Opening a new account: You may not be able to open a new account using the same username, email, or phone number associated with the deleted account.

To learn more, visit Data and privacy on Fiverr and Fiverr’s Privacy Policy.

Can I reuse my email, phone, or username after deletion?

When your account is deleted, your username is anonymized and cannot be reused.

Some of your personal data may be retained for purposes such as security, fraud prevention, and complying with applicable laws. Therefore, you might not be able to reuse your email address and phone number to open a new account after deletion.

If you want to use the same email address or phone number to open a new account after deletion, make sure you don’t have another open account with these details. Even then, we can’t guarantee they will be released once your account is deleted.

FAQs

  • Up to 30 days from the moment you confirm. Your account is deactivated immediately, and full erasure completes within 30 days.
  • No. The on-screen confirmation you see right after clicking Delete is the only notification.
  • No. Deletion is final from the moment you confirm.
  • If you’re on Fiverr Pro, admins need to downgrade to Fiverr Marketplace first. Pro members need their admin to remove them from the team.
  • If your account is restricted or permanently disabled, contact support using your account’s registered email address.

ID verification: Data protection and usage (Freelancers: Account settings & security)

We handle your ID information carefully and only use it to verify your account and to create a safe and secure marketplace. This article explains what to expect when we ask you to verify your identity with an official government ID, including how we protect that information, why we collect it, and how long we keep it.

Who this applies to

Fiverr may ask any freelancer to verify their identity with an official government ID. When we ask you to complete ID verification, this article explains how we handle that information.

Data privacy and security

We take the security of the site and your information seriously. We use industry-standard technologies and internal procedures to prevent unauthorized access to your data.

Learn more in our Privacy Policy.

Why we collect and use your ID information

We collect and process ID cards to help build a trustworthy marketplace and enforce our Terms of Service. This process allows us to:

  • Improve trust in the marketplace and service quality
  • Secure our platform and prevent fraud, for example, freelancers misrepresenting themselves
  • Recover hijacked accounts and confirm ownership of freelancer accounts
  • Enforce Fiverr’s Terms of Service
  • Confirm that users are at least 18 years old
  • Confirm that users comply with applicable laws

The importance of ID verification

ID verification helps us maintain high security standards for you and the rest of the Fiverr community.

We do not use your identification card for any other purpose, including marketing, and we do not share it with other users. We keep the copy of your identification card only for as long as required for these safety purposes.

Learn more in our Privacy Policy, which governs how we process ID verification data. If you believe your ID is not necessary for these purposes, open a Customer Support ticket using the Contact us tab at the bottom of the page.

How long we keep your data

We keep the copy of your identification document for 30 days and your selfie for 60 days. After this period, we retain only your name, date of birth, gender, hashed ID number, document type, and document country.

The copy of your identification document and the personal information you provided when performing the ID verification process are kept in order to verify your account or the identity you reported to us, and create a safe and secure marketplace for our community.

Learn more in our Privacy Policy.

You can ask us to delete this information at any time. In some cases, this may restrict your account. Contact our Customer Support team using the Contact us tab at the bottom of the page if you have questions.

Summary

ID verification helps us build a safer marketplace, while keeping your personal data secure and retained only as long as necessary.

Managing your account settings (Freelancers: Account settings & security)

Your account settings page is the central hub for managing your personal information, security preferences, and account status on Fiverr. This article explains what each section contains and how to update your settings.

Before you begin

To access your account settings, click your profile picture and select Account Settings.

You must verify your email address before you can edit your account settings. Restricted accounts cannot edit settings.

Personal information

This section lets you manage the following:

  • Your full name is used for internal verification only and is not displayed publicly on your profile. To update it, click Edit next to your name, enter the new name, and click Save.
  • Full name requirements:
    • Between 2 and 50 characters
    • Must start with a letter, number, or underscore
    • Only English letters, numbers, and the following characters are allowed: - _ @ +
  • Your email address is used for all Fiverr communications and notifications. To change it, follow these steps.
  • If your account has a verified phone number:
    • Go to Account Settings and enter your new email address in the Email field, then click Save.
    • Click the confirmation link sent to your new email address.
    • Enter the verification code sent to your phone.
  • If your account does not have a verified phone number:
    • Go to Account Settings and enter your new email address in the Email field, then click Save.
    • Click the confirmation link sent to your old email address and log back in to Fiverr.
    • Go to your new email account and click the second confirmation link.
  • If you do not have access to your registered phone number, contact Customer Support for help.
  • Your online status controls how you appear to other users. The default is online.
    • For freelancers: Being set to online makes you visible under the “online freelancers” filter in search results, and shows you as online to other users.
    • For clients: Being set to online shows you as online to other users.
  • To change your status, click Edit next to Online status, choose a duration from the dropdown (1 hour, 1 day, 1 week, or Forever), and click Save. To go back online, select Go Online from the same dropdown.
  • If you no longer need your account, you can deactivate it directly from Account Settings. Note that users with active orders cannot close their account.
  • Learn more in the article How to deactivate or permanently delete your account.

Account security

This section contains your security settings:

  • Change password: Update your password to keep your account secure.
  • Security question: Set up a security question to help verify your identity if you need to recover your account.
  • Two-factor authentication (2FA): Add an extra layer of security that requires a second verification step when you log in.
  • Phone verification: Verifying your phone number adds an essential layer of security to your account.
  • Connected devices: View all devices and locations that have logged in to your account. Use this to monitor for suspicious activity and log out of devices you no longer use.

For more detail on passwords, security questions, and 2FA, see the article Password, security question, and two-factor authentication.

Notifications

To view your notifications, click the bell icon at the top of the page. To change your notification preferences, go to Account Settings > Notifications, or click the Settings icon at the bottom of the notifications panel.

  • Select how you want notifications delivered: via Email or as a Push notification.
  • Check or uncheck boxes to turn specific notification types on or off.
  • Use the Real-time notifications toggle to turn on-screen updates on or off.
  • Use the Sound effects toggle to enable or disable notification sounds.
  • Click Update preferences to save your changes.

Android tip: If you experience delayed notifications on Android, go to Settings > Battery > Battery optimization, find Fiverr in the app list, and select Don’t optimize or Allow background activity. Steps may vary by device.

Personal & business information (freelancers only)

This section is required for freelancers only to comply with Digital Services Act (DSA) regulations. It allows you to verify your personal and business information. For full details, see the article Personal and business information verification.

FAQs

  • Your email address must be verified before you can edit your settings. Restricted accounts also cannot make changes to account settings.
  • Check that your name is between 2 and 50 characters, starts with a letter, number, or underscore, and only uses English letters, numbers, or the characters - _ @ +.
  • Contact Customer Support for help with email changes when you no longer have access to your registered phone.
  • For freelancers, setting yourself to offline removes you from the “online freelancers” search filter. For clients, it simply hides your online status from other users. You can set it to offline for 1 hour, 1 day, 1 week, or Forever, and switch back anytime by selecting Go Online.
  • No. You must wait until all active orders are completed or resolved before you can deactivate or delete your account.

Managing your display name (Freelancers: Account settings & security)

Your display name is the name shown publicly on your Fiverr profile. It helps others identify you on the platform and adds a personal touch to your presence. Using your real name or a consistent professional identity helps users feel confident they are working with which supports a safer, more trustworthy marketplace.

Your display name explained

Whether you’re a client looking to personalize your profile or a freelancer building a brand, your display name plays an important role in how you’re recognized on Fiverr. It appears in places like messages, reviews, and your public profile.

Note: Your display name is different from your username, which is your permanent Fiverr account ID and cannot be changed.

Edit your display name
  • Log in and switch to your selling view.
  • Click your profile picture, navigate to your profile, and click the pencil icon next to your display name.
  • Edit your name and save your changes.

Note: The names will be saved automatically and will be displayed according to standardized capitalization practices. For example, Joseph will be saved as Joseph, and David will be saved as David.

Guidelines

Here’s what you need to know when creating your display name, including requirements, best practices, and specific examples.

  • Best practice: We recommend using your first name and the initial of your last name.
  • For instance, if your name is Daniel Zee and you go by Danny, consider “Daniel Z” or “Danny Z”.

Following this best practice establishes a sense of trust even before a project begins. Choosing a display name that reflects your real identity is important for users to clearly know who they’re working with. We recommend avoiding misleading names that may affect how other users perceive you in the marketplace.

  • Your display name must:
    • Be your real name or a name that represents you (nickname).
      • Refrain from creating a display name that is far from your identity.
      • Please don’t invent a name that is irrelevant or unrelated/dissimilar to your real name.
    • Only have English letters and spaces are allowed.
    • Must be aligned with our Community Standards.
    • Not have special characters (except for periods and apostrophes) or numbers.
  • Examples:
    • Danny Z.
    • Dee 4 Designs
    • Zee’s Designs
    • ‘Z’ Designs
  • For individuals with multiple first, middle or last names:
    • Try to pick one name for your first and one letter (initial) for your last name.
    • For example: “Shirley Ann Jackson” can be “Shirley J.” or “Shirley Ann J.”
  • For individuals with long names:
    • We recommend that you use an abbreviation, a representative nickname, or an initial for your last name.
    • For example: “Shashikant” can be “Shashi”. “Christopher Blinko” can be “Christopher B”, “Christopher”, “Chris B.”, or “Chris”.
  • Your display name can’t contain:
    • The name of your service (e.g., SEO, graphic, design)
    • Professions (e.g., Designer, Developer)
    • Adjectives (e.g., expert, best)
    • Pro, level 1, level 2, top rated, Fiverr
  • Agency
    • You can choose either the name of your agency/business or the name of the person that is responsible for communication.
    • For example: “Rocket Designs” or “Sam D.”
  • Long agency/business names
    • If your name exceeds the 15-character limit, use abbreviations that are aligned with your main brand name.
  • For example: “Rocket and Beyond designs” can be “Rocket designs”

Password, security question, and two-factor authentication (Freelancers: Account settings & security)

Learn how to keep your Fiverr account secure by managing your password, setting up a security question, and using two-factor authentication (2FA).

To add, manage and remove your password, security question, or two-factor authentication please follow these steps:

  • Go to your profile image and select Account Settings.
  • Select Account Security.
  • Choose the topic you want to manage and select it from the menu.

Password

Your password is the primary layer of security for your Fiverr account. It is created during sign-up and used for all logins. Never share your password with anyone.

Customer Support will never ask for your password. It should always remain private and known only to you.

Password requirements
  • Must begin with a letter
  • Between 8 and 30 characters
  • Must contain both upper and lower case letters
  • Must contain both letters and numbers
  • Cannot be a password you have used before
How to change your password

If you are signed in and remember your current password:

  • Go to your profile image and select Account Settings.
  • Select Account Security.
  • In the Change password section, enter your current password, then your new password.
  • Click Update password.

If your account has a verified phone number, you will be prompted to enter a verification code before the change is confirmed.

  • If you have forgotten your password or signed up with a social account and do not have a password set:
    • Go to Fiverr.com and click Sign in.
    • Select Continue with username/email.
    • Click Forgot password?
    • Enter your email address and click Reset password.
    • If the email matches an account, a password reset link will be sent to that address. Click the link and follow the instructions to set a new password.
  • If your account has a verified phone number, you will need to pass phone verification before you can enter your new password.
    • Clear your browser’s cache and cookies.
    • Double-check the email address for typos.
    • Check all folders in your inbox, including spam.
    • Temporarily disable any password-saving browser extensions such as LastPass.
    • If you are locked out after too many incorrect password attempts, wait 24 hours before trying again.
    • If you do not have access to your registered email address, contact Customer Support.
  • If you signed up with a social account (such as Google or Facebook), you may need to log in through that connection rather than with an email and password.

Security question

A security question adds an extra layer of verification to your account. You may be asked to answer it when making certain changes. Make sure your answer is something only you would know.

Customer Support may also ask for your answer to verify account ownership, this will always be done through an official support request.

Security answer requirements

  • The answer is case-sensitive. Use the correct upper/lower case.

  • Do not include spaces.

  • Maximum 20 characters.

    • Go to your profile image and select Account Settings.
    • Select Account Security.
    • In the Security question section, click Set.
    • Choose your question, enter your answer, and click Submit.
    • Go to your profile image and select Account Settings.
    • Select Account Security.
    • In the Security question section, click Edit.
    • Answer your existing question.
    • Choose a new question, enter your answer, and click Submit.

  • If you cannot remember your current answer, click I forgot and follow the instructions.

Two-factor authentication (2FA)

Two-factor authentication adds an extra layer of security to your account. When you log in from a new or unrecognised device, you will be asked to verify your identity using a code in addition to your password.

This means that even if someone knows your password, they cannot access your account without the second factor.

2FA is available on web, iOS, and Android.

When 2FA is triggered

You will be asked to verify your identity when:

  • Logging in from a new or different device

  • Logging in from the same device using a new browser

  • Logging in from the same device using incognito or private mode

  • Logging in from the same device after clearing your browser cache and cookies

  • Logging in from the same device after removing it from your connected devices list

    • Go to your profile image and select Account Settings.
    • Select Account Security.
    • Scroll down to the Two-factor authentication section and click Edit.
    • Select or unselect Enable 2FA.

  • 2FA cannot be completely removed from your account. If you disable it, you will still receive notifications when a new device logs in, but you will not be asked to enter a verification code.

  • When 2FA is triggered, you can choose how to receive your verification code:

    • Email
    • SMS or WhatsApp (if your phone number is verified)
    • Notification on an already logged-in device

  • Enter the code you receive to complete the login. You will also receive an email notification whenever a new device logs into your account.

  • If you did not authorize this login, change your password immediately from your security settings.

    • Go to your profile image and select Account Settings.
    • Select Account Security.
    • Scroll down to Connected devices, click Manage.
    • Find the connected device you want to remove and click Disconnect device and log out.

FAQs

  • No. Your password is private and not visible to anyone, including Customer Support. Fiverr will never ask for your password.
  • Fiverr’s security system automatically logs users out of all devices and resets their password if it detects suspicious activity or a potential account breach. If this happens and you did not request it, contact Customer Support immediately.
  • This can happen if you cleared your browser cache or cookies, switched to a new browser, used incognito mode, or removed the device from your connected devices list. All of these actions cause Fiverr to treat your device as new.
  • You can turn off the 2FA toggle, but 2FA cannot be completely removed from your account. You will still receive login notifications when a new device signs in.
  • Try logging in from a device that is already verified. If you cannot access any of your verified devices or contact methods, reach out to Customer Support for help with account recovery.
  • For Facebook or Google, you can disconnect the link directly from those accounts. For other social platforms, contact Customer Support.

Phone verification: Secure your Fiverr account (Freelancers: Account settings & security)

Phone verification is a security measure that links the phone number to your Fiverr account. It helps enhance your account security and maintain trust within the marketplace, while meeting required security standards.

The phone number you provide is used for verification purposes only. It won’t be shared with third parties or used for marketing.

Who is it for?

  • All freelancers on Fiverr must verify their phone numbers before offering services. This step is necessary for the Gig creation process.
  • For new clients registering with an email address: You will be asked to verify your phone number when you attempt to communicate with another Fiverr user.
  • For existing users: We recommend verifying your phone number in your security settings to better protect your account.

Before you begin

Keep these few key points in mind to ensure the verification process goes smoothly:

  • The phone number you’re using is operational, valid, and reliable.
  • The verification process must be initiated via a desktop/PC and cannot be completed on a mobile device.
  • A phone number can be associated with only one Fiverr account.
  • Ensure “Do Not Disturb” is turned off.
  • Google Voice and similar VOIP services are not supported.

How to verify your phone?

Keep in mind that verification attempts are limited. You can try twice via text and once via phone, and only one phone number can be verified every 24 hours.

Follow these steps to complete phone verification on your account:

For new users:

When you create a new account and you attempt to communicate with another Fiverr user, you will be prompted to verify your phone number.

When you are prompted to verify:

  • Select your country (if not preselected) and enter your phone number.
  • Click on send code to receive a verification code via text message (SMS or WhatsApp, depending on your country).
  • Insert the received verification code.
For existing users and freelancers:

You can add or update your phone number at any time from your account settings.

  • Log in and click your Profile picture Account settings Account security.
  • Under Phone verification, click Verify Now.
  • Enter your phone number.
  • Click on verify by text to receive a verification code via text message (SMS or WhatsApp, depending on your country).
  • Insert the received verification code.
  • Add a Security question to complete verification (if it wasn’t added before).

How to change your verified phone number?

If you need to update your phone number:

  • Log in and click your Profile picture Account settings Account security.
  • Under Phone Verification, click Edit.
  • Answer your Security question.
  • Provide your old phone number (you do not need to have access to that number).
  • If you cannot remember your security question or old phone number, please contact Customer Support.
  • Enter your new number.
  • Click on verify by text to receive a verification code to your new number via text message (SMS or WhatsApp, depending on your country)
  • Insert the received verification code.

After updating your phone number, you must wait 48 hours before you can withdraw your funds again.

Limitations

If you experience issues while verifying, please keep these rules and common errors in mind:

  • You can only request a verification code up to 5 times within a 24-hour period. If you exceed this limit, you must wait 24 hours before trying again.
  • Once requested, you must use the code within the next 10 minutes of it being sent. The code will expire after this time.
  • Virtual numbers, landlines, and VoIP (Voice over IP) services are not compatible with the verification system.
  • Each phone number can only be linked to one Fiverr account. If a number is already associated with another account, even if that account is disabled, it cannot be used again.
  • Numbers should be entered without leading zeros, spaces, or special characters.
  • SMS codes can take up to 10 minutes to arrive depending on your local carrier. Requesting a new code before this time window expires may reset the process or lead to a temporary block.

Troubleshooting

If you’re having issues with the phone verification process, try the troubleshooting steps below.

If the problem persists, please contact Customer Support.

  • Ensure you are using a laptop or PC, as the process cannot be completed on a mobile device.
  • If the ‘Verify’ button is greyed out, complete the process on a computer.
  • Clear your browser’s cache and cookies.
  • Use incognito mode or a different browser.
  • If you are not receiving a verification code:
    • Check that your phone is updated and that no apps are blocking or filtering SMS/WhatsApp messages.
    • Wait 30–60 minutes before trying again, and avoid making multiple requests in a short period.
    • Restart your device to help it reconnect to the local network, or try using another internet connection.
    • Try using the same SIM card on a different phone or test your phone with another SIM card.
  • If you signed up to Fiverr via email you can log out and log back in activating the one-click login using your Google, Apple, or Facebook account. This way, no phone number is needed. Note that this does not apply to freelancer accounts.

FAQs

  • For clients, no. Your phone number is never displayed on Fiverr. For freelancers, your phone number is typically not displayed. It will only appear to an EU client viewing your profile if you have completed the Personal & Business Information verification process, as required by the EU Digital Services Act (DSA).
  • After initial verification, we may occasionally request that you verify your phone at different touchpoints to maintain account security.
  • A unique security question is required as a backup procedure, for example, if you lose your phone or change your number. This question is our only way of recovering your account if you have verification problems. Learn more in this article.
  • Please ensure that you complete the process using a computer, as the phone verification process cannot be completed on a mobile device.
  • We offer the option to receive the verification code by call or text, so you can provide a landline phone number if you do not have a mobile number.
  • This usually means you already have an existing account on Fiverr. Sign in to that account and close it, so you can use the number in the new account. If you can’t access the old account, contact Customer Support.

Verify your identity

At Fiverr, ensuring a safe community for everyone is a top priority. To achieve this and facilitate secure business practices, we routinely require freelancers to verify their identity.

This process typically involves submitting an official government Identity Document (ID). In some instances, we may also use alternative methods like phone verification, either in addition to or instead of an ID.

Completing identity verification may be necessary to offer your services on Fiverr.

Note: Some new freelancers may be required to pay a one time fee to complete ID verification. If you’re enrolled in Seller Plus Kickstart, this fee is included as part of your membership at no extra cost.

ID verification Step by step

  • Before you begin the ID verification process, ensure you have the following ready:
    • A Computer and Smartphone: Log in to your Fiverr account on a computer and have a smartphone with a camera ready.
    • Original ID: Use a physical ID, such as a Driving License, Passport, Permanent Residency Card, ID Card, Residency Permit, or Diplomatic Passport. Digital or online copies are not accepted.
  • Clear Camera Access: Ensure your smartphone camera is functioning properly and has access permissions enabled in your browser.
    • Log into Your Fiverr Account: Use a computer to access your Fiverr account.
    • Access Verification Settings:
      • Navigate to your profile image, then click on Account settings
      • Select “Personal & business info.”
      • Locate the “Verify” button and click on it.
    • Or you can click on this link.
    • Take a Clear Photo of Your ID: Ensure all information on your ID is visible and legible. Avoid using saved images or screenshots.
    • Enter Your Name Accurately: Type your name exactly as it appears on your ID.
  • Select the Correct ID Type: Choose the ID type you are using from the drop-down list.
  • If you encounter issues during verification, consider the following solutions:
    • Clear Cache and Cookies: This can resolve many technical issues.
    • Disable VPN: Ensure no VPN is active during the verification process.
    • Use a Different Browser: If issues persist, try using a different web browser.
  • Ensure Correct Region Selection: Make sure the region selected matches the one on your ID.
  • If your verification attempt fails:
    • Review the Account Verification Help Center Article: Ensure you understand all requirements and steps.
    • Wait Before Retrying: Allow at least 6 hours before attempting verification again.
  • Check for Verification Button: If you cannot find the “Verify” button, ensure you are in the correct section under “Personal & Business Info.”
    • Proof of Residency: Acceptable documents include utility bills, telephone bills, or rental agreements.
    • Language and Name Issues: If your ID is in a different language, ensure you follow any specific instructions provided by Fiverr.
    • Camera and Photo Quality: Ensure your face and ID are clearly visible with no obstructions.

Do not take photos of scanned images of yourself or your ID, these cannot be verified.

As part of the ID verification process, we use a third-party service provider’s identity verification software. The software first validates that your image is from an official government ID and that your selfie is authentic. It then compares the two images you upload to determine whether the uploaded ID and selfie are authentic images that match.

This process is required to prove that the document submitted represents you, and isn’t copied from other sources.

If issues persist, consider reaching out to Fiverr support for further assistance.

How we use your data

The collection and processing of ID cards are required to ensure a trustworthy community and marketplace, to enforce our terms of service, and in order to comply with applicable laws.

We assure you that the identification card won’t be used for any other purpose—including marketing purposes—nor shared with other users.

The copy of your identification card is only kept for as long as required—and for the required purpose explained above.

We take great care in maintaining the security of the site and your information. If you believe that your ID is not necessary for the mentioned purposes, you can contact Customer Support using the ‘Contact us’ tab at the bottom of the page.

Learn more about privacy and security with ID verification: Data protection and usage and our Privacy Policy.

ID verified freelancers

Please be aware that the verification process relies on information provided by the freelancer; therefore, we cannot guarantee that they are who they claim to be or that the data provided by them is accurate. We always encourage and enforce that all communication and transactions remain on Fiverr—this also allows us to support and assist our clients and freelancers.

Use your best judgment and learn more with Communication: The dos and don’ts.

FAQs

  • The information you provide is to verify your identification with Fiverr. Your ID will not be shared with other users, including other members of the community.
  • You must verify your ID as soon as you receive a notification on your account. You will have 14 days to complete the process. Failing to do so will remove your ability to sell on Fiverr.
  • ID verification helps keep Fiverr safe and honest. You may be asked to complete ID verification before joining one of our premium programs, if there are concerns about the safety of your account, or when required by regulations.
  • Our ID verification process is explained in detail above. We ask that you refrain from sending your ID through a Customer Support request, as we are unable to verify your ID for you this way.
  • Note: Fiverr will never ask for ID verification via email.
  • Safety Tips:
    • Do not share personal details like phone numbers, home addresses, tax-related information, banking details, etc..
    • Beware of fake emails with company logos, fake login pages and URL’s, and messages requesting personal information or payments.
    • Do not click on suspicious links or links connected within an email from an unknown sender
    • Always check the sender’s email address to ensure it is from an official Fiverr domain.
    • Use strong, unique passwords for your Fiverr account and change them regularly.
  • We take great care in maintaining the security of the site and your information, to prevent unauthorized access, loss, misuse, alteration, destruction, or damage to it through industry-standard technologies and internal procedures.
  • Once we have received your data, we will use strict procedures and security measures to try to prevent unauthorized access. Learn more with our Privacy Policy.
  • You must verify your identity with a valid ID. This includes a driver’s license, passport, or other valid ID included in the list found when you start the ID verification process. The IDs available vary per country.
  • Yes. Fiverr may require some of our customers to go through a verification process. Fiverr does not require account verification when opening an account.
  • Note: Customer Support is not able to start this process for you, nor are they able to verify your ID for you—this includes trying to verify through a ticket request.

Verifying your identity as a new freelancer

Ensuring a safe community for everyone is a top priority at Fiverr. To facilitate secure business practices, we require freelancers to verify their identity. This process helps us build a trusted marketplace and protects your account from unauthorized access.

Overview

Identity verification helps keep the Fiverr marketplace trustworthy and secure. Completing these steps may be required to publish your Gigs in the Fiverr Catalog. Some new freelancers may also be required to pay a one time fee to complete ID verification. This fee covers the cost of verifying your identity through our verification partner. If you’re enrolled in Seller Plus Kickstart, ID verification is included as part of your membership at no extra cost.

Verification covers three areas:

  • Business verification: Providing information about your professional status to comply with global regulations, including the EU Digital Services Act (DSA).
  • Phone verification: Linking a valid phone number to your account for added security.
  • ID verification: Confirming your identity with a government-issued document.

New freelancers may be required to complete these steps before their Gigs can be added to the Fiverr Catalog.

Before you begin

To ensure a smooth process, please have the following ready:

  • A computer: Use a desktop or laptop to log in and start the process.
  • A smartphone: You will need a smartphone with a working camera to take photos of your ID and a selfie.
  • Working phone number: Google Voice and similar VOIP services are not supported. If you don’t have a mobile phone, you can verify your account via an SMS-enabled landline or by receiving a call.
  • Original ID: Have your physical government-issued document (e.g., passport, driver’s license, or ID card) ready. Digital copies or screenshots are not accepted.
  • Valid documents: Ensure your documents are current and not expired.
  • Stable connection: Disable any VPN or proxy settings before starting, as these may interfere with the process.
  • Device permissions: Ensure your smartphone browser has permission to access your camera.

Understanding the verification process

The verification process follows a specific sequence. You can track your progress on your Talent Dashboard. To access it, navigate to your Talent Dashboard by clicking on “Dashboard” from your freelancer profile.

The verification task remains locked and cannot be initiated until you publish your first Gig.

How to complete verification

1. Phone verification

This adds a layer of security to your account.

  • Enter your country and phone number.
  • Click Verify by text.
  • Enter the code received.
  • Add a security question: This is essential for account recovery.

You can read more in our article Phone verification: Secure your Fiverr account.

Keep in mind that verification attempts are limited.

2. Personal & business verification

You will be asked to provide details about your business and professional background to ensure compliance with regulations, such as the DSA. You can read more in our article Personal & business information verification.

  • Status selection: You must choose if you use Fiverr “Outside of my primary job” or “As part of my primary job.”
  • Data privacy: If you are a trader, certain details (name, address, business email) will be visible to EU customers as required by law.
3. ID or business verification check

This is the final technical check to confirm your identity.

For individuals:

  • Provide your full name, email, and address exactly as they appear on your ID.
  • Select your ID country and document type.
  • Use your smartphone to take a clear photo of your ID and a selfie.

You can read more in our article Verify your identity.

For registered businesses:

  • Enter the country in which your business is registered.
  • Enter your business entity name, business email, business phone number, address, and business registration number. Check out our article Business Registration Number Information by Country for detailed guidance.
  • Take a picture of the required business documents to verify your company.
  • Required documents: Proof of business address (e.g., utility bill or lease).
  • Optional documents: Additional business documents to support verification (if available).

You can read more in our article Personal & business information verification.

4. Confirmation

You will receive an account notification and an email informing you if the verification was successful.

Once completed, you can check your verification status (which will be one of the following: required, in progress, or successfully verified) in the Personal & Business Info section of your account settings.

Troubleshooting & best practices

  • Follow these tips for a successful ID submission:
    • Use a physical, original ID that is current and not expired.
    • Ensure all four corners of the ID are visible in the frame.
    • Avoid glare by moving away from direct light sources.
    • Take your selfie in a well-lit area with a neutral background.
    • Don’t use a saved image, screenshot, or photo taken from another screen.
  • If you are having trouble with phone verification, try the following:
    • Ensure you are not using a VOIP service like Google Voice; these are not supported.
    • If the Verify button is greyed out, ensure you are using a computer rather than the mobile app to initiate the step.
    • If you do not receive a code, wait 30–60 minutes before trying again.
    • Restart your device to refresh your network connection.
    • Ensure your phone is up to date and that no apps are blocking or filtering SMS/WhatsApp messages.
    • Try using the same SIM card on a different phone or test your phone with another SIM card.
  • If you are having trouble with ID verification, try the following:
    • Ensure the issuing country you select in the menu matches the country on your ID.
    • If your ID is in a different language, ensure you follow any specific instructions provided by Fiverr.
    • Confirm you are in the correct section under Account settings > Personal & business info.
  • If you are having trouble with business verification, try the following:
    • Having your business documents ready will speed up the process.
    • Make sure your name, address, and any business information exactly match your official documents. Discrepancies may lead to verification failure.
    • Enter the Business ID number in the correct format, as it was assigned to your business by the local government. If you’re unsure, please consult your legal consultant.
    • When filling out forms, provide your details in English, exactly as they appear on your government-issued ID. Use documents with English text when available.
  • If you encounter a general technical issue, try the following:
    • Clear your browser’s cache and cookies if you encounter a glitch. You can also try incognito mode or a different browser.
    • Disable any active VPNs, as the system may block verification for security reasons.
    • If an attempt fails, wait at least 6 hours before trying again to allow the system to reset.
    • Check your smartphone settings to ensure your mobile browser has permission to access the camera.

How we use your data

We take great care in maintaining the security of the site and your information.

  • Purpose: Data collection is required to ensure a trustworthy community, enforce our terms of service, and comply with applicable laws.
  • Privacy: Your identification card won’t be used for any other purpose, including marketing, nor shared with other users.
  • Retention: We retain the selfie for 60 days and your ID document for 30 days. After this period, we only retain essential details such as your name, date of birth, gender, hashed ID number, document type, and document country.
  • Security: We use strict procedures and industry-standard security measures to prevent unauthorized access, loss, or misuse of your data.

Learn more about privacy and security with our Privacy Policy.

FAQs

  • It depends on the type of verification:
    • Business verification: If you are a trader, certain details (name, address, business email) will be visible to EU customers as required by law.
    • Phone verification: For clients, no. Your phone number is never displayed on Fiverr. For freelancers, your phone number is typically not displayed. It will only appear to an EU client viewing your profile, as required by the EU Digital Services Act (DSA).
    • ID verification: Your ID document and selfie are never made public. We retain the selfie for 60 days and your ID documents for 30 days. We only keep essential details required by law. If you are a trader under the DSA, certain business details will be visible to EU clients.
  • If you have not yet completed the identity verification process, your Gigs will not be shown in the Fiverr Catalog until you are fully verified. You will see a banner that indicates your profile is unlisted, and Gigs are not shown in the Fiverr Catalog until completed.
  • You must verify your identity with a valid government-issued ID from the list of documents available for your country. If you are a minor, please read more about our Minor’s Policy.
  • The number of attempts allowed depends on the specific verification process you are completing:
    • Business verification: You have two attempts to successfully verify your business. Our system checks that your business name and address exactly match the information on your official documents.
    • Phone verification: You can attempt verification 3 times via text. Only one phone number can be verified every 24 hours.
    • ID verification: You are typically granted five individual attempts to verify your ID.
  • If you exhaust all available attempts for any of these processes, you can contact Customer Support for further assistance.

Ensuring your identity is verified helps keep your account and the entire Fiverr marketplace secure.

Freelancers: Features & programs

Advanced Analytics for Seller plus

Seller Plus members get access to a set of Advanced Analytics tools that go beyond the standard Overview and Repeat Business tabs available to all freelancers. These tools give you a deeper view of how your Gigs are performing in search, where your orders come from, which keywords drive the most traffic and revenue, and how to re-engage past clients. This article covers each tool and how to get the most out of it.

How to access Advanced Analytics

  • Log in to your Fiverr freelancer account.

  • Click Analytics in the top navigation menu.

  • Select the analytics you want to view, switch between tabs to find what you are looking for.

  • Gig Performance, Orders Breakdown, and Top Keywords are filtered by Gig and time frame.

  • Keyword Research is filtered by category and subcategory.

  • Pricing Insights is only available for specific subcategories.

Use the filter drop-downs at the top of each tab to set your view.

Advanced Analytics is available to Seller Plus Standard and Premium members only. All tabs in this article are web-only, they are not accessible on the mobile app.

Top Keywords

The Top Keywords tab shows which search terms clients used to find your Gig, along with how each keyword performed across impressions, clicks, orders, and earnings.

Use it to identify your strongest keywords and make sure they are placed prominently in your Gig title, positive keywords field, and description.

Metric

What it means

Impressions

How many times your Gig appeared in search results for this keyword.

Clicks

How many times clients clicked on your Gig card within search results for this keyword.

CTR

Your click-through rate for this keyword, how often clients clicked after seeing your Gig.

Orders

Total orders from clients who found your Gig by searching this keyword.

CR

Conversion rate, how often clients placed an order after clicking your Gig for this keyword.

Earnings

Total revenue from orders placed through this keyword, before taxes and fees (extras included).

The # icon next to a keyword shows its personal ranking relative to your other keywords for that metric. For example, the keyword with the highest impressions is ranked #1.

How to use Top Keywords
  • Select the Gig and time frame you want to analyze.
  • In the “Top 10 keywords” field, choose the metric you want to sort by (impressions, clicks, orders, etc.).
  • Identify your top-performing keywords and move the strongest ones to the front of your Gig title. The algorithm prioritizes title text first, then the positive keywords field, then the description.

Give any new or updated keywords at least 30 days before reviewing their impact and analyzing their performance.

Gig Performance

The Gig Performance tab shows how well each of your Gigs is performing in the marketplace and how it compares to similar Gigs in the same subcategory.

Gig Metrics

The top section shows your click-through rate (CTR) and conversion rate (CR) side by side with the subcategory average, so you can quickly see where you stand relative to similar freelancers.

  • The percentage of clients who clicked on your Gig after seeing it in search results. A high CTR means your Gig card is compelling.
  • The percentage of clients who placed an order after clicking on your Gig page. A high CR means your Gig page is effective at converting interest into orders.

Performance Trendline

The trendline graph lets you track how your Gig has changed over time. Switch between two views:

  • Conversion view: Shows your CTR and CR over the selected time frame. Use this to see how changes to your Gig description or images affected conversion.
  • Performance view: Plots impressions, clicks, and orders. Use this to understand visibility trends and how Gig updates affect search exposure.

Tip: Hover over any point on the graph to see the exact data for that date. Make one change to your Gig at a time, then wait at least 30 days before reviewing the impact, this makes it easier to understand what actually moved the needle.

Orders Breakdown

The Orders Breakdown tab shows where your orders are coming from, broken down by traffic source. Use it to understand which channels are driving your business and identify sources you could lean into more.

Source

What it means

Organic traffic

Orders from clients who found your Gig through Fiverr search results or recommendations, without any paid promotion.

Fiverr Ads

Orders generated through your Fiverr Ads campaigns. Learn more about Fiverr Ads.

Coupons

Orders placed by clients who used a coupon you sent them. Learn more about Growth tools.

Buyer Briefs

Orders placed after you were matched with a client brief.

Fiverr’s Choice

Orders from clients who found you through the Fiverr’s Choice program.

Fiverr Pro

Orders placed by Fiverr Pro clients, typically on longer-term business projects.

The tab also shows a funnel view for Organic and Fiverr Ads traffic, illustrating how clients move from impressions to clicks to orders for each source.

Keyword Research

The Keyword Research tab shows how search terms are performing across the broader Fiverr marketplace, not just for your Gig. Use it to discover high-potential keywords when creating a new Gig, expanding into a new service area, or comparing your current keywords against alternatives.

  • Overall Rank: A combined score reflecting the keyword’s overall performance across all metrics.
  • Search Volume: How often this keyword is searched compared to others. Higher is better for visibility.
  • Average Order Price: The average price of orders placed after a client searched this keyword. Higher is better for revenue.
  • Conversion Rate: How often an order is placed after a client searches this keyword. Higher is better.
  • Competition: The level of competition from other Gigs for this keyword. Lower is better.

To use Keyword Research, filter by the category and subcategory you want to analyze, then sort the results by the metric most relevant to your goal (for example, sort by Search Volume to find high-traffic terms, or by Competition to find gaps).

Note: Keyword Research shows keywords that clients use across the marketplace and may include keywords not directly related to your specific Gig. Use it as a research and discovery tool alongside Top Keywords, which shows performance data specific to your Gig.

Follow-up Messages

Follow-up Messages let you send a personalized message to past clients from your Fiverr dashboard to encourage repeat orders or introduce them to other Gigs you offer. All messages must adhere to Fiverr’s Terms of Service and Community Standards.

  • Seller Plus Standard members can use up to 10 follow-up messages per month. This count resets on the start of the next month’s Seller Plus billing date.

  • Seller Plus Premium members can use up to 20 follow-up messages per month. This count resets on the start of the next month’s Seller Plus billing date.

  • Character limit: 250 characters per message

  • Eligible clients: Clients who completed an order with you in the last 60 days and do not have an active coupon from you.

  • One message per order: You can only send one follow-up per completed order.

  • Client opt-out: Clients can unsubscribe from follow-up messages. Once unsubscribed, they cannot re-subscribe and you will not be able to send them follow-ups.

How to send a follow-up message
  • Go to Growth & Marketing in the top menu and select Marketing Tools.
  • On the Follow-up Messages tab, browse or search for the client you want to contact.
  • Choose your message type:
    • Encourage to reorder (same Gig): The client sees the last Gig they purchased. Only available if that Gig is still active.
    • Offer other Gigs: You select 1 to 3 active Gigs for the client to see. If you only have one active Gig, it is selected automatically.
  • Write your message. Edit the Fiverr provided default template to sound personal and relevant to the client.
  • Preview your message and the selected Gigs, then send.

Tip: Personalizing the default message, even briefly, tends to get a better response. Reference the specific project you worked on together or note something relevant to the Gig you are offering.

Once sent, the message appears in the client’s inbox labeled “Follow-up from [your username]”, so they can distinguish it from a regular conversation. You can review all sent follow-up messages from within your inbox.

Pricing Insights

Pricing Insights is a specialized feature for Seller Plus Standard and Premium available for three subcategories only: Logo Animation, Logo Design, and Article & Blog Posts.

This feature helps you compare your package prices against similar Gigs ordered on Fiverr in the last 30 days. The comparison includes Gigs with similar characteristics to yours, such as country, freelancer level, and order details.

The graph shows the distribution of orders across price ranges for similar packages and indicates whether your current pricing is on the higher or lower end of the market.

Price ranges reflect package prices set by freelancers and exclude extras, subscriptions, milestones, and custom offers.

Best practices

  • Review your Gig Performance data after every significant Gig update.
  • Change one thing at a time and wait 30 days to better understand the impact.
  • Place your top-performing keywords (by impressions and orders) at the start of your Gig title. The algorithm weighs title text most heavily.
  • Use Keyword Research when creating a new Gig or expanding into a new service. Look for keywords with high search volume, good conversion rate, and low competition.
  • Use Follow-up Messages strategically; you have a limited monthly quota. Prioritize clients from high-value orders or those who may benefit most from a follow-up offer.
  • Keep follow-up messages short, specific, and personal. The 250-character limit encourages staying brief, so use it to your advantage.

FAQs

  • Seller Plus Standard and Premium members only. The Gig Performance, Orders Breakdown, Top Keywords, and Keyword Research tabs are not available on Kickstart or non-Seller Plus accounts.
  • No. All Advanced Analytics tabs are web-only and not accessible on the mobile app.
  • Top Keywords shows how specific search terms have performed for your own Gig; including impressions, clicks, orders, and earnings. Keyword Research shows how search terms perform across the broader marketplace, which is useful for discovering new keywords or researching a new Gig.
  • Give new keywords at least 30 days before reviewing their impact on your Gig’s visibility and performance.
  • A feature that compares your package prices to similar Gigs ordered in the last 30 days. Currently available for Logo Animation, Logo Design, and Article & Blog Posts subcategories only.
  • Standard members can send 10 per monthly cycle. Premium members can send 20. The count resets on your Seller Plus monthly billing date.
  • Only to clients who completed an order with you in the last 60 days and do not have an active coupon from you. Clients who have unsubscribed from follow-ups cannot be contacted through this tool.
  • You will no longer be able to send them follow-up messages. Clients who unsubscribe cannot re-subscribe.

Being a Pro freelancer: Guidelines and responsibilities

As a Fiverr Pro freelancer, you are expected to have extra high standards regarding professional ethics.

To help you achieve those standards, we have created these important guidelines to be aware of and comply with.

  • In accordance with Fiverr Pro’s commitment to maintaining high-quality service standards, freelancers enrolled as Fiverr Pro may be subject to demotion or probation if they fail to consistently meet the elevated expectations of delivery excellence and professionalism. The criteria for assessment include but are not limited to, client communication and satisfaction, adherence to Fiverr’s Terms of Service and Community Standards, responsiveness, on-time delivery, and maintaining satisfactory ratings. The determination of whether a Fiverr Pro freelancer meets these standards and subsequently the decision to demote or place on probation remains at the discretion of Fiverr, allowing flexibility to address various factors that may impact the overall quality and performance of a Pro freelancer. Please be aware that these standards may evolve over time, with ongoing efforts to elevate and ensure the premium nature of Fiverr Pro services.
    • Be professional and fair with the whole Fiverr community
    • Be aware that multiple complaints against you can lead to the Fiverr Pro badge being removed from your profile and Pro Gigs.
    • Don’t discriminate based on gender, religion, ethnicity or nationality
    • Diversity is an integral part of Fiverr, so any discrimination or use of hate speech can lead to blocking your Fiverr account.
    • Play fair: any attempt to manipulate Fiverr’s review or charging systems is unacceptable
    • Always use appropriate language when communicating with your clients and/or Fiverr’s team
    • Using inappropriate language, threats or rude behavior toward clients or Fiverr staff will not be tolerated.
    • Do not deliver any hate-related content
    • If you are in any doubt about content, please contact Customer Support.
    • Please make sure that the services you offer or agree to deliver align with our Terms of Service and Community Standards.
    • For any service request that raises concerns, feel free to contact our Customer Support team for clarification.
    • Work that you deliver or provide must be original work or content that you have the right to use
    • We vetted you based on the work you submitted and we expect that same level of competence in your deliveries to clients.
    • All work that you provide should be customized and unique to each order
    • Work that you deliver or present must be free from copyrighted materials
  • Effective communication is essential for creating a positive experience on Fiverr. Conducting all interactions through Fiverr’s communication tools ensures transparency, supports professionalism, and allows Fiverr to assist in any disputes or issues.
  • Pro freelancers may communicate with their clients externally, but please be aware that:
    • If you communicate through third-party tools, document your conversations (notes, summaries, etc.) and share them on the platform. This keeps all records transparent and accessible for both parties in case of any client-freelancer dispute.
    • It is prohibited to offer or accept payments outside of Fiverr: All payments must be processed through Fiverr to ensure full protection.
    • Conducting business off-platform directly violates Fiverr’s Community Standards. This includes breaching the payment agreement, which encompasses Fiverr’s service fees. User accounts involved in violation of this policy risk permanent suspension of their accounts.
  • For additional guidance, visit the Communication and payment dos and don’ts article.
  • Converting your existing Gig to a Pro Gig will be subject to the Fiverr Pro team’s review and approval, taking into account, the quality of your existing Gig, your communication with clients in connection with such Gig, and any warnings or terms of service violations in connection with such Gig.
