Cash advance

Cash advance lets eligible freelancers receive an on-the-spot advance on their future earnings to help grow their business. The advance is deposited directly into their Fiverr Balance and is available to withdraw right away.

Cash advance is currently available in selected regions.

How cash advance works

When you receive a cash advance, you agree to sell a set amount of your future Fiverr earnings at a discount. For example, you might receive a $1,000 USD advance in exchange for $1,204 USD of your future earnings.

Repayment is automatic:

  • The total amount of future earnings you will pay is set upon receipt of the cash advance and does not change.
  • 40% of each cleared payment you receive goes toward repaying the advance.
  • If you have no earnings, no repayment is deducted.
  • Deductions begin as soon as the advance is credited to your account and new payments become available, regardless of when those orders were placed.
  • Deductions apply only to payments already in your balance, not earnings pending clearance.
  • Having an active cash advance does not affect your eligibility for other features, such as Fiverr Ads or early payout.
  • You cannot hold more than one cash advance at a time. Once your advance is fully repaid, you can request a new one if you still meet the eligibility criteria.
Cash advance amounts
  • The minimum advance amount is $100 USD and the maximum is $5,000 USD.
  • Your available advance amount is based on your earnings in the last six months and may differ each time you are eligible.
  • The amounts available to you are determined by your eligibility and cannot be changed.
Repayment status

You can track your repayment progress at any time on your Earnings page under the Cash Advance tab. The tab shows:

  • Cash advance: the amount added to your available balance.
  • Amount to pay: the total amount you’ll repay to cover the advance.
  • Paid to date: the amount repaid so far.
  • Amount left to pay: the remaining balance.
  • Date range: a filter for cash advance-related transactions.
  • Activity: a filter to view all cash advance transactions or payments.

You will not receive a notification when your advance is fully repaid. Check the Cash Advance tab on your Earnings page to see your current status.

Eligibility

Cash advance eligibility is a multi-factor evaluation that is determined automatically by our system based on a combination of factors, including your recent sales, overall performance, and account standing. The system refreshes daily, which means eligibility can change from one day to the next. There is no manual review and no action required from you to trigger an offer. When you meet the criteria, a Get Cash Advance option will appear on your Earnings page. If the option is not visible, it means you are not currently eligible.

Because eligibility is based on your sales and overall performance, focusing on quality and consistency can help:

  • Maintain consistent sales and positive earnings trends.
  • Deliver orders on time and as described.
  • Keep a strong rating by providing excellent service and communication.
  • Avoid cancellations and disputes where possible.
  • Respond promptly to messages and maintain account health and compliance.

How to request a cash advance

If you are eligible, a Cash Advance tab will appear on your Earnings page.

  • Go to your Earnings page and click the Cash Advance tab.
  • Click Get your cash advance (first-time users) or Get a cash advance (returning users).
  • Select your preferred amount from the drop-down list and click Continue.
  • Review the cash advance amounts, including the advance amount and the total amount to be paid from your future earnings.
  • Scroll through and read the full terms. You must scroll all the way down before you can select the checkbox.
  • Check the checkbox to confirm you agree to the terms.
  • Enter your full name (not your Fiverr username) as your signature to confirm you understand and agree to the terms.
  • Click Get cash now.
  • Complete phone verification. A verification code will be sent to your phone via text. Enter the code to complete the process. If you have not yet activated two-factor authentication, you will be asked to do that first before completing phone verification.

When the process is complete, you will receive a confirmation email summarizing your cash advance and including a copy of the terms. The funds will appear in your balance as available to withdraw.

If you are not ready to proceed, click Not now to return to your Earnings page. You can start the process again at any time from the Cash Advance tab.

It may take up to 48 hours for your cash advance to be fully processed after you complete the request.

FAQs

  • Cash advance is available to selected freelancers. Eligibility is reviewed automatically on a regular basis. If you are eligible, a Cash Advance tab will appear on your Earnings page.
  • The minimum amount is $100 USD and the maximum is $5,000 USD. Your specific amount depends on your earnings history and may be different each time you are eligible. The available amounts are set automatically and cannot be manually adjusted by you or Customer Support.
  • The cash advance is the amount deposited into your Fiverr Balance. The amount to pay is higher because it represents the total future earnings you agreed to sell to Fiverr in exchange for the advance.
  • Repayment is automatic. For every payment you receive, 40% goes toward repaying your cash advance until it is paid in full. When you have no earnings, no deduction is made.
  • Paying your cash advance all at once is not a standard option. If your account has been disabled, contact our support team for assistance.
  • No. You can only hold one cash advance at a time. Once your current advance is fully repaid, you can request another if you still meet the eligibility criteria.
  • No. You will not receive a notification. You can check your repayment status at any time on your Earnings page under the Cash Advance tab.
  • No. An active cash advance does not affect your access to other features, including Fiverr Ads and early payout.
  • Cash advance eligibility is recalculated daily. If the option is not visible, it means you are not currently eligible. The option can appear and disappear depending on your current eligibility. This is normal and does not indicate a problem. The option appears automatically when you are eligible. Our support team cannot manually enable it.
  • Because eligibility is based on your sales and overall performance, focusing on quality and consistency can help:
    • Maintain consistent sales and positive earnings trends.
    • Deliver orders on time and as described.
    • Keep a strong rating by providing excellent service and communication.
    • Avoid cancellations and disputes where possible.
    • Respond promptly to messages and maintain account health and compliance.

There is no manual review and no action required from you to trigger an offer. When you meet the criteria, the option will appear on your Earnings page. Eligibility is recalculated daily, so it can change from one day to the next.
  • No. Once your advance is fully repaid, your account returns to the normal daily eligibility evaluation. There is no fixed waiting period beyond the daily refresh. If your sales, performance, and account standing meet the criteria, a new offer will appear on your Earnings page. No additional action is required from you.
  • Cash advance amounts are personalized and determined automatically based on your sales and performance history. Your offer may change over time as your account performance and sales trends evolve.

Freelancer level is one of the criteria considered in the cash advance eligibility evaluation, but it is not a direct eligibility requirement on its own, meaning a high Success Score or a high freelancer level does not guarantee a cash advance offer.

The offer is not tied to any single metric, and changes to your Success Score or level may correlate with changes in your eligibility, but will not automatically trigger or remove an offer.

Client activity insights

Client activity insights give you data-driven information about the clients you’re talking to, directly in your Inbox. As a Seller Plus member, you can see details about a client’s order history on Fiverr before you accept their order, helping you make more informed decisions and tailor your service from the start.

How to access client activity insights

  • Go to your Inbox and open a conversation with a client.
  • Look for the Activity panel on the right side of the screen.
  • Use the time frame toggle to switch between Last 60 days and All time.

If you have previously completed at least one order for the client, you will see two tabs:

  • With you: Data specific to the client’s orders with you.
  • On Fiverr: Data about the client’s activity across the platform, based on public reviews. Because this data is based on public reviews only, it may not reflect all of their order activity.

If you have never worked with the client before, you will only see the On Fiverr tab.

Client activity insights are available to Seller Plus members only and are only accessible on the Fiverr website, not the app.

What are the available insights?

Depending on the client’s history, you may see all or some of the following insights. Some insights are only available in one of the tabs.

  • The following insights are based on the client’s order history specifically with you.
  • Completed orders
    • What it shows: The number of orders the client has completed with you, excluding cancelled or in-progress orders.
    • How to use it: Helps you gauge whether the client is new to Fiverr or experienced. New clients may need more guidance and clearer communication.
  • Average rating given
    • What it shows: The average star rating the client has given you after order completion.
    • How to use it: Understand how the client has rated past work so you can set expectations and prepare accordingly.
  • Average order price
    • What it shows: The average price paid on orders placed with you, excluding tax and fees.
    • How to use it: Helps you gauge what the client expects to pay and price your offer accordingly.
  • Order completion rate
    • What it shows: The client’s completion rate for orders placed with you.
    • How to use it: Helps you assess how likely it is that the order will be completed rather than cancelled.
  • Date of last order
    • What it shows: The date of the client’s most recent order with you.
    • How to use it: Helps you understand how recently the client has been active on Fiverr.
  • Preferred service
    • What it shows: The service the client has ordered most often with you.
    • How to use it: Helps you identify the most relevant service to offer or highlight in your response.
  • Tip frequency
    • What it shows: The percentage of orders where the client has left a tip with you.
    • How to use it: Sets expectations for whether the client is likely to tip on future orders.
  • The following insights are based on the client’s activity across the entire Fiverr platform, based on public reviews.
  • Completed orders
    • What it shows: The number of orders the client has completed on Fiverr, excluding cancelled or in-progress orders.
    • How to use it: Helps you gauge whether the client is new to Fiverr or experienced. New clients may need more guidance and clearer communication.
  • Average rating given
    • What it shows: The average star rating the client has given all freelancers (based on public reviews), after order completion.
    • How to use it: Understand how the client has rated past work so you can set expectations and prepare accordingly.
  • Average order price
    • What it shows: An estimated price range based on similar clients on all Fiverr orders.
    • How to use it: Helps you gauge what the client expects to pay and price your offer accordingly.
  • Order completion rate
    • What it shows: Shown as “High” if similar clients tend to complete orders on Fiverr.
    • How to use it: Helps you assess how likely it is that the order will be completed rather than cancelled.
  • Date of last order
    • What it shows: The date of the client’s most recent order with another freelancer (based on public reviews).
    • How to use it: Helps you understand how recently the client has been active on Fiverr.
  • Preferred service
    • What it shows: The service the client has ordered most often with other freelancers (based on public reviews).
    • How to use it: Helps you identify the most relevant service to offer or highlight in your response.
  • Tip frequency
    • What it shows: The percentage of orders where the client has left a tip.
    • How to use it: Sets expectations for whether the client is likely to tip on future orders.
  • Repeat order rate
    • What it shows: Shown as “High” if the client is likely to reorder from a freelancer they’ve worked with before on Fiverr, based on public reviews.
    • How to use it: Helps you assess the potential for a long-term client relationship.

If you don’t see the order completion rate for a client, it simply means there isn’t enough data, not that the client has a poor track record.

FAQs

  • The insights shown depend on the client’s order history and how long they’ve been using Fiverr. If a client is new or has limited activity, fewer data points will be available.
  • On Fiverr data is based on public reviews and may not reflect all of a client’s orders. For average order price, Fiverr shows an estimated range based on similar clients rather than the client’s exact figures.
  • No. Insights are visible to you only. Clients are not notified when you view their activity data.
  • Clients can manage their data sharing preferences from the “Shared activity information” setting at the bottom of their profile page.
  • No. Client activity insights are only available on the Fiverr website.

Client recommendations

Fiverr Pro freelancers can now showcase recommendations from external clients directly on their profiles. This new feature allows clients who haven’t used Fiverr to leave reviews, helping potential clients get a more comprehensive picture of the freelancer’s skills and experience.

How does it work?

Pro freelancers with less than three reviews can add up to five external recommendations from clients they’ve worked with in the past.

When prompted, here is what you should do to get the external reviews added to your profile:

  • Ensure you’re logged in and navigate to your Fiverr Pro profile by clicking the “Take me to my Fiverr Pro profile” button.
  • Locate the ‘Recommendations’ section on the left side of your profile.
  • Complete the recommendation request form by filling out all required fields. Once finished, click the “Submit” button to send your request.
  • Your recommendation request will undergo a review process conducted by Fiverr’s Pro team.
  • If your request is approved, your recommendation will be published on your freelancer profile, visible to potential clients.

Recommendation status

After a recommendation is submitted, it will be processed and assigned one of the following statuses, keeping you informed of its progress:

  • The review will automatically be published on the freelancer’s profile.
  • The review was not approved by Fiverr’s internal team. At this point, the client may be asked to amend it and will have two weeks to do so.
  • This marks that the review is undergoing the internal review process.

FAQs

  • Eligible freelancers will receive an email and a popup notification.
  • This feature is not yet available on the app.
  • Yes, however, only the first 5 client recommendations are shown on your profile. Keep in mind that a business domain email is required for each submission.
  • The review process may take up to two weeks.
  • Both freelancers and clients will be notified via email. The client has up to two weeks to resubmit the request.
  • If the submission is rejected twice, the client will no longer be able to amend it. However, the freelancer can delete the request and create a new entry.

Your skills deserve recognition with client recommendations – submit yours today!

Compliance services for freelancers

Fiverr Pro clients can request compliance services from freelancers they work with on the platform. These services, which include a background check, a worker classification audit, and legal document signing, help clients meet their legal and organizational requirements. Compliance services are available to all Pro clients, and all freelancers on Fiverr can receive these requests from a Pro client.

Before you begin

  • Background checks and worker classification audits cannot be requested from agencies. Legal document requests can be sent to agencies.
  • You will receive all requests and communications by email. You do not manage these requests inside the Fiverr platform.

Compliance services overview

There are three compliance services a Pro client can request from you:

  • Background check
  • Worker classification audit
  • Legal document signing

Each service is described in detail below.

Declining a compliance service request does not affect your Fiverr score, level, visibility, or opportunities on the platform. However, it may influence the client’s decision to continue working with you. It is always best to communicate and agree with the client first.

Background check

A background check verifies information about your past, which may include your criminal, employment, education, and credit history. Fiverr uses a trusted third-party provider called Checkr to run background checks.

How it works
  • You receive an email from Fiverr explaining that a client has requested a background check.
  • You also receive an email from Checkr with a disclosure form. You must electronically sign the disclosure, consent, and authorization form to proceed.
  • You have 7 days to give your consent through Checkr. If you do not respond within this timeframe, the request expires, and the client is notified.
  • Once you complete onboarding with Checkr, the background check begins. Checkr typically completes the process within 3 to 5 business days.
  • Both you and the client receive an email confirmation when the check is complete.
Background check results

The results of your background check are visible only to you and the requesting client. They are not visible to anyone else on the marketplace.

The client sees one of two results: Clear or Issues Found. If you were onboarded to Checkr through the process, you can log into your Checkr account to view your results.

Background check results do not expire.

Disputing results: If you believe your background check results are inaccurate, you can initiate a dispute directly with Checkr.

Worker classification audit

A worker classification audit determines whether you are correctly classified as an independent contractor or an employee in your working relationship with a client. The audit helps clients comply with relevant labor laws and regulations. Fiverr uses a third-party provider called Greenlight to conduct these audits.

This service is relevant when a client has worked with you for a longer period of time and has made at least one completed payment to you, either for a specific order or for hourly services.

How it works
  • You receive an email from Fiverr stating that a client has requested a worker classification audit and that your cooperation is required.
  • You also receive an email from Greenlight, our third-party provider, requesting that you electronically sign a disclosure, consent, and authorization form and complete an onboarding process.
  • You must also answer questions about your working relationship with the client during the Greenlight onboarding process.
  • You have up to 14 days to complete the onboarding process. If you do not respond within this timeframe, the invite expires, and the client is notified.
  • Once the audit is complete, both you and the client receive an email with the results. You may also log into your Greenlight account to view further details.
Audit results

The results of the worker classification audit are visible only to you and the requesting client.

Results are either Low Risk or High Risk:

  • Low Risk means you are at very low risk of being misclassified as an employee in the client’s records.
  • High Risk means there is a significant likelihood of misclassification, which may have legal implications for the client.

You will receive an email letting you know how you were classified. The full high/low-risk indications are visible to the client only.

The outcome of a worker classification audit is final and cannot be disputed or changed. The audit process is handled by Greenlight and not directly by Fiverr. The client retains full discretion in deciding whether to continue working with you based on the results.

Legal document signing

A Pro client may ask you to sign a legal document, such as a non-disclosure agreement (NDA) or another type of business agreement. This helps clients protect their information and establish formal agreements before or during a project. Fiverr uses DocuSign to manage legal document signing.

How it works
  • You receive an email from Fiverr letting you know a client has sent you a legal document to sign.
  • You also receive an email from DocuSign with a link to review and sign the document.
  • You have up to 30 days to sign the document. If the document is not signed within 30 days, the DocuSign link expires and the client will need to resubmit the request.
  • Once you sign the document through DocuSign, you become legally compliant with the client’s request. The client can then view and download the signed document.

Legal document requests can be sent to agencies as well as individual freelancers.

FAQs

  • Only the client who requested the service can see the results. Results are not visible to the rest of the Fiverr marketplace.
  • No. Compliance service results do not affect your rating, level, visibility, or opportunities on Fiverr. However, declining a request may affect the client’s decision to work with you.
  • Yes. You can decline any compliance service request by contacting Fiverr directly. Refusing does not impact your Fiverr status, but the client may choose not to continue working with you.
  • For background checks and worker classification audits, you will receive an email from Fiverr and a separate registration email from the third-party provider (Checkr or Greenlight). Follow the instructions in those emails to complete the process. For legal documents, you will receive an email from DocuSign with a link to review and sign the document.
  • Response timeframes depend on the service:
    • Background check: 7 days to give your consent through Checkr.
    • Worker classification audit: 14 days to complete the onboarding process through Greenlight.
    • Legal document signing: 30 days to sign the document through DocuSign.
  • Fiverr recommends responding as soon as possible to ensure a smooth experience with the client. If you do not respond within the timeframe, the request expires and the client will need to resubmit.
  • Fiverr and its third-party partners handle your data securely, with access limited to authorized parties. To learn more, refer to Fiverr’s Privacy Policy.
  • No. Compliance services do not increase your risk on the platform. They are designed to build trust between you and the client, which can make you more appealing for long-term collaborations.
  • Yes. If you believe your background check results are inaccurate, you can initiate a dispute directly with Checkr.com.
  • No. The outcome of a worker classification audit is final and cannot be changed.

Creating and optimizing your Fiverr Pro Gig

Your Fiverr Pro Gig is how you showcase your skills and help potential clients decide if you’re the right fit for their project. As a Pro freelancer, your Gig is reviewed by Fiverr’s Pro team before it appears in the marketplace, so taking the time to set it up properly pays off.

This article covers how to create a new Pro Gig, convert an existing Gig, expand into new categories, and make the best possible impression on clients.

What is a Pro Gig?

A Gig is the service listing you offer on Fiverr. Your Pro status means your Gig carries the Pro badge, which signals quality and credibility to clients. Before your Gig goes live, the Pro team reviews it and may approve it or send feedback requesting changes. You can resubmit your Gig after making the requested updates.

Key things to know:

  • You can only create Pro Gigs in subcategories where you are approved.
  • When you are accepted to Pro, you receive an email with a Gig creation checklist to help you get started.
  • If your Gig is priced below $100, it will not display the “Pro Vetted” badge.

Creating a new Pro Gig

Before you get started, make sure that you have the following:

  • You must have an active Pro badge on your account.

  • You can only list Pro Gigs in subcategories where you have been approved. Approved subcategories are marked with a Pro badge during Gig setup.

  • To sell in a new category, you must submit a Pro Expansion application. See “Expanding to new Pro categories” below.

    • Log in to Fiverr.
    • From the Selling menu, click My Business and select Gigs.
    • Click Create a new Gig. Subcategories with Pro approval are marked with a Pro badge next to the category name.

  • Gig title: Write a title of up to 80 characters. Include relevant keywords for your service. Make it short, clear, and concise.

  • Tip: Keep the title under 50 characters so it doesn’t get cut off on the Gig card.

  • Category: Select the subcategory in which you are approved. Only approved subcategories are available for Pro Gigs.

  • Service type: Choose a service type to ensure you appear in the search results related to the category you selected.

  • Note: This feature is only available for specific categories.

  • Metadata: In the Metadata section, select the relevant criteria for each topic.

  • Note: This feature is only available for specific categories.

  • Search tags: Add at least one word or phrase that best describes your Gig.

  • Tip: Three to four accurate tags are recommended to keep your Gig professional and discoverable.

  • First, you set up your packages. We recommend creating three packages: Basic, Standard, and Premium. These package tiers let you offer different levels of service to suit a range of clients. For each package:

    • Set a clear price.
    • Specify the delivery time.
    • Define what’s included (revisions, deliverables, etc.).

  • Note: If your Gig is priced below $100, the “Pro Vetted” badge will not appear. Custom offers can go as high as $50,000.

  • Description: Make it as informative as possible. Describe exactly what you offer and what you don’t offer. Use simple, clear language. Invite clients to contact you before placing an order, and add any specific requirements or instructions. A strong description helps reduce cancellations and unnecessary questions.

  • FAQ: Add answers to common questions about your service. FAQs increase conversion and help clients make confident decisions.

  • List what you need from the client to get started. Clear requirements help you deliver on time and reduce unnecessary back-and-forth.

  • Upload images and, optionally, a video. Use the gallery to give clients a strong first impression of your work and style. See the Best practices section below for tips.

  • Submit your Gig for review. The Pro team member will review it and contact you by email:

    • Approved: The Pro team adds the badge and banner to your Gig, and it goes live in the marketplace.
    • Needs changes: The Pro team sends notes on what to fix. Make the changes and resubmit.

Converting an existing Gig to Pro

If you already have active Gigs on your account in the marketplace, you can request to convert them to Pro, as long as you’re approved for Pro in the same subcategory.

After your Pro approval, you receive an email with a link to the Gig conversion form. To convert a Gig:

  • Open the Gig conversion form from the link in your onboarding email.
  • Submit a request for each Gig you want to convert.
  • Wait for the Pro team’s email response.

Note: You must submit the form separately for each Gig you want to convert. There is no limit on the number of requests you can submit at the same time.

Expanding to new Pro categories

To offer Pro services in a category you haven’t been approved for yet, you need to submit a new application.

  • Open the Pro expansion form from the link in your onboarding email.
  • Submit your application, including portfolio samples and any other required materials.
  • Wait for the Pro team’s email response.

Each new category requires its own separate application. If your application was previously rejected for a category, you must wait 6 months before reapplying for that same category. For a category you haven’t applied for before, you can submit an application at any time.

Best practices for making a good impression

On Fiverr, first impressions matter. Here are the best practices to make your Pro Gig stand out.

  • Good images are crucial for getting clients to click on your Gig and place an order:
    • Use high-resolution, sharp, and clear images. Avoid blurry, pixelated, or stretched images.
    • Recommended size: 1280 × 769 px. Minimum: 712 × 430 px. Maximum: 4000 × 2416 px at 72 DPI.
    • Use only images you have permission to use.
    • Don’t overcrowd your gallery. Less is more.
    • Avoid too much text on an image: clients should be able to read it at thumbnail size.
    • Use a different image for each Gig if you have more than one.
    • Make sure your images directly relate to the service you offer. Random images can damage a Gig’s reputation and lower the Editorial pick possibility.
  • For more information, see Gig image guidelines and Fiverr’s Community Standards.
  • Videos help you explain your service in a personal, engaging way:
    • Keep it short and to the point.
    • Include a clear description of what you offer.
    • Add music or a voiceover to increase engagement.
    • Use your own voice: don’t narrate with a computer voice.
    • Upload a high-quality video with no audio/video sync issues.
    • Never include personal contact information.
    • Maximum size: 50 MB. Supported formats: MP4 or AVI.
    • You can set a custom thumbnail frame for your video.
  • For more information, see Adding a video to your Gig.
  • Give clients the opportunity to see your work with reviews and files so they can evaluate your output before ordering.
  • For more information, see Using your Fiverr portfolio.
  • Use Gig extras to offer complementary services and give clients a more complete offering.

Category-specific tips

  • ​
    • Upload images in all three image slots.
    • Use the two PDF slots to display more work (up to three pages per PDF).
  • ​
    • Use illustrations that are iconic and elemental rather than detailed or cartoon-style.
    • Include a professional photo of yourself as part of the main Gig image.
    • Set your delivery time to give yourself enough time to complete the work.
    • Use a video of yourself explaining the service to build client confidence.
    • Show only one certification badge in your main image.
    • Use the PDF section to build brochures about your service.
  • ​
    • Use PDFs in the gallery to display writing samples.
    • Provide URLs to published online works.
    • Use a professional photo of yourself as part of the main Gig image.
  • ​
    • Upload a video with sound for each Gig.
    • Use the Set Thumbnail option to choose a still image for your Gig card from the video.
    • Only use vertical videos for the Short Video Ads category.
  • ​
    • Use illustrations that are iconic and elemental rather than detailed or cartoon-style.
    • Avoid using a website screenshot as the main Gig image: details are lost on the Gig card.
    • Show only one certification badge in your main image.
    • To list client websites, create a section in the description titled “Client Work Examples”: do not use “www.”
    • Use the PDF section to build brochures or display website examples.

FAQs

  • No. You can only create Pro Gigs in subcategories where you have Pro approval. To sell in a new category, submit a Pro Expansion application.
  • The Pro team reviews it and contacts you by email. If approved, the badge and banner are added and your Gig goes live. If changes are needed, you’ll receive notes and can resubmit after making updates.
  • Yes. There is no limit on the number of conversion requests you can submit at the same time. However, you must submit a separate form for each Gig.
  • You must wait 6 months before reapplying for the same category. For a different category you haven’t applied for before, you can apply at any time.

Featured Clients

Featured Clients lets you showcase up to five notable companies you have worked with directly on your Fiverr profile and Gig pages. When clients browse your profile, they can see the names and logos of the businesses you have serviced, giving them confidence in your experience and track record.

What are Featured Clients?

The Featured Clients section appears on your Fiverr profile page and Gig page immediately after a client entry is approved. Each entry displays the client company name and logo, giving potential clients a quick view of the quality of work you have delivered.

You can add, edit, or remove Featured clients at any time from your profile. Once you reach five approved clients, you will need to remove one before you can add another.

Eligibility

This feature is available to the following freelancers:

  • Level 2
  • Top Rated
  • Pro
  • Agencies
  • Seller Plus Kickstart

Once you become eligible, you keep access to this feature permanently, even if your level changes. For example, if you are demoted from Top Rated to Level 1, you will still be able to use Featured Clients.

What counts as a valid Featured Client?

You can add companies from Fiverr’s pre-approved list. If the company isn’t on the list, you can also submit it yourself and we will let you know if it gets approved. Before you submit, make sure your entry meets all of the following rules.

You can add a client if:

You cannot add a client if:

  • The company hired you directly for a paid project.

  • The work you did is related to the services you offer on Fiverr.

  • You can provide a link proving the working relationship (portfolio, invoice, contract, or Fiverr order link).

  • The “client” is a platform or marketplace you used as a tool (for example, Shopify, Amazon, Facebook, YouTube, Fiverr, Etsy, or Google).

  • The client is not related to the services you offer. For example, if your Gig is about social media growth, you cannot list Instagram as a featured client.

  • You worked for the client as part of a personal or unpaid project.

By confirming and providing proof of your business relationship with a client, you take full responsibility for sharing valid and genuine information. Providing false proof or information may result in removal of your Featured Clients eligibility.

Featured Clients Guidelines

  • Make sure any proof link you submit (portfolio, invoice, contract, or Fiverr order link) is accessible and leads directly to the relevant content. Broken, expired, or restricted links without access granted will be declined.
  • Make sure your proof clearly shows that the listed company hired you directly for the project, connecting you, the client, and the work described.
  • Make sure your project description is clear, specific, and consistent with your proof. Focus on the work you did, not the client’s general reputation.
  • Make sure your project meets Fiverr’s eligibility requirements for Featured Clients, including accurate project dates and sufficient detail about the work completed.
  • Make sure the project you submit reflects a service you currently offer on Fiverr. Projects unrelated to your current Gigs will not be approved.
  • Make sure all proof and information you provide is authentic. Providing false or misleading information may result in actions on your Fiverr account.

How to add a Featured Client

You will receive an email and push notification when you become eligible to add Featured Clients. You can access the feature at any time via your profile page or freelancer dashboard.

Step 1: Go to your Featured Clients page
  • Log in to Fiverr and go to your profile.
  • Scroll to the Featured Clients section.
  • Click Add a client.
Step 2: Fill in the client details

Complete all required fields for each client:

  • Select from the pre-approved dropdown list. You cannot type in a custom company name.
  • Enter the dates of the project.
  • Describe the work you did for this client. Focus on the project details, not the client’s general reputation or your reviews. Here are some examples to guide you.
  • Good example:
    • I worked as a content creator for the Nike Marketing team, producing social media posts, blog articles, and customer offer copy. The project drove an increase in organic traffic and supported seasonal sales campaigns.
  • What to avoid:
    • I built a website for a client who has a store on Amazon. They were really happy with the result, which led to an increase in sales. This describes work done for a private individual using Amazon as a platform, not work done for Amazon as a client.
  • Provide at least one link that proves your working relationship (see Accepted proof types below).
  • Tick the checkbox to confirm you worked with this client and to allow Fiverr to display the client’s name and logo on your profile.
Step 3: Submit your proof

You must attach at least one of the following as your proof. Generic links such as google.com, youtube.com, or fiverr.com are not accepted.

  • A link to a portfolio containing the project you completed for this client
  • A link to an invoice for the services you provided
  • A link to a signed contract, or the Fiverr order link if the project was placed on Fiverr

If you have privacy concerns about sharing proof (for example, if documents contain banking details), you may blur or remove sensitive information before sharing, or provide a Google Drive link set to restricted access. Fiverr’s review team will request access when they review your submission.

Step 4: Submit and wait for review
  • Click Submit. You will see a confirmation message on screen.
  • Your submission will show as Pending while Fiverr reviews it.
  • The review process typically takes 2–3 weeks, but may take up to 8 weeks during high-demand periods.
  • You will receive an email when your submission is approved or if changes are needed.

The mobile app does not support adding or editing Featured Clients. Use Fiverr on a desktop browser to manage your featured clients.

Managing your Featured Clients

Editing or removing a client

You can edit or delete any approved Featured Client directly from your profile page. Hover over the client entry and select Edit or Delete.

Application statuses

Once you have submitted a client, you can track its status on your profile page. Here is what each status means:

Status

What it means

Pending

Your submission is being reviewed. Please wait for an email notification.

Approved

Your client is live on your profile and Gig page.

Declined

The entry was rejected because the information or proof did not meet the requirements. You will receive an email explaining what needs to be updated. You can delete the entry and resubmit it with corrected information.

Repeated declines may result in permanent removal of your Featured Clients eligibility.

Best practices

  • Choose clients that are directly relevant to the services you offer. Relevance builds credibility with potential clients browsing your profile.
  • Write clear, specific project descriptions. Explain what you did, not just who the client is.
  • Keep your proof links accessible and up to date. Broken or expired links can result in a declined submission.
  • Add up to five clients to maximize the social proof visible on your profile and Gig pages.
  • If you have more than five eligible clients, replace lower-profile entries over time to keep your profile current and impressive.

FAQ’s

  • You can add up to 5 featured clients.
  • They appear on your Fiverr profile page and Gig page immediately after approval.
  • Yes. You can add a company from Fiverr’s pre-approved list or submit one that’s not on the list, and we will let you know if it gets approved.
  • You will receive an email with details. You can delete the declined entry and resubmit it with updated information and proof.
  • Currently, you cannot manually reorder featured clients. The display order is determined automatically based on the Fortune 1000 list and company name length.
  • No. Once eligible, you keep access permanently regardless of level changes.
  • You can view your featured clients on the app, but adding and editing is only available on the desktop site.
  • At least one of: a portfolio link with the project, an invoice link, a contract link, or a Fiverr order link. Generic links are not accepted.
  • Typically 2–3 weeks. During busy periods it may take up to 8 weeks. Your entry will show as Pending until the review is complete.
  • This may be due to a missing company logo. If your approved client is not visible, contact Fiverr Support.

Fiverr agencies

Fiverr agencies give established companies a dedicated space on the platform to showcase their team, services, and expertise, making it easier for clients to find the right partner for large-scale, multi-disciplinary projects. This article explains what a Fiverr agency is, how to apply, and exactly what you need to complete your agency profile.

Eligibility & how to apply

Who can apply?

An agency on Fiverr is a company that employs a team of professionals with diverse skills and experience, offering a broad range of services and solutions. Unlike individual freelancers, agencies can manage multiple high-scale projects and clients simultaneously, with the capacity to scale up as demand grows.

  • A team of at least 3 in-house professionals
  • An active presence in one of the eligible categories
  • A solid online presence and the capacity to handle high-scale projects

Agencies are currently open to these categories only: Digital Marketing, Programming & Tech, Graphics & Design, Video and Animation, and Business. Additional categories will be added over time.

How to apply

Fiverr runs a thorough vetting process to ensure the quality and reliability of agencies on the platform. Here is how it works:

  • Invitations are sent to users who meet the current eligibility criteria.
  • You fill out the application form.
  • Qualified applicants are invited to create their agency from the profile self-view page.
  • After you complete onboarding, your agency details are carefully reviewed by the Fiverr team.
  • You are notified whether your agency is approved and live, or whether minor adjustments are needed to finalize your profile.

Not yet eligible? Join the waiting list to be notified as soon as your agency qualifies to apply.

Completing your agency profile

Once you are invited to create your agency, you will complete an onboarding form. All onboarding fields are mandatory. You do have the option to save your progress and return to complete the form later.

The section below summarizes each field, what is required, and tips for getting it right.

  • Requirement
  • Your official agency name.
  • Tip
  • Use the name clients will recognize. This will appear on your agency card and page.
  • Requirement
  • The year your agency was founded.
  • Tip
  • Must reflect when the agency itself was established, not when you joined Fiverr.
  • Requirement
  • The primary industry your agency specializes in. Search and choose from the drop-down.
  • Tip
  • Select at least 3 industries for the best visibility. Multiple selections are allowed.
  • Requirement
  • Choose from: 3–9, 10–49, 50–249, or more than 250.
  • Tip
  • This should reflect your full in-house team size.
  • Requirement
  • A description of your agency and the services you provide.
  • Tip
  • Write about the agency, not you as an individual. Include fields of expertise, experience, achievements, tools, and partnerships. A summarized version appears on your agency card in search results.
  • Requirement
  • Upload your agency logo or brand image.
  • Tip
  • This appears on your agency card. It should represent your agency brand and be different from your cover photo.
  • Requirement
  • Upload a visual image for the top of your agency page.
  • Tip
  • Size: 1280 x 776 px, 72 dpi. Keep text under 30% of the image surface. Do not include service descriptions, ratings, reviews, or credentials. Use high-quality images only.
  • Requirement
  • Add at least 3 team members. Up to 9 are allowed.
  • Tip
  • Organize by seniority. Include full names, roles, and profile photos (clear portrait, neutral background, single person, not cropped or blurry). Describe each member’s experience, skills, and expertise.
  • Requirement
  • Select your agency type from the available categories, then choose at least 2 service sub-categories.
  • Tip
  • Services appear on your profile page, not in the Skills section. Your individual Gig skills remain unaffected and can still be edited from the self-view page.

The Services section on your agency profile is separate from the Skills section on your individual Gigs. Adding or updating services here will not affect the skills listed on your existing Gigs.

Cover photo guidelines

Your cover photo is the banner image at the top of your agency page. It is the first visual impression clients get, so make it count. Follow these guidelines:

  • Image size: 1280 x 776 px, 72 dpi
  • Text: no more than 30% of the image surface
  • Content: visual representation only — no service descriptions, ratings, reviews, work experience, or credentials
  • Quality: high-resolution images only
  • Must be different from your profile image
Team member photo guidelines

Each team member’s photo should meet these standards:

  • Clear portrait with a neutral background
  • Single person only (no group shots)
  • Face should not be cropped
  • No busy or cluttered backgrounds
  • High quality — no blurry or pixelated images

Benefits of becoming a Fiverr Agency

Registering as an agency on Fiverr unlocks a number of advantages over a standard freelancer profile:

Visibility & discovery
  • Your agency is eligible to appear in dedicated sections where Fiverr suggests clients order from agencies.
  • Clients can use the “Seller type” filter to search for agencies specifically, making it easier for the right clients to find you.
  • Your freelancer profile becomes a full agency page that includes your team members, services, and agency description — all in one place.
Operational benefits
  • Agencies often work on large projects that require upfront alignment. The book-a-meeting feature lets you schedule a free video meeting with prospective clients before the order begins. If you have the paid consultation feature active on your account, it will automatically revert to a free meeting.
  • Your orders, Gigs, chats, and reviews carry over when you switch to an agency profile. The only things that change are your profile page layout and how you appear in search results.

What changes & what stays the same

Switching to an agency profile does not reset your Fiverr history. Here is a clear breakdown:

  • What stays the same when you switch to an agency profile:
    • All existing orders
    • Gigs
    • Chats and inbox
    • Reviews and ratings
    • Financial / earnings page
  • What changes when you switch to an agency profile:
    • Your profile page (becomes an agency page)
    • How you appear in search results (agency card instead of Gig card)

Best practices

  • Write your agency description as a business, not as an individual. Mention your fields of expertise, experience, tools, partnerships, awards, and what makes your agency different.
  • Organize your team members by seniority and use professional portrait photos. This builds client trust before they even read a word.
  • Select at least 3 industries in the Industry field to maximize discoverability.
  • Keep your cover photo visual and brand-focused. Avoid using it as a second profile description.
  • Use the free meeting tool proactively. For large projects, a short alignment call before the order starts reduces misunderstandings and protects both sides.
  • Check back on eligible categories regularly. Fiverr is expanding the agency program and your category may become available soon.

FAQs

  • Digital Marketing, Programming & Tech, Graphics & Design, Video and Animation, and Business. More categories will be added over time.
  • Invitations are sent to users who meet the current criteria. If you are not yet eligible, you can join the waiting list to be notified when your agency qualifies to apply.
  • You must add at least 3 team members during onboarding. Up to 9 team members are allowed.
  • Yes. Your orders, Gigs, chats, and reviews all remain unchanged when you switch to an agency profile. Only your profile page and appearance in search results will change.
  • It is possible but not recommended. Future phases of the agency product will introduce role and permission management features that depend on a single account. Each email can only be connected to one Fiverr account.
  • Agencies can offer a free video meeting with prospective clients before an order begins to align on the project. If you have the paid consultation feature active, it automatically reverts to free for agency meetings.
  • You can switch back, but if you later want to become an agency again, you may need to go through the full onboarding process from the beginning.
  • No. The Services section on your agency profile is separate from the Skills section on your Gigs. Your Gig skills remain unchanged and can still be edited from the self-view page.

Fiverr Community & Rewards Store explained

The Fiverr Community is an online platform for freelancers to connect, collaborate, and share knowledge. By joining, you become part of a supportive network that helps you succeed on the platform. The Community also features the Rewards Store, a program that recognizes and rewards your contributions and active participation.

What is the Fiverr Community?

The Community provides a space for freelancing-related conversations, whether you’re seeking advice, support, or looking to engage with others.

How you can benefit:

  • Tips and advice on growing your Fiverr business.
  • Productivity hacks for freelancers.
  • Industry news and updates.
  • Inspiration and motivation from other Fiverr members.

You can join discussions, ask questions, and learn from fellow members. The Community’s key features include:

  • Freelancers with one completed order are eligible to engage in discussions within the Forum. The Forum consists of a variety of topics to help you navigate your freelancing experience. Learn more about how to navigate the forum. Freelancers who have not yet completed an order will automatically have access to the Community and will automatically be included in the Forum upon first order completion.
  • Access helpful guides, articles, and tutorials to improve your skills and knowledge. For instance, freelancers can learn how to build their personal brand or develop strategies for offering new Gigs. Clients can better understand how to choose the right freelancer and engage in the clients guide for navigating common challenges.
  • Connect with other freelancers to build relationships and find support from like-minded individuals.
  • Join various clubs, including program-specific spaces such as Seller Plus, and localized chapters. Localized chapters provide a space for users to communicate and connect with freelancers in their region. So far, we have chapters in Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Pakistan, India, France, Germany (Deutschland), the UK, and the US.
  • Fiverr hosts regular online events with topics ranging from internal trends and communication best practices to AI and the future of work.

Learn more about joining the Fiverr Community.

Best practices for Community engagement
  • Search for answers first: Before posting a new question, use the search bar to see if the same or a similar question has already been asked. This helps you find answers more quickly and avoids duplicate posts.
  • Contribute to others: It’s a place where you can not only get help but also contribute to the growth of others in the Fiverr ecosystem.
  • Limit the use of AI: The community is all about authentic human-to-human connection. It’s acceptable to use AI to tidy up your grammar, but make sure you’re only posting your original thoughts and opinions.
  • No self-promotions: The community is primarily comprised of Fiverr freelancers building their businesses, just like you, so avoid promoting your gigs, posting links to your services, or cold-messaging people for advice or help.

What is the Community Rewards Store?

The Community Rewards Store is a new program designed to recognize and reward users for their active participation and contributions in the Fiverr Community.

When you sign up, rewards start accumulating immediately, with your first award coming after you complete onboarding. Top Rated Seller (TRS) and Pro freelancers get bonus points when they sign up.

Learn more about the Community Rewards program here.

You also earn points for actively contributing to the platform in the following ways:

  • Event participation: Including hosting, speaking at, organizing, or attending an event.
  • Content engagement: Such as speaking in a video, authoring content, watching videos, or reading content.
  • Forum activity: Points are earned for publishing a post, commenting on or replying to a post, and having your answer accepted.
  • General activity: Including completing onboarding, joining a club, and daily active participation.

When you’re ready, you can redeem your points for exciting rewards. Options include Fiverr-branded merchandise, gift cards and Fiverr credits. Check out our full catalogue here.

FAQs

  • The Community is open to all Fiverr freelancers and clients who want to connect and share knowledge about freelancing on the platform.
  • No, the Fiverr Community is a free platform for all users.
  • You can redeem your points for rewards by viewing our full catalogue available in the Rewards Store.

Fiverr Enterprise (Freelancers: Features & programs)

Fiverr Enterprise is a Freelance Management System (FMS) that enables businesses to source, hire, onboard, manage, and pay their external workforce more effectively while ensuring legal and tax compliance. Unlike a typical freelance marketplace, Fiverr Enterprise is a system that helps businesses find and manage freelance talent within their own ecosystem. While Fiverr Pro focuses on individual client connections, Fiverr Enterprise acts as a matchmaker, connecting freelancers with relevant job opportunities within large organizations.

Overview

Fiverr Enterprise provides a centralized solution for high-level management of external workforces.

Why it’s useful:

  • Streamlined management: Centralizes engagements, work descriptions, and payment tracking.
  • Compliance: Ensures all engagements meet legal and tax compliance requirements.
  • Project variety: Handles hourly, fixed, or retainer-based projects, with a specific focus on long-term engagements.

Who it’s for:

  • Clients: Typically big tech companies and digital agencies.

How it works for Freelancers

The process is designed to be automated and non-intrusive:

  • Invitation: You will receive an email asking if you are interested in offering your freelance talent on Fiverr Enterprise.
  • Profile activation: You will receive a notification via email when your profile becomes visible to potential clients.
  • Job offers: If a client wishes to use your services, you will be notified of the job offer via email.
  • Decision: You can review the work descriptions and choose to accept or decline the offer.

Note: You are under no obligation to accept work. Declining an offer will not affect your Fiverr Pro metrics.

How it works for Clients

To be a part of Fiverr Enterprise, visit the Fiverr Enterprise page and book a demo with the team.

FAQs

  • Fiverr Enterprise uses public information from your Fiverr Pro profile, including your profile image, home country, education, skills, and display name.
  • It creates a profile visible to all Fiverr Enterprise clients, allowing them to reach out to you for job offers and potential collaborations. This includes your username and email address.
  • The platform features hourly, fixed, or retainer-based projects, focusing primarily on long-term work. Clients are generally digital agencies and big tech companies.
  • All engagements are managed via the Fiverr Enterprise solution, where you can accept or decline offers and track your earnings.

Fiverr Pro community

The Fiverr Pro community is specifically for our top freelancers. This community serves as a central hub for networking, professional growth, and accessing a wealth of resources tailored to enhance your freelance career. Here, you’ll find everything from personal introductions and networking opportunities and get a dose of motivation from freelancer success stories. The community also offers direct access to premium webinars, the latest announcements, and unique business growth strategies, including insights from industry leaders.

Pro freelancers can strengthen their skills, expand their pro network, and get resources for continuous career development.

Join the Fiverr Pro freelance talent community and master your freelancing career here.

Community resources

Pro network central:
  • A space to introduce yourself and foster connections within the Pro community.
  • Explore and create collaboration and partnership opportunities within Fiverr Pro.
  • See, share, and celebrate notable achievements and milestones by fellow community members.

  • The go-to source for the latest updates and developments.
Pro mastery:

Community benefits

  • Achieve career success with best practices tailored for Fiverr Pro. Gain exclusive access to advanced features, resources, and commercial insights. Continuous learning and development to stay ahead in your freelance career.
  • Leverage crowdsourced advice to enhance your skills. Engage in valuable networking opportunities for collaborative projects. Benefit from a community-driven knowledge base.
  • Directly impact Fiverr Pro with your feedback - your voice matters. Enjoy priority community support, ensuring your concerns are addressed promptly. Influence the direction and development of the community through active participation.

Can anyone access the Fiverr Pro community?

No, the community is exclusive to Fiverr Pro pre-vetted freelancers.

For any questions, contact our Customer Support team by using the ‘Contact us’ tab at the bottom of the page or join the community forum.

Fiverr Pro freelancer: Badge and benefits

Fiverr is the world’s largest marketplace for digital services. Fiverr brings clients and freelancers together by enabling freelancers and digital agencies to offer their services, or as we call them - “Gigs,” so businesses can quickly select and hire freelance talent. As a verified Pro freelancer, you are part of a hand-vetted group of professionals -in other words, you’re the best of the best! Now you will have access to over 11,000,000 businesses that use Fiverr to hire freelancers - and your Fiverr Pro status means that you will truly stand out in the marketplace.

The Pro benefits

The Pro badge

Boost visibility with an exclusive badge on your profile and services. The Vetted Pro badge signifies your vetted status on Fiverr and helps you stand out to clients looking for business skills.

As of March 2025: We’ve updated the badge design to improve clarity, transparency, and recognition of your Pro status. We believe the new badge provides:

  • We’re moving the Pro badge away from profile pictures to eliminate any confusion with identity verification indicators.
  • The new design ensures clients understand that the Pro badge represents a vetted professional, not a paid subscription or premium membership, as seen on other platforms.
More benefits
  • The dedicated Pro catalog connects you with top clients for bigger, ongoing projects. The curated catalog enhances your visibility, offering business clients an easy-to-access collection of Fiverr’s best freelancers.
  • Showcase career milestones on your profile, from past achievements to current skills. Provide potential clients with a better understanding of your skills through your work history.
  • Kick-start your Pro journey with a dedicated session. We’ll guide you to success as a Pro freelancer, outlining expectations, benefits, and tips to effectively work with business clients.
  • Join our Pro-only hub for career advancement resources, strategic partnership opportunities, and perks. Network with peers, learn business growth strategies, and insider tips. Stay informed with the latest news and attend premium webinars.
  • We believe in your ability to deliver excellent work and have your back if a Pro client is unsatisfied and cancels the order within 14 days.

Getting started

Only registered users can order and offer services on Fiverr. Signing up is quick and easy. Be sure to use the same email address you used for your Fiverr Pro freelancer application when creating your Fiverr account so that we can link you to your Fiverr Pro status.

Put some thought into the username you choose as it can’t be changed once it’s created.

For more information and the next steps, see Creating your Fiverr Pro account. Once your profile is set up, it’s time to create your first Gig so you can get hired! Get details on the process in our article, Creating and optimizing your Fiverr Pro Gig.

Most often, you can expect to receive inquiries from small businesses and entrepreneurs. Those looking, specifically, for Fiverr Pro freelancers usually have higher budgets.

    • How much do you usually charge for your service?

You can always adjust your prices later if you find you are not getting the number of inquiries you were expecting, or you want to attract clients with bigger projects.
