Fiverr Pro satisfaction guarantee - Freelancer guide

What is Fiverr Pro satisfaction guarantee?

Fiverr Pro offers Pro clients a full money-back guarantee for every order from a Pro freelancer and orders from Pro’s managed services.

Why is it necessary?

At Fiverr Pro, we trust our freelancers’ ability to deliver excellent work and prioritize clients’ satisfaction. This offer is designed to provide a safety net for both you and the client and emphasize our commitment to your success on Fiverr Pro.

Will it affect my revenues or cancellation rate?

No, the cancellation of an order only due to client dissatisfaction will not affect your revenue from the order and will not count toward your cancellation rate.

How would I know if a client is ordering on Fiverr Pro?

Find out if a client is Pro by checking if the Pro badge appears next to the client’s username in your Inbox messages. If the Pro client didn’t message you via Inbox but placed an order instead, in the early events of the Order page will display the message ‘This user is a Fiverr Pro client’.

Important:

  • This offer is limited to the specific time frame listed above, and all Fiverr Terms of Service Apply.
  • The offer is only for Pro clients. Find out if a client is Pro by checking if the Pro badge appears next to the client’s username in your Inbox messages. If the Pro client didn’t message you via Inbox but placed an order instead, the early events of the Order page will display the following message ‘This user is a Fiverr Pro client’.
  • The refund amount is limited to the amount of the order.
  • The Fiverr Pro satisfaction guarantee does not apply to hourly orders.
  • Use of a canceled order by a client is strictly prohibited. You will retain all of your rights as freelancers for the canceled order.
  • Fiverr reserves the right to determine which orders are eligible, and to exclude instances of abuse, fraud, or any other inappropriate activity.

Fiverr’s Freelancer Reward Program

Fiverr’s Freelancer Rewards Program is designed to reward certain high-performing Fiverr freelancers by granting a cash bonus based on annual earnings growth on Fiverr. This program encourages and acknowledges eligible freelancers who consistently excel and expand their success within Fiverr.

Important: Fiverr cannot offer advice on taxes or legal matters. For guidance on these topics, you should consult your tax professional.

Enrollment into the program is currently closed.

Award value

Eligible freelancers will be awarded a bonus of $10,000 over four years, distributed as $2,500 annually, subject to meeting the annual eligibility criteria.

Continuing annual eligibility

Freelancers must achieve a minimum of $30,000 in annual earnings and at least a 10% annual earnings growth compared to the previous year to qualify for the $2,500 cash bonus each year.

  • Currently available open only to individual freelancers who are defined as a U.S. person by the U.S. tax authorities.
  • Must be either a Pro freelancer or a Top Rated freelancer for a consecutive period of at least one year and throughout the entire Measurement Period (defined below).

In case a freelancer loses their Pro or TRS status, they will be withdrawn from Fiverr’s Freelancer Rewards Program.

Measurement & award schedule

  • January 1 - December 31 of the qualifying year.
  • During the first quarter following the Measurement Period, if you meet all eligibility criteria.
  • Earnings include payments from completed orders and hourly contracts that have completed their clearance periods and any compensation handled by customer support during the Measurement Period, and exclude payments from canceled orders, payments being cleared, and payments for active orders.

Learn more about our program terms here. For further assistance, please contact your Success manager if applicable.

FAQs

  • On your ‘Earnings’ page, track your yearly earnings with filters for ‘Since joining,’ ‘This year,’ or ‘This month’ to get a comprehensive view:
  • Your earnings growth is calculated based on your total earnings on Fiverr for each calendar year compared to the previous year. For example, your 2025 earnings will be compared to your 2024 earnings to determine if you’ve met the 10% growth target.
  • Growth is calculated on an annual basis, so individual monthly fluctuations won’t directly impact your eligibility. This allows for natural business cycles while focusing on long-term growth.
  • Yes, your growth is calculated based on net earnings not including any cancellations or refunds. This ensures the program rewards sustainable, high-quality business growth.
  • You can pause your activities on Fiverr and still remain in the program. It is important to note that extended periods of inactivity may affect your ability to meet annual earnings growth targets. In order to qualify for share grants, you must meet the growth targets each year, regardless of your time off.

Legal disclaimer:

Participation in Fiverr’s Freelancer Reward Program is subject to eligibility in accordance with the terms of the program. Fiverr reserves the right to cancel, amend or terminate the program at any time without prior notice. The program and each issuance of Fiverr’s shares are subject to applicable laws, including applicable U.S. securities laws.

Freelancer Referral Program

The freelancer referral program lets you recommend trusted freelancers directly to your clients in an inbox conversation. Whether you can’t take on a project, don’t offer a specific service, or simply know the perfect person for the job, referring another freelancer helps your client move forward while strengthening your relationship with them.

Before you begin

  • You must be a Level 1, Level 2, Top Rated, or Pro freelancer to use this feature. If you are demoted below Level 1, you lose access to the program.
  • The freelancer you refer must also be Level 1 or above, or Pro.
  • You can only refer a specific freelancer to a specific client once.
  • Each referral message can include up to three freelancers.

How to send a referral

  • In any inbox conversation, click the Refer a freelancer icon to open the referral tool.
  • For each freelancer you want to refer, do one of the following:
    • Paste their Fiverr username (without the @) or the URL to their profile or a specific Gig.
    • Click Get suggestions to browse Fiverr’s recommendations: freelancers offering related services, similar freelancers, or your previous referrals.
    • Click Search on Fiverr to find someone new.
  • Once you’ve added a freelancer, you’ll see a preview of their profile. Write a short explanation of why they’re a good fit for the client (10 to 500 characters, required).
  • To add more freelancers, click + Add another referral and repeat this step. You can include up to three freelancers per referral message.
  • If you see an error when adding a freelancer, check the following:
    • Ineligible freelancer: the person you’re referring, doesn’t meet the level requirements.
    • Invalid URL: the link is not a valid Fiverr username or Gig link.
    • Self-referral: you tried to refer yourself.
    • Already referred this freelancer: you’ve already referred this person to this client.
  • Add an intro message to guide your client (10 to 2,000 characters required). This message appears above the freelancer cards in the conversation.
  • Click Send to client to deliver the referral message. Your client will see the freelancer cards in the conversation and can click each one to view their full profile. If they choose to contact a referred freelancer, a note with your name appears at the top of that new conversation for up to 60 days.

Track your referrals

Go to Growth & Marketing > Referrals to view your Referrals page.

Under “Referrals I’ve given”:

  • Total referrals given: total number of referrals you’ve shared with clients.
  • Orders created: number of orders placed with your referrals.
  • Orders completed: number of orders completed by your referrals.
  • Fiverr Credits received: total credits earned from completed referral orders.

Under “Referrals I’ve received”:

  • Freelancers who referred me: number of freelancers who referred you to clients.
  • Total referrals received: number of referrals you’ve received.
  • Orders I’ve completed: number of orders you’ve completed through others’ referrals.

Earn Fiverr Credits

When a client completes an order with a freelancer you referred, you earn Fiverr Credits equal to 2.5% of the order’s total value, excluding tips, taxes, and fees. There is no cap on the amount you can earn.

Example: If the referred freelancer completes a $150 USD order, you receive $3.75 USD in Fiverr Credits (2.5% of $150 USD).

A few rules to keep in mind:

  • The order must be completed within 60 days of your referral.
  • You only earn credits for the first completed order between the referred freelancer and that client.
  • You can only refer a specific freelancer to a specific client once.
  • If multiple freelancers refer the same freelancer to the same client, all of them earn credits if the client completes an order.
  • Credits are valid for 90 days from the date they are issued.
  • Credits cannot be withdrawn or refunded, but they can be used toward Fiverr orders and freelancer programs: Fiverr Ads and Seller Plus.

See more in the Freelancer Referral Program Terms of Service and Fiverr’s Payment Terms.

Earn the referral profile badge

You can earn a badge for your profile that shows you are trusted by other freelancers. To qualify:

  • Complete at least three orders for clients referred to you by other freelancers.
  • Share at least 10 referrals with clients.

Your progress toward the badge appears on your Referrals page.

Best practices

  • Refer freelancers whose skills directly match your client’s next step. A relevant, targeted referral is far more useful than a general one.
  • Write a specific, personalized reason for each referral. The more context you give, the more likely the client is to follow through.
  • Refer freelancers proactively, even when your client hasn’t asked. It demonstrates commitment to their project’s success.
  • Check your Referrals page regularly to see which referrals are converting and who is referring you in return.

FAQs

  • Level 1, Level 2, Top Rated, and Pro freelancers can use this feature. If you are demoted below Level 1, you lose access.
  • You can refer any Level 1 or above freelancer, or a Pro freelancer, whether you know them personally or not. Use Get suggestions or Search on Fiverr to find someone new.
  • Credits are added to your balance once the referred order is completed. You’ll receive an email notification with the amount.
  • You won’t earn credits from that referral, but it still counts toward your total referrals given and your badge progress.
  • No. You can only refer a specific freelancer to a specific client once.
  • The freelancer referral program is for recommending active Fiverr freelancers to your existing clients. Fiverr’s referral program is for inviting new people to join Fiverr as clients; it offers a discount on their first order and credits based on that order’s value.

Growth Tools for Seller Plus

Seller Plus includes three tools designed to help you attract new clients, reward returning ones, and re-engage past clients. This article explains how to use First-time client promotions, Coupons, and Follow-up messages and how to get the most out of them.

How to access your marketing tools

  • Log in to your Fiverr freelancer account.
  • Click Growth & Marketing in the top navigation menu.
  • Select Marketing Tools from the dropdown.

All monthly limits reset on your Seller Plus monthly billing cycle date, not the calendar month. Unused allowances do not roll over.

First-time client promotions

First-time client promotions let you offer a 5% or 10% discount to clients who have never ordered from you before. Eligible clients see a promotion pop-up when they visit a Gig you have included in the promotion. The discount is applied automatically to their first order.

  • Seller Plus Standard members have a monthly limit of 10 orders.
  • Seller Plus Premium members have a monthly limit of 20 orders.

If the limit is reached, all active and scheduled promotions for the current monthly billing cycle automatically end.

About First-time client promotions

First-time client promotions let you offer an automatic discount to clients who have never ordered from you before.

The basics

  • You set a discount of 5% or 10%, choose which Gigs to include, and set a start and end date (up to 30 days).
  • The discount is applied automatically; the client does not need a code.
  • “First-time” means new to you, not new to Fiverr.
  • Clients who have ordered from you before won’t see the promotion.
  • Once created, a promotion cannot be edited. You can end it early by clicking the three dots next to an active promotion and selecting End Early.

Requirements

  • You can have up to five active or scheduled promotions at a time, with only one per Gig.
  • Eligible Gigs must have at least one package priced at $15 USD or more.
  • Cannot be combined with coupons, custom offers, or milestone orders.

How to track promotions

You can see all your promotions, including status, discount rate, orders generated, and dates, from the My Promotions tab on your Marketing Tools page.

First-time client promotions cannot be edited once created or combined with seller coupons, other discounts, custom offers, or milestone orders.

  • Follow these steps to set up a new First-time client promotion:
    • Go to Growth & Marketing and click on Marketing Tools.
    • Click Create a promotion.
    • Select the Gigs you want to include, then click Add promotion details.
    • Enter a promotion name (visible to you only), select your discount, and set the start and end dates.
    • Click Review details, then click Confirm promotion.
  • Go to the My Promotions tab on the Marketing Tools page to see all your promotions, including their name, discount amount, dates, orders generated, and current status.
  • To end a promotion early, click the three dots next to an active promotion and select End Early.

Watch this short video to see how to create a First-time client promotion:

Coupons

Coupons let you send a personalized discount code directly to past clients to encourage a repeat order. Coupons are client-specific and can only be used by the client you send them to.

Coupons are offered by you directly to your clients, not by Fiverr. The discount amount comes out of your earnings. Your revenue will equal 80% of the post-discount order amount.

  • Here’s how coupons work:
    • You set the discount (up to 30% off) and send it to a specific client from your Marketing Tools page.
    • The coupon is tied to that client only; it cannot be used by anyone else, and it can only be used once.
    • It’s valid for 30 days from the date you send it.
    • The discount comes out of your earnings, not Fiverr’s fee. Your revenue equals 80% of the post-discount order amount.
  • There are two types of coupons you can send:
    • Repeat client coupons: Sent directly to past clients through the Marketing Tools page. Valid for 30 days.
    • Custom offer coupons: A discount you attach to a custom offer. This is the only way to send a coupon to a client who has never ordered from you before.
  • Before sending a coupon, make sure you meet the following requirements:
    • Monthly limit: Kickstart and Standard members receive five coupons. Premium members receive 20 coupons. Unused coupons do not roll over and reset on your Seller Plus monthly billing date.
    • Discount: Up to a maximum of 30% off the Gig price.
    • Minimum order amount: Coupons cannot be applied to orders below $15 USD.
    • Client-specific: Each coupon can only be used by the client it was sent to, and only once.
    • Cannot be combined with: Fiverr Credits, tips, or other promotional discounts. On milestone orders, the coupon applies to the first milestone only.
    • Cancelled orders: If an order is cancelled, the coupon cannot be reused or replaced.
  • You can track coupon usage and stats from the My Coupons tab on the Marketing Tools page.
How to send a repeat client coupon
  • Go to Growth & Marketing and click on Marketing Tools.
  • Click Send a coupon.
  • Select the clients you want to send a coupon to.
  • Set the discount (up to 30%).
  • Add an optional personal note (up to 250 characters).
  • Click Send. The client receives an email and notification with the coupon.

You can also add a coupon when sending a custom offer. At the bottom of the offer creation form, check the box for Offer a Coupon and set the discount before sending.

Follow-up messages

Follow-up messages let you send a personalized message to past clients from your Fiverr dashboard to encourage repeat orders or introduce them to other Gigs you offer. All messages must adhere to Fiverr’s Terms of Service and Community Standards.

Follow-up messages are available to Seller Plus Standard and Premium members only. The tool works on the web and can be viewed on the app.

  • Here’s how follow-up messages work:
    • You choose a client, pick a message type, write your message, and send.
    • The message lands in the client’s inbox labeled “Follow-up from [your username]” so they know it’s a proactive outreach, not a regular conversation.
    • You can only send one follow-up per completed order.
  • Choose from two message types when sending a follow-up:
    • Encourage to reorder: The client sees the last Gig they ordered from you. Only available if that Gig is still active.
    • Offer other Gigs: You select one to three active Gigs for the client to see alongside your message.
  • Follow-up messages are subject to the following conditions:
    • Monthly limit: Standard members get 10 per billing cycle. Premium members get 20 per billing cycle. The limit resets on your Seller Plus billing date.
    • Character limit: 250 characters per message.
    • Eligible clients: Clients who completed an order with you in the last 60 days and do not have an active coupon from you.
    • One message per order: You can only send one follow-up per completed order.
    • Client opt-out: Clients can unsubscribe from follow-up messages at any time. Once unsubscribed, they cannot re-subscribe, and you cannot contact them through this tool.
How to send a Follow-up message
  • Go to Growth & Marketing and click on Marketing Tools.
  • Select the Follow-up Messages tab.
  • Browse or search for the client you want to contact.
  • Choose your message type: Encourage to reorder or Offer other Gigs.
  • Write your message. Fiverr provides a default template; we recommend editing it to sound personal and relevant to the client.
  • Preview your message and select Gigs, then send.

Tip: Personalizing the default message, even briefly, tends to get a better response. Reference the specific project you worked on together or note something relevant to the Gig you are suggesting.

Best practices

  • Use First-time client promotions on Gigs that are not already high-performers. This helps you gain new repeat clients without discounting your most in-demand work.
  • Send repeat client coupons shortly after delivering an order, while the experience is still fresh. The sooner you follow up, the higher the chance of a repeat order.
  • Use custom offer coupons to convert new leads; it is the only way to send a coupon to a client who has never ordered from you before.
  • Use Follow-up messages strategically; you have a limited monthly quota. Prioritize clients from high-value orders or those most likely to benefit from a follow-up.
  • Keep follow-up messages short, specific, and personal. The 250-character limit encourages brevity; use it to your advantage.
  • Track all three tools from the Marketing Tools page to see which are driving the most orders and adjust your approach accordingly.

FAQs

  • All Seller Plus tiers (Kickstart, Standard, Premium) can use First-time client promotions and Coupons. Follow-up messages are available to Standard and Premium members only.
  • A client who has never placed an order with you before. It does not matter whether they are new to Fiverr; only whether they have previously ordered from you.
  • The discount comes out of your earnings. For coupons and promotions, your revenue equals 80% of the post-discount order amount. Fiverr’s 20% is calculated on the discounted price.
  • Only through a custom offer. Repeat client coupons can only be sent to clients you have worked with before.
  • No. Once a promotion is created it cannot be edited. You can end it early by clicking the three dots next to an active promotion and selecting End Early.
  • No. Unused coupons, promotion order slots, and follow-up message credits all expire at the end of your billing cycle and do not carry over.
  • On your Seller Plus billing cycle date, not the first of the calendar month.
  • No. Coupons cannot be combined with Fiverr Credits, promotions, or other discounted rates. On milestone orders, the coupon applies to the first milestone only.
  • You can no longer send them follow-up messages through this tool. Clients who unsubscribe cannot re-subscribe.
  • From the Marketing Tools page, the My Promotions, My Coupons, and Follow-ups tabs show the status and results of each tool.

How can I purchase & manage Google Workspace on Fiverr? (Freelancers: Features & programs)

What is Google Workspace?

Google Workspace is a cloud-based suite for professional communication, collaboration, and productivity.

It includes:

  • Gmail, Calendar, Meet & Chat for communication
  • Google Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides & Forms for creation and storage
  • Admin controls, security tools, and AI-powered features

When you purchase through Fiverr, you can:

  • Manage subscriptions in one place
  • Access exclusive discounts (50% off for new users, 20% off transfers)
  • Enjoy simplified setup and management

What plans are available on Fiverr?

Fiverr offers two subscription plans: Business Starter and Business Premium.

Both plans include:

  • Unlimited devices, cross-platform compatibility
  • Smart Canvas, real-time collaboration, advanced scheduling
  • Gemini AI Premium plan
  • Security: SSO, 2-step verification, password monitoring, spam/virus/phishing protection
  • Migration tools from free @gmail.com to your domain email
Additional benefits per package:
  • 30GB of pooled storage.
    • 2TB of pooled storage
    • Personalized email campaigns
    • Meeting recordings
    • Shared drives

New to Google Workspace? You can receive 50% off your first subscription by visiting: Fiverr Google Workspace and clicking “Claim your Discount.”

If you already have an active GWS subscription, you can transfer it to Fiverr and receive a 20% discount on your subscription payments. Click here.

What should I know before I purchase?

  • You must own the domain you register with.
  • If you already have Workspace, you can’t buy a new one for the same domain; You must modify the existing subscription instead.
  • Annual commitment plans can’t be downgraded or partially canceled.
  • Taxes are applied at checkout based on billing details.
  • Purchases are non-refundable.

How do I purchase Google Workspace on Fiverr?

  • Go to the Google Workspace page on Fiverr.
  • On the product card, enter your product key from a freelancer, or click “Skip.”
  • Choose your plan: Business Starter or Business Premium.
  • Enter your domain: Use an existing domain, or buy a new domain from the dropdown list.
  • Complete contact and business info.
  • Review your order:
    • Set number of seats
    • View discounts
    • Add payment details
    • Enable or disable auto-renewal
  • Agree to the terms and click “Confirm.”

What happens after I purchase?

After completing your order, you’ll receive confirmation emails from both Fiverr and Google.

- Sign in to the Google admin console within 24 hours using the activation link (the link expires after 24 hours). If the link expires, contact Fiverr support.
- Accept the Google product agreement.
- Activate your license.
- You’ll receive a purchase receipt and invoice.
- Once your account is verified, you’ll have full access to Gmail and all other Google Workspace tools.

How do I manage my Workspace subscription on Fiverr?

In the Fiverr admin console, you can:

  • Create users and set access rights
  • Add secondary domains
  • Personalize the dashboard
  • Adjust settings and billing

Tip: Adding seats is done in the GWS subscription console, not in your Google admin console.

Common actions

- Log in to your [GWS Subscription Console](http://fiverr-manage.gsubscriptions.com/) using the same email address and password as your Google Workspace account. If the login field is pre-filled with a domain name, delete it before entering your full email address.
- Access the 'Subscriptions' tab.
- Select the Subscription you want to modify by clicking on the "Subscription name" to open it.
- Select "Edit" on the subscription.
- Choose to apply changes now or on a custom date.
- Adjust the seat count and click "Save."
- Accept the Terms & Conditions.
- Scroll to the bottom of your subscription page (if upgrades are available).
- Click "Upgrade."
- Complete the form and click "Save."
- In the subscription view, click "Edit."
- Go to the 'Details' tab and check or uncheck auto-renewal.
- Save changes immediately or set a custom date.
- Sign in to the Google admin console.
- Go to account > Domains > Manage domain.
- Add and verify your new domain.
- Update MX records to activate Gmail.
- Sign in to the Google admin console using a super administrator account. If you’re not signed in as a super administrator, you won’t be able to complete this process.
- Go to Menu > Account > Reseller management. If you don’t see this option, open the [reseller management page](https://admin.google.com/ac/resellermanagement) directly.
- Go to 'Subscriptions from resellers' or 'Subscriptions from Google', find the subscription that you want to transfer, and click "Transfer."
- Enter C016bjjss and click "Continue."
- For each product group that you want to transfer, select "Transfer to" reseller name, and click "Continue."
- Check the box to agree to theTerms and Conditions and click "Generate transfer authorization."
- Click "Close."
- To complete the transfer, email support@fiverr.com and provide your domain or Cloud ID associated with your Google Workspace account.

Common issues and best practices

  • Can’t log in for the first time? Contact Fiverr support for a new temporary password.
  • Domain verification problems? Contact your domain host for DNS help.
  • Enable two-step verification for better security.

How to become a Fiverr Pro freelancer

Fiverr Pro is a premium marketplace dedicated to connecting top clients and freelancers. Every Pro freelancer is handpicked to ensure they offer the highest level of quality and service to our business clients.

Fiverr Pro explained

Fiverr Pro empowers both freelancers and clients to connect with the best, tackle bigger projects, and leverage exclusive resources for growth.

Fiverr Pro for freelancers:

  • What it is: Fiverr Pro is a curated tier on Fiverr where freelancers are vetted for the highest quality of work, service, and professionalism.
  • Why is it useful: It gives you a Pro badge on your profile and Gigs, which boosts your visibility and signifies your vetted status to clients. You also gain access to a dedicated Pro catalog for top clients and larger projects.
  • Who is it for: The application is open to all freelancers, whether you are new to Fiverr or a long-time freelancer.

Fiverr Pro benefits for freelancers

As a Pro freelancer, you gain the following exclusive benefits:

  • A blue checkmark on your profile and services that helps you stand out to clients.
  • The dedicated Pro catalog connects you with top clients for bigger, ongoing projects.
  • Establish credibility by requesting up to five endorsements from clients outside of Fiverr to showcase your expertise.
  • Join a Pro-only hub for networking, career advancement resources, and access to premium webinars.
  • Fiverr will support you if a Pro client is unsatisfied and cancels an order within 14 days. Read more about the Pro satisfaction guarantee.
  • Showcase career milestones and work history on your profile to help potential clients understand your skills.

Application and requirements

  • To become a Fiverr Pro freelancer, you must submit an application. Please be aware that being a Fiverr Pro client does not grant you the ability to operate as a freelancer or offer services on the platform.
  • The selection process for freelancers is based on various factors, including your current category or subcategory. If your category isn’t listed, you can choose to be notified when applications reopen.

    • Graphic and Design
    • Programming and Tech
    • Writing and Translation
    • Video and Animation
    • Digital Marketing
    • Music and Audio
    • Business
    • Data

  • If you’ve applied to become a Fiverr Pro freelancer, please be aware that some categories may have a longer review timeframe which can delay response times.
  • Note: More categories will be released gradually. You are welcome to apply now regardless of your category.
  • To increase your chances of being accepted, follow these best practices for your application:
    • Provide accurate & detailed information: Use the free text fields to promote yourself and include information about your business, studio, and the skills of any employees.
    • Showcase your skills: Share portfolio links for work done for both Fiverr and external clients. Highlight work for your most high-profile business clients, and link to where the result can be seen live.
    • Share your social platforms: This is not required, but it is helpful in verifying your identity and will speed up the process.
    • Describe your creative process: Share your workflow in detail, including any specific software you use.
  • Note: The review process may take longer than usual due to the high volume of applications.
  • Fiverr Pro freelancers must consistently meet high expectations for delivery excellence and professionalism to maintain their status.
  • Assessment criteria includes:
    • Client communication & satisfaction
    • Adherence to Fiverr’s Terms of Service & Community Standards
    • Responsiveness
    • On-time delivery
    • Maintaining satisfactory ratings
  • Note: The determination to demote or place a freelancer on probation is at the discretion of Fiverr.

Managing orders with Request to order

The Request to order feature gives you more control over your workflow by allowing you to review project requirements before an order begins. This ensures better alignment with clients, reduces cancellations, and helps you manage your schedule effectively.

What is the Request to order feature?

Request to order shifts the order process from automatic acceptance to a manual review. Instead of a client purchasing a Gig immediately, they must submit a request for your approval.

This feature is exclusive to Seller Plus Premium members.

Instead of automatically accepting orders as soon as clients place the order, the Request to order option gives you the ability to choose:

  • Review clients’ needs in advance, make sure their project requirements are clear, and that their selected Gig package is correct.
  • Since it’s harder to meet deadlines when you receive orders during hours that you’re unavailable (like at night), this feature helps you meet your deadlines and gives you the ability to discuss the Gig’s start date with the client, in advance.
By implementing Request to order, you can benefit from:
  • Review a client’s needs in advance to ensure their requirements are clear and the selected package is correct.
  • Discuss start dates before the clock starts ticking on a deadline, especially if a request arrives while you are unavailable.
  • Ensure you are the right fit for the job before the order is officially placed.
  • Clients who have already received a custom offer may still be able to place an order without a request.

How to set up Request to order?

You can customize when and for whom this feature is active.

How to activate the feature:

  • Go to Advanced Settings > Order settings.
  • Select Request to order to turn the feature on.
  • Choose your audience: First-time clients or All clients.
  • Select the specific Gig packages you want to include.
  • Set the days and hours the feature should be active (based on your current time zone).
  • Click Save.

Tip: To activate the feature during nighttime only, set two separate time periods (e.g., 12:00 AM – 6:00 AM and 9:00 PM – 12:00 AM).

How to optimize Request to order?

  • Use selectively: Only turn this on for Gigs that strictly require a consultation or contact before an order. Limiting instant orders may lower your total order volume.
  • Respond quickly: Clients sending a request are often ready to buy immediately. High response speed is critical for conversion and maintaining your metrics.
  • Update availability: If you will be away for more than a day, set your Gig to “not available” to protect your response rate metric.

FAQs

  • No, your cancellation rate won’t be affected by declined requests. However, visits to your Gig page that don’t convert into orders might impact your metrics negatively. Make sure to respond as fast as possible to requests, and decline a project only if it’s irrelevant to you.
  • To approve a request, send the client a Custom offer based on their chosen package or specific requirements.
  • Yes, you can enable or disable Request to order for each Gig individually and edit these settings at any time.
  • Yes. You can decide if you want to set an expiration date for your custom offers. If you didn’t set an expiration date, the client can still accept it whenever they want.

Offering paid video consultations to clients

Paid video consultations let you connect with clients before they place a full order. You can discuss a client’s project needs, align expectations, and leave a strong first impression of your expertise and skills. Using consultations helps you build trust with clients and can lead to more orders.

How paid video consultations work

A paid video consultation works like a regular Gig when it comes to client reviews, cancellations, refunds, and freelancer ratings. Turning on the feature does not count toward your active Gig count.

  • You need Level Two, Top Rated, or Pro Talent status to use this feature. It unlocks automatically once you reach an eligible level.

  • You need to connect a Google Calendar or Office (Microsoft) calendar to accept bookings. iCloud calendars are not supported.

  • Go to Manage consultations in your Fiverr account to turn on the feature and set up your availability and pricing.

  • Paid video consultations are not available on the Fiverr iOS or Android app. Use a desktop or web browser to set up and manage your consultations.

  • The Request to order feature is not available on paid consultation Gigs.

  • If you’re an Agency, this feature isn’t available to you. Instead, you can invite clients to a free meeting. Learn more about agencies with Fiverr agencies.

  • Here is what happens before a client books:

    • Your profile shows the paid video consultations tool once you become eligible.
    • Clients book a video consultation through your profile. They can choose a time starting two hours from when they are looking for availability, up to one week out.
    • Clients fill out a requirements form with preset questions when they book, so you can review their answers before the meeting.
    • Once a client selects and reserves a time, we create a calendar event titled “Fiverr consultation, details TBD.”
    • We update the event with full details once the client completes payment.
    • If a client does not complete payment within an hour, we cancel the consultation and calendar event, and the time slot becomes available again.
    • After the client submits their requirements, we send them an automated message in the order chat that displays your name as the sender. The message includes the consultation time in the client’s timezone and when they can expect your written summary.

  • After payment, you receive a payment confirmation and a reminder email 15 to 45 minutes before the scheduled call.

  • Here is what happens after the consultation:

    • You meet with your client through a Zoom video call at the scheduled time. Review the requirements your client submitted before the call.
    • You send your client a written summary of the discussion. This summary serves as your order delivery.
    • You have up to ten days from the day the client placed the order, not the consultation date, to deliver the summary.
    • Your client can access the recording of the call for 30 days through the order page.

  • If you agree to reschedule a consultation without canceling it first, we do not update your reminder email or other Fiverr communications with the new date and time, and you need to start the call yourself since it does not start automatically.

How to set up and use paid video consultations

Set up your consultations
  • Go to your freelancer profile.
  • Click Manage consultations on the right-hand panel to turn on the consultation option.
  • Connect your Google or Office calendar.
  • Select your general availability, for example Monday through Thursday, between 2:00 PM and 5:00 PM.
  • Choose the session lengths you want to offer: 30 minutes, 60 minutes, or both. Turning off both options pauses the feature until you turn one back on.
  • Set a price for each session length.
  • Add a description that explains what your consultations cover, what clients should prepare beforehand, and which languages you offer.

Once you connect your calendar, we automatically update your availability whenever you have an existing calendar event scheduled.

Join a scheduled consultation

Click Join to start your video call. You can find the Join button through:

  • The order page
  • Your calendar event
  • Your reminder email

Best practices for your consultations

- Review the client's business or background details and their requirements form, including any links they shared, before the call.
- Write down notes or questions in advance so you do not forget anything you want to cover.
- Set up your workspace in a tidy, well-lit, and quiet location, and keep pen and paper or a notes app nearby.
- Dress and present yourself professionally.
- Check your internet connection to avoid disruptions.
- Join a few minutes early so you have time to resolve any technical issues, and do not keep your client waiting.
- Turn on your camera so your client can connect with you and build trust in you.
- Treat your client with kindness and respect, and speak clearly and calmly.
- Listen closely to your client and give them time to explain their project needs.
- If a question catches you off guard, let your client know you will check and get back to them.
- Write a clear, structured summary of the call, including next steps and helpful links, and send it as soon as possible.
- Ask your client for feedback so you can improve your consultations for future clients.
  • Missing your consultation counts the same as not delivering your order.

FAQ

  • Yes. From your Gig page, clients click Contact me to open the menu and book a consultation.
  • Yes. Your Gig listing shows that paid video consultations are available under the “Service Offerings” filter in search results.
  • Only 30 and 60-minute consultations are available at the moment.
  • Rescheduling works like a regular order. If a client wants to reschedule, you need to cancel the original order, and they need to place a new order for the new time.
  • No, this is not possible at the moment. We recommend you make it clear in your description what the client can expect during the call, to reduce cancellations.
  • Yes. You can choose which session lengths, 30 or 60 minutes, stay active, or deactivate both.
  • There are no specific guidelines, but we recommend you tailor the summary to your client’s project needs and expectations, including what was discussed and the next steps.
  • Yes. Include the languages you offer in your consultation description.
  • Yes. We record and monitor all calls, and both you and your client can use the report button if needed. Learn more about meeting safety in Video calls (Zoom calls).

How it works

As one of only a few freelancers who receive these briefs, consider creating a great offer to help you stand out. The results will show which preferences match up with the client’s needs and will be marked with a checkmark.

Fiverr’s do’s and don’ts for sending offers

When sending an offer on Fiverr, here are some important guidelines to follow.

Do’s

Don’ts

By following these guidelines, you can send a professional and compliant offer on Fiverr.

Project management service by Fiverr Pro for freelancers

Working with a professional project manager can help make the process smooth and seamless for all participants, which is why our project management service for Fiverr Pro clients is the perfect addition to your workflow.

What is Fiverr Pro project management service?

The project management service is a new service for Fiverr Pro clients only. It allows all types of clients—from solopreneurs to large companies and brands—to execute projects with the help of a dedicated project manager that they get matched with.

Project managers are certified by Fiverr that they have years of experience in project management and delivery and are skilled in their fields.

The clients’ project managers will help them execute their project by:

  • Building a dream team of freelancers
  • Communicating with freelancers throughout the process
  • Managing the project from the start until the final delivery

What are the benefits of working with a project manager?

All project managers are skilled in their fields and are here to help you execute high-level projects. Rest assured that the project manager you get paired with understands your professional world, knows and speaks the field’s lingo, and is easy to work with.

Here are the main benefits you can look forward to:

  • The manager serves as a single point of contact for both you and your client. This allows you more time to focus solely on your work and perfect your professional skills, while your manager takes care of the clients and project management.
  • The project managers manage projects for a living. They will be available throughout the process to answer your questions, help provide you with what you need to complete the projects successfully and give you a great service experience.
  • The project management service can help increase income stability with networked access to new and challenging opportunities. With a more complex project, you and your business can look forward to professional growth and fulfillment, and more connections and possibilities for recurring work, instead of a one-time-only project.
  • Since clients typically reach out to the same freelancers time and again, a successful project manager will help manage and lead to more business opportunities in the future. The project management service can also help you gain a lasting reputation on Fiverr—which can directly and positively impact your business.

How it works

A project led by a manager is similar to any other project executed on Fiverr Pro. The only difference is that the main point of contact for the project is the project manager. Also, these types of projects will typically involve multiple freelancers working simultaneously as a team.

Clients can view all communication between you and their project manager and reply if necessary, however, the goal is that the project will be led by the manager, instead of the clients themselves.

Here’s how the process works:

  • Interested clients reach out to Fiverr Pro’s project management team about their project.
  • The project manager meets with the client to understand their project’s scope and exact needs/requirements.
  • The project manager builds a team of freelancers who seem like a great fit for the project and can successfully execute the project.
  • If you’re a suitable candidate, the project manager will reach out to you from their personal account to check your availability, share the client’s brief, and ask you for a quote.
  • Once the client approves you as a freelancer, the manager will reach out to you again via the client’s account, and ask you to send a custom offer in an inbox message.
  • Once the custom offer is approved, the project manager will be there to check in and follow up with you about all the details of the project until the final delivery.

Note: Working with a project manager does not limit your other work as a freelancer in any way.

Learn more about our Fiverr Pro satisfaction guarantee for clients.

FAQs

  • Unfortunately, you can’t contact a manager first. Once a manager receives a project request from the client, they will reach out to you with the project brief if they think you’re a suitable fit.
  • Our service is designed in a way that allows the manager to be the single point of contact for both the client and you, the freelancer. This benefits both parties and allows a more productive workflow.
  • Not at all, the manager’s fee will be paid in full by the client.
  • Since the manager is your point of contact for the project, they will be the one to leave you a review after you deliver your final delivery.
  • Most of our manager projects require the work of multiple freelancers, but there is no need to contact or report to any other freelancers. Your manager will be the one fully responsible for the communication and coordination between the freelancers, so feel free to reach out to them if you need anything.
  • Project manager orders are just like any other order placed on Fiverr Pro. Once the client approves your custom offer, their charged funds will be held on Fiverr until the client approves your final delivery. Learn more about Withdrawing your earnings.
  • If one of your packages fits the exact needs of your client, you can feel free to ask your manager to order it. If not, send your manager a custom offer that fits the project’s details, requirements, and specifications based on the client’s brief.
  • The project manager will initially contact you through their personal account, and then ask you for a custom offer via their Fiverr Pro client’s account in an inbox message. Send the custom offer as a reply to the inbox message.
  • The client is the only one who can approve your final delivery and provide feedback on revisions, if necessary. However, the manager is in charge of making sure all deliveries meet the original scope of work and communication between yourself and the client.
  • With that said, feel free to take advantage of your manager’s experience and enjoy the benefit of working with them to share creative thoughts, questions, and concerns.
  • Our project manager worked hard to create an ideal brief for every field in our service. If you feel you are still missing some information in the client’s brief, please feel free to reach out to your project manager with additional questions.
  • It all depends on the freelance services you offer and the specific requirements of the project. Your project manager will manage the entire process and be responsible for making sure that you have everything you need to complete your part of the project—including communication between freelancers. They will also keep you updated if any changes occur.

Promoting your Gigs with Fiverr Ads

With Fiverr Ads, you can push your services to prime locations in Fiverr’s search results, category pages, and other pages across the platform. Gain enhanced visibility and get more orders using smart technology that optimizes your budget and ensures your Ads reach the right clients.

What are Fiverr Ads?

Fiverr Ads uses an auctioning system to place your Gigs where they perform best. A higher Ad placement increases your Gig’s visibility, leading to more clicks and helps boost your overall sales.

- Level 1 and Level 2 freelancers
- Top Rated freelancers
- Pro freelancers
  • Only active Gigs are eligible for Fiverr Ads.
  • All services are eligible, excluding:
    • Tax Consulting services found in our Financial Consulting service category
    • Accounting & Bookkeeping services under the Financial Consulting service category
    • All of the Legal Consulting service category

How to set up my Fiverr Ads campaign?

  • Go to the Fiverr Ads dashboard by navigating to the header of your freelancer profile and clicking Growth & Marketing > Fiverr Ads
  • Choose the Gigs you would like to promote
  • Pick your daily spend limit (you can change these limits at any time)
  • Fiverr’s smart algorithm will handle the rest, optimizing your Ads for the best performance

How do Fiverr Ads work?

Fiverr Ads uses a “first-price auction” mechanism. Your placement is determined by:

  • This represents how well your service matches a specific client’s needs. Factors include:
    • Gig appearance quality: Use appealing titles and high-resolution videos or images.
    • Gig delivery quality: Your performance within orders, communication, and client satisfaction are all taken into account.
  • To increase your Gigs’ chances of winning an Ad auction, we highly recommend applying the best practices used to optimize your Gigs. Learn more tips and tricks to improve your Gigs with Gigs best practices and Best practices for Fiverr freelancers.
  • A bid is the highest amount you are willing to pay per click (also known as cost per click, CPC).
    • Automatic bidding: Bids are automatically set by Fiverr to keep your Ad competitive.
    • CPC cap: You can set a maximum limit for each click. Note that a low CPC cap may make you less competitive in auctions for high-valued clients.
    • Bidding formula: This considers your Conversion Rate (CR), Revenue per click, competition in your category, and your Return Over Ad Spend (ROAS).

How am I charged for Ads?

With Fiverr Ads, you only pay when clients click on your Ads. You are not charged for views (impressions) of your Ads. What you pay depends on how many clients click on your Ads, and how valuable your Ad placement is.

Note that views or even “hovering” over a sample video is not considered a click and will not be charged.

  • CPC can vary for each service, and for each time it’s displayed to clients.
    • Your dashboard counts the clicks and calculates the average click cost.
    • By multiplying these two variables of clicks and average click cost, you can understand the amount “spent”.
  • Your actual cost per click may be lower than your bid as you will only pay the minimum amount needed to win over other freelancer’s bids. This means that each click can have varying amounts.
  • This is the maximum amount that you are willing to pay per click on your Ad. A higher bid cap helps you get a better ad placement, and, coupled with the fact that Fiverr will optimize your bid selection for you, your Ad will be placed as optimally as possible at the lowest cost to you.
  • Therefore, bids can change to keep your Ad competitive in a given auction, but you will only pay when a client clicks on your ad.
  • Factors that affect the bid’s amount’s calculation are:
    • Conversion rate (CR): The likelihood of receiving an order once the ad has been clicked.
    • Revenue per click: How valuable a click is to the freelancer. For example, if, on average, 10 clicks generate one order of $50, that means that every click is worth $5.
    • Competition: The level of competition in the specific service category at the time of the potential client’s search. The more freelancers competing in a domain, the higher the bid will be.
    • Return over ad spend (ROAS): The smart algorithm aims to optimize the seller’s ROAS over time.
  • Tip: Select the “No CPC cap” option, which will allow us to set the optimal bid on your behalf, with up to $6 per click.
  • Payments occur once per month. Costs are deducted from your Fiverr balance first. If funds are insufficient, the remaining balance is charged to your saved payment method (Credit Card/PayPal) or future earnings.
  • The amounts on your dashboard do not include taxes. Taxes are calculated at the end of the month. You will receive an invoice if you have enabled this option in your billing history.
  • Members of Seller Plus Standard and Premium receive a $5 monthly credit toward Fiverr Ads. This credit is applied automatically and does not roll over.
  • Beginning April 2025, regional taxes (VAT/GST/HST) may be applied based on your location. To ensure accurate charging or tax-exempt status, update your Billing information under your profile settings.
  • Taxes are charged on the cost of the Ads from each month and are calculated at the end of the month.
  • To see your country’s regional taxes, please visit the FAQ to locate your place of residence.

Where will clients see my Ads?

To increase your chances of converting your Ad to an order, Fiverr will only show your Ads to the most relevant clients and will optimize the bid that will deliver the best performance for your campaign.

Fiverr Ads allows your advertisements to appear in prime locations across the platform. This includes the top of Fiverr’s search results, category pages, and various other Fiverr pages on web and the mobile apps, as well as in clients’ inboxes.

  • Inbox Ads are advertisements shown directly in a client’s conversation list as a “contact card” with an Ad badge.
    • How it works: When a client clicks the card, it opens a conversation widget where they can view your service, check your profile, or send a message.
    • Charging: You are not charged for the initial click to open the ad (external interaction). You are only charged for internal interactions, such as clicking your Gig card, your profile, or when the client sends you a message.
    • Client control: Clients can hide specific Ads they find irrelevant. Hiding Ads will not affect your organic rating.

How do I optimize my Ads?

  • Track your performance using the following metrics on your Ads dashboard:
    • Impressions: How many times your Gig was seen as an ad. If impressions are high but clicks are low, consider updating your Gig card appearance.
    • Clicks: Total times clients clicked your ad. Multiple clicks from the same user only count as one click.
    • Orders: Total orders placed within a 30-day “attribution window” from the last click.
    • Spend vs. Sales: Compare your total ad costs against the revenue generated to understand your campaign’s success.
  • To achieve the most optimal ad placement and convert leads:
    • Winning the lead: Respond fast to messages, ask for details, and send custom offers to seal the deal.
    • Professional imagery: Use a high-quality profile picture showing your face to build trust.
    • Gig details: Ensure your Gig image and title are short, concise, and professional.
    • Spam protection: Fiverr implements safeguards to identify and cancel charges from “click fraud.” If a spammer is detected, you will not be charged for those clicks.
    • Ads on hold: If your ads are not visible, check your Earnings page for outstanding debts. Settle these via the “pay overdraft balance” button to resume your ads.

FAQs

  • Ads are shown to clients we believe are most likely to be interested in your services based on their behavior and search intent.
  • Clients do not get push notifications for the Ad itself, but you will receive a notification like a regular message once a client responds to your Inbox Ad.
  • Inbox Ads are an expansion of the program. There is no separate opt-out; simply toggle off “Promote” on your Gigs to stop all advertising.
  • Our user-level attribution model tracks the initial engagement. If a client clicks Gig X but buys Gig Y within 30 days, the click is attributed to Gig X and the order to Gig Y.
  • Combine these strategies to scale your business and maintain a competitive edge on Fiverr.

Referring friends on Fiverr (Freelancers: Features & programs)

Fiverr’s referral program lets you invite friends to join Fiverr through your personal referral link. When your friend signs up and completes their first qualifying order, we give your friend a discount on that order and reward you with Fiverr Credits. Referring friends is a simple way to earn credits toward your future orders while introducing people you know to Fiverr.

Before you begin

  • Before you refer a friend, make sure you have an active Fiverr account.
  • Your friends must sign up through your referral link. The referral won’t work if your friend already has a Fiverr account or signs up without using the link.
  • You can refer friends from the Fiverr website, iOS app, or Android app.
  • The referral program isn’t available to Fiverr Pro clients.

How the referral program works

  • When you refer a friend, they receive 10% off their first qualifying order, and you receive a reward once that order is completed. Your friend’s first order must total $100 or more to qualify, and they cannot combine the referral discount with a promo code.
  • You earn 10% of your friend’s order amount in Fiverr Credits, up to $100 per referral. We add the credit to your Fiverr Balance within 24 hours of your friend’s order being marked complete. You can earn up to $500 in Fiverr Credits in total through the program.

Fiverr Credits expire three months after we add them to your account. Use your credits before they expire.

If your friend cancels their first order, you do not receive a reward for that order. Your friend must complete a new order for you to earn the credit.

How to use the referral program

- Select your profile picture, then select Refer a friend.
- On the referral page, enter your friend's email address, or copy your personal referral link.
- Share the referral link through email, social media, or another channel.
- Your friend signs up for Fiverr using your referral link. Their account links to yours only if they sign up this way.
- Your friend places a first order of $100 or more. We apply the 10% discount automatically at checkout.
- Your friend completes the order without using a promo code, since they can't combine the referral discount with a promo code.

All orders must be legitimate. Any attempt to manipulate or exploit the referral program may result in an account suspension. Read the Referral Program Terms & Conditions here.

Troubleshooting

  • If your friend’s account doesn’t link to yours, confirm they signed up using your referral link and not another method. We cannot add or change this association after signup.
  • If your friend’s order is canceled, you will not receive a reward for that order. Ask your friend to complete a new order so you can earn the credit.

FAQs

  • You can earn up to $500 in Fiverr Credits by referring friends. Each qualifying referral earns you 10% of your friend’s first order amount, up to $100.
  • We add the credit to your Fiverr Balance within 24 hours after your friend’s order is marked complete.
  • You do not receive a reward. Your friend must complete a new order for you to earn the credit.
  • The referral doesn’t work. Your friend must sign up for Fiverr through your referral link as a new user for you to earn a reward.
  • Fiverr Credits expire three months after we add them to your account.
  • No. Your friend cannot combine the referral discount with a promo code.
  • Select your profile picture, then select Refer a friend. Your personal referral link is on the referral page.
  • No, the referral program isn’t available to Fiverr Pro clients.

Select reviews to highlight

The “What people loved about this seller” section on your Gig page shows a short selection of reviews to help clients decide whether to place an order. As a Seller Plus member, you can hand-pick the reviews you want to feature and arrange them in any order. This article will help you understand highlighted reviews and how to use it.

How to get started

  • Highlighted Reviews is available to Seller Plus Standard and Premium members.
  • The feature only appears on Gigs that have enough eligible reviews. If you don’t see it, your Gig may not yet qualify.
  • You can select a minimum of 3 and a maximum of 5 reviews.
  • Highlighting reviews does not remove or hide any of your other reviews. All reviews remain visible on your Gig in the usual order.
  • Editing highlighted reviews is only available on the Fiverr website, not on the mobile app.

How to select your highlighted reviews

  1. Go to My Business > Gigs.

  2. Click the dropdown arrow next to the Gig you want to update and click Edit.

  3. Go to the Advanced Settings tab and scroll to the Highlighted Reviews section.

  4. Click Seller’s Choice.

  5. Browse the review list. Use the keyword search or sort by the filters Most Relevant or Most Recent to find the right ones.

  6. Click the checkbox next to each review you want to highlight (minimum 3, maximum 5).

  7. Drag and drop your selected reviews into the order you want.

  8. Click Confirm, then Save.

How to update or remove your highlighted reviews

Go back to the Highlighted Reviews section in Advanced Settings and click Update Reviews. You can add, remove, or reorder your selection at any time.

Because the date of each review is visible to clients, it is worth refreshing your selection periodically; recent reviews tend to be more persuasive.

Best practices

  • Select reviews that speak to the specific type of work you want to attract. A review mentioning a particular skill or outcome is more compelling than a general compliment.
  • Update your selection regularly; recent reviews carry more weight with potential clients.
  • Use a mix of reviews that highlight different aspects of your service, such as communication, quality, and turnaround time.
  • Use the keyword filter to find reviews that mention specific skills or services you want to emphasize.

FAQs

  • No. This feature only controls which reviews appear in the highlighted section. All your reviews remain visible in the usual order.
  • The option only appears on Gigs with enough eligible reviews. Keep delivering great work and it will become available as your review count grows.
  • Automated means Fiverr selects reviews for you. Seller’s Choice means you choose between 3 and 5 reviews and arrange them yourself.
  • No. You need the Fiverr website to make changes. Highlighted reviews are visible to clients on all devices.

Payment method

The system will always attempt to charge your subscription using this order:

  • Available funds: Charged from your Fiverr balance first.

  • Future earnings: If your balance is insufficient, a Seller Plus debt will be created on your account, charging future earnings as they clear. The payment method on file will not be charged.

  • You are allowed to accumulate debt for up to two months. If the debt remains unpaid after two months, you will be removed from the program.

  • Freelancers who doesn’t have a payment method added to their subscription, your monthly subscription fee is withheld from your earnings. Semi-annual and annual subscription fees are held against your withdrawable earnings balance 30 days prior to each renewal date. During this period, the renewal amount will not be available for withdrawal.

Managing your subscription

You can manage your membership, subscription tier, update payment details, or cancel your subscription at any time from the Manage membership page on your freelancer dashboard.

If you chose to cancel your subscription, you are eligible for a refund if you cancel within 48 hours of your last plan payment. To receive a refund, please contact customer support within 48 hours.

If you cancel outside of the refund window of 48 hours after payment, you will still retain your Standard or Premium benefits until the end of your current billing cycle (monthly, semi-annually, annually).

Upgrading and downgrading

You can choose to upgrade or downgrade based on your subscription tier and billing cycle.

- Upgrades (e.g., Standard to Premium): Take effect immediately, and your next bill will be adjusted to reflect the change.
- Downgrades (e.g., Premium to Standard): You will remain in your current, higher tier until the end of the existing billing cycle. The downgrade and new charge will take effect on your next billing date.
- Upgrades (e.g., Monthly to Semi-annually): Take effect immediately, and your next bill will be adjusted to reflect the change and will not be double charged for any overlapping time.
- Downgrades (e.g., Annually to Semi-annually): You will remain in your current, higher tier until the end of the existing billing cycle. The downgrade and new charge will take effect on your next billing date.

Setting Availability for freelancers

Need a break? Fiverr’s Availability feature lets you set a time frame when you cannot receive new orders or messages. By setting the Availability feature, both freelancers and clients experience a better experience by managing expectations and ensuring effective communication.

What does the Availability feature do?

When you set yourself as unavailable, your Gigs will remain visible, and you will automatically become available again when your scheduled break ends. To ensure transparency, your out-of-office status will be clearly indicated when clients view your Profile page, your Gig page, or your conversations in the Inbox.

- Clients can view your profile, Gigs, and return date.
- Clients will not be able to place a new order when you are marked as out of the office.
- Clients cannot accept custom offers if your availability status is set to "pause".
- Your client will receive a pop-up letting them know that you are unavailable, and there is no option to accept the custom offer.
- Clients will only be able to contact you if you have specified that you want to receive messages while out of the office, unless they have an active order.
- Clients with an active order can message you and you are expected to deliver their orders as agreed upon.

How to set your Availability?

  • After logging in, click your profile image and select Dashboard from the menu.
  • In your profile panel at the top of the screen, click on the “Available” status. Important: Once you click the Available button, a pop-up will open where you can provide additional details.
  • Select a first day (this can be today’s date or a future date) and the last day.
  • Tip: It is optional but recommended to leave a message to existing and potential clients. You can either use the default message or customize it to your liking. This message will be displayed on your Profile page, Inbox, and Gig pages.
  • When you are unavailable, you can opt to receive messages from all clients to ensure that you don’t miss any exciting collaborations. If you want to allow all clients to contact you while unavailable, switch on the All buyers can contact me toggle.
  • Important: If you choose to receive messages, your response rate calculation will remain the same as when you are not out of the office (24 hours).
  • Click Confirm dates.

FAQs

  • You can change your availability settings, including your return time, at any time on your Dashboard page. This can be accessed in the profile panel section at the top of the dashboard.
  • No, if you choose to set your Availability as unavailable, your response rate will be unaffected. However, if you switch on the All buyers can contact me toggle, which enables all clients to contact you, your response time and response rate will be counted as usual.
  • Once you have set yourself to unavailable, a banner will be displayed notifying clients of your time away. According to your preferred setting, if the client has not ordered from you in the past, or does not have a current active order, they will not be able to message you.
  • Yes, however, you are still required to deliver your orders on time. The client can still message you, and the response rate metric calculation will continue as usual.
  • Yes, your Gig will be temporarily removed from the search. Once you become available again, your Gigs will reappear.
  • Setting Availability will not necessarily have an impact on your Gig ranking. However, if the unavailability period runs over 30 days within a timeframe of 180 days, your Gig ranking might be affected.

Standing out as a Fiverr Pro freelancer

Being a Pro freelancer is not just about high-quality deliverables; it’s about giving your client pro-level service as well! Clients expect Pro freelancers to shine throughout the ordering and delivery process. Use our tips to make sure you stand out as the top-tier freelancer you are.

Communicate like a Pro

Communication is the ultimate cheat code for Fiverr success. Strong communication leads to more satisfied clients, better ratings, and revenue. Here are some tips to keep in mind when communicating with your clients:

- Answer questions quickly! Clients usually contact more than one freelancer for information. The faster you reply, the more likely you are to convert that inquiry into a sale.
- End each message with a question or other reason for your client to respond. Your messages should never leave a client wondering where they stand. End every message with a call to action. "Should I send you a custom offer?" "How does that sound?" "What do you think about XYZ?"
  • Notes:
    • Receiving spam messages? Use the Report button at the bottom of the message, so it doesn’t affect your response rate.
    • Pro freelancers can call clients to discuss order details (via Skype, Hangouts, etc.). Just make sure to document your discussion within Fiverr.
    • Spell everything out. On digital sites, there’s a big temptation to be casual in your communication, as if you were texting a friend. Don’t do it. Write in clear, full sentences using proper grammar and punctuation.
    • When quoting a clients, there is no such thing as giving too much information. Lay everything out on the table. What is the client getting when they order your service? What can they expect from your timeline? How do you break down your pricing?
    • Break down your offer, tell them what the workflow will be, ask them if they want a custom offer, etc.
  • Use unifying words (ex: with, us, or together) to let the client know that you consider their project to be a partnership.
  • Set expectations with your clients by providing estimated dates for reaching out to them again or sending work deliveries. Meet or beat all your obligations.
  • Here are some helpful tips to effectively follow up with your clients:
    • Follow up with potential clients even if they haven’t replied to your last message
    • You’ll find that emails that end with a specific follow-up question receive a better response
    • Don’t forget to follow up with past clients after order completion
  • Downloading the Fiverr Android or iOS app will help you keep up with orders & client requests on the go. Being able to see and respond to requests anytime is a great way to grow your business faster while keeping your flexible lifestyle.
  • Want to increase the chance of closing the sale by 50%? Pro freelancers who respond to new messages within 12 hours do just that. This means responding to new messages must be your priority on Fiverr Pro.
  • Use Quick Responses to Save Time Time is money for a freelancer. You can create Quick Responses when responding to messages and delivering orders to help save time, improve communication, and maximize your earnings per hour.
  • People don’t always behave well online. Some potential clients may behave rudely. If this happens, respond politely and professionally. In other words, don’t feed the trolls. If another user’s behavior crosses the line, report it. If you feel like you’re in a gray area, reach out to your Business Success Manager for help and advice.
  • This should go without saying, but to be clear, don’t contact other users to sell them something without their consent. It’s a violation of our terms of service, and it’s not Fiverr Pro behavior.
  • You don’t have to miss out on earnings if your service doesn’t exactly meet your client’s needs. Send them a Custom Offer with a custom price (up to $50,000).
  • Sometimes something gets in the way of meeting a deadline. For example, you’re writing a case study, and the client’s contact didn’t get back to you by the designated time. Never click the delivery button to deliver an incomplete order—it’s a violation of Fiverr’s Terms of Service, and it won’t end with a happy client. Instead, visit the Resolution Center to extend the delivery date of the order. Be sure not to make a habit of this. If you find yourself always needing extensions, update your Gig with a more accurate timeline for delivery.
  • Fiverr features allow you to track revenues and performance. You can use this information to tweak how you do business and maximize your profits. For example, take a look at your best selling Gig and see if you can use it to improve how you present your other Gigs. Or consider adjusting your pricing and measure the results. We recommend you take a snapshot of your revenue every month to measure your progress.
  • As a Pro freelancer, you’re part of something special. Your freelance talent stands out, so your client care and work quality should, too. Your Business Success Manager is here to offer guidance and answer any questions you may have along your Fiverr Pro journey—we’re just a call, message, or email away.
  • Perhaps most importantly, be yourself and create an authentic brand that reflects your unique identity.

Ready to go Pro? Find more information and apply here!

Team Account

Introducing Team Account for freelancers on Fiverr, enabling multiple people from the same team to collaborate and communicate. Each team owner is also the admin for their team. They will have their own team admin dashboard and members of their team will have access to a team dashboard.

Invitation

The team owner can invite team members by going to the admin dashboard.

  • Click on “Invite members.”
  • Enter the member’s email address.
  • Click “Invite.”

Note: Members are only able to be part of 1 team.

Team member

You will receive an invitation to join a team via email. The invitation is only valid for 7 days. Team members can access and perform any actions related to client management, including orders and message history.

  • Enter a username and password.
  • Once you have entered your password, click “Create my account.”
  • Enter your name and role which is how you will appear to clients and team members.
  • Click “Join.”
    • If you already have an active Fiverr account when logged out, you will be redirected to the sign in.
    • If you already have an active Fiverr account when logged in, you will be redirected to join the team.

Team member dashboard

The dashboard contains the following information.

Using Fiverr Answers (Freelancers: Features & programs)

Fiverr Answers is a public content hub where a select group of invited freelancers share their expertise by answering questions about their professional fields. Answers are visible to everyone and can help clients make more informed decisions when looking for services. If you have been invited to contribute, participating can increase your visibility and direct more potential clients to your Fiverr profile.

Fiverr Answers was discontinued

As of Nov 11, 2026 Fiverr Answers was discontinued.

answers.fiverr.com is no longer accessible, and you can’t log in or interact with the platform.

Your Fiverr account wasn’t affected by this change.

What Fiverr Answers is

Fiverr Answers is designed to provide helpful information for clients and freelancers on topics related to professional projects, deliveries, and communication. Questions are generated using AI based on recurring topics across the broader online landscape.

The hub is public, meaning anyone can read the questions and answers. To post an answer, upvote, downvote, or report content, users must be logged in.

Fiverr Answers is not:

  • A how-to guide or Help Center replacement.
  • A marketing tool for freelancers.
  • A forum for creating conversation threads.

Eligibility and access

Participation in Fiverr Answers is invite-only. Only hand-picked freelancers receive invitations to answer questions. If you have not received an invitation, you will not be able to post answers.

Fiverr Answers is available on desktop only. It is not available on iOS or Android.

How questions are assigned

Fiverr posts the questions, and they are assigned to freelancers based on the professional area in which they have their strongest services. Each freelancer can contribute one answer per question, and answers must be at least 30 words long. Freelancers can hide or delete their answers at any time.

Benefits for freelancers

When you answer a question on Fiverr Answers, your username is linked directly to your Fiverr profile. Clients reading your answer can click on your username and be redirected to your profile page. Answers are also indexed by search engines, which means your expertise can reach people searching for answers beyond the Fiverr platform.

Fiverr Answers ranks and badges are displayed on your public Fiverr Answers profile only. They do not appear on your main Fiverr profile page.

Tips from top-tier talent

For users who are not logged into Fiverr and are browsing services, the most popular Fiverr Answers from a given subcategory may appear at the bottom of the search results page. These tips help potential clients understand what to look for in a freelancer or what tools are commonly used for a service. This feature applies to select subcategories only, not all of them. If you would like your tip removed from the search results, contact our Customer Support team.

Content guidelines

All answers must follow the Fiverr Answers Community Guidelines. When posting, keep the following rules in mind:

  • AI-generated content is not allowed. If a high percentage of AI is detected in your answer, you may receive an educational warning.
  • Links to any other sites, including Fiverr, are not allowed in answers.
  • Both questions and answers can be reported by any logged-in user for review.

Warnings issued on your Answers account are educational and have no penalty effect on your Fiverr account or your Answers account standing.

Content moderation

After you submit an answer, it goes through a moderation review before it is published. Moderation is typically completed within 24 hours of submission. Reviews may take longer over weekends. If your answer has been pending for an extended period, contact our Customer Support team.

Ranks and badges

When you actively participate on Fiverr Answers, you earn points and unlock recognition through two types of awards: Badges and Ranks. Both are shown on your public profile within Fiverr Answers. To view them, click on your username from any page on the platform.

To improve your rank and earn additional badges, log in regularly and engage with the platform by posting answers, upvoting other users’ answers, and participating in discussions.
