  • Not always. If a client cancels before submitting their project requirements, the cancellation does not impact your OCR. However, very late orders force-canceled by the client and orders where you submit the cancellation request affect your OCR.
  • If your client is unresponsive, you can initiate a mutual cancellation through the Resolution Center on the order page.
  • You can extend the delivery date directly from the order page. If you need to cancel, communicate with your client through the order chat first, and then use the Resolution Center if necessary.
  • You need to withdraw the open Resolution Center request first from your Orders page. Once you withdraw it, you can submit a cancellation request.
  • You cannot cancel a completed order through the Resolution Center. Contact Customer Support for help.
  • Delivering an empty message or incomplete work to avoid late delivery is a violation of Fiverr’s Terms of Service. This may result in your account being reviewed.
  • Contact Customer Support if a natural disaster, a government-imposed outage or restriction, a global event, a serious illness, or an emergency stops you from completing an order. We review each case. We may ask you to use the Resolution Center if we cannot confirm the situation.

Leaving and managing reviews on Fiverr (Freelancers: Order management)

Reviews and ratings are the foundation of a trusted marketplace. They give clients confidence when choosing a freelancer, and help freelancers showcase their work and build a strong reputation. Fiverr uses a two-way feedback system: both the client and the freelancer can leave a review after an order is completed. Reviews are visible to the public only after both parties submit their feedback, or once the review window closes.

Types of reviews

The review system has two types of reviews:

  • Public review: A star rating plus written feedback that appears on the freelancer’s Gig page and profile page, and on the client’s profile page.
  • Private review: An anonymous satisfaction rating submitted by the client. This review is not shared with the freelancer and is used by Fiverr for internal quality measurement only.

Public ratings on a freelancer’s profile reflect activity over the past two years, so they always show current performance rather than a lifetime average.

Before you begin

  • You can only leave a review on a completed or eligible canceled order.
  • The client must submit a public review first — this enables the freelancer to leave their own review.
  • All reviews must come from legitimate purchases made through Fiverr. Reviews from accounts used to artificially boost ratings will result in permanent suspension. Learn more in Fiverr reviews: Content guidelines and removal policy.

How to leave a review

  • As a client, after your order is marked as completed, you will be taken to the public rating page automatically.
    1. Rate the order on three questions:
  • • How would you rate the quality of this delivery?
  • • How was it working with the freelancer?
  • • How would you rate the value for money of this service?
  • 2. After selecting a star rating, choose the checkboxes that best describe your experience.
  • 3. Write a review (minimum 10 characters). You can also approve attaching files from the order at this step. The attached file will be added to the freelancer’s Live Portfolio and showcased as examples of your work.
  • 4. Optionally add a tip for the freelancer.
  • 5. Click Submit.
  • Once a client submits their public review, as a freelancer you will receive a notification. You then have 14 days (or 30 days in certain categories — see Review Windows below) to leave your own review.
    1. Click the notification you receive after the client submits their review.
  • 2. Go to your order page and scroll to the bottom.
  • 3. Rate your experience and leave a comment.
  • 4. Click Send.
  • 5. Once you submit your review, you can see the client’s review and respond publicly.
  • You cannot see the client’s review until after you submit your own, or until the review window closes.
  • Highlighted reviews are short snippets of positive feedback shown on a Gig page. They are selected automatically from recent reviews. Freelancers with a Seller Plus membership can also manually select up to five reviews to highlight.

Please note that Fiverr reserves the right to restrict review capabilities if there is evidence of Terms of Service or Community Standards breaches. If you require further help, our Customer Support team is available via the Contact Us button below.

How long can I leave a review?

  • Both clients and freelancers have 14 days after an order is completed to submit their public review in most categories.
  • The following categories have a 30-day review window:
  • • Programming & Tech
  • • Digital Marketing — SEO, SEM, Local SEO, Video Marketing, and E-Commerce Marketing subcategories
  • Once the window closes, no new reviews can be added to the order.
  • Clients can submit a private review within 60 days of an order being completed. The private review option appears 24 hours after the order is marked completed. If you skip it, the option will no longer be available.

Editing a review

  • Clients can edit their public review from the moment they submit it until it becomes live on Fiverr (i.e., until the freelancer submits their own review, or the review window closes).
  • To edit your review:
    • Go to your order page.
    • Scroll down to the review section.
    • Click Edit review and ratings, make your changes, and save.
  • To give you time to make edits, Fiverr delays the notification asking freelancers to submit their review by 20 minutes. This means you have at least 20 minutes after submitting your review to make changes.
  • Freelancers cannot edit their public review once it has been submitted.

Once both reviews are live, neither party can make further edits.

Responding to a review

After both public reviews are published, freelancers can respond to the client’s review from their order page. The response appears publicly on the Gig page.

  • There is no time limit for adding a response, as long as the Gig is active.
  • If you miss the review window entirely and cannot leave a review, you can still respond to the client’s review.
  • Once published, a response cannot be edited or removed.

Reviews for multi-payment and hourly orders

  • For Subscription orders, each order within a subscription is standalone. You are prompted to leave a review for each individual order within the subscription.
  • For Milestone orders, you leave a review once the final Milestone is completed, or if the remaining Milestones are stopped.
  • For Hourly orders, you can leave a review once the contract is completed. For ongoing weekly orders within a contract, a private review is requested after the first completed weekly order only, not for every weekly order.

Reviews for canceled orders

To maintain a transparent marketplace, clients may leave feedback for orders that were canceled, provided they meet specific criteria. When eligible, clients have a 5-day window to submit their review. After the client provides feedback, the freelancer can share a public response.

  • Reviews on canceled orders are available in these eligible scenarios:
  • • Late delivery: the project is overdue by at least 24 hours.
  • • Lack of communication: the freelancer has not replied to messages for more than 24 hours.
  • • Delivery sent: files were submitted through the system prior to the cancelation request.
  • • Account history: the client has successfully completed one or more previous purchases on the platform.
  • Reviews on canceled orders are excluded in the following scenarios:
  • • New users: the transaction was the client’s first order on Fiverr.
  • • Freelancer profiles: the client also maintains an active freelancer account.
  • • Payment disputes: the order was reversed due to a chargeback.

Reviews on canceled orders are excluded in the following scenarios:

• New users: the transaction was the client’s first order on Fiverr.

• Freelancer profiles: the client also maintains an active freelancer account.

• Payment disputes: the order was reversed due to a chargeback.

Repeat client reviews

Clients who placed multiple orders with the same freelancer can leave the same review they previously left, instead of writing a new one each time.

This option is available if the previous rating was 4+ stars and it’s less than 6 months old.

If the criteria aren’t met, a new review must be written.

  • As a client, once you accept the delivery and complete the order, or if the order is auto-completed, you will be offered the option to keep the previous review or write a new one.
  • As a freelancer, your profile will display the most recent review and have the following indications:
    • Ongoing collaboration: Multiple orders between the users.
    • Number of reviews left by the client: If a client left multiple duplicate reviews, the number will indicate how many.

FAQs

  • Customer Support will only remove reviews following the Fiverr reviews removal policy. You cannot ask another user to remove their review, and you cannot remove your own review once it has been published. If an account is deleted, its reviews are anonymized rather than removed.
  • Once a review is published, it can no longer be edited to ensure the integrity of the rating system. However, clients do have the flexibility to make changes to their feedback within the 14-day review window, provided the freelancer has not yet submitted their own review.
  • Clients may see an option to generate a review draft using AI. This feature uses information from the order and communication to create a starting point. You can edit the AI-generated draft or write your own review from scratch before publishing.
  • The option to leave a review is only available once an order is officially marked as completed. If your order is currently in an active status such as In Progress, In Revision, Late, or Very Late, the review feature is not yet enabled and will only appear after delivery.
  • No. The order must meet the eligibility criteria for a repeat review: the previous rating was 4+ stars, and the order is less than 6 months old.
  • Reviews are generally only possible on orders where a delivery has taken place. In cases where a client purchases the wrong service, fails to provide necessary requirements, or makes an error in ordering, there is typically no delivery, making the order ineligible for review. To prevent these situations, we suggest establishing clear expectations immediately -either before the purchase or as soon as it is made -to confirm that the client’s needs align with your specific expertise and available services.
  • While meeting every client’s expectations is not always achievable, resolving issues through a mutual cancelation can preserve a positive professional relationship. Clients can leave reviews on eligible canceled orders, so maintaining open communication and professionalism throughout the cancelation process is especially important. Many clients value a freelancer’s dedication and transparency during this process. Maintaining a high overall satisfaction rate across your portfolio ensures that occasional disputes will not heavily impact your standing. We encourage you to view all feedback as a valuable tool for refining your service and growing your freelance business.
  • Freelancers do not have the ability to submit a review for the client in this scenario. They do, however, retain the right to provide a public response to any feedback the client leaves regarding the cancelation.
  • To maintain a transparent marketplace, any feedback left for an order that was canceled will be clearly marked with a specific label identifying it as such.

Offering extra services within an active order

When you receive an order, you can offer the client additional services within the active order. For example, if a client orders your basic logo package, you can message them to suggest upgrades such as higher-resolution files, additional revisions, or custom stationery.

How to offer extras

  • Select Orders from the My Business tab.
  • Note: You can access your orders in several ways, such as through emails, dasboard or notifications.
  • Click on the Message button located on the right side of the screen, under the client’s username.
  • An Inbox conversation panel will open: Click on Offer Extras at the bottom of this panel.
  • Within the list of extra services you provide in your Gig, select a service, the quantity, and the number of days you’ll add to the delivery date.
  • If you would like to add a custom service not listed in your Gig, click Add custom extra, then enter a description, the amount you charge, and the number of days to deliver.
  • When finished, click Send.
  • The client will be notified and may choose to accept the offer and pay, decline it, or request changes. You can also withdraw the offer. You will be notified whenever the order status changes.
Notes:
  • If the offer is accepted, the order delivery time will be updated.
  • Keep in mind the days are added to the original delivery date, not the current date.
  • If the order has already been delivered and the client purchases the custom extras, the order’s status will revert to In progress, meaning you’ll have to meet the original delivery date again.

Partial refunds (Freelancers: Order management)

The partial refund option lets you adjust the payment for an existing order without canceling it entirely. If a project’s scope changes or an issue comes up mid-order, a partial refund allows the freelancer to be compensated for the work they’ve already completed while returning part of the payment to the client.

This article guides you through how partial refunds work, who can request them, and the steps involved.

Overview

Only a freelancer can initiate a partial refund through the Resolution Center on the order page. If you’re a client who’d like a partial refund, reach out to your freelancer via inbox first to agree on an amount.

Here is what you need to know:

  • A partial refund applies to the initial (primary) amount of an active order only.
  • If extras were added after the order was placed, the partial refund covers only the original amount, not the extras.
    • Example: if you paid $50 on the initial order and later added a $10 extra, only the $50 is covered by the partial refund.
  • Partial refunds are processed to the original payment method used to purchase the order. It takes 2-10 days for the refund to complete.
  • Partial refunds on completed orders are also available, but they can only be processed through Customer Support. Contact us to check whether a partial refund is available for a completed order.

Before you begin

Before submitting a partial refund, make sure your order meets all of the following criteria.

Order status & amount

  • The order must be active (not yet completed).
  • The order amount must be over $50.

Refund limits

  • The minimum refund amount is $5.
  • The maximum refund is 60% of the original order price.

Example: a $200 order allows a partial refund of up to $120.

Eligible order types

  • One-time purchase orders are eligible.
  • Milestone orders are eligible, but only for the first milestone. Once the first milestone is marked complete, the option is no longer available.
  • Subscription orders are also eligible.
  • Orders purchased with a promo code, coupon, promotion, or Fiverr Credits are not eligible.

Other conditions

  • Only one partial refund is allowed per order.
  • Once a partial refund is accepted, it cannot be reversed.

How to offer a partial refund for freelancers

We encourage both parties to discuss and agree on an amount before submitting a partial refund request. This helps set clear expectations.

Only freelancers can send a partial refund offer.

- Go to the Resolution Center from the order page.
- Select Offer a partial refund.
- Enter the amount you'd like to refund and add a note explaining the offer to the client. You'll also be asked to select a reason from a dropdown — this is for internal use only and won't be shared with the client.
- Click Send offer.
  • A notification confirms the client has received your offer. If the client doesn’t respond within 3 days, the offer expires automatically. You can withdraw the offer at any time if no agreement is reached on the order page.
  • Note: If the client rejects your delivery before accepting the partial refund offer, you’ll need to resend the delivery once they accept the partial refund so they can review and accept it.
  • Learn more with Using the Resolution Center.
    • Go to the Resolution Center from the order page.
    • Select Offer a partial refund.
    • Select the reason for the refund.
    • Enter the amount and add a note for the client.
    • Tap Send.

How to respond to a partial refund offer for clients

  • You’ll receive an email and a notification on the order page when the freelancer sends an offer.
  • Go to the Activity section of the order page to review the proposed amount and the reason.
  • Accept or decline the offer. You’ll be asked to provide a reason for your decision.

If you don’t respond within 3 days, the offer expires automatically.

Best practices

  • Discuss the scope of work completed before making or requesting a refund offer.
  • Make sure the refund amount reflects the value of the work that was delivered.
  • If you’re a client and you’d like a partial refund, contact your freelancer directly via your inbox.

FAQs

  • The refund is sent to the original payment method used for the order.
  • Yes, the partial refund feature is available through the Fiverr app.
  • If the service fee on the new (lower) price is less than what was originally charged, the difference is refunded to the client. If the new price would result in a higher fee, the difference is not charged.
  • No. Whether the offer is accepted or declined, it won’t affect the freelancer’s order completion rate.
  • The freelancer’s fee is calculated based on the final price after the partial refund is applied.
  • No. Once a partial refund is accepted, no further refund offers can be made on that order.
  • Yes. Partial refunds on completed orders are possible, but they can only be processed through Customer Support.
  • Yes. Orders that have received a partial refund are treated as completed orders, so both parties can leave a review.

Quick responses and auto-replies

Fiverr gives you several tools to help you communicate faster and more consistently with clients. This article covers two of them: quick responses and auto-replies. Used together, these two features help you keep your response rate high, make a strong first impression, and spend less time typing the same things over and over.

Overview

Here’s a quick overview of the two features:

Quick responses

Auto-reply

What it is

Saved message templates you can insert manually at any time during a conversation. You can personalize before sending. You can save up to 100 quick responses.

A message that triggers automatically on the very first message in a new conversation. Does not send to clients you have already spoken with.

How it works

You pick a saved template and send it manually.

Fiverr sends it automatically when a new client messages you for the first time.

Best for

FAQs, formats, pricing info, and requirements.

Acknowledging first contact, setting expectations, and requesting project details.

Where it works

Inbox, active orders, delivery messages.

Inbox only (first message in a new conversation).

Both features use the {username} variable to automatically insert the recipient’s username into your message, making it sound more personal.

Quick responses

How to create a quick response
  • Go to your Inbox and open any message.
  • Click the lightning bolt icon below the message area.
  • Click Add a quick response (or the + icon).
  • Give your response a name (for example, “File formats” or “Timeline and revisions”).
  • Type your message in the Enter your quick response field. Use {username} anywhere in the text to automatically insert the client’s username.
  • Click Save.
How to use a quick response
  • In your inbox, an active order, or a delivery message, click the lightning bolt icon below the message area.
  • A pop-up appears with your saved responses and any suggested quick responses for common client questions.
  • Click the response you want to use. The text populates in the message field.
  • Edit the text to personalize it. If you see <please add details here>, replace that placeholder with the relevant information.
  • Click Send.
How to edit, duplicate, or delete a quick response

Open the quick responses panel via the lightning bolt icon. Hover over any saved response to reveal the action icons on the right:

  • Edit icon: Update the name or message text.
  • Duplicate icon: Create a copy to use as a starting point for a new template.
  • Delete icon: Remove the response permanently.

Auto-reply

The auto-reply feature automatically sends a prewritten message the first time a client contacts you. Use it to acknowledge new enquiries, set your response time expectations, or collect project details before you get to the conversation.

How to set up your auto-reply
  • Go to your Inbox and open any message.
  • Click the lightning bolt icon at the bottom left of the message area.
  • Select Auto-reply.
  • Toggle auto-reply on.
  • Write your message in the text field. Use {username} to personalize the greeting automatically.
  • Click Save.

To turn off auto-reply, follow the same steps and toggle it off.

Auto-reply messages do not substitute direct reply messages. Respond within 24 hours to maintain your inbox response rate. Unread messages will remain marked in your inbox to remind you to provide a manual response when available.

Auto-reply templates

You can use these templates as a starting point. Feel free to personalize them with your name, business hours, and any details specific to your services.

  • Use this template when you want to reassure new clients that you’ve received their message and will follow up soon.
  • Hi {username},
  • Thanks for reaching out! I’ve received your message, and I’ll get back to you soon. If there are any additional details you want to add, feel free to send them my way.
  • I look forward to chatting with you!
  • Use this template when you want to get a head start on understanding the client’s project before your first real exchange.
  • Hey {username},
  • Thanks for your message — I’d love to help! While I get back to you, could you share a few more details about your project? References, timelines, and anything that helps me understand your vision are all very useful.
  • If you’re still figuring out the details, no worries — I’m happy to help you decide which package works best or put together a custom offer.

Best practices

  • Combine both features. Use auto-reply to handle first contact automatically, and build a library of quick responses for the follow-up conversation.
  • Keep your auto-reply brief and warm. Clients want to know you’ve seen their message. A short, friendly acknowledgment is more effective than a long message.
  • Always personalize before sending. Quick responses are templates. Review and adjust the text to fit the specific client or situation before you hit Send.
  • Name your quick responses clearly. Use names like “File formats” or “Revision policy” so you can find the right template quickly when a client is waiting.
  • Update your auto-reply if your availability changes. If you mention business hours, make sure they’re accurate. An auto-reply promising a response “within 2 hours” when you’re actually unavailable can cause frustration.
  • Use {username}. Personalized greetings feel less robotic. Both features support this variable.

Learn more with The art of auto replies.

FAQs

  • No. It only sends once, to the very first message in a new conversation. It does not send to clients you’ve already spoken with, and it does not repeat in ongoing conversations.
  • No. The auto-reply does not count as a response toward your Fiverr response rate. You still need to reply manually to satisfy the response rate metric.
  • Yes. The lightning bolt icon is available in the Fiverr mobile app, so you can use your saved quick responses on the go.
  • No. When the PA is active, your auto-reply is automatically disabled to prevent clients from receiving duplicate messages. If you turn the PA off, you can re-enable auto-reply.
  • You can save up to 100 quick responses. If you try to save more, the additional responses are stored but will not be visible in the panel after the page refreshes.
  • Yes. Fiverr provides suggested quick responses for the most common client questions. You can use them as-is or edit them before sending.

Response time and rate explained for freelancers

Responsiveness is a key factor in your success on the Fiverr platform. Tracking your response rate and time helps you manage your inbox effectively, stand out to potential clients, and understand your performance.

Understanding response time and response rate

  • This is the percentage of first responses to new messages that a freelancer sends within 24 hours. It is visible only to freelancers and factors only the last 90 days of activity.
  • The response rate indicator tracks only your first response to a new request. Later messages in a conversation do not factor into the overall response rate.
  • This is the average amount of time in hours that it takes for a freelancer to respond to a new message in their inbox. It is visible to clients.
  • Working with clients in other time zones can affect your response time, but not your response rate, because you have a full 24 hours to respond.

Improving responsiveness

  • Continually check your messages, especially during an active order. Responding quickly and politely, even to decline work, builds rapport and can lead to future business.
  • Download the Android or iOS app to receive immediate notifications and respond anywhere.
  • Efficiently reply to common messages using pre-written templates. Use Quick Responses to politely decline a project or to turn down requests for free samples.
  • Your Auto Reply message only informs the client that you’re looking into their message, but it won’t mark the message as “answered” if you don’t manually respond within 24 hours. Your response time will be affected by the time you take to manually respond to the client.
  • You do not need to reply to spam. Click Report to mark the message as spam within 24 hours so it does not affect your response rate.
  • Note that if you unmark a message as spam, you must respond to the client within 24 hours.
  • Change or extend the delivery time on your Gigs if you feel overwhelmed with inbox requests.
  • If you need to take a break, use Fiverr’s availability settings to pause your Gigs and protect your response rate.
    • Go to your Dashboard and find the availability panel on the top of your dashboard.
    • Set your status to Unavailable and choose a return date.
    • Leave the “All clients can contact me” toggle off if you do not plan to respond while away.
  • When you are set to unavailable:
    • Your Gigs stay visible in search but cannot accept new orders.
    • Your response rate is not affected as long as you keep the contact toggle off.
    • If you switch on the “All clients can contact me” toggle, your response time and response rate will be counted as usual.
  • You can monitor both metrics from your Analytics dashboard. Check it regularly to catch any drop before it affects your freelancer level. Your response rate updates daily, so consistent effort pays off quickly.

Best Practices

  • Reply to every new message within 24 hours, even if it is just a brief acknowledgment or a polite decline.
  • Use Quick Responses to reduce the time it takes to reply to common questions.
  • Enable push notifications on the mobile app so you can respond on the go.
  • Set your availability to unavailable (with the contact toggle off) when you go on a longer break, rather than ignoring messages.
  • Check your analytics regularly so you can address any dip in your response rate before it impacts your level.

FAQs

  • The indicator promotes quicker responses to create a positive client experience. It also helps you understand how responsiveness can grow your business and allows you to track your improvement over time.
  • No, automatic responses are not considered a response to the client’s message. Your auto-reply message only informs the client that you are looking into their request. You must manually respond within 24 hours.
  • Spam and solicitations do not count against your response rate. You must report the message as spam within 24 hours.
  • The response rate tracks the percentage of first responses sent within 24 hours over the last 90 days. For example, if you receive 10 new requests in the last 90 days and reply to nine of them within 24 hours, your response rate is 90%.

Subscription orders for freelancers

Subscriptions are a way to offer your services on an ongoing basis, helping you work with your favorite clients long-term and attract new ones. By providing a predictable service schedule, you can increase your repeat business score and potentially generate more income.

Before you begin

Subscriptions allow clients to book your services at set intervals for recurring periods, depending on how they are offered: Within a Gig or in a Custom Offer.

  • Freelancers in certain categories who meet specific Fiverr eligibility criteria can offer Subscriptions for a monthly period of 3 or 6 months.
  • Your Gig must be priced at $10 or more, except for Voiceover Gigs, which can offer subscriptions starting at $5.
  • The maximum delivery time for subscription Gigs is 30 days.

How subscriptions work

Each subscription order is treated as a standalone order. This means the next order in the cycle will start automatically, even if the previous one is still in progress.

  • You are paid after every successful delivery for each subscription order.
  • Like regular orders, subscriptions will auto-complete if the client does not accept within 3 days of delivery.
  • Clients can cancel upcoming orders. You must cancel a subscription at least 10 days before the renewal date so that your metrics are not affected.
  • Your metrics are only affected if you cancel after an order that has already started.
  • Clients can provide new requirements for every individual order via the order page.
  • If a client needs extra services outside the subscription scope, they must message you directly.
  • The subscription starts when the client pays and places an order. Currently, you cannot change the start date of a subscription once it is established.

Milestone and subscription orders can’t be combined and offered simultaneously.

Adding subscriptions to a Gig

You can add or remove the subscription option from your Gigs at any time.

  • Go to your Gigs page.
  • Click Add Subscription next to the Gig in question.
    • Tip: First, add subscriptions to your existing Gigs instead of new Gigs, as they have more exposure.
  • Choose the subscription period (3 or 6 months).
  • Optional: Select a discount of 5%, 10%, 15%, or 20% to offer your clients.
  • Click Save.

Note: Discounts start from the second order and apply to all related Gig packages.

Subscriptions in Custom Offers

Freelancers can also send subscriptions through Custom Offers for a more personalized approach.

  • You can create subscription Custom Offers from a desktop or mobile web browser.
  • Unlike standard Gig subscriptions, Custom Offers allow for any interval, including daily, weekly, biweekly, or monthly.
  • The automated discount feature is not available for Custom Offers. If you want to offer a lower price, you must manually adjust the base price in the offer.

FAQs

  • No, you cannot combine milestone and subscription structures in the same order.
  • You can choose to offer a discount of 5%, 10%, 15%, or 20% on your Gig, but it’s not a must. The chosen discount applies to all packages for a given Gig; it starts with the second order.
  • Clients can see the option in your Gig package descriptions, the “Compare packages” table, or by using the “Subscription services” filter on the listing page.
  • You can offer a subscription for up to 6 months.
    • Daily subscription: Orders can recur every 5 to 29 days.
    • Weekly subscription: Orders can recur every 1 to 7 weeks.
    • Monthly subscription: Orders can recur every 1 to 2 months.
  • You’ll get paid after every delivery.
  • Canceling a subscription order does not affect your metrics as long as it is done at least 10 days before the next order starts. Your metrics are only impacted if you cancel an order that has already begun.
  • You can only create a subscription from desktop or mobile web, but clients can accept and pay via mobile.

Using my contacts

My contacts enables you to keep in touch with Fiverr users you have interacted with in the past. Your contact lists display the key interactions between you and your contact, the number of completed orders, the amount spent, when the last order was made, and a link to your inbox conversation. As most clients on Fiverr are repeat customers, we recommend reaching out to one or two clients periodically. Let your previous clients know that you appreciate their business and are available if they should require anything in the future. Keeping the line of communication open and friendly only betters your opportunity for future work.

Note: This tool should not be used for sending mass messages or offers to users. This is considered spam and can lead to an account warning.

- In the Selling menu, click on "Growth & Marketing". Then, select "Contacts."
- Select "My buyers" to view the list of your previous clients.
- Buyer name
- Completed orders
- Amount spent
- Last order
- Chat bubble: When you click on it you will be redirected to the last comment in your conversation with your buyer.
- Send offer: By clicking on create an offer, you can create a custom offer for your clients.

Using the Resolution Center (Freelancers: Order management)

The Resolution Center is an essential tool that helps you resolve requests and manage active orders with ease. Whether you’re a freelancer dealing with project scope changes or a client seeking updates, this tool provides a streamlined way to address concerns directly with the other party.

Overview

The Resolution Center allows users to resolve order-related inquiries without the need to contact Customer Support. Once a request is submitted, it is sent directly to the other party, who has 48 hours to accept or decline.

Note: You can withdraw your request before it’s accepted or declined.

If the request submitted in the Resolution Center isn’t accepted or declined within 48 hours, the system will automatically accept it.

Before you begin

  • The Resolution Center is unavailable for orders that are already completed or canceled.
  • Orders that are waiting for requirements or are very late (24 hours past the expected delivery time) can be canceled by the client without the freelancer’s approval.
  • We recommend communicating with the other party before opening a request to reach an amicable solution.

How to use the Resolution Center

To access the Resolution Center:

  • Navigate to the Orders section from your dashboard.
  • Select the specific order you want to manage and click View.
  • Click Resolution Center located on the right side of the page.
  • Select the option available to you in the Resolution Center.
  • Fill in the details and submit your request.

Client options

Use these features to stay informed or end a project that no longer meets your needs.

  • If you need to confirm details or check progress before completion, use this option to prompt a response.
    • Select Get an order update from the action menu.
    • Submit your request to the freelancer.
  • If requirements change or expectations aren’t met, you can request an amicable cancellation.
    • Select Cancel order.
    • Add your comments and submit the request.
  • Important: If there is already an open request for a delivery extension or update, you must withdraw it before you can request a cancellation.

Freelancer options

Use these features to maintain your performance metrics and manage client expectations.

  • A delivery date extension allows you to set a new delivery date if you can’t meet the original timeframe.
    • The time is added to the original delivery date, not the current date: Keep this in mind when calculating how much time you will need to deliver.
    • You can add up to 60 days to each request.
  • To request an extension:
    • Click Extend delivery date located under the Deliver now button on the order page.
    • Add how many days you need to deliver.
    • Add a note to the client explaining your decision.
    • Click Send Request.
  • A partial refund is appropriate for changes in project scope, compensation for delays, or minor dissatisfaction.
    • Select Offer a partial refund in the Resolution Center.
    • Enter the amount (up to 60% of the original price).
    • Provide a clear explanation and select a reason from the dropdown menu (this reason remains confidential).
    • Click Send offer.
  • Important: If accepted, your performance metrics are not affected. However, you can’t make further refund requests on the same order.
  • Learn more with Partial refunds.
  • Request this if the project scope has changed significantly or if you are unable to complete the work.
    • Select the reason and provide an explanation.
    • Click Cancel order.
  • Canceled orders can affect your earnings, performance metrics, and search visibility.
  • Learn more with the following Help Center articles:
    • Using the Resolution Center.
    • How disputes work.

FAQs

  • No, requests in the Resolution Center are sent directly to the other party and can be viewed on the Order page. Customer Support is not notified of these requests.
  • If a freelancer is late with their delivery and no mutual agreement was made to extend the delivery date, you can cancel the order 24 hours after the expected delivery time without the freelancer’s approval.
  • No, the Resolution Center is unavailable for orders that have already been completed or canceled.
  • Both freelancers and clients have up to 48 hours to accept or decline a request or cancellation request.
  • You can’t open a new request if there is already an open request for the same order, which addresses issues such as delivery extensions, updates, or cancellations. You must first withdraw the current request on the Orders page, then open a new one.
  • If the client accepts a partial refund offer, the refund is processed, and your order performance metrics will not be affected.
  • No, once a partial refund has been accepted, you can’t request further refunds for that same order. However, if the initial offer for the partial refund was declined, you can send a new one.

Using your inbox effectively (Freelancers: Order management)

The Inbox is your central hub for sending, receiving, and managing all communication with users on Fiverr. It brings together conversations from every stage of the Fiverr experience, including inquiries, Custom Offers, and order-related messages, so you can easily stay on top of your workflow.

How to access your Inbox?

You can easily access the Inbox from your Fiverr account:

  • Click the envelope/message icon at the top-right of the page.
  • To view all your messages, click See all in Inbox.

What you can see in a conversation

Within a conversation, the right side of the screen displays useful information about the user you’re speaking with.

  • As a client, the following information is displayed about the freelancer:
    • Location
    • Seniority
    • Spoken languages and their level
    • Freelancer level
    • Response rate
    • Rating
    • Hourly rate availability: Learn more with Hourly orders for clients.
    • Order history
  • As a freelancer, the following information is displayed about the client:
    • Location
    • Seniority
    • Spoken languages and their level
  • If you’re subscribed to Seller Plus, you can also view:
    • Number of completed orders
    • Average rating given
    • Average order price
    • Order completion rate
    • Date of last order
    • Preferred service
  • If you’re just starting your journey on Fiverr, learn more with Seller Plus Kickstart: Start your freelance journey strong.
  • If your freelancer level is 1 and up, learn more with Seller Plus Standard and Premium: Advanced tools for business growth.

Managing your conversations

You can take actions on conversations and individual messages directly from your Inbox.

Conversation actions

From the All messages list, you can take the following actions on any conversation:

  • Star/Unstar (star icon): Highlight specific users, conversations, or services.
  • Apply labels (tag icon): Organize your Inbox and highlight specific conversations. You can rename a label by clicking the Edit icon next to the label, or remove it by clicking the Delete icon.

Click the ellipsis (…) for more options:

  • Mark as read/Unread: Keep track of your conversations, and answer when convenient.
  • Archive: Declutter your Inbox but keep relevant conversations on hand.
  • Delete: Remove the conversation entirely. If you delete a conversation by mistake, you can always search for the user with the All messages filter.
Message actions

Hover over any message and click the ellipsis (…) to access the following actions:

  • Reply: Reply directly to a specific message or file.
  • Edit: Correct a recently sent message within 15 minutes of sending. All active participants will see the update in real time. Supported on web only.
  • Save message: Save important messages in a separate Saved tab, located next to the Messages tab. Delivery messages can’t be saved.
  • Delete: Remove a recently sent message within 15 minutes of sending. All active participants will see the update in real time. Supported on web only.
  • Mark as spam: Flag the message as spam. Learn how to protect your account and stay safe with Avoiding spam and staying safe on Fiverr.
  • Report: Report the message to Fiverr. Learn more with Reporting content or behavior on Fiverr.
Message toolbar

At the bottom of the message area, a toolbar gives you quick access to the following options:

  • Attachment: Attach a file to your message. You can send files up to 1 GB in size.
  • Emoji: Add an emoji to your message.
  • Video call (camera): Start a Zoom-based video call. Only freelancers can initiate video calls. Some freelancers will also have the option to book a consultation. Learn more with Video calls (Zoom calls).
  • Add person: Add another participant to the conversation. Available for Team Account and Fiverr Pro users only.
  • Refer a freelancer: Recommend a freelancer you worked with before who best fits the client’s needs. Learn more with Refer fellow freelancers for client projects.
Filtering your Inbox

Use the magnifying glass icon to search for a specific conversation, or go to All messages and activate a filter. You can also create your own labels when filtering conversations.

  • All conversations: View all your inbox conversations.
  • Unread: View unread conversations.
  • Starred: View conversations you’ve marked with the star icon.
  • Archived: View conversations you’ve stored in your history.
  • Spam: View conversations flagged as spam.
  • Custom offers: View conversations where you’ve received custom offers.
  • Requests: View conversations with your requested quotes from other freelancers.
  • Follow-up: View conversations you marked with the Follow-up label.

Inbox features

The Inbox includes several features to help you communicate more effectively.

  • When you receive a message in any language, there is an option to translate it into English right from your Inbox, eliminating language barriers and delays.
  • You can customize how the Enter key functions in your Inbox. Click the up arrow to choose between starting a new line or sending the message.
  • Before an order is placed, if a client is communicating with a freelancer, the system may detect a mismatch between the client’s needs and what the freelancer is providing. The system will find a potential match on budget, availability, and time requirements that will be shared with the client.

Freelancer tools

As a freelancer, you have access to additional tools directly from your Inbox.

  • Freelancers can set up an auto-reply, a message sent automatically to a client when they reach out for the first time. Quick responses are pre-written sentences that make follow-up communication much quicker.
  • Learn more with Auto-replies & quick responses
  • Send a Custom Offer to a client to proactively offer your services in a customized way.
  • Learn more with Custom offers.

Order-specific messages

If a message is attached to an order, it will have an icon you can hover over to see the corresponding order number. Click the order number to go directly to the order page. You can also access and respond to conversations directly from the orders page.

Where to find your order messages
  • All related messages remain available in the order chat.
  • All order-related communication now appears directly in your Inbox for a more streamlined workflow.

Searching past activity

You can search and see all your past activity on Fiverr, including orders, messages, and interactions with other users.

  • Within your Inbox, click the search icon next to All messages and type the name of the user you would like to find.
  • Click the search icon; all communication with that username will appear.
  • Click any item in the results to view more information.

Messaging limits

To ensure a secure and positive experience, Fiverr sets limits on message activity to minimize excessive or unwanted communication and reduce spam.

  • If you reach your messaging limit, you’ll receive a notification and will need to wait 60 minutes before sending messages to users who are not already in your contact list.
  • During this period, you can still message existing contacts, and other users can initiate conversations with you.
  • If you continue to exceed the limit, you will receive a warning notification informing you that further violations may result in an account suspension.
  • Continued violations will lead to a permanent suspension of your account for spamming.

File management

  • Attachments that haven’t been accessed in two years are automatically archived. If you try to download an archived attachment, the download will initially fail, triggering a 12-hour restoration process. After this process is completed, you’ll be able to download the attachment. If the file remains unavailable after 12 hours, contact Customer Support.
  • Attachments are automatically deleted three years after they are sent. Fiverr cannot retrieve these files as they are permanently removed from the system. Files that are part of a delivery message may also be deleted.
  • Users can send files up to 1 GB in size. If you need to send a larger file, upload it to a cloud service such as Google Drive and share the link with the user. Ensure the user you’re sharing with has access to the file only.

Using the Inbox on the mobile app

Similar to the web or desktop experience, you’ll find the same filtering and action options on the mobile app by tapping the filter icon at the top right of your main Inbox screen or by tapping the ellipsis (…) in the upper right corner within an individual conversation.

  • From the main menu, tap the envelope icon for your Inbox.
  • Tap any conversation from the list to open it. Once inside, you can see the user’s status at the top of the screen (online or away).

Video calls (Zoom calls) (Freelancers: Order management)

Video calls on Fiverr let you connect face-to-face with a client or freelancer before or after an order is placed. Fiverr hosts all calls through Zoom and covers the associated costs. Use Zoom calls to align on project details, set clear expectations, and build a stronger working relationship.

Before you begin

  • Only freelancers can initiate Zoom video calls. Clients can request a Zoom video call from an eligible freelancer’s profile page.
  • Fiverr hosts all calls through Zoom. You do not need your own Zoom account.
  • All calls are automatically recorded and saved for 30 days, so both parties can review them.

Eligibility for freelancers

Freelancers can initiate calls from two places: an order page or an inbox conversation. Each location has different requirements.

  • Available to all freelancers.
  • How to access: Open the inbox with the user by clicking Message [username] under the user’s name.
  • To initiate a call from the inbox, you must have at least one order (any status) in the last 60 days, and meet at least one of the following requirements:
    • Be an Agency.
    • Be in a conversation with a Fiverr Pro customer.
    • Be a Level 1 freelancer with an Average Selling Price (ASP) of $50 or above.
  • The ASP on your Earnings page includes tips and extras, but the ASP used to determine Zoom eligibility does not. Therefore, you can’t use the ASP from the Earnings page to check if you’re eligible.

Agencies: scheduling a future meeting

In addition to starting an immediate call, Agencies can invite a client to schedule a meeting at a future time based on the Agency’s availability.

Using Zoom calls

Call time limits

The maximum length of a call depends on whether an order has been placed:

  • Before an order is placed: up to 30 minutes.
  • After an order is placed: up to one hour.
Transcripts

Every call is automatically recorded by Fiverr. After the call ends:

  • Both the freelancer and client can view the recording and transcript by clicking Watch Recording.
  • A dedicated Zoom page will open where both parties can download the recording.
Joining with multiple participants

If your client is a Fiverr Pro user, multiple team members can join the call. The call link is only available during the session and cannot be shared in advance.

Reporting a call

After any call, both the freelancer and the client can report the meeting to Fiverr using the Report the incident option, or directly to Customer Support if the client/freelancer acted unprofessionally regarding the order (e.g., by asking for personal or payment details).

  • In your inbox, go to the meeting card and click Report the incident.
  • In the Report a video meetup window, select the reason for your report:
    • They asked to pay/communicate outside of Fiverr.
    • They behaved/spoke inappropriately.
    • Other.
  • In the Incident occurred at field, enter the timestamp when the incident took place.
  • Click Report.
  • Click Got it to close the confirmation window.

Your report will not be shared with the other person. Fiverr’s Trust & Safety team will review your report.

How to start a Zoom call

  • Clients cannot initiate a Zoom video call. You can request one from an eligible freelancer’s profile page. If the freelancer is not eligible, you will see only the option to contact them.
    • Go to the freelancer’s profile page.
    • Click Ask to schedule an intro Zoom meeting.
    • The request appears in your inbox along with the freelancer’s response when they reply.
    • Open the inbox conversation or the order page.
    • Click the video icon in the message box.
    • A Zoom call is created. Both you and your client can join.
    • You will see a pop-up confirming that the account owner is Fiverr.
  • When a client sends a Zoom video call request from your profile:
    • Open your inbox.
    • Accept or decline the request.
    • If you accept, suggest time slots for the meeting.
    • Open the inbox conversation or the order page.
    • Click the video meeting icon in the message box.
    • Select the option to invite the client to book a future meeting.
    • The client receives an invitation to schedule a meeting based on your availability.

Video call policies

Zoom video calls are designed to provide the best possible ordering experience and ensure freelancers are aligned with their clients’ needs. Freelancers and clients are expected to act professionally at all times and to adhere to our Community Standards.

By joining a Fiverr Zoom video call, you agree to abstain from using:

  • Inappropriate language.
  • Offensive comments related to gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, disability, mental illness, physical appearance, body size, race, religion, accent, dialect, or national origin, etc.
  • Hate speech or harassment.
  • Adult content, nudity, or sexual activity, including sexual attention of any kind.
  • Threats of violence.
  • Prohibited Services on Fiverr, both offering and asking for said services.
  • Any attempts to move business off of Fiverr.

We recommend that the summary of the order’s requirements discussed on the call be written down in the order to avoid any misunderstandings that may arise.

Best practices for freelancers

  • Before creating a meeting, contact your client to confirm they are available and to account for any time zone differences.
  • After the call, send your client a written summary of the main points and any agreements you reached. This helps prevent misunderstandings.
What to avoid
  • Don’t share any sensitive personal information. This includes passwords, credit card information, SSN, national identification card numbers, or any other private information.
  • Don’t click on any links or attachments you may receive unless the context is absolutely clear. We recommend that you always use an antivirus on your own device as extra security.
  • Avoid remote access tools. Refrain from using tools such as TeamViewer and AnyDesk that allow a second party to potentially take control of your computer. If you do need to use such a tool, make sure not to allow any operations, as these may damage your computer if accessed by another party.
  • Don’t engage in any conversation that makes you feel uncomfortable. Remember, you can report your Zoom video call by clicking Report the incident or by contacting Customer Support.

FAQs

  • All freelancers can start a Zoom video call from a conversation in the order page. To start calls from an inbox conversation, you need to meet specific eligibility criteria.
  • Your Average Selling Price (ASP) for Zoom eligibility must be $50 or above if you are a Level 1 freelancer. This ASP does not include tips or extras and can’t be used to determine your eligibility.
  • Before an order is placed, the call can last up to 30 minutes. After an order is placed, the call can last up to one hour.
  • After the call, click the recording button in your inbox to go to the Zoom page. You can view the transcript and download the recording and transcript files. Recordings are available for 30 days.
  • You will receive the request in your inbox. You can accept or decline. If you accept, you then suggest time slots for the meeting.
  • Clients cannot initiate Zoom video calls directly. You can request one by clicking Ask to schedule an intro Zoom meeting on an eligible freelancer’s profile page.
  • If the freelancer is not eligible for Zoom, you will see only the option to contact them. The Zoom video call request option will not appear.
  • Yes. Every call is automatically recorded by Fiverr. You can view and download the recording and transcript for up to 30 days after the call.
  • Before an order is placed, the call can last up to 30 minutes. After an order is placed, the call can last up to one hour.
  • No. Calls are hosted by Fiverr through Zoom. When you join, you will see a pop-up confirming that the account owner is Fiverr.

Working with Milestones

Working with Milestones allows clients to review freelancers’ workflow and pricing before placing an order. This transparency helps freelancers manage expectations and attract larger projects by demonstrating exactly what deliverables to expect and when.

Why should I work with Milestones?

Why it’s useful:
  • Milestones are a great tool to boost conversion and Gig interest.
  • Milestones are perfect for large projects that require multiple steps to complete.
  • Transparency in the freelancer’s management process builds a level of trust and understanding with the client by clearly setting expectations.
  • Milestones are delivered separately to help manage client expectations. This ensures clients know what to expect and by when.
  • Freelancers are reimbursed per completed Milestone rather than waiting for the entire order to finish.

Before you begin

To add Milestones to a Gig, it must match the following eligibility:

  • Price: The basic package must be at least $100 or more, and each Milestone must be at least $50.

  • Minimum requirements: A minimum of 2 Milestones must be added.

  • Maximum limits: Up to 5 Milestones to a Gig can be added.

  • Available subcategories: This feature is only available in specific subcategories. Eligible subcategories include:

  • • 3D Product Animation

  • • Custom Application

  • • On-Page SEO

  • • Accounting & Bookkeeping

  • • Customization

  • • Ad Review & Optimization

How do Milestones work?

A single order contains multiple Milestones, and they function like this:

  • Client charges: Clients are charged for the first Milestone upon placing the order and then for each additional Milestone as they are delivered.
  • Clearance period: The clearance period is 14 days and 7 days for Pro, TRS or Seller Plus freelancers.
  • Milestone approval: Once a Milestone is approved, the client initiates the next one and pays for it.
  • Revision window: Clients have 8 days from delivery to request a revision or accept the current Milestone. If no action is taken, the order is marked completed.
  • Delivery: A separate delivery is sent for each Milestone. The client has 10 days to pay for the next Milestone after they accept the delivery. If the client doesn’t pay, the order is stopped.
  • Reviews: Clients can leave reviews for Milestone orders.
    • Learn more with Leaving and managing reviews on Fiverr.
  • Stopping an order: Clients can stop a Milestone order after any Milestone is accepted. If stopped, the order is marked completed, and you are paid for the approved work.
  • Cancellations: Each Milestone can be canceled individually.

Note: As long as one Milestone is completed in an order, the rest of the canceled Milestones won’t affect the freelancer’s statistics.

Once a Milestone order is stopped, it can’t be resumed.

How to set up Milestones

To add Milestones, go to the Description & FAQ tab when creating or editing your Gig.

  • Click Start from scratch to create your first Milestone.
  • Click Add a Milestone and fill in the Name and description.
  • Select the Available packages and toggle Zoom on or off if needed.
  • Verify that all details are accurate and click Save Milestone.
  • After adding the first Milestone, a ‘substep’ (optional) can be added to the Milestone.
    • Click ‘Add a substep,’ enter the substep name, and select the ‘Available packages.’
    • Verify that all details are correct and click “Save substep.”
  • Save all changes by clicking Save and continue.

As soon as the Milestone is saved and added,, clients will see the option to use Milestones on your Gig.

Adding Milestones to a custom offer

Milestones can be used in custom offers even if they are not applied to your Gig.

  • Go to Messages and select Inbox
  • Open a message and click Create an offer.
  • Select a Gig and click Choose an order type, then select Milestones.
  • Provide a name, completion time, and amount for each Milestone.

Note: Custom offers allow up to 6 Milestones per project.

Best practices

- Be specific: Define how many Milestones you need and what each Milestone should include.
- Review the delivery: Carefully review and approve the delivery for each Milestone to ensure a successful start to the next one.
- Encourage discussion: Discuss every step of the Milestone with the freelancer to monitor progress and avoid misunderstandings.
- Break it down: Use manageable, deliverable Milestones to give clients an idea of what it is like to work with you.
- Define revisions: Set specific revisions per Milestone for a more organized project.
- Use as motivators: Milestones act as motivators for both parties; clients have reduced risk, and you have the incentive to complete each task.

FAQs

  • Once each Milestone is completed and approved, the freelancers will be paid. Freelancers are reimbursed per Milestone, rather than waiting for the entire order to be completed.
  • Revisions are defined per Milestone and can be utilized at each individual step of the order.
  • We recommend using Milestones for larger projects that require more flexibility through smaller, manageable steps.
  • Clients are charged for the first Milestone when the order is placed. For subsequent steps, the client is charged when they approve the current Milestone and initiate the next one.
  • Yes, clients can choose to stop an order after any Milestone is accepted. This does not cancel previous deliveries but stops the order from progressing to the next step. Once stopped, it cannot be resumed.
  • Yes, a specific Milestone or the entire order can be canceled through the Resolution Center or Customer Support for valid reasons.
  • If at least one Milestone was completed before the order was canceled, the order will still be considered as completed.
  • Clients have 8 days from the delivery of each Milestone to either request a revision or accept it. If they take no action, the order stops and is marked as Completed.
  • Clients have 10 days to pay for the next Milestone after they accept the delivery. If the client doesn’t pay, the order is stopped.

Freelancers: Selling on Fiverr

Adding and managing your Gig video

A Gig video lets clients see your work quality and understand your service before placing an order, which can increase your chances of getting hired. You can add a video to any Gig on Fiverr, and in some Video & Animation categories, a video is required. Use a high-quality, original video focused on the service you offer, and make sure it follows our content and technical guidelines.

Before you begin

Gig videos are available to all freelancers. A video is required for the following Video & Animation subcategories:

  • Animation for Kids
  • App & Website Previews
  • Book Trailers and Game Trailers
  • Live-Action Explainers
  • Lyric and Music Videos
  • Real Estate Promos
  • Short Video Ads
  • Spokesperson Videos
  • Whiteboards
  • Animated Explainers

For all other categories, a video is optional but recommended.

You can add or manage your Gig video from the Gallery tab when creating or editing a Gig from your desktop.

Tips for your Gig video

Your video should:

  • Help the client visually understand your style: Set client expectations and give an idea of what you can deliver.
  • Be engaging: Some clients are more likely to place an order when they feel connected to your work.
  • Showcase your work and tell a story: Use a strategic and logical sequence when creating and editing your video, think of a beginning, middle, and end.

Gig video technical requirements

Your video must meet the following requirements before you upload it:

  • Length: up to 75 seconds (no longer than one minute and 15 seconds)
  • File size: less than 50 MB up to 5GB
  • Accepted formats: MP4 and AVI
  • Orientation: landscape only

Gig video approval process

When you upload a video, it goes through a review process. Your video stays pending until we approve it, and this review typically takes a few business days.

Once we approve your video, it goes live on your Gig page. While your video is pending, your Gig can still be active and visible to clients.

If your Gig is not active because your video is still pending after the expected review period, contact our support team.

How to add a Gig video

  • Go to Create a New Gig > Gallery tab.
  • Drag and drop your video file, or click to browse your computer for the file.

When clients search the marketplace, your video appears as the Gig cover image. Additionally, if you want to add a video to an existing Gig, go to your Gig page and open the Gallery tab of that Gig.

Managing your Gig video thumbnail

Your video thumbnail is the frame clients see when they browse the marketplace. You can customize it after your video is approved.

You cannot adjust your video thumbnail until we have approved your video.

To edit your video thumbnail:

  • Go to Gig Edit mode > Gallery > Video > Edit.
  • Click Play and pause the video on the frame you want to use as your thumbnail.
  • Click Set as preview, then click Close.

After you update your thumbnail, it can take up to 24 hours for the change to appear on the marketplace.

Gig video guidelines

  • Follow these guidelines when creating your Gig video:
    • Keep your video focused on the service you offer and keep it concise.
    • Record clear audio without background noise. Use professional audio equipment and position your microphone properly.
    • Use your own voice when possible. If you use computerized narration, make sure it is high quality and sounds natural.
    • Mention that your services are offered exclusively on Fiverr.
    • If you offer your service in another language, write your Gig details in that language in addition to English. Your video can be in the other language, but include the language in your Gig title. Example: “I will create video ads in Spanish.”
    • Use only content you created or fully own. Do not use copyrighted images, audio, or watermarks that are not yours.
  • Avoid the following when creating your Gig video:
    • Do not include contact information, URLs, or external links in your video. If you use portfolio samples, replace any contact details with placeholder information, for example “myemail@email.com” or “555-5555.”
    • Do not use the same video for multiple Gigs. Each video must be specific to the service it represents.
    • Do not include Fiverr level badges, rating stars, or other Gig-specific metrics. These can change over time and may become inaccurate.
    • Do not ask another freelancer to create samples of your work. If your service is in the Video & Animation category, you cannot use another freelancer to create your Gig video.

Video & Animation category: Subcategories

Freelancers in any category can add a video to their Gig. However, a video is required for all Gigs in the Video & Animation category.

Since each Video & Animation subcategory highlights different services and skills, make sure your Gig video clearly showcases your relevant expertise and work.

Audio is required in the videos of all subcategories (except for “Logo Animation,” “Animated characters & Modeling,” and “Visual Effects”).

Guidelines for each subcategory

Whiteboard & Animation Explainers

  • Demonstrate different functionalities for both existing products and work in progress. Use this in your Gig Video to explain a complicated business or a product.
    • Videos can be either Animated Explainer samples or showreels of a few compiled samples.
    • Video may include a voice-over, if you offer this in your Gig Packages.

Disclaimer: Subcategories in the Video & Animation category are subject to change. Learn more about the Product Photography subcategory changes with Photography and related services.

  • Use Intros & Outros to help engage audiences before and after they watch your videos. This includes YouTube Intros, Call for Action Outros, and Twitch Scenes.
  • Please note, if your service is about animating a logo (even if it will be used as an intro), Fiverr recommends that you place your Gig in the Logo Animation subcategory.
  • This is a service that’s focused on animating your client’s existing logo. Help clients by building a professional, recognizable brand with custom-made logo animation. You can also utilize this service to spice up promotional videos, product UI, social networks, and even email signatures.
  • Guidelines for Gig Video:
    • Include 3-10 seconds of moving/animated logos.
    • Put a few logo animation examples together (one after another in your video) to showcase your reviews with files.
    • Audio isn’t mandatory unless offered in one of your Gig Packages.
  • This service is for template-based slideshows and promo videos.
  • Guidelines for Gig Video:
    • Provide a great, quick solution for customer video needs.
    • Examples: App and website previews, book trailers, or even slideshow videos for a real estate property or family vacation.
    • If you’re using a specific template, make sure you showcase this in your Gig video.
    • If you’re using a few templates, make sure to display them all.
  • Use this service to add credibility, build trust, and highlight the personality and emotions behind a company or a product.
  • Guidelines for Gig Video:
    • Scripted videos should include actual production/video footage.
    • Videos are made to explain and should include live/actual footage.
  • Footage can be stock footage that you have the license/permission to use.
  • Utilize Short Video Ads to drive action in specific social networks and platforms. Keep in mind that your Gigs in this subcategory should be:
    • Specifically designed for the short internet-age attention span.
    • Can be created/are in multiple formats and versions, enabling marketing performance optimization across various channels.
    • Videos should be short (5-60 seconds), platform-specific (vertical/square), include either animation or live-action and be marketers/marketing focused.
  • Guidelines for Gig Video:
    • Include videos with the aspect ratio that you are offering in your Gig. If you are providing all options, make sure to include all of them.
    • If you’re debating whether your video belongs to one of the Explainer subcategories or this subcategory, the focus for these videos is selling.
    • If your video is about a drive to action, your video should be placed here.
  • If your video is about explaining, we suggest you place your Gig in one of the Explainer subcategories.
  • Help customers describe their service, vision, and product with this subcategory.
  • Guidelines for Gig Video:
    • It has to be you on camera.
    • Freelancers may speak on behalf of a company and talk about its value proposition but not present themselves as a user or client.
    • If you’re offering different settings/outfits, make sure to showcase these in either your video or Gig images.
  • Shoot video footage and edit it into a short and compelling video, or repurpose a video your client already has.
  • Guidelines for Gig Video:
    • Videos where your editing skills are explicit.
    • Examples: Editing to the beat, showing rare footage, compiling footage in a cool and engaging way, multiple cut-downs of one video ad, etc.
    • All video samples should be edited yourself, and showcase your talent as a video editor.
  • Bring 3D models, products, or characters to life with this subcategory. Whether it’s a medical device, gadget, or elaborate video game characters, you can really get things moving with a Gig Video for your professional rigging and animation services.
  • Add audio to enhance your Gig Video, this is not mandatory.
  • Take your client’s video to the next level with visual effects. Whether it’s color grading, compositing, clean-ups, beauty retouching, or anything else, all the services for a post-production project are here.
  • Guidelines for Gig Video:
    • Focus your videos on fixing/improving/enhancing existing footage, rather than video editing.
    • Your video may be super short, and we recommend being widescreen instead of vertical/square.
    • Showcase before and after videos.
  • From clips made of pre-taped footage with artistic lyrics and titles to custom video productions that will bring your customer’s music to the screen, you have an opportunity to offer a wide variety of lyric or music videos.
  • Audio is mandatory when uploading a video to this subcategory.
  • Create engaging content for children, from nursery rhymes to educational animation.

FAQs

  • No, each Gig must have its own video that is specific to the service it represents. You cannot use the same video across multiple Gigs.
  • Your Gig may go live automatically, but your video stays pending until we review and approve it. This process typically takes a few business days. Once we approve your video, it goes live on your Gig page.
  • If your Gig is not active after the expected review period, contact our support team for assistance.

Best practices for Fiverr freelancers

Building strong connections with your clients, delivering on time, and continuously optimizing your Gigs, sets you up to grow your business and shine on Fiverr. This article will provide you with tools and tips to grow as a freelancer.

To ensure success and maintain a high standard of service, it’s recommended to keep these core values in mind:

  • Set expectations: Clearly define when a client can expect drafts, feedback, and final delivery at the start of the process.
  • Respond promptly: Swift replies create a positive experience and improve your response rate.
  • Deliver on time: Meeting your deadlines is one of the most important factors for your success and client satisfaction.

Best practices for success

Being responsive and organized helps you build a positive reputation. Take this a step further by providing detailed updates to your clients throughout your work process. Communicate with clients frequently and honestly to help build strong client relationships.

  • Reply to clients faster using pre-written response templates found in your inbox. These are ideal for managing communication during busy periods.
  • To use quick responses in your inbox:
    • Open a conversation with a client.
    • Click the lightning bolt icon on the lower panel.
    • Use a provided template or click to create your own unique response.
    • Use the Fiverr mobile app to respond to messages anytime and from anywhere to increase your chances of securing future business.
  • Use platform tools to ensure you can always meet your commitments and make deadlines:
    • Order limit: If you are receiving too many orders, limit the number of active orders you can have in your queue for each Gig.
    • Set availability: Use this feature before taking leave. It lets customers know when you are unavailable and automatically reactivates your Gigs at the end of the set period.
    • Delivery extensions: If you are unable to finish an order on time, be proactive. Contact your customer as soon as possible and use the Resolution Center to request more time.
  • The delivery should always fulfill or exceed your customers’ requirements. Follow up your delivery by asking if the client is satisfied with the service they received.
  • If your Gig isn’t receiving enough views or orders, experiment with the following to improve performance:
    • Pricing: Test different price points for your packages.
    • Visuals: Update your main Gig image to be more engaging and professional.
    • Titles: Refine your title to ensure it clearly describes your service.
  • Note: Your Gig will be paused if you are inactive for longer than 30 days. You can unpause it at any time from your Gigs page.

Resources for freelancers

To further scale your business and manage complex workflows, explore these additional tools:

  • For large-scale projects, break the work into manageable phases by using Milestones to ensure structured delivery and clear payment intervals.
  • For analytics, tools, and personalized guidance, join the Seller Plus program to help grow your business.
      • New freelancers can join Seller Plus Kickstart
      • Experienced freelancers can join Seller Plus Standard or Premium
  • If you are an expert in your field, apply to join Fiverr Pro. Pros are vetted and elite professionals who gain access to high-budget business clients and exclusive growth opportunities.
  • Boost your exposure and reach more potential clients by using Fiverr Ads to place your services in prime search result locations.
  • Connect with fellow professionals in the community forum to share experiences, ask questions, and learn from other successful freelancers. Learn more about joining the Fiverr Community.

FAQs

  • Orders are automatically completed three days after the delivery is submitted, provided the customer does not request a revision or accept it manually.
  • No. Only send the final, completed work as a delivery. Use the message thread on the order page to share drafts for feedback.
  • You can access the free “Be a successful seller” course through the Fiverr platform to dive deeper into these strategies.
