Your earnings page

The Earnings page is your central hub for tracking income, reviewing transactions, managing financial documents, and withdrawing funds from completed orders.

Overview

The Earnings page is available to all freelancers on Fiverr. From a single dashboard, you can:

  • Check your available balance and future payments
  • Withdraw earnings using your preferred payout method
  • Filter and download your activity history
  • Access financial documents such as earnings statements and tax forms
  • Use Cash Advance and Early Payout if you are eligible for the features

Before you begin

  • To open your Earnings page, click My Business > Earnings.
  • All amounts shown on the page are before taxes. When applicable, you can view the total taxes you paid through the tooltip on the page.
  • For every order you complete, you earn 80% of the purchase amount, including Gig Extras and tips. For more details, see Fiverr’s Payment Terms.

Understanding your earnings

The Earnings section shows a breakdown of your funds. You can filter the data by this month, this year, or since joining by selecting a time frame from the dropdown menu.

  • Balance available for use: The amount you can spend on Fiverr or withdraw.
  • Current Overdraft: Appears when your available funds are overdrawn, reflecting funds withdrawn before order completion or used for services.
  • Future payments: Payments for active orders that move into clearance once completed, and cleared orders that will become available funds.
  • Earnings and Expenses: Your all-time earnings (cleared payments and any Customer Support compensation, before taxes) and expenses (purchases made with your earnings).

How to withdraw your earnings

You may withdraw any amount up to $5,000 USD, keeping the rest of your balance intact.

  • Click Withdraw balance.
  • If you wish to edit the amount, click the pencil icon next to the amount and enter the amount you want to withdraw. Click Apply.
  • Choose your withdrawal method.
  • Click Confirm and withdraw to complete.

For more information, see the Withdrawing your earnings & managing payout methods Help Center article.

Pay a Current Overdraft

An overdraft is covered by future earnings, interest-free. You can also choose to pay the outstanding balance immediately using a payment method.

  • Click Pay overdraft balance.
  • A payment page opens. Add a payment method or select a saved one.
  • Click Confirm & Pay to complete.

Filtering & downloading your activity

The Activity table shows all your account activity, including order details and transaction descriptions.

To email an activity report:

  • Filter the data by date range and/or activity type.
  • Click the Email activity report button.

When you sort the Activity table by date, it shows your local date in your timezone. When you filter or request a report, dates reflect the system timezone (UTC). The CSV report is sent to your registered email address. Future earnings do not appear in the report.

Activity types in the table:

  • Clearing: Payments for completed orders that are still in the clearing period.
  • Earning: Earnings from orders, extras, or tips.
  • Earnings Reversed: Canceled earnings.
  • Compensation: Earnings compensation granted to you by Fiverr.
  • Expense: Earnings spent on purchasing services, such as Promoted Gigs or Seller Plus.
  • Expense cancellation: Funds returned to your earnings after a purchase cancellation.
  • Withdrawal: Funds withdrawn from your Fiverr balance to a payout service.
  • Withdrawal failed: Withdrawal was not successful.
  • Cash Advance payment: Cash Advance funds deposited and available for withdrawal.

Using Early Payout

Eligible freelancers can skip the clearing period and get paid faster, with a 1% fee. The Early Payout option appears in the Activity table for eligible orders. For more information, see the Early Payout Help Center article.

Tracking your earnings with Analytics

Use Analytics to track earnings and cash flow over time and see how your business grows.

  • From your Earnings page, click the graph icon.
  • Select a filter by data type:
    • Earnings: Cleared payments before taxes and any compensation.
    • Cashflow: Net amount available to withdraw, including earnings, expenses, and all other transactions.
    • Time frame: Filter data by a specific date range.
  • Select how to view the results: Monthly, Quarterly, or Yearly, and Compare Year-over-Year.

Accessing financial documents

The Financial Documents tab provides access to your earnings statements and tax-related forms.

How to download a Statement of Earnings

All freelancers can download a PDF earnings statement for any full 12-month period.

  • Click Choose date range.
  • Select the time frame and confirm your billing info is correct. Click the update link to make any changes.
  • Click Download statement.
How to update your W-9 form

Freelancers can update their US Person declaration as defined by the IRS.

  • Click Update your declaration.
  • Select Yes or No to the US Person declaration.
    • If you selected No: click Save. Your information is updated.
    • If you selected Yes: click Update Form W-9, complete both pages of the form, then click Submit.

For more information, see W-9 collection in the Help Center.

How to download your 1099-K form

Eligible freelancers can download the 1099-K form.

  • Click the 1099-K Download report.
  • Verify your account with the code sent to your registered phone number. After verification, click Continue.
  • Select the year for which you want the report and click Download.
  • You receive an email with a View Financial Documents link to download the report.
How to complete your Tax Compliance Forms
  • Freelancers registered in the EU, Canada, or Australia must provide tax compliance information. The specific information required varies by location.
    • Click Tax Regulations Edit information and follow the steps.
    • Click Save.
    • Click Done on the confirmation pop-up.
  • For more information, see Tax Regulations for Canada, Australia, and the European Union in the Help Center.
  • Fiverr verifies the withholding tax (‘Nikui Mas Bamakor’) status of freelancers based in Israel. By providing your tax information, you ensure the correct tax rate is applied to your earnings and avoid the maximum default tax deduction required by law.
    • Click Tax Regulations Edit information and follow the steps.
    • Click Save.
    • Click Done on the confirmation pop-up.
  • For more information, see Israeli tax requirements for freelancers in the Help Center.

Accessing Cash Advance

The Cash Advance feature gives selected freelancers the option to receive an immediate cash advance to help grow their business. The amount is deposited into your Fiverr Balance and is available for withdrawal right away. For more information, see the Cash Advance Help Center article.

Best practices

  • Review your Activity table regularly to stay on top of earnings, expenses, and upcoming payouts.
  • Use the Analytics view to spot trends and plan for seasonal changes in your workload.
  • Keep your billing information up to date so your earnings statements generate correctly.
  • If you are based in the EU, Canada, Australia, or Israel, complete your Tax Compliance Form to avoid any disruption to your account.
  • Use the partial withdrawal option if you need only part of your available balance — you do not have to withdraw everything at once.

FAQs

  • Earnings include only your cleared payments and any compensation.
  • A Current Overdraft appears when your available funds are negative. This happens when funds are withdrawn before order completion or used for services. Future earnings cover the overdraft automatically, interest-free, or you can pay it off immediately.

Pro clients: Account settings & security

Account access troubleshooting guide (Pro clients: Account settings & security)

If you’re having trouble accessing your account, this article walks you through the most common reasons and how to resolve them. Each section covers a specific scenario, so you can find the one that matches your situation and follow the steps to get back in.

Before you begin

This article applies to all Fiverr users. If you need to complete phone verification as part of any of the steps below, use a desktop browser. Phone verification is not available on the Fiverr mobile app.

Forgot your password or not receiving the reset email

If you forgot your password, you can reset it from the login page.

  • Go to Fiverr.com and click Sign in.
  • Select Continue with username/email.
  • Click Forgot password?
  • Enter your email address and click Reset password.
  • Check your inbox for the reset email and follow the link.

If you’re not receiving the reset email or the link isn’t working, try the following:

  • Clear your browser’s cache and cookies.
  • Check that the email address you entered is correct and has no typos.
  • Check all folders in your inbox, including spam and junk.
  • If your email is on a private domain, confirm that no additional filters are blocking messages from Fiverr.
  • Temporarily disable password and saving add-ons like LastPass.
  • If you’ve been locked out after too many incorrect attempts, wait 24 hours before trying again.
  • If you don’t have access to your registered email address, contact our Customer Support team.

For more information on managing your password, security question, and two-factor authentication, see Password, security question, and two-factor authentication.

Not receiving your email verification code

If you’re not receiving a verification code sent to your email, try the following:

  • Check your spam and junk folders.
  • If your email is on a private domain, confirm that no additional filters are blocking messages from Fiverr.
  • Verification codes expire after 10 minutes. If your code expired, request a new one and enter it right away.
  • Only the most recent code is valid. If you requested multiple codes, use the latest one.
  • If the issue persists after trying these steps, contact our Customer Support team.

Not receiving your SMS verification code

If your account is phone-verified and you’re not receiving the SMS code, try the following:

  • Make sure your phone has a signal and can receive international messages.
  • Only the most recent code is valid. If you requested multiple codes, use the latest one.
  • Verification codes expire after 10 minutes. If your code expired, request a new one and enter it right away.
  • Some carriers and regions have limitations on receiving SMS from international senders. Check with your provider if restrictions apply.
  • If the issue persists, contact our Customer Support team to verify ownership of your account and update your number.

Automatically logged out due to suspicious activity

If we detect suspicious activity on your account, we automatically log you out of all devices and require you to reset your password before you can log back in. This is a security measure to protect your account.

To regain access:

  • Go to Fiverr.com and click Sign in.
  • Click Forgot password? and follow the reset steps.

Once you’re back in, we strongly recommend you:

  • Enable two-factor authentication (2FA).
  • Review your connected devices and remove any you don’t recognize.
  • Run an antivirus scan on your device.

Can’t reset your password or forgot your email or username

If you’re unable to reset your password because you’ve lost access to your registered email, or you’ve forgotten your email or username, our Customer Support team can help after verifying that you own the account.

To help us verify your ownership, have the following ready:

As a freelancer:

  • The answer to your security question.
  • Your full registered phone number.
  • Your Payoneer ID or PayPal email address used for withdrawals.

As a client:

  • The first six and last four digits of your credit card, along with the expiration date.

Once we verify your ownership, we can update your email, reset your phone number, or reset your security question. Note that we can only update one security detail per 24 hours. After your email is updated, you can reset your password from the login page.

Security question is blocking you

Your security question is required to change your phone number or update your security question itself. If the system isn’t accepting your answer, check the following before contacting us:

  • The answer field is case-sensitive. Make sure you’re using the correct upper and lower case letters.
  • Do not add spaces before or after your answer.

Security question answers are limited to 20 characters; the system won’t accept longer answers even if correct. If your answer isn’t working or you’ve forgotten it, contact our Customer Support team. After we verify your ownership, we can reset your security question so you can set a new one.

For setup instructions, see Password, security question, and two-factor authentication.

Lost access to your registered email or phone number

If you no longer have access to the email address or phone number on your account, contact our Customer Support team. After we verify your ownership, we can update your email address or reset your phone number.

To help us verify your ownership, provide the following:

  • Your Fiverr username.
  • The registered email address or phone number on the account, even if you no longer have access to it.
  • The new email address you’d like to use.

As a freelancer, also provide:

  • Your Payoneer ID or PayPal email address used for withdrawals.

As a client, also provide:

  • The first six and last four digits of the last card used on the account, along with the expiration date.

Once we confirm your ownership, we update your email address so you can regain access.

If you can contact us from your registered email address, that’s the fastest way to verify ownership.

Restoring a closed account

If you previously closed your account and want to restore it, contact our Customer Support team.

  • Contact us using the email address registered on the account. If you can’t, provide your username and email address.
  • Our Customer Support team will review your request and confirm whether reactivation is possible.
  • Once reactivated, log in using your existing credentials. If you don’t remember your password, reset it from the login page.
  • After logging in, make sure your email address, phone number, and security question are up to date.

If your account was closed for more than a year, it may have been automatically deleted and cannot be restored. For more information, see How to deactivate or permanently delete your account.

Account disabled or restricted

If your account has been disabled or restricted, the steps below can help you resolve it. Common reasons include violations of our Terms of Service or Community Standards, payment disputes, pending ID verification, or missing financial documents such as tax forms or DAC7.

To resolve your restriction:

  • Review our Terms of Service and Community Standards to understand what may have triggered it.
  • Complete any pending ID verification or submit any required financial documents.
  • Contact our Customer Support team from your registered email address at support@fiverr.com for further assistance.

A few things to know while your account is restricted:

  • Your balance stays in your account. You can withdraw your funds after 90 days.
  • Creating a new account after yours has been disabled is not allowed.
  • You have the right to appeal by contacting our support team, as stated in our Terms of Service.

For help completing ID verification, see Verify your identity or Verifying your identity as a new freelancer.

FAQs

  • Yes. After we verify your ownership, we can temporarily disable 2FA or clear the old phone number so you can add a new one. Contact our Customer Support team to start this process.
  • We automatically log you out if our system detects suspicious activity on your account. This protects your account from unauthorized access. You’ll need to reset your password to log back in. If you didn’t trigger this yourself, we recommend running an antivirus scan and enabling 2FA after regaining access.
  • This can happen if a new verification requirement was added after your previous one completed, or if the restriction is related to a policy issue rather than verification. Sign out and back in, then check your account settings. If you’re still restricted, contact our Customer Support team with a screenshot of what you see so we can review and reset the flow if needed.

Account roles and management

Fiverr Pro accounts let teams collaborate on projects, payments, and orders. Each member has a role with specific permissions to keep work organized and secure. This article explains the different Fiverr Pro roles, what each role allows, and how Admins can manage invitations, permissions, and account access.

Overview of account roles

The Fiverr Pro account structure includes three distinct roles. It is important to understand the capabilities of each to manage your team’s workflow and security.

Admin

The account owner who has full access to manage the account, finances, and account members. Teams can have only one Admin. Assigning a new Admin will make the previous Admin a regular member.

  • Remove members from the team, manage projects and finances, and place orders. Admins can implement policies requiring approval when members invite new users.
Billing manager

A role focused on financial management. Only the admin can assign this role, and an unlimited number of members can hold billing manager permissions.

  • Access billing history, download invoices, deposit funds, edit billing information, change payment methods, and hire freelancers. An admin can assign a billing manager, either an existing member or a new user, to give them access to the account’s billing history and permission to edit billing details, while the admin always retains full billing manager permissions.
Member

The standard role for purchasing orders, collaborating on projects with other members and interacting with freelancers.

  • Create and track projects, place orders, and save freelancers.

For the Fiverr Pro Business Rewards program, only admins and billing managers can redeem gift cards or use points for donations. Members can only redeem Fiverr Credits. Learn more about the Fiverr Pro Business Rewards program.

How to invite members

All Pro clients can invite people to join the account. You can invite non-Fiverr users via email; they need to click on the invite link from the email, sign up, and create a Fiverr Pro account to collaborate. To invite people:

  • Click your Profile picture, and select Administration > Account members. If you are not the Admin you can select Account members.
  • Click Invite members located in the top right corner of the page.
  • In the pop-up window, enter the email address (separate multiple emails with Enter).
  • Make sure to not input an email address that is already associated with another Pro account.
  • Admins can assign the role Member or Billing manager from the invite.
  • Click Yes, Invite. The recipient will receive an email invitation. Their status will be listed as Pending until they accept.

Admins can set a policy to approve member-sent invitations before they’re sent. To set up the policy:

  • Go to Administration > Approval policies via your Profile picture.
  • For Invitation policy select Add policy.
  • Select who it will apply to: Billing managers, members, or both.
  • Click on Create policy.
  • You will now receive a notification to approve an invitation before it is sent out to the invitee.

How can admins manage account members

Admins can update a member’s role or remove them from the account.

  • As the Admin, go to Administration > Account members via your Profile picture.
  • To change a role: Click the dropdown arrow (^) under the Role column and select the new role (e.g., Member, Billing manager).
  • To deactivate/remove: Click the ellipses (…) next to the member’s name and select the appropriate action.

Removing a member will automatically deactivate (close) that member’s account. If the member wishes to continue in Fiverr, they will need to create a new Fiverr account.

Admin switching to Fiverr

As the Admin you can switch your account plan from Fiverr Pro to Fiverr. Only the admin has the option to switch their account to Fiverr, while members can close their account and open a new account in Fiverr.com with a different email address.

  • Be aware of the following before switching from Fiverr Pro to Fiverr:
    • All account members will be deactivated when the admin switches from Fiverr Pro to Fiverr.
    • Any remaining Pro account credits will not be transferred with you to Fiverr (though they are restored if you upgrade back to Fiverr Pro later).
    • Your order history and messages will remain accessible on Fiverr.
    • If you were subscribed to the Advanced plan, you can cancel anytime and receive a prorated refund based on the time you used the plan.
    • You’ll lose access to all premium features.
To switch from Fiverr Pro to Fiverr
  • Go to your profile picture on the top right corner and click Account plan.
  • Select the View plans button.
  • On the Plans and pricing page, select Switch in the Fiverr plan column.
  • Confirm the switch and optionally choose a reason for leaving.

If the team account has active orders, you will not be able to switch to Fiverr until the orders are completed.

Member switching to Fiverr

Only the admin has the option to switch their account to Fiverr, while members can close their account and open a new account.

To close your account as a member:

  • Go to your profile picture on the top right corner and click My settings.
  • Click on Personal information.
  • On the Account Deactivation section select a reason for closing your account and click on Deactivate account.
  • Go to Fiverr.com and create a new account with a different email address.

If you want to re-use your original email address, ask the admin to remove you from the Pro team instead of closing your own account. Then, go to Fiverr.com and create a new account with the same email address you previously used for Pro.

FAQs

  • You can appoint as many members and billing managers as you need; there is no limitation.
  • Yes, billing managers have permission to hire freelancers through the Pro account.
  • Yes. To make another user the Admin, the current Admin must assign the role to an existing member. Navigate to Administration > Account members, click the ellipses (…) or action menu, and change the role to Admin.
    • The current Admin will automatically become a Member.
    • If the Admin left without assigning a replacement, a current member must contact Customer Support to resolve this.
  • If you withdraw/delete an invitation before it is accepted, the email link will expire. The invitee will be notified that the invitation is no longer valid and will not be able to join.
  • You cannot edit a sent invitation. You must either withdraw the specific invitation and send a new one, or send a new invitation which will override the existing one.
  • If you already have a Pro account, you won’t be able to be invited to another Pro team with the same email address. You can be a part of multiple Pro teams, but each one needs to be associated with a different email address.
  • Check that the email address is correct and hasn’t gone to spam. You can resend the invitation via the Account members section.

Creating your Fiverr Pro account (Pro clients: Account settings & security)

Your Fiverr Pro account is the central hub for managing all your work on Fiverr. It is designed to help teams and businesses manage projects efficiently. With Fiverr Pro, you can track orders, collaborate with team members, and use a shared payment method for all your purchases.

How to sign up for Fiverr Pro

- Go to the Fiverr Pro landing page and click Join Fiverr Pro.
- Choose to sign up with your Google account or another email address.
- Fill in your first name, last name, and desired username, and create a password.
- Click Create my Fiverr Pro account.
- Answer a few quick questions about your business and click Done.
- On the Fiverr Pro landing page, click Join Fiverr Pro.
- Confirm your existing email address and click Continue.
- Answer a few questions about your business and click Done.
  • Your account is now a Fiverr Pro admin account. You can invite team members by going to Profile picture > Administration > Account Members > Invite Members.

Joining an existing Fiverr Pro account

This section applies to users who have been invited to join as a team member or billing manager.

Do not create a separate Fiverr Pro account with the same email address. Only join through the invitation link sent by the admin.

If a Fiverr Pro admin has invited you to join:

  • Click the invitation link in the email.
  • Enter your first and last name, desired username, and password.
  • Click Create My Fiverr Pro Account to join your team.
  • Enter your professional field and role, then click Let’s start.

The admin will receive a notification that you have joined.

Changing your picture or full name displayed on your profile

To edit your profile as a Pro client, go to your underlined name next to Welcome in the top left and click it > In the Edit your profile window, click your default picture to upload a different one and/or change your displayed name under the Full name field.

Switching back to regular Fiverr

Switching back to the standard Fiverr plan means you will no longer have access to Fiverr Pro features. Before you switch, there are a few things to be aware of.

Before you switch:

  • Make sure there are no ongoing orders within your team account.

When you switch:

  • All team members will be removed from the account.
  • Any Fiverr Pro credits you have will be lost temporarily, but they will be restored if you upgrade to Pro again later.
  • Your past order history and messages will still be accessible on regular Fiverr.
  • If you were on a paid Fiverr Pro plan, you may be eligible for a partial refund depending on how long you used it.
  • You will lose access to all Fiverr Pro features.

How to switch back to Fiverr:

  • Go to your Admin page.
  • Click Account plan.
  • Click Switch plan.
  • On the Plans and Pricing page, find the Fiverr plan and click Switch.
  • Confirm your decision to switch. You can optionally provide a reason for leaving.

Only admins can switch a Fiverr Pro account to a standard Fiverr account. Team members who are not admins can ask the account admin to remove them from the team. Once removed, their account will be closed, and they can create a new Fiverr account using the same email address.

Understanding your dashboard

Your Fiverr Pro dashboard automatically personalizes its layout based on your current activity on the platform. There are two primary views:

  • A view focused on discovering talent, for clients without active orders.
  • A view focused on order management, for clients with at least one active order.

The dashboard adapts automatically to provide the most relevant tools for your needs. It is not possible to manually switch between these two views. Regardless of which view is active, you will always find the main hiring options, such as Post a brief, at the top of the page.

FAQs

  • We use the information you provide when creating your Fiverr Pro account to show you personalized and relevant content for your business needs.
  • Team members you invite to your account can view the company name. No one else can see the data you filled out when opening the Fiverr Pro account.
  • If you are a new user, you will be asked for your business email, your name, and to choose a username and password. You will then be guided through the onboarding process.
  • You have two options:
    • Merge the accounts by keeping the same email address. Your Fiverr orders and information will transfer to your new Fiverr Pro account.
    • Keep the accounts separate by continuing the onboarding process with a different email address.
  • If you are no longer an active freelancer and have not published or sold a Gig in the last 180 days, you can upgrade to Fiverr Pro and get full access to its features.
  • If you have created or sold a Gig in the past 180 days, you will need to wait until 180 days of freelancer inactivity before upgrading. Alternatively, you can register a new Pro account with a different email address.
  • Fiverr Pro is built for clients, especially professionals and business teams looking for top-tier services.

Fiverr Pro satisfaction guarantee (Pro clients: Account settings & security)

Order with confidence

At Fiverr Pro, we trust our Pro freelancers’ ability to deliver excellent work and prioritize your satisfaction above all. Our satisfaction guarantee ensures you can collaborate with top-tier talent with total peace of mind, offering a full money-back guarantee on eligible orders on every service provided by our Managed services on Fiverr Pro.

What’s covered?

Satisfaction guarantee applies to the following Fiverr Pro services:

  • Services provided by vetted Pro freelancers.
  • Project manager and project planning services.
  • Sourcing by domain expert, including both the service payment and orders placed with recommended freelancers.

How it works

  • Cancellation timeframe: You must submit a cancellation request to Fiverr’s Customer Support Team within 14 days of order completion.
  • Refund process: The refund amount is limited to the amount of the order and approved refunds are credited to your Fiverr Pro Balance for future orders.
  • Usage rights: If an order is canceled and refunded, you may not use any part of the delivered work. The freelancer retains all rights to the canceled delivery.
  • Exclusions: Satisfaction guarantee does not apply to hourly orders.

Fiverr reserves the right to determine orders’ eligibility, to exclude instances of abuse, fraud, or any other inappropriate activity, and to withdraw, cancel, or amend this offer, without prior notice, at Fiverr’s sole discretion. All Fiverr Pro Terms of Service apply.

Best practices

  • While our support team is here to help, we recommend communicating your concerns with your freelancer first. Often, a quick revision or clarification can align the project with your expectations without needing a cancellation.
  • Since there is a 14-day window for guarantee claims, make it a habit to review all delivered files as soon as they are received. This ensures you have ample time to request adjustments or contact support if the work does not meet the agreed-upon requirements.
  • To get the most out of the satisfaction guarantee, ensure your initial brief is detailed. Having clear, documented requirements makes it easier for our team to evaluate your claim if the final delivery doesn’t match the project scope.

Summary

The Fiverr Pro satisfaction guarantee is our commitment to quality, allowing you to hire with confidence. By understanding the eligibility requirements and maintaining clear communication with your freelancers, you can ensure every project contributes to your business success.

Fiverr Pro subscription plans

Accelerate your business growth with plans built for every stage of your journey. Whether you’re a solopreneur, a small business owner, or part of a larger team, our plans are designed to elevate your experience.

Join Fiverr Pro Essential today and unlock exclusive features with no upfront cost.

Choosing the right Fiverr plan

Fiverr Pro offers tiered subscription levels to provide businesses with curated talent and advanced management tools.

  • Fiverr: Best for finding skilled freelancers for any project and budget.
  • Fiverr Pro Essential: Ideal for businesses seeking vetted freelance talent and hands-on hiring services.
  • Fiverr Pro Advanced: Tailored for compliant hiring while providing advanced management tools for teams.

Before you begin

  • Eligibility: Anyone can activate Fiverr Pro Essential by signing up to Fiverr Pro.
  • Advanced Access: Only an Admin or Billing Manager can subscribe to the Advanced plan. The subscription auto-renews monthly and can be canceled at any time.
  • Essential Maintenance: Essential access is included at no extra cost for an unlimited time.
  • Payment Restrictions: Fiverr Pro Advanced cannot be paid for using Fiverr credits, coupons, or your existing Fiverr balance.

Subscriptions functionality & behavior

- Essential Plan: Access is free for an unlimited timeframe.
- Advanced Subscription: This plan requires a monthly fee of $129 USD (plus applicable taxes) and auto-renews monthly. To upgrade to this plan, go to Account Plan, click on View plans, click on Upgrade under Advanced plan, and pay to subscribe.
- Switching to Fiverr: You can switch back to a standard Fiverr account at any time, but you must ensure you have no active orders on your team account first.
- Team Deactivation: If an admin switches from Fiverr Pro to Fiverr, all team members are deactivated.

FAQs

  • Yes, you can cancel your plan at any time. You will receive a refund for the unused portion of your current billing cycle. Your account balance and remaining plan fees will be refunded to your original payment method within 10 business days. The cancellation is immediate, and you will no longer have access to any plan’s features.
  • No, members cannot directly subscribe to the Advanced plan. Only an admin or billing manager can subscribe. However, you can request a plan from an admin by explaining why you need it. The admin will receive an email with your request.
  • You cannot switch your account from Fiverr Pro to Fiverr without the approval of your account admin. Please reach out to them to discuss your request.
  • No, your Fiverr balance cannot be used to subscribe to a plan. This must be done by an admin or billing manager. Additionally, the Fiverr Pro plans cannot be paid for with Fiverr credits or coupons.
  • No, the original payment method for the current plan cannot be changed directly. To use a different payment method, the current plan must be canceled. Then, a new plan can be created using the desired payment method.
  • Any user in your account can request an upgrade by sending a request through the platform. You, as the admin or billing manager, will receive this request via email.
  • No, you cannot purchase the Essential plan, as it is free.

A Guide to Fiverr Pro (Pro clients: Account settings & security)

Whether you’ve just kicked off your business or you’re scaling up, you can streamline all your Fiverr projects, teamwork, and finances into one productive workspace with your team. Learn how to best use Fiverr Pro.

What’s in it for your business?

With Fiverr Pro, your business gets access to advanced tools built for smarter collaboration, full visibility, and streamlined freelance management.

  • Flexible plans built for growing businesses: Choose the right subscription plan for your business. The Essential plan is free, and you can use it to hire vetted freelance talent and seamlessly execute strategic projects of any size, or choose the Advanced plan for businesses that require compliance support and benefit from advanced management tools for greater control and oversight.
  • Centralized freelancer management: Use the freelancer network space to save and share your favorite freelancers, manage hired, saved, and viewed talent in one place, collaborate on curated lists, and access insights like reviews and order history to support informed hiring decisions.
  • Seamless team collaboration and payments: Add a shared payment method for faster purchasing, maintain full transparency into team activity, track projects, align on feedback, and eliminate scattered communication.
