How to deactivate or permanently delete your account (Pro clients: Account settings & security)

Choosing the right option matters. Deactivating pauses your account and is reversible for 12 months. Permanently deleting erases your access to invoices, orders, and messages. This article helps you pick the right option and walks you through it on desktop web, iOS, and Android.

Before you begin

This applies to any Fiverr account, client or freelancer, on desktop web, iOS, or Android. The following account type restrictions apply to both deactivating and deleting:

  • Fiverr Marketplace (client or freelancer): Deactivate or delete your account yourself, on desktop web or in the app.
  • Locked out or can’t log in: Contact support.
  • Restricted account: Contact support using your account’s registered email address.
  • Fiverr Pro admin: Downgrade to Fiverr Marketplace first, then deactivate or delete.
  • Fiverr Pro member: Ask your admin to remove you from the team first.

Deactivate vs. delete: which is right for you?

Deactivate

Permanently delete

What it does

Hides your profile and pauses your account. You can log back in and reactivate anytime within 12 months.

Removes your account and its data. Cannot be reversed.

How long it takes

Immediate.

Up to 30 days after you confirm.

Reversible?

Yes, within 12 months.

No.

What happens to your reviews and messages

They stay on Fiverr while you’re deactivated.

Messages or files you’ve sent to others, and ratings and reviews you’ve published, will not be deleted if the recipient’s account is still active, as they’re part of other users’ order history. They will appear anonymized (your identifying information will be removed).

Best for

Taking a break, or being unsure if you’ll come back.

Being certain you no longer want a Fiverr account.

If you’re not sure, deactivate first. You can always come back and delete later.

How to deactivate your Fiverr account?

After 12 months of deactivation, your account is deleted automatically and cannot be reactivated.

  • To deactivate your account on desktop web, follow these steps:
    • Click your profile picture (top right) and select Account settings.
    • Click Personal information.
    • Click Deactivate account.
    • Select a reason from the dropdown.
    • Click Deactivate account.
  • To deactivate your account in the Fiverr iOS or Android app, make sure your app is on the latest version, then follow these steps:
    • Tap your profile icon.
    • Under Settings, tap Account → Account management.
    • Tap Deactivation and deletion → Deactivate account.
    • Continue to Account deactivation.
    • Select a reason from the dropdown.
    • Tap Deactivate account.
How to reactivate a deactivated account?

If you change your mind within 12 months, contact support, and we’ll reactivate your account.

How to permanently delete your Fiverr account?

Deleting your account is irreversible. Once you confirm deletion, your account cannot be reactivated, and the deletion can’t be undone. Download anything you need first, including invoices, order files, and messages, because you won’t be able to access them afterward, and they cannot be retrieved.

What to sort out before deleting?

Before you delete permanently, resolve anything that applies to your account:

  • Active orders: Cancel or complete any open orders where you’re the client or the freelancer.
  • Available balance: Withdraw your earnings, or refund any refundable balance to your payment method.
  • Outstanding debt: Pay off any debt on your account.
  • Active subscription: Cancel it yourself. Deleting your account won’t cancel it for you.
  • Non-withdrawable Fiverr Credits: Use these before you delete. Unused credits are forfeited automatically.
  • Earnings waiting clearance: Wait for these to clear before deleting.
How to delete your account?
  • To delete your account, follow these steps:
    • Click your profile picture (top right) and select Account settings.
    • Click Personal information.
    • Click Deactivate account.
    • Select a reason from the dropdown.
    • Click Deactivate account.
    • Click Contact support to request the account’s deletion.
  • To delete your account in the Fiverr iOS or Android app, make sure your app is on the latest version, then follow these steps:
    • Tap your profile icon.
    • Under Settings, tap Account → Account management.
    • Tap Deactivation and deletion → Delete account.
    • Continue to Account deletion.
    • Select a reason from the dropdown.
    • Tap Delete account.

Both the mobile app and contacting support produce the same result. The only difference is where you start.

What happens next?
  • Your account is deactivated immediately.
  • Full erasure completes within 30 days.
  • You will not receive a confirmation email when erasure finishes.
What if you can’t delete your account yourself?

Some accounts can’t use the self-service flow, for example, if your account is restricted or permanently disabled. In these cases, contact Support for help.

What happens to your data when you delete?

Once deleted, your account can’t be restored. Your personal data will be deleted from Fiverr, but some information may be retained for purposes such as record-keeping, security, fraud prevention, and complying with applicable laws.

  • Billing information, invoices, files, and deliveries: You’ll lose access to your billing information, invoices, and files associated with your account. We recommend downloading them before proceeding.
  • Messages, ratings, and reviews: Any messages or files you’ve sent to others, or ratings and reviews you’ve published, will not be deleted if the recipient’s account is still active, but will appear anonymized.
  • Opening a new account: You may not be able to open a new account using the same username, email, or phone number associated with the deleted account.

To learn more, visit Data and privacy on Fiverr and Fiverr’s Privacy Policy.

Can I reuse my email, phone, or username after deletion?

When your account is deleted, your username is anonymized and cannot be reused.

Some of your personal data may be retained for purposes such as security, fraud prevention, and complying with applicable laws. Therefore, you might not be able to reuse your email address and phone number to open a new account after deletion.

If you want to use the same email address or phone number to open a new account after deletion, make sure you don’t have another open account with these details. Even then, we can’t guarantee they will be released once your account is deleted.

FAQs

  • Up to 30 days from the moment you confirm. Your account is deactivated immediately, and full erasure completes within 30 days.
  • No. The on-screen confirmation you see right after clicking Delete is the only notification.
  • No. Deletion is final from the moment you confirm.
  • If you’re on Fiverr Pro, admins need to downgrade to Fiverr Marketplace first. Pro members need their admin to remove them from the team.
  • If your account is restricted or permanently disabled, contact support using your account’s registered email address.

Managing your account settings (Pro clients: Account settings & security)

Your account settings page is the central hub for managing your personal information, security preferences, and account status on Fiverr. This article explains what each section contains and how to update your settings.

Before you begin

To access your account settings, click your profile picture and select Account Settings.

You must verify your email address before you can edit your account settings. Restricted accounts cannot edit settings.

Personal information

This section lets you manage the following:

  • Your full name is used for internal verification only and is not displayed publicly on your profile. To update it, click Edit next to your name, enter the new name, and click Save.
  • Full name requirements:
    • Between 2 and 50 characters
    • Must start with a letter, number, or underscore
    • Only English letters, numbers, and the following characters are allowed: - _ @ +
  • Your email address is used for all Fiverr communications and notifications. To change it, follow these steps.
  • If your account has a verified phone number:
    • Go to Account Settings and enter your new email address in the Email field, then click Save.
    • Click the confirmation link sent to your new email address.
    • Enter the verification code sent to your phone.
  • If your account does not have a verified phone number:
    • Go to Account Settings and enter your new email address in the Email field, then click Save.
    • Click the confirmation link sent to your old email address and log back in to Fiverr.
    • Go to your new email account and click the second confirmation link.
  • If you do not have access to your registered phone number, contact Customer Support for help.
  • Your online status controls how you appear to other users. The default is online.
    • For freelancers: Being set to online makes you visible under the “online freelancers” filter in search results, and shows you as online to other users.
    • For clients: Being set to online shows you as online to other users.
  • To change your status, click Edit next to Online status, choose a duration from the dropdown (1 hour, 1 day, 1 week, or Forever), and click Save. To go back online, select Go Online from the same dropdown.
  • If you no longer need your account, you can deactivate it directly from Account Settings. Note that users with active orders cannot close their account.
  • Learn more in the article How to deactivate or permanently delete your account.

Account security

This section contains your security settings:

  • Change password: Update your password to keep your account secure.
  • Security question: Set up a security question to help verify your identity if you need to recover your account.
  • Two-factor authentication (2FA): Add an extra layer of security that requires a second verification step when you log in.
  • Phone verification: Verifying your phone number adds an essential layer of security to your account.
  • Connected devices: View all devices and locations that have logged in to your account. Use this to monitor for suspicious activity and log out of devices you no longer use.

For more detail on passwords, security questions, and 2FA, see the article Password, security question, and two-factor authentication.

Notifications

To view your notifications, click the bell icon at the top of the page. To change your notification preferences, go to Account Settings > Notifications, or click the Settings icon at the bottom of the notifications panel.

  • Select how you want notifications delivered: via Email or as a Push notification.
  • Check or uncheck boxes to turn specific notification types on or off.
  • Use the Real-time notifications toggle to turn on-screen updates on or off.
  • Use the Sound effects toggle to enable or disable notification sounds.
  • Click Update preferences to save your changes.

Android tip: If you experience delayed notifications on Android, go to Settings > Battery > Battery optimization, find Fiverr in the app list, and select Don’t optimize or Allow background activity. Steps may vary by device.

Personal & business information (freelancers only)

This section is required for freelancers only to comply with Digital Services Act (DSA) regulations. It allows you to verify your personal and business information. For full details, see the article Personal and business information verification.

FAQs

  • Your email address must be verified before you can edit your settings. Restricted accounts also cannot make changes to account settings.
  • Check that your name is between 2 and 50 characters, starts with a letter, number, or underscore, and only uses English letters, numbers, or the characters - _ @ +.
  • Contact Customer Support for help with email changes when you no longer have access to your registered phone.
  • For freelancers, setting yourself to offline removes you from the “online freelancers” search filter. For clients, it simply hides your online status from other users. You can set it to offline for 1 hour, 1 day, 1 week, or Forever, and switch back anytime by selecting Go Online.
  • No. You must wait until all active orders are completed or resolved before you can deactivate or delete your account.

Managing your display name (Pro clients: Account settings & security)

Your display name is the name shown publicly on your Fiverr profile. It helps others identify you on the platform and adds a personal touch to your presence. Using your real name or a consistent professional identity helps users feel confident they are working with which supports a safer, more trustworthy marketplace.

Your display name explained

Whether you’re a client looking to personalize your profile or a freelancer building a brand, your display name plays an important role in how you’re recognized on Fiverr. It appears in places like messages, reviews, and your public profile.

Note: Your display name is different from your username, which is your permanent Fiverr account ID and cannot be changed.

Edit your display name
  • Log in and switch to your selling view.
  • Click your profile picture, navigate to your profile, and click the pencil icon next to your display name.
  • Edit your name and save your changes.

Note: The names will be saved automatically and will be displayed according to standardized capitalization practices. For example, Joseph will be saved as Joseph, and David will be saved as David.

Guidelines

Here’s what you need to know when creating your display name, including requirements, best practices, and specific examples.

  • Best practice: We recommend using your first name and the initial of your last name.
  • For instance, if your name is Daniel Zee and you go by Danny, consider “Daniel Z” or “Danny Z”.

Following this best practice establishes a sense of trust even before a project begins. Choosing a display name that reflects your real identity is important for users to clearly know who they’re working with. We recommend avoiding misleading names that may affect how other users perceive you in the marketplace.

  • Your display name must:
    • Be your real name or a name that represents you (nickname).
      • Refrain from creating a display name that is far from your identity.
      • Please don’t invent a name that is irrelevant or unrelated/dissimilar to your real name.
    • Only have English letters and spaces are allowed.
    • Must be aligned with our Community Standards.
    • Not have special characters (except for periods and apostrophes) or numbers.
  • Examples:
    • Danny Z.
    • Dee 4 Designs
    • Zee’s Designs
    • ‘Z’ Designs
  • For individuals with multiple first, middle or last names:
    • Try to pick one name for your first and one letter (initial) for your last name.
    • For example: “Shirley Ann Jackson” can be “Shirley J.” or “Shirley Ann J.”
  • For individuals with long names:
    • We recommend that you use an abbreviation, a representative nickname, or an initial for your last name.
    • For example: “Shashikant” can be “Shashi”. “Christopher Blinko” can be “Christopher B”, “Christopher”, “Chris B.”, or “Chris”.
  • Your display name can’t contain:
    • The name of your service (e.g., SEO, graphic, design)
    • Professions (e.g., Designer, Developer)
    • Adjectives (e.g., expert, best)
    • Pro, level 1, level 2, top rated, Fiverr
  • Agency
    • You can choose either the name of your agency/business or the name of the person that is responsible for communication.
    • For example: “Rocket Designs” or “Sam D.”
  • Long agency/business names
    • If your name exceeds the 15-character limit, use abbreviations that are aligned with your main brand name.
  • For example: “Rocket and Beyond designs” can be “Rocket designs”

Password, security question, and two-factor authentication (Pro clients: Account settings & security)

Learn how to keep your Fiverr account secure by managing your password, setting up a security question, and using two-factor authentication (2FA).

To add, manage and remove your password, security question, or two-factor authentication please follow these steps:

  • Go to your profile image and select Account Settings.
  • Select Account Security.
  • Choose the topic you want to manage and select it from the menu.

Password

Your password is the primary layer of security for your Fiverr account. It is created during sign-up and used for all logins. Never share your password with anyone.

Customer Support will never ask for your password. It should always remain private and known only to you.

Password requirements
  • Must begin with a letter
  • Between 8 and 30 characters
  • Must contain both upper and lower case letters
  • Must contain both letters and numbers
  • Cannot be a password you have used before
How to change your password

If you are signed in and remember your current password:

  • Go to your profile image and select Account Settings.
  • Select Account Security.
  • In the Change password section, enter your current password, then your new password.
  • Click Update password.

If your account has a verified phone number, you will be prompted to enter a verification code before the change is confirmed.

  • If you have forgotten your password or signed up with a social account and do not have a password set:
    • Go to Fiverr.com and click Sign in.
    • Select Continue with username/email.
    • Click Forgot password?
    • Enter your email address and click Reset password.
    • If the email matches an account, a password reset link will be sent to that address. Click the link and follow the instructions to set a new password.
  • If your account has a verified phone number, you will need to pass phone verification before you can enter your new password.
    • Clear your browser’s cache and cookies.
    • Double-check the email address for typos.
    • Check all folders in your inbox, including spam.
    • Temporarily disable any password-saving browser extensions such as LastPass.
    • If you are locked out after too many incorrect password attempts, wait 24 hours before trying again.
    • If you do not have access to your registered email address, contact Customer Support.
  • If you signed up with a social account (such as Google or Facebook), you may need to log in through that connection rather than with an email and password.

Security question

A security question adds an extra layer of verification to your account. You may be asked to answer it when making certain changes. Make sure your answer is something only you would know.

Customer Support may also ask for your answer to verify account ownership, this will always be done through an official support request.

Security answer requirements

  • The answer is case-sensitive. Use the correct upper/lower case.

  • Do not include spaces.

  • Maximum 20 characters.

    • Go to your profile image and select Account Settings.
    • Select Account Security.
    • In the Security question section, click Set.
    • Choose your question, enter your answer, and click Submit.
    • Go to your profile image and select Account Settings.
    • Select Account Security.
    • In the Security question section, click Edit.
    • Answer your existing question.
    • Choose a new question, enter your answer, and click Submit.

  • If you cannot remember your current answer, click I forgot and follow the instructions.

Two-factor authentication (2FA)

Two-factor authentication adds an extra layer of security to your account. When you log in from a new or unrecognised device, you will be asked to verify your identity using a code in addition to your password.

This means that even if someone knows your password, they cannot access your account without the second factor.

2FA is available on web, iOS, and Android.

When 2FA is triggered

You will be asked to verify your identity when:

  • Logging in from a new or different device

  • Logging in from the same device using a new browser

  • Logging in from the same device using incognito or private mode

  • Logging in from the same device after clearing your browser cache and cookies

  • Logging in from the same device after removing it from your connected devices list

    • Go to your profile image and select Account Settings.
    • Select Account Security.
    • Scroll down to the Two-factor authentication section and click Edit.
    • Select or unselect Enable 2FA.

  • 2FA cannot be completely removed from your account. If you disable it, you will still receive notifications when a new device logs in, but you will not be asked to enter a verification code.

  • When 2FA is triggered, you can choose how to receive your verification code:

    • Email
    • SMS or WhatsApp (if your phone number is verified)
    • Notification on an already logged-in device

  • Enter the code you receive to complete the login. You will also receive an email notification whenever a new device logs into your account.

  • If you did not authorize this login, change your password immediately from your security settings.

    • Go to your profile image and select Account Settings.
    • Select Account Security.
    • Scroll down to Connected devices, click Manage.
    • Find the connected device you want to remove and click Disconnect device and log out.

FAQs

  • No. Your password is private and not visible to anyone, including Customer Support. Fiverr will never ask for your password.
  • Fiverr’s security system automatically logs users out of all devices and resets their password if it detects suspicious activity or a potential account breach. If this happens and you did not request it, contact Customer Support immediately.
  • This can happen if you cleared your browser cache or cookies, switched to a new browser, used incognito mode, or removed the device from your connected devices list. All of these actions cause Fiverr to treat your device as new.
  • You can turn off the 2FA toggle, but 2FA cannot be completely removed from your account. You will still receive login notifications when a new device signs in.
  • Try logging in from a device that is already verified. If you cannot access any of your verified devices or contact methods, reach out to Customer Support for help with account recovery.
  • For Facebook or Google, you can disconnect the link directly from those accounts. For other social platforms, contact Customer Support.

Phone verification: Secure your Fiverr account (Pro clients: Account settings & security)

Phone verification is a security measure that links the phone number to your Fiverr account. It helps enhance your account security and maintain trust within the marketplace, while meeting required security standards.

The phone number you provide is used for verification purposes only. It won’t be shared with third parties or used for marketing.

Who is it for?

  • All freelancers on Fiverr must verify their phone numbers before offering services. This step is necessary for the Gig creation process.
  • For new clients registering with an email address: You will be asked to verify your phone number when you attempt to communicate with another Fiverr user.
  • For existing users: We recommend verifying your phone number in your security settings to better protect your account.

Before you begin

Keep these few key points in mind to ensure the verification process goes smoothly:

  • The phone number you’re using is operational, valid, and reliable.
  • The verification process must be initiated via a desktop/PC and cannot be completed on a mobile device.
  • A phone number can be associated with only one Fiverr account.
  • Ensure “Do Not Disturb” is turned off.
  • Google Voice and similar VOIP services are not supported.

How to verify your phone?

Keep in mind that verification attempts are limited. You can try twice via text and once via phone, and only one phone number can be verified every 24 hours.

Follow these steps to complete phone verification on your account:

For new users:

When you create a new account and you attempt to communicate with another Fiverr user, you will be prompted to verify your phone number.

When you are prompted to verify:

  • Select your country (if not preselected) and enter your phone number.
  • Click on send code to receive a verification code via text message (SMS or WhatsApp, depending on your country).
  • Insert the received verification code.
For existing users and freelancers:

You can add or update your phone number at any time from your account settings.

  • Log in and click your Profile picture Account settings Account security.
  • Under Phone verification, click Verify Now.
  • Enter your phone number.
  • Click on verify by text to receive a verification code via text message (SMS or WhatsApp, depending on your country).
  • Insert the received verification code.
  • Add a Security question to complete verification (if it wasn’t added before).

How to change your verified phone number?

If you need to update your phone number:

  • Log in and click your Profile picture Account settings Account security.
  • Under Phone Verification, click Edit.
  • Answer your Security question.
  • Provide your old phone number (you do not need to have access to that number).
  • If you cannot remember your security question or old phone number, please contact Customer Support.
  • Enter your new number.
  • Click on verify by text to receive a verification code to your new number via text message (SMS or WhatsApp, depending on your country)
  • Insert the received verification code.

After updating your phone number, you must wait 48 hours before you can withdraw your funds again.

Limitations

If you experience issues while verifying, please keep these rules and common errors in mind:

  • You can only request a verification code up to 5 times within a 24-hour period. If you exceed this limit, you must wait 24 hours before trying again.
  • Once requested, you must use the code within the next 10 minutes of it being sent. The code will expire after this time.
  • Virtual numbers, landlines, and VoIP (Voice over IP) services are not compatible with the verification system.
  • Each phone number can only be linked to one Fiverr account. If a number is already associated with another account, even if that account is disabled, it cannot be used again.
  • Numbers should be entered without leading zeros, spaces, or special characters.
  • SMS codes can take up to 10 minutes to arrive depending on your local carrier. Requesting a new code before this time window expires may reset the process or lead to a temporary block.

Troubleshooting

If you’re having issues with the phone verification process, try the troubleshooting steps below.

If the problem persists, please contact Customer Support.

  • Ensure you are using a laptop or PC, as the process cannot be completed on a mobile device.
  • If the ‘Verify’ button is greyed out, complete the process on a computer.
  • Clear your browser’s cache and cookies.
  • Use incognito mode or a different browser.
  • If you are not receiving a verification code:
    • Check that your phone is updated and that no apps are blocking or filtering SMS/WhatsApp messages.
    • Wait 30–60 minutes before trying again, and avoid making multiple requests in a short period.
    • Restart your device to help it reconnect to the local network, or try using another internet connection.
    • Try using the same SIM card on a different phone or test your phone with another SIM card.
  • If you signed up to Fiverr via email you can log out and log back in activating the one-click login using your Google, Apple, or Facebook account. This way, no phone number is needed. Note that this does not apply to freelancer accounts.

FAQs

  • For clients, no. Your phone number is never displayed on Fiverr. For freelancers, your phone number is typically not displayed. It will only appear to an EU client viewing your profile if you have completed the Personal & Business Information verification process, as required by the EU Digital Services Act (DSA).
  • After initial verification, we may occasionally request that you verify your phone at different touchpoints to maintain account security.
  • A unique security question is required as a backup procedure, for example, if you lose your phone or change your number. This question is our only way of recovering your account if you have verification problems. Learn more in this article.
  • Please ensure that you complete the process using a computer, as the phone verification process cannot be completed on a mobile device.
  • We offer the option to receive the verification code by call or text, so you can provide a landline phone number if you do not have a mobile number.
  • This usually means you already have an existing account on Fiverr. Sign in to that account and close it, so you can use the number in the new account. If you can’t access the old account, contact Customer Support.

Pro clients: Communication & project tools

Blocking a user from messaging you (Pro clients: Communication & project tools)

If you want to stop receiving messages from a specific user on Fiverr, you can block them directly from your inbox. Blocking prevents the user from contacting you and limits their ability to place new orders or send offers. Both freelancers and clients can block users, and you can unblock anyone at any time.

What blocking does

When you block a user on Fiverr, the following restrictions apply:

  • They cannot send you messages.
  • They cannot place new orders with you (if you are a freelancer).
  • They cannot send you offers (if you are a client).

You can unblock a user at any time by going to the same blocking feature and clicking Unblock.

You can only block users you have had a prior interaction with, such as a message exchange before or after an order.

How to block a user from your inbox

- In your inbox, hover over a message from the user you want to block.
- Click the action ellipsis (...).
- Click Report.
- Select a reason for the report.
- Select the option to block the user.
- Open your inbox.
- Long-tap on a message from the user you want to block.
- Tap Report Spam.
- The user is automatically blocked.

Reporting a message & marking spam

From the same action ellipsis (…) menu, you can also:

  • Report: flags the message for a policy violation. You will be asked to select a reason. You also have the option to block the user.
  • Mark as spam: moves the message to your Spam folder.

To report any behavior that violates Fiverr’s Community Standards, see Reporting content or behavior on Fiverr.

What to do when you have an active order

If you encounter an issue with another user while an order is ongoing, contact Fiverr Customer Support immediately for assistance. Once the order is completed, you can block the user from your inbox.

FAQs

  • If you encounter an issue with another user while an order is active, contact Fiverr Customer Support immediately for assistance. You can block the user once the order is completed.
  • After you block a client, they cannot place new orders with you.
  • After you block a freelancer, they cannot send you offers.

Team comments tool

The Team comments tool is a feature available to Fiverr Pro clients that enables account members to share orders and communicate with each other directly on the order page.

Overview

  • What it is: Allows account members to leave comments for other members, open threads, and tag the members directly on the order page.
  • Why is it useful: Keeps discussions organized among the account members regarding an order. It also ensures that only account members with access to the order receive notifications, minimizing noise and speeding up collaboration.
  • Who it is for: Account members who need to share feedback or coordinate tasks with each other on active orders.

How to share an order for collaboration

Before you begin using the Team comments tool, ensure the order is shared with your team. To share the order:

  • Navigate to the order page.
  • Click the Share button in the top-right corner of the order page.
  • Select the option to share with the team.
  • Click on Share for confirmation.

Note: By default, your order is already shared with the project collaborators. To change the scope to include all members, press the Share button.

How to Create and Manage Team Comments

Below is how to create new comments and notify specific team members using mentions.

Creating a New Comment
  • Click on the Team comments button in the top right corner of the order page to start a conversation with your account members about the order.
  • Click on the Add Comments button at the bottom of the drawer.
  • Add the comments and content you wish to share with your collaborators, then click Post.
    • • Adding a new comment automatically opens a new thread.
  • Collaborators (aka Account members) can reply within the thread you started or open a new comment to begin a separate thread.
Mentioning Specific Account Members

To ensure specific account members are notified:

  • In your comment, type the “@” symbol.
  • Follow the symbol with the collaborator’s name (e.g., @Name). You can mention multiple collaborators in a single comment.
  • The collaborator(s) mentioned will receive a notification.

Limitations to the Team Comments Tool

The Team comments tool is a great way to communicate with your team directly on the order page. Nevertheless, it’s essential to keep in mind the following limitations:

  • These comments are visible only to account members and do not appear on the freelancer’s end.
  • At this time, the feature doesn’t support multiple team members communicating with the freelancer or managing the order. Only the member who placed the order can message the freelancer and handle order-related actions.

Using projects to organize orders and collaborate with your team

Projects lets you organize your orders, collaborate with team members, and track spending across multiple initiatives. As a Fiverr Pro account member, you can create different project types, invite collaborators, and manage all your orders from one place. This article covers how to create and manage projects, invite members, handle orders, and access your project deliveries.

Before you begin

  • Available to Fiverr Pro account members, including admins, billing managers, and members.
  • All account members can create new projects.

Types of projects

There are three project types. Choose the one that fits your needs.

Public project

A public project is visible to all account members. Anyone in the account can join by clicking Join project without an invitation.

  • Only the project owner can invite collaborators.
  • All new orders in the public project will be automatically shared with all project collaborators.
  • You can change the share option to all members but, once shared, you cannot unshare it.
Private project

A private project is only visible to its collaborators. Any member can create a private project, but joining requires an invitation from the project owner.

  • All new orders are automatically shared with project members.
  • Once you share a private project with account members, you cannot make it private again.

To make a project private:

  • Create your project.
  • On your project page, click the ellipsis from the upper-right corner.
  • Click Edit project details.
  • Enable the Private project toggle.
My project

My project is a personal workspace for tasks only you can see. It is created automatically for every account member and cannot be duplicated.

  • You can’t invite other members to this project as collaborators, and the default sharing option for orders in this project is only me.
  • Orders in My project are visible only to you by default.
  • You can share individual orders with your team by moving the order outside of ‘My project’ into a private or public project.

Creating a new project

All account members can create new projects.

  • Go to Projects and click Create new project.
  • Enter a project name. A description is optional.
  • Turn on the privacy toggle if you want the project to be private.
  • Click Close. You are taken to your new project page.
  • Click the Share button to add collaborators.

Inviting members

Only project owners can invite members to a project. You can send an invitation by email from the Projects dashboard or the order page.

  • New members must be associated with both the project and the Fiverr Pro account.
  • Once added to a project, a member can also invite additional collaborators.
  • Project owners and members who are associated with the project can remove other members, including the project owner.

Orders

Order sharing

How orders are shared depends on the project type.

  • Public and private projects: All new orders are automatically shared with all project collaborators.
  • My project: New orders are only visible to you by default.

You can change the sharing scope to All members at any time. Once shared, you cannot unshare an order.

Fiverr Pro orders & personal orders
  • The Orders menu shows your Fiverr Pro orders. If you migrated an existing Fiverr account to Fiverr Pro, your previous marketplace orders are also visible here, and they will also appear in your My project space by default.
  • Admins can see all orders placed by account members that are public or shared.
  • Order details include the freelancer name, extras ordered, total cost, and order status.
  • You can filter orders by project in the Orders page.

Project deliveries

All deliverables from project orders are stored in a dedicated Deliveries tab within each project.

  • Download all deliverables as a ZIP file with one click.
  • Filter deliveries by collaborator or order date.
  • Click the preview icon on any service card to open the Collaboration window to comment on the delivery file for the freelancer to view. This is only available while the order is active.

You can use the Team Comments tool on the order page to collaborate with other team members who have access to the order regarding deliveries and the project as a whole. These comments are visible only to your team; freelancers cannot see them and will not receive notifications, as this is a Fiverr Pro feature designed for internal team collaboration.

What your Projects page looks like

  • You see two tables on your Projects page.
  • Your projects: This tab will show 3 types of projects:
    • Projects you’re in: Projects in which you are a collaborator (created by you or you were added by others). This includes your personal projects.
    • Projects you can join: You can see all the public projects within your account. You may join any public project by clicking Join.
    • Completed: Projects that include past orders that you or other collaborators marked as completed.
  • Projects you can view:
    • Their own personal projects.
    • Private collaborative projects.
  • You can see project names, collaborators, total orders, and spending. You cannot access personal projects or private projects unless you are invited.
  • You see one table, Your projects, with three sections:
    • Projects you’re in: Projects where you are a collaborator, including your personal project.
    • Projects you can join: All public projects in the account.
    • Completed: Projects that you or a collaborator marked as complete.

FAQs

  • Yes. You can move orders to any project you can view, such as projects where you are a collaborator or public projects. When you move an order to My project, the sharing scope changes to Only me. You can always change the scope back to All members.
  • A collaborator is an account member you invite to join your project. Collaborators can view orders, invite additional members, and access project deliveries.
  • Yes. Project owners and members who are associated with the project can remove other collaborators, including the project owner.
  • In a private project, all new orders are automatically shared with the project’s collaborators. Only members you have invited to the project can see the orders.

Using your inbox effectively (Pro clients: Communication & project tools)

The Inbox is your central hub for sending, receiving, and managing all communication with users on Fiverr. It brings together conversations from every stage of the Fiverr experience, including inquiries, Custom Offers, and order-related messages, so you can easily stay on top of your workflow.

How to access your Inbox?

You can easily access the Inbox from your Fiverr account:

  • Click the envelope/message icon at the top-right of the page.
  • To view all your messages, click See all in Inbox.

What you can see in a conversation

Within a conversation, the right side of the screen displays useful information about the user you’re speaking with.

  • As a client, the following information is displayed about the freelancer:
    • Location
    • Seniority
    • Spoken languages and their level
    • Freelancer level
    • Response rate
    • Rating
    • Hourly rate availability: Learn more with Hourly orders for clients.
    • Order history
  • As a freelancer, the following information is displayed about the client:
    • Location
    • Seniority
    • Spoken languages and their level
  • If you’re subscribed to Seller Plus, you can also view:
    • Number of completed orders
    • Average rating given
    • Average order price
    • Order completion rate
    • Date of last order
    • Preferred service
  • If you’re just starting your journey on Fiverr, learn more with Seller Plus Kickstart: Start your freelance journey strong.
  • If your freelancer level is 1 and up, learn more with Seller Plus Standard and Premium: Advanced tools for business growth.

Managing your conversations

You can take actions on conversations and individual messages directly from your Inbox.

Conversation actions

From the All messages list, you can take the following actions on any conversation:

  • Star/Unstar (star icon): Highlight specific users, conversations, or services.
  • Apply labels (tag icon): Organize your Inbox and highlight specific conversations. You can rename a label by clicking the Edit icon next to the label, or remove it by clicking the Delete icon.

Click the ellipsis (…) for more options:

  • Mark as read/Unread: Keep track of your conversations, and answer when convenient.
  • Archive: Declutter your Inbox but keep relevant conversations on hand.
  • Delete: Remove the conversation entirely. If you delete a conversation by mistake, you can always search for the user with the All messages filter.
Message actions

Hover over any message and click the ellipsis (…) to access the following actions:

  • Reply: Reply directly to a specific message or file.
  • Edit: Correct a recently sent message within 15 minutes of sending. All active participants will see the update in real time. Supported on web only.
  • Save message: Save important messages in a separate Saved tab, located next to the Messages tab. Delivery messages can’t be saved.
  • Delete: Remove a recently sent message within 15 minutes of sending. All active participants will see the update in real time. Supported on web only.
  • Mark as spam: Flag the message as spam. Learn how to protect your account and stay safe with Avoiding spam and staying safe on Fiverr.
  • Report: Report the message to Fiverr. Learn more with Reporting content or behavior on Fiverr.
Message toolbar

At the bottom of the message area, a toolbar gives you quick access to the following options:

  • Attachment: Attach a file to your message. You can send files up to 1 GB in size.
  • Emoji: Add an emoji to your message.
  • Video call (camera): Start a Zoom-based video call. Only freelancers can initiate video calls. Some freelancers will also have the option to book a consultation. Learn more with Video calls (Zoom calls).
  • Add person: Add another participant to the conversation. Available for Team Account and Fiverr Pro users only.
  • Refer a freelancer: Recommend a freelancer you worked with before who best fits the client’s needs. Learn more with Refer fellow freelancers for client projects.
Filtering your Inbox

Use the magnifying glass icon to search for a specific conversation, or go to All messages and activate a filter. You can also create your own labels when filtering conversations.

  • All conversations: View all your inbox conversations.
  • Unread: View unread conversations.
  • Starred: View conversations you’ve marked with the star icon.
  • Archived: View conversations you’ve stored in your history.
  • Spam: View conversations flagged as spam.
  • Custom offers: View conversations where you’ve received custom offers.
  • Requests: View conversations with your requested quotes from other freelancers.
  • Follow-up: View conversations you marked with the Follow-up label.

Inbox features

The Inbox includes several features to help you communicate more effectively.

  • When you receive a message in any language, there is an option to translate it into English right from your Inbox, eliminating language barriers and delays.
  • You can customize how the Enter key functions in your Inbox. Click the up arrow to choose between starting a new line or sending the message.
  • Before an order is placed, if a client is communicating with a freelancer, the system may detect a mismatch between the client’s needs and what the freelancer is providing. The system will find a potential match on budget, availability, and time requirements that will be shared with the client.

Freelancer tools

As a freelancer, you have access to additional tools directly from your Inbox.

  • Freelancers can set up an auto-reply, a message sent automatically to a client when they reach out for the first time. Quick responses are pre-written sentences that make follow-up communication much quicker.
  • Learn more with Auto-replies & quick responses
  • Send a Custom Offer to a client to proactively offer your services in a customized way.
  • Learn more with Custom offers.

Order-specific messages

If a message is attached to an order, it will have an icon you can hover over to see the corresponding order number. Click the order number to go directly to the order page. You can also access and respond to conversations directly from the orders page.

Where to find your order messages
  • All related messages remain available in the order chat.
  • All order-related communication now appears directly in your Inbox for a more streamlined workflow.

Searching past activity

You can search and see all your past activity on Fiverr, including orders, messages, and interactions with other users.

  • Within your Inbox, click the search icon next to All messages and type the name of the user you would like to find.
  • Click the search icon; all communication with that username will appear.
  • Click any item in the results to view more information.

Messaging limits

To ensure a secure and positive experience, Fiverr sets limits on message activity to minimize excessive or unwanted communication and reduce spam.

  • If you reach your messaging limit, you’ll receive a notification and will need to wait 60 minutes before sending messages to users who are not already in your contact list.
  • During this period, you can still message existing contacts, and other users can initiate conversations with you.
  • If you continue to exceed the limit, you will receive a warning notification informing you that further violations may result in an account suspension.
  • Continued violations will lead to a permanent suspension of your account for spamming.

File management

  • Attachments that haven’t been accessed in two years are automatically archived. If you try to download an archived attachment, the download will initially fail, triggering a 12-hour restoration process. After this process is completed, you’ll be able to download the attachment. If the file remains unavailable after 12 hours, contact Customer Support.
  • Attachments are automatically deleted three years after they are sent. Fiverr cannot retrieve these files as they are permanently removed from the system. Files that are part of a delivery message may also be deleted.
  • Users can send files up to 1 GB in size. If you need to send a larger file, upload it to a cloud service such as Google Drive and share the link with the user. Ensure the user you’re sharing with has access to the file only.

Using the Inbox on the mobile app

Similar to the web or desktop experience, you’ll find the same filtering and action options on the mobile app by tapping the filter icon at the top right of your main Inbox screen or by tapping the ellipsis (…) in the upper right corner within an individual conversation.

  • From the main menu, tap the envelope icon for your Inbox.
  • Tap any conversation from the list to open it. Once inside, you can see the user’s status at the top of the screen (online or away).

Video calls (Zoom calls) (Pro clients: Communication & project tools)

Video calls on Fiverr let you connect face-to-face with a client or freelancer before or after an order is placed. Fiverr hosts all calls through Zoom and covers the associated costs. Use Zoom calls to align on project details, set clear expectations, and build a stronger working relationship.

Before you begin

  • Only freelancers can initiate Zoom video calls. Clients can request a Zoom video call from an eligible freelancer’s profile page.
  • Fiverr hosts all calls through Zoom. You do not need your own Zoom account.
  • All calls are automatically recorded and saved for 30 days, so both parties can review them.

Eligibility for freelancers

Freelancers can initiate calls from two places: an order page or an inbox conversation. Each location has different requirements.

  • Available to all freelancers.
  • How to access: Open the inbox with the user by clicking Message [username] under the user’s name.
  • To initiate a call from the inbox, you must have at least one order (any status) in the last 60 days, and meet at least one of the following requirements:
    • Be an Agency.
    • Be in a conversation with a Fiverr Pro customer.
    • Be a Level 1 freelancer with an Average Selling Price (ASP) of $50 or above.
  • The ASP on your Earnings page includes tips and extras, but the ASP used to determine Zoom eligibility does not. Therefore, you can’t use the ASP from the Earnings page to check if you’re eligible.

Agencies: scheduling a future meeting

In addition to starting an immediate call, Agencies can invite a client to schedule a meeting at a future time based on the Agency’s availability.

Using Zoom calls

Call time limits

The maximum length of a call depends on whether an order has been placed:

  • Before an order is placed: up to 30 minutes.
  • After an order is placed: up to one hour.
Transcripts

Every call is automatically recorded by Fiverr. After the call ends:

  • Both the freelancer and client can view the recording and transcript by clicking Watch Recording.
  • A dedicated Zoom page will open where both parties can download the recording.
Joining with multiple participants

If your client is a Fiverr Pro user, multiple team members can join the call. The call link is only available during the session and cannot be shared in advance.

Reporting a call

After any call, both the freelancer and the client can report the meeting to Fiverr using the Report the incident option, or directly to Customer Support if the client/freelancer acted unprofessionally regarding the order (e.g., by asking for personal or payment details).

  • In your inbox, go to the meeting card and click Report the incident.
  • In the Report a video meetup window, select the reason for your report:
    • They asked to pay/communicate outside of Fiverr.
    • They behaved/spoke inappropriately.
    • Other.
  • In the Incident occurred at field, enter the timestamp when the incident took place.
  • Click Report.
  • Click Got it to close the confirmation window.

Your report will not be shared with the other person. Fiverr’s Trust & Safety team will review your report.

How to start a Zoom call

  • Clients cannot initiate a Zoom video call. You can request one from an eligible freelancer’s profile page. If the freelancer is not eligible, you will see only the option to contact them.
    • Go to the freelancer’s profile page.
    • Click Ask to schedule an intro Zoom meeting.
    • The request appears in your inbox along with the freelancer’s response when they reply.
    • Open the inbox conversation or the order page.
    • Click the video icon in the message box.
    • A Zoom call is created. Both you and your client can join.
    • You will see a pop-up confirming that the account owner is Fiverr.
  • When a client sends a Zoom video call request from your profile:
    • Open your inbox.
    • Accept or decline the request.
    • If you accept, suggest time slots for the meeting.
    • Open the inbox conversation or the order page.
    • Click the video meeting icon in the message box.
    • Select the option to invite the client to book a future meeting.
    • The client receives an invitation to schedule a meeting based on your availability.

Video call policies

Zoom video calls are designed to provide the best possible ordering experience and ensure freelancers are aligned with their clients’ needs. Freelancers and clients are expected to act professionally at all times and to adhere to our Community Standards.

By joining a Fiverr Zoom video call, you agree to abstain from using:

  • Inappropriate language.
  • Offensive comments related to gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, disability, mental illness, physical appearance, body size, race, religion, accent, dialect, or national origin, etc.
  • Hate speech or harassment.
  • Adult content, nudity, or sexual activity, including sexual attention of any kind.
  • Threats of violence.
  • Prohibited Services on Fiverr, both offering and asking for said services.
  • Any attempts to move business off of Fiverr.

We recommend that the summary of the order’s requirements discussed on the call be written down in the order to avoid any misunderstandings that may arise.

Best practices for freelancers

  • Before creating a meeting, contact your client to confirm they are available and to account for any time zone differences.
  • After the call, send your client a written summary of the main points and any agreements you reached. This helps prevent misunderstandings.
What to avoid
  • Don’t share any sensitive personal information. This includes passwords, credit card information, SSN, national identification card numbers, or any other private information.
  • Don’t click on any links or attachments you may receive unless the context is absolutely clear. We recommend that you always use an antivirus on your own device as extra security.
  • Avoid remote access tools. Refrain from using tools such as TeamViewer and AnyDesk that allow a second party to potentially take control of your computer. If you do need to use such a tool, make sure not to allow any operations, as these may damage your computer if accessed by another party.
  • Don’t engage in any conversation that makes you feel uncomfortable. Remember, you can report your Zoom video call by clicking Report the incident or by contacting Customer Support.

FAQs

  • All freelancers can start a Zoom video call from a conversation in the order page. To start calls from an inbox conversation, you need to meet specific eligibility criteria.
  • Your Average Selling Price (ASP) for Zoom eligibility must be $50 or above if you are a Level 1 freelancer. This ASP does not include tips or extras and can’t be used to determine your eligibility.
  • Before an order is placed, the call can last up to 30 minutes. After an order is placed, the call can last up to one hour.
  • After the call, click the recording button in your inbox to go to the Zoom page. You can view the transcript and download the recording and transcript files. Recordings are available for 30 days.
  • You will receive the request in your inbox. You can accept or decline. If you accept, you then suggest time slots for the meeting.
  • Clients cannot initiate Zoom video calls directly. You can request one by clicking Ask to schedule an intro Zoom meeting on an eligible freelancer’s profile page.
  • If the freelancer is not eligible for Zoom, you will see only the option to contact them. The Zoom video call request option will not appear.
  • Yes. Every call is automatically recorded by Fiverr. You can view and download the recording and transcript for up to 30 days after the call.
  • Before an order is placed, the call can last up to 30 minutes. After an order is placed, the call can last up to one hour.
  • No. Calls are hosted by Fiverr through Zoom. When you join, you will see a pop-up confirming that the account owner is Fiverr.

Pro clients: Features & services

Background checks on Fiverr Pro

Fiverr offers background checks to help Pro clients hire with confidence. By ordering this service, organizations can verify a freelancer’s past details and criminal history to ensure they meet specific business and compliance requirements.

  • What the service provides: Facilitates international or national criminal history searches through a trusted third-party provider.
  • Why it’s useful: Provides an extra layer of security and helps organizations confirm a freelancer’s history before starting a project.
  • Who it’s for: This service is available for Fiverr Pro clients.

Before you begin

  • Eligibility: The background check process is handled by a trusted third-party, Checkr, and not directly by Fiverr. Access to and use of criminal information may be subject to country-specific restrictions.
  • Setup required: First-time users must initiate the process via a freelancer’s profile or the banner next to inbox messages.
  • Pricing: Background check pricing depends on the freelancer’s location:
    • United States: $60 (before fees and taxes)
    • Outside the United States: $110 (before fees and taxes)
  • Payment:
    • This service can’t be paid for with Fiverr credits or promo codes.
    • You must use an available payment method or your existing deposit balance.
    • Advanced plan Pro clients are eligible for one free background check a month and additional checks at a 10% discount. Check your Fiverr Pro subscription plan for more information.

How it works

The type of check performed depends on the freelancer’s location and local regulations:

  • Reviews major offense conviction records in the freelancer’s home country.
  • Scans public lists, media sources, and private records to identify criminal activity.
  • A standard search performed for all freelancers based in the United States (USA).
Understanding statuses

You can track the progress of a check directly in your dashboard.

  • Clear: The search returned no records.
  • Issues found: The report contains information that requires your manual review.

Important: You must review the report in both cases and make hiring decisions based on your own business requirements.

Step-by-step process
  • Initiate the request:
    • New users: Go to the freelancer’s profile or inbox and click the Ensure this freelancer is compliant with your business banner, then select Background check.
    • Existing users: Click Background check located under the freelancer’s profile or in your inbox.
  • Complete payment: Select your payment method. If your Fiverr balance is lower than the total cost, you will be charged the difference.
  • Wait for processing: The total process can take up to 12 days. The freelancer has 7 days to give consent, followed by up to 5 days for the review.
  • Download the report: Once you receive an email notification that the check is complete, click Get report next to the status to download the full file.

Best practices

  • Download immediately: Reports are only available for 45 days. After this period, they are permanently removed and cannot be retrieved.
  • Save local copies: Be sure to save the report to your computer before the 45-day window expires.
  • Manage access: While all team members can see the result status, only the Admin or the member who requested the check can download the full report.

FAQs

  • The entire process can take up to 12 days. This includes a 7-day window for the freelancer to provide their consent and up to 5 days for the actual review to be completed.
  • No, the service cannot be paid for with Fiverr credits or promo codes. You must use a standard payment method or your deposit balance.
  • The price of a background check depends on the freelancer’s location. Background checks for freelancers based in the United States cost $60, while checks for freelancers located outside the United States cost $110. This difference reflects variations in local regulations and the scope of checks required in different countries. All prices are listed before fees and taxes.
  • This status means the report contains information for you to review. You should download the full report and evaluate the findings against your specific business requirements to decide how to proceed.
  • The member who requested the check and account Admins are the only users who can download the full report. Other team members can see the final result status (e.g., Clear) but cannot access the detailed report.

Consultations for clients (Pro clients: Features & services)

Consultations let you book a paid video call with a freelancer before placing an order. It’s a chance to discuss your project in detail, understand exactly what the freelancer offers, and make sure you’re choosing the right person before committing to a full order. This article will outline the full consultation process.

How to find a freelancer offering consultations

Consultations are only available on profiles of eligible freelancers (Level 2, Top Rated, Pro, and Agencies). Booking is available on the Fiverr website only, not on the iOS or Android apps.

You can find freelancers who offer consultations in two ways:

  • Search filter: When browsing search results, click Service options and look for the consultation option in the dropdown.
  • Freelancer profile: Look for the Book a consultation button on a freelancer’s profile or service page, or inside the Contact me dropdown. Read the freelancer’s consultation description to understand what to expect from the call.

How to book a consultation

  • Click Book a consultation on the freelancer’s profile or service page.
  • Choose how long you’d like to meet, either 30 or 60 minutes. The freelancer sets which options are available.
  • Select a date and time. All available slots are shown in your local time.
  • Click Continue to reserve your slot.
  • Enter your payment details and complete payment. You have up to 1 hour to pay. If you miss this window, your slot will be released and you’ll need to choose a new time.

After payment is confirmed, you’ll receive a confirmation email with your consultation details. A reminder email will be sent 15–45 minutes before the call.

Filling in your consultation requirements

Once payment is complete, you’ll be asked to fill in a short requirements form so the freelancer can prepare for your call. These questions are set by Fiverr. Some fields are optional, but the more detail you provide, the more productive your consultation will be.

Include any relevant project files or context that will help the freelancer understand your needs before the meeting. Once done, click Submit requirements.

Joining the call & after the consultation

  • When it’s time for your consultation, click the Join button to start the video call. You can find it on your Orders page or in the reminder email.
  • If you need to reschedule, return to the order chat and let the freelancer know. The freelancer will need to initiate the call in that case; it won’t start automatically.
  • After the consultation you have the following options:
    • Recording: The call is recorded and available to you for 30 days via the order’s page.
    • Written summary: The freelancer will write up a summary of your consultation. This is the order’s delivery and should arrive within 10 days of the order date. If it’s not delivered within 10 days, it is considered late.
    • Review: Once the summary is delivered, you can leave a review for the freelancer, just like a regular order.

Cancellations & rescheduling

Cancellations and refunds follow the same process as any regular order. You can cancel via the Resolution Center.

  • If the freelancer misses the call: This is treated the same as an undelivered order.
  • If you miss the call: We recommend reaching out to the freelancer to reschedule before cancelling.
  • To reschedule: Cancel the original consultation and place a new one at a different time. If you arrange a new time without cancelling first, your reminder emails will still reflect the original booking date and time.

Frequently asked questions

Creating a logo with the Logo Maker for clients (Pro clients: Features & services)

The Logo Maker lets you create a professional logo for your brand without hiring a freelancer directly. We match your brand brief to logo design templates from top freelancers on Fiverr using AI, so you get design options in moments. With Logo Maker, you can build and customize your logo for free, and pay only when you find a design you want to buy and download. This gives you a quick, affordable way to get a logo you can use for your business right away.

Before you begin

  • The Logo Maker editor works on desktop only.
  • On mobile, you can browse and choose from suggested designs, but you cannot customize colors, fonts, layout, or shapes.
  • Use a desktop browser if you want to customize your logo.

Once you purchase your logo, your order isn’t eligible for cancellation, but you can still make revisions if you’d like changes. See the Revisions section to learn how.

Logo ownership & rights

When you buy a logo, you get a non-exclusive license. This gives you full commercial and non-commercial rights to use your logo, for example on merchandise, web ads, or personal projects, but you cannot resell, trademark, or claim exclusive ownership of the design.

See Fiverr’s Terms of Service for the full terms.

Because a design can stay live on the marketplace after you buy it, more than one client could technically choose the same design, though this is unlikely given the number of symbols, fonts, and color combinations available.

We recommend you customize your logo to make it more unique to your brand. Freelancers retain all ownership rights over their designs.

Some social media kit dimensions may vary slightly, depending on your logo’s layout. We automatically size the social media kit to each platform’s best practices, so you don’t have to resize your logo yourself.

Revisions

After you buy your logo, you can create additional revisions from the My Designs tab in your saved logos.

  • A revision lets you edit your logo’s colors, fonts, size, and positioning, along with your text’s size and positioning.
  • If you bought the Essential or Professional package, you can buy additional revisions for $15.
  • The Unlimited package includes unlimited free revisions.

Your freelancer does not make revisions to your Logo Maker design. Create revisions yourself in the Logo Maker editor from the My Designs tab in your saved logos.

If you want to place a new order that isn’t related to the Logo Maker, you’re welcome to contact your freelancer directly.

Fixing small mistakes in your logo

If you notice a small mistake in your logo, such as a typo, misaligned text, or a sizing issue with your logo or text, contact Customer Support for help.

Logo Maker options

When you review your selection of designs, you can:

  • Select the Heart icon to save a logo to your favorites so you can compare designs or return to them later.
  • Select Edit your brief to adjust your answers and see new designs.
  • Select Explore logo designers if you want a fully custom logo made by a freelancer instead.

How to use the Logo Maker

Logo Maker is quick and intuitive to use, with no design experience needed. In just a few steps, you go from a blank brief to a finished, ready-to-download logo. Follow these steps to create your logo:

  • Search for a service using the word “logo” (for example, logo, logo design, or company logo).
  • Select Logo Maker next to the Logo Services to open the Logo Maker panel. You can also go directly to the Logo Maker landing page and select Make Your Logo.
  • Type your business name and slogan. The slogan is optional.
  • Select up to three industries that describe your business, and add optional graphical elements you want your logo to include, such as sun, dog, or book.
  • Move the sliders to set your brand’s personality, from classic to modern, accessible to premium, and fun to serious.
  • Submit your brief to generate your personalized selection of logo designs.
  • Click a logo to review the designer’s suggested design variations.
  • Select Buy & Download to buy the design as is, or select Customize this design to open the Logo Editor and change colors, fonts, layout, and shapes.
  • Choose a branding package, Essential, Professional, or Unlimited, and complete checkout. We deliver your files immediately after checkout.

Upgrading your package

You can upgrade your branding package after you purchase your logo. To upgrade:

  • While logged into your Fiverr account, go to the Logo Maker home page.
  • Select My logos.
  • Select the My Designs tab.
  • Under Orders, select the logo you want to upgrade.

Your logo file format

We deliver your logo as several PNG files, to keep the design’s high quality and support transparent backgrounds. PNG is a higher-quality compression format than JPEG, so we do not convert your logo files to JPEG.

Every package includes your PNG logo in three forms:

  • The original logo, with its background.
  • The original logo, with a transparent background.
  • A grayscale version, with a transparent background.

Your PNG logos come in high resolution, 300 dpi. Since logo layouts vary, there are no fixed dimensions. You can check a file’s exact dimensions using your device’s image-viewing application.

Downloading & extracting your files

After you complete your order, we redirect you to the post-order page. Select Download Assets to download your .zip file. If you have more than one logo variation, use the arrow buttons to navigate between them and download each one separately.

Your order confirmation email includes a link to the post-order page. You can also reach it from the My Designs tab in your saved logos.

To open your files, extract the .zip folder on a computer. Some mobile devices cannot extract .zip files.

- Open the folder where you downloaded the .zip file, usually your Downloads folder.
- Double-click the .zip file to extract it into the same folder.
- Open the new folder to find your logo files.
- Open the folder where you downloaded the .zip file, usually your Downloads folder.
- Right-click the .zip file and select Extract all.
- Choose a destination folder and select Extract.
- Open the new folder to find your logo files.
  • If you open the .zip file directly from your browser, select Extract all from the top menu of your Downloads folder, choose a destination folder, and select Extract.

Converting your PNG file to JPEG

To convert your PNG logo to JPEG, follow the steps for your operating system.

- Open the folder where you downloaded the .zip file.
- Double-click the PNG logo to open it in Preview.
- From the File menu, select Export.
- Select JPEG as the file format.
- Name your file and choose a folder to save it in.
- Open the folder where you downloaded the .zip file.
- Right-click the file and select Open with.
- Open the file with Paint.
- From the File menu, select Save as.
- Select JPEG as the file format.
- Name your file and choose a folder to save it in.
