Fiverr Enterprise (Pro clients: Features & services)

Fiverr Enterprise is a Freelance Management System (FMS) that enables businesses to source, hire, onboard, manage, and pay their external workforce more effectively while ensuring legal and tax compliance. Unlike a typical freelance marketplace, Fiverr Enterprise is a system that helps businesses find and manage freelance talent within their own ecosystem. While Fiverr Pro focuses on individual client connections, Fiverr Enterprise acts as a matchmaker, connecting freelancers with relevant job opportunities within large organizations.

Overview

Fiverr Enterprise provides a centralized solution for high-level management of external workforces.

Why it’s useful:

  • Streamlined management: Centralizes engagements, work descriptions, and payment tracking.
  • Compliance: Ensures all engagements meet legal and tax compliance requirements.
  • Project variety: Handles hourly, fixed, or retainer-based projects, with a specific focus on long-term engagements.

Who it’s for:

  • Clients: Typically big tech companies and digital agencies.

How it works for Freelancers

The process is designed to be automated and non-intrusive:

  • Invitation: You will receive an email asking if you are interested in offering your freelance talent on Fiverr Enterprise.
  • Profile activation: You will receive a notification via email when your profile becomes visible to potential clients.
  • Job offers: If a client wishes to use your services, you will be notified of the job offer via email.
  • Decision: You can review the work descriptions and choose to accept or decline the offer.

Note: You are under no obligation to accept work. Declining an offer will not affect your Fiverr Pro metrics.

How it works for Clients

To be a part of Fiverr Enterprise, visit the Fiverr Enterprise page and book a demo with the team.

FAQs

  • Fiverr Enterprise uses public information from your Fiverr Pro profile, including your profile image, home country, education, skills, and display name.
  • It creates a profile visible to all Fiverr Enterprise clients, allowing them to reach out to you for job offers and potential collaborations. This includes your username and email address.
  • The platform features hourly, fixed, or retainer-based projects, focusing primarily on long-term work. Clients are generally digital agencies and big tech companies.
  • All engagements are managed via the Fiverr Enterprise solution, where you can accept or decline offers and track your earnings.

How can I purchase & manage Google Workspace on Fiverr? (Pro clients: Features & services)

What is Google Workspace?

Google Workspace is a cloud-based suite for professional communication, collaboration, and productivity.

It includes:

  • Gmail, Calendar, Meet & Chat for communication
  • Google Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides & Forms for creation and storage
  • Admin controls, security tools, and AI-powered features

When you purchase through Fiverr, you can:

  • Manage subscriptions in one place
  • Access exclusive discounts (50% off for new users, 20% off transfers)
  • Enjoy simplified setup and management

What plans are available on Fiverr?

Fiverr offers two subscription plans: Business Starter and Business Premium.

Both plans include:

  • Unlimited devices, cross-platform compatibility
  • Smart Canvas, real-time collaboration, advanced scheduling
  • Gemini AI Premium plan
  • Security: SSO, 2-step verification, password monitoring, spam/virus/phishing protection
  • Migration tools from free @gmail.com to your domain email
Additional benefits per package:
  • 30GB of pooled storage.
    • 2TB of pooled storage
    • Personalized email campaigns
    • Meeting recordings
    • Shared drives

New to Google Workspace? You can receive 50% off your first subscription by visiting: Fiverr Google Workspace and clicking “Claim your Discount.”

If you already have an active GWS subscription, you can transfer it to Fiverr and receive a 20% discount on your subscription payments. Click here.

What should I know before I purchase?

  • You must own the domain you register with.
  • If you already have Workspace, you can’t buy a new one for the same domain; You must modify the existing subscription instead.
  • Annual commitment plans can’t be downgraded or partially canceled.
  • Taxes are applied at checkout based on billing details.
  • Purchases are non-refundable.

How do I purchase Google Workspace on Fiverr?

  • Go to the Google Workspace page on Fiverr.
  • On the product card, enter your product key from a freelancer, or click “Skip.”
  • Choose your plan: Business Starter or Business Premium.
  • Enter your domain: Use an existing domain, or buy a new domain from the dropdown list.
  • Complete contact and business info.
  • Review your order:
    • Set number of seats
    • View discounts
    • Add payment details
    • Enable or disable auto-renewal
  • Agree to the terms and click “Confirm.”

What happens after I purchase?

After completing your order, you’ll receive confirmation emails from both Fiverr and Google.

- Sign in to the Google admin console within 24 hours using the activation link (the link expires after 24 hours). If the link expires, contact Fiverr support.
- Accept the Google product agreement.
- Activate your license.
- You’ll receive a purchase receipt and invoice.
- Once your account is verified, you’ll have full access to Gmail and all other Google Workspace tools.

How do I manage my Workspace subscription on Fiverr?

In the Fiverr admin console, you can:

  • Create users and set access rights
  • Add secondary domains
  • Personalize the dashboard
  • Adjust settings and billing

Tip: Adding seats is done in the GWS subscription console, not in your Google admin console.

Common actions

- Log in to your [GWS Subscription Console](http://fiverr-manage.gsubscriptions.com/) using the same email address and password as your Google Workspace account. If the login field is pre-filled with a domain name, delete it before entering your full email address.
- Access the 'Subscriptions' tab.
- Select the Subscription you want to modify by clicking on the "Subscription name" to open it.
- Select "Edit" on the subscription.
- Choose to apply changes now or on a custom date.
- Adjust the seat count and click "Save."
- Accept the Terms & Conditions.
- Scroll to the bottom of your subscription page (if upgrades are available).
- Click "Upgrade."
- Complete the form and click "Save."
- In the subscription view, click "Edit."
- Go to the 'Details' tab and check or uncheck auto-renewal.
- Save changes immediately or set a custom date.
- Sign in to the Google admin console.
- Go to account > Domains > Manage domain.
- Add and verify your new domain.
- Update MX records to activate Gmail.
- Sign in to the Google admin console using a super administrator account. If you’re not signed in as a super administrator, you won’t be able to complete this process.
- Go to Menu > Account > Reseller management. If you don’t see this option, open the [reseller management page](https://admin.google.com/ac/resellermanagement) directly.
- Go to 'Subscriptions from resellers' or 'Subscriptions from Google', find the subscription that you want to transfer, and click "Transfer."
- Enter C016bjjss and click "Continue."
- For each product group that you want to transfer, select "Transfer to" reseller name, and click "Continue."
- Check the box to agree to theTerms and Conditions and click "Generate transfer authorization."
- Click "Close."
- To complete the transfer, email support@fiverr.com and provide your domain or Cloud ID associated with your Google Workspace account.

Common issues and best practices

  • Can’t log in for the first time? Contact Fiverr support for a new temporary password.
  • Domain verification problems? Contact your domain host for DNS help.
  • Enable two-step verification for better security.
  • Use migration tools to move Gmail emails, contacts, and calendars.

FAQs

Managing your freelance network (Pro clients: Features & services)

The freelance network is a feature that helps you manage and rehire freelancers and agencies you have worked with in the past. Use it to access past hires and organize freelancers and services into lists, all in one place.

How the freelance network works

The freelance network gives you three core capabilities:

  • Centralization: Access and organize freelancers or agencies you have hired, saved, or viewed, all in one place.
  • Organized lists: Categorize freelancers using lists for efficient management. You and your team can collaboratively create a shortlist of freelancers.
  • Team insights: For Pro clients, view your team’s insights on each freelancer, including reviews and orders.

Key benefits include:

  • Increased efficiency: Easily access and maintain a network of freelancers for future projects.
  • Reduced time-to-hire: Quickly find and hire trusted freelancers with a proven track record.
  • Cross-team transparency: For Pro clients, gain insights into your company’s hires, projects, and collaborations.

How to access the freelance network

To access the freelance network, go to either:

  • Your homepage, under Freelance network.
  • The heart icon in the top-right corner of the page.
  • Your avatar drop-down menu, and select the appropriate Freelance network.

Page overview

The page features a left navigation panel that controls the content displayed. The panel includes two sections:

Based on your activity:

  • All hires: Displays freelancers previously hired by the organization.
  • Recently viewed: Displays freelancers or services you have recently viewed. Fiverr Pro clients can view freelancers recently viewed by their team members as well.

Your lists: Displays all lists you have access to. For Pro clients, there are two types of lists:

  • Shareable lists: Visible and editable by everyone on the account.
  • Private lists: Visible only to the creator.

How to view your network

The All hires tab is where you can see your past freelancer collaborations. Each freelancer card shows a summary of your collaboration, including the number of orders, services provided, reviews, and more.

To rehire a freelancer, click the Contact button on their card.

You can use the following filters to narrow down the list:

  • Hired more than once: View freelancers who have worked with you more than once.
  • Provided service: View freelancers that provided a selected service in at least one order.
  • Hired by: For Pro team accounts, view freelancers hired by a selected team member. For individual accounts, this filter appears as Hired by you.

To view in-depth information and access previous work, click on a freelancer’s card to open the Activity panel:

  • Collaboration summary: Get a deeper look at their work.
  • Reviews: Read the feedback you provided.
  • Activity timeline: View the orders the freelancer has worked on, and click on delivered work files to preview or download them.
  • Contact: Send a direct message to the freelancer.

For Pro clients, the All hires view provides a broader picture of your team’s freelancer collaborations. In addition to your own hires, you can see freelancers hired by other team members, the projects and services they worked on, and feedback from your team, giving you better context on each freelancer’s experience and overall collaboration with your organization.

Using lists for potential hires

Lists are part of the freelance network page. Lists allow you to organize freelancers and services you are interested in, making them easy to find for future projects. When you save a service, the freelancer’s profile will appear in your list with the saved service nested within their card.

How to create a list
  • Click the + icon on the left side of the freelance network page.
  • Enter a list name.

For Pro clients: Select whether it is a private list (visible only to you) or a shared list (visible to the entire account).

How to save freelancers to a list
  • From the Gig results: Click the heart icon on the Gig, then choose an existing list or create a new one with the + icon.
  • From the freelancer profile: Click the heart icon in the top-right corner of the freelancer profile, then choose an existing list or create a new one with the + icon.

When viewing saved items in a list:

  • Saved services: When you save a service, it is displayed under the freelancer who provides it rather than as a separate service card.
  • Multiple services from the same freelancer: If you save more than one service from the same freelancer, the freelancer appears only once in the list, with the saved services grouped under their card.
How to access your lists
  • From the header: Select the heart icon to access a specific list from the dropdown.
  • From the freelance network page: Click a list name in the left panel to see all saved freelancers, including your team’s shared lists.
How to manage lists

Edit list:

  • From the freelance network page, click on the list you wish to update on the left.
  • Click on the three dots in the top-right corner and select Edit list, where you can rename the list, add a description to provide more context, or, for Pro clients, set the list as private to restrict access to yourself only.

Delete list: Remove lists you no longer need.

Share list: Share a list with others by clicking the Share icon in the top-right corner of the list. You can copy the list link or share it through the available social platforms.

  • If you previously hired the freelancer, they will remain visible in your network with a notice stating that they are no longer providing services on Fiverr.

Using Logo Maker as a freelancer (Pro clients: Features & services)

Logo Maker lets clients purchase a ready-to-use logo built from a design you create, then edit it themselves with no extra work from you. Once a client buys one of your designs, we give them tools to customize it, and you continue earning from that design over time.

Before you begin

This article is for freelancers who already have a Logo Maker account. Logo Maker is currently closed to new freelancers.

There are two levels of access within Logo Maker:

  • All current Logo Maker freelancers can edit, track, and earn from their published designs.
  • Only a limited number of eligible freelancers can add new logos at this time. If you become eligible, we’ll notify you.

If we reopen the program to new freelancers, or expand upload access, we’ll let you know.

To access Logo Maker, log in, switch to selling, and go to My Business > Logo Maker.

How Logo Maker works

Clients can purchase a logo without any extra effort from you. After a client buys your design, they can:

  • Enter their brand name, slogan, design, and branding preferences into Logo Maker’s Brief Wizard. They see a personalized, real-time catalog of logos that best match their brand name and slogan.
  • Edit the logo and adjust typography, colors, and layout using the Editor tool.

There is no communication between you and the client for Logo Maker orders. You cannot make revisions, and you do not influence the client’s design choices.

Customizations & packages

If a client wants specific customization from you, they can order a custom service directly from you.

After a client purchases a logo, they can upgrade the logo package or buy additional logo variations. This generates more revenue for you, since 20% of every additional order goes to you, with no extra effort required.

  • If a client purchased the basic package, they can upgrade to the professional package for $30 USD within the first 72 hours, or for $45 USD after that. Clients can also purchase additional logo variations, such as font, layout, and color, for $15 USD per variation.

Logo statuses

Each logo design you publish has a status:

  • Pending: the logo stays in pending mode for up to four days before it turns active.
  • Draft: the design is unfinished. Finalize publishing to change its status to active.
  • Paused: the design is published but not offered for sale, so clients cannot see it. Your design switches to paused if you reach your limit of active logos.
  • Active: the design is published and offered for sale.

We occasionally review accounts that reach their limit of active logos and notify you if you’re eligible to increase that limit; however, you can’t currently request an increase on your own.

Tracking your performance with the Logo Maker dashboard

The Logo Maker dashboard gives you general and in-depth information about your logos, statistics, and ways to improve as a freelancer.

To access the dashboard, go to My Business > Logo Maker, then select the Overview, My logos, or Insights tab.

  • In the Overview tab, you can view:
    • Your metrics bar (earnings this month, total earnings, completed orders, clicks, favorites, and impressions)
    • Your performance chart, filterable by earnings, orders, clicks, impressions, and time range
    • Your top logos, filterable by impressions, clicks, orders, and earnings
    • Your recent activity, including recent sales and designs added to favorites
    • Your current earnings share and how close you are to the next tier
    • News and tips
  • At the top of the My logos tab, you can view the number of logos in each status: active, pending, paused, drafts, denied, and total.
  • Below the status overview, you can view the metrics table for a detailed breakdown of each logo design’s performance. You can:
    • Switch between a gallery or list display
    • Search and filter by logo name, industry, or status
    • Click a logo to open a side panel showing its performance data, variations, metadata, and recent orders
  • If a client has already purchased a design, you cannot delete it.
  • The metrics table displays detailed stats of each individual logo design:
    • Status: whether the design is pending, draft, paused, or active.
    • Earnings: the total amount you’ve earned from that design so far.
    • Click rate (CR): how often clients who see the design go on to click it.
    • Orders: the number of times that design has been purchased.
    • Clicks: how many times a client clicked the design.
    • Favorites: how many times clients added the design to their favorites.
    • Impressions: how many times the design was shown to a client.
    • Last order: the date of the design’s most recent order.
    • Actions: the options available for that design, including pausing it, sharing it, editing it, viewing it as a client would see it, or deleting it.
  • The Insights tab shows Logo Maker trends, including top searched industries, top converting industries, top picks by industry and tag, and industries with low logo supply.

The earliest date you can view data in the dashboard is January 1, 2022. Activity and metrics from before this date, including “Total” and “all time” data, are not shown.

Earnings tier model

Your earnings share, the percentage of each sale you keep, is based on your total Logo Maker sales over the last 12 months. The higher your sales, the higher your earnings share.

  • Entry-level freelancers start at a 20% earnings share.
  • We recalculate your tier on the first day of every month.
  • Your earnings share applies as a fixed percentage regardless of which package a client purchased.

The tier-based earnings model took effect on March 1, 2023. It applies to Logo Maker packages (Essential, Professional, and Unlimited), package upgrades, and new paid variations ($15 USD each). It does not apply to other products or services you sell outside Logo Maker.

How to use the Logo Maker dashboard

  • Go to My Business.
  • Select Logo Maker.
  • Choose the Overview, My logos, or Insights tab.
  • Check your current earnings tier and share it under the Overview tab.

Best practices for creating logos

This section is relevant for those freelancers who can upload new logos to Logo Maker.

  • Keep logos simple: favor minimal, focused designs over complex ones, and center each logo around one or two emotions.
  • Design for versatility: use single-letter monograms and leave room for both short and long business names.
  • Avoid duplicate uploads: add real variations in color, layout, or font instead of uploading near-identical designs.
  • Build out variations: aim for four to five varied typography, color, and layout options per logo.
  • Cover different layouts: design for both vertical and horizontal formats, such as social media, business cards, and merchandise.
  • Tag accurately: use simple, element-specific tags based on what’s visually in the logo.
  • Pick a specific industry: choose the most specific sub-industry rather than a broad category.
  • Use color palettes thoughtfully: vary hue, saturation, and value across variations, and avoid gradients.
  • Set up typography and layers first: layering is fixed (text, symbol, shape), so arrange and crop your symbol before uploading.
  • Keep your active lineup strong: swap out lower-performing designs for higher-quality ones over time.

FAQs

  • The new tier-based earnings model took effect on March 1, 2023, and it applies to all Logo Maker packages and new paid variations; however, it doesn’t apply to orders outside of Logo Maker.
  • We reevaluate your earnings tier placement on the first day of each month.
  • The monthly calculation works the same way, with fewer months to review. We reevaluate your placement on the first day of each month, starting from the month you began selling logos. Once you’ve sold for 12 or more months, we recalculate your placement based on your total sales in the last 12 months.
  • Yes. If your sales decrease, we may downgrade your earnings tier, since we calculate it based on your last 12 months of sales.
  • Uploading a wider variety of high-quality logos, where you’re eligible to do so, increases your chances of matching more clients, which can raise your income potential.
  • Yes. We determine your upload capacity based on your performance and reevaluate it monthly.
  • You can view your tier on the Overview tab of your Logo Maker dashboard.
  • Yes, it applies to logo packages (Essential, Professional, and Unlimited), package upgrades, and new paid variations ($15 USD each). It does not apply to other products or services you sell outside Logo Maker.
  • We recommend four to five variations that differ in color, layout, or typography. This gives clients more options and increases your chances of a sale.
  • The same symbol in a different color, rotation, or font counts as a variation, not a new design. If you reuse a design, add or remove enough elements to make it distinct before publishing it separately.
  • Pick the most specific sub-industry that fits your design, and tag it based on what’s visually in the logo rather than abstract concepts or industry names.
  • The program is currently closed to new freelancers. Only freelancers who joined before can use Logo Maker. If we start accepting new freelancers, we will let you know.
  • Currently, only a limited number of freelancers can upload new logos. If this changes, we will let you know.

Using the Fiverr mobile app (Pro clients: Features & services)

The Fiverr mobile app lets you manage your Fiverr account from anywhere. Whether you are a client searching for services or a freelancer tracking orders and earnings, the app gives you access to the most important Fiverr features from your phone.

Before you begin

The app is available on iOS and Android devices. Some features are only available on the PC, including starting the process to become a freelancer, and changing your email address.

Navigating the app

The Fiverr mobile app has five main menus. The content in each menu changes based on whether you are using a client or freelancer account:

  • Inbox
  • Search
  • Manage orders
  • Account

Home

Functionality for clients and freelancers
  • The Home screen gives clients quick access to services, popular categories, and Fiverr updates.
    • Services search: Search for services on Fiverr, select Gigs, and place orders.
    • Most popular services: Browse popular services by category and save categories as your interests in the Interests tab.
    • What’s new on Fiverr: Read recent news and posts from Fiverr.
    • Recently viewed & more: Return to past Gigs and refer friends to Fiverr through Fiverr’s Refer a Friend program.
  • The Home screen gives freelancers a summary of their performance and activity.
    • Level and Success Score: View information about your current level and Success Score.
    • Orders: See the total number of orders you have received.
    • Unique clients: See how many unique clients you have worked with on the platform.
    • Total lifetime earnings: View the total earnings you have made on Fiverr.
    • New briefs: See all new briefs you have matched with and can respond to.
    • Earnings: View detailed information about your earnings.
    • To-dos: See a list of action items, including:
      • Number of unread messages
      • Number of upcoming deliveries
      • Number of revision requests
      • Number of new orders
    • My Gigs: View analytics for your Gigs over the last seven days, including:
      • Number of impressions
      • Clicks
      • Conversion percentage
  • Learn more about briefs and Success Score with the following articles:

Inbox

The Inbox works the same way for both clients and freelancers. You can view all your conversations, reply to messages, and filter your inbox.

Search

Search is available to both clients and freelancers, allowing you to find services and browse Gigs. If you are a freelancer and use the Search menu, you will be automatically switched to the client profile.

Manage orders

The Manage orders menu is available to both clients and freelancers. From here you can:

The following features are available to both clients and freelancers:

Using worker classification audits

Worker classification audits help you ensure your freelancers are correctly classified as independent contractors, protecting your business from potential legal and financial risks. By identifying compliance concerns early, you can stay aligned with local labor regulations and maintain healthy professional relationships.

Overview

A worker classification audit is a specialized service provided through Fiverr to help clients clarify the nature of their working relationship with freelancers.

  • What it does: Uses a third-party expert, Greenlight, to evaluate if a freelancer is an independent contractor or should be classified as an employee.
  • Why it’s useful: Reduces the possibility of misclassification, which can result in significant legal consequences and financial liabilities.
  • Who it’s for: This service is available for Fiverr Pro clients who have worked with freelancers for a long period.

Before you begin

  • Eligibility: Audits only apply to self-employed individuals (freelancers) and can be requested only by Pro clients.
  • Order requirement: You must have purchased and completed at least one order with the freelancer being audited, either for a specific order or for hourly services.
  • Third-party process: The audit is conducted by Greenlight, a trusted third-party, and not directly by Fiverr.
  • Platform limitations: The service cannot be paid for using Fiverr credits or promo codes.

How it works

The audit process is designed to be thorough and transparent, typically taking up to 16 days to complete.

Audit process & triggers
  • Questionnaire: You will answer a screening questionnaire regarding daily management, worker substitution, exclusivity, and internal staff roles.
  • Freelancer authorization: The freelancer has 14 days to authorize the audit request.
  • Review: Once authorized, the review takes up to 2 days.
Understanding results

Once completed, you will receive an email with one of two statuses:

  • Low risk: The freelancer is correctly classified as an independent contractor.
  • High risk: The freelancer could be classified as an employee, posing legal implications for your company.
Payments & refunds
  • Cost: Fees depend on your specific subscription plan.
  • Discounts: Pro clients subscribed to the Advanced plan are eligible for a 10% discount.
  • Refund policy: You can request a refund within 24 hours of your initial request. After 24 hours, refunds are no longer processed.

How to request an audit

  • Locate the banner:
    • First-time clients: Go to the freelancer’s profile or your inbox and click the Ensure this freelancer is compliant with your business banner.
    • Existing clients: Click Worker classification located under the freelancer profile or in your inbox.
  • Select service: Click Worker classification.
  • Complete screening: Answer all required questions in the questionnaire.
  • Make a payment: Select an available payment method or use your deposit balance to complete the request.
  • Track progress: Monitor the audit status in your dashboard until you receive the final email notification.

Best practices for addressing risks

If an audit reveals a high-risk status, consider the following steps to protect your business:

  • Consult experts: Work with employment law or HR professionals to evaluate if you need to reclassify the worker or utilize Employer of Record (EOR) services.
  • Update contracts: Ensure contracts reflect the independent nature of the relationship by limiting day-to-day oversight and redefining the scope of work.
  • Train your team: Educate your staff on managing independent contractors properly to prevent future compliance issues.

FAQs

  • The process can take up to 16 days. This includes a 14-day window for the freelancer to authorize the request and a 2-day period for the third-party expert to conduct the review.
  • The freelancer has 14 days to respond to the request. If they do not respond to the audit within this timeframe, the request will expire.
  • Refunds are only available within the first 24 hours of submitting your request. After this 24-hour window, the payment is non-refundable.
  • The audit is conducted by Greenlight, a third-party compliance expert. Greenlight bears sole responsibility for the results, and Fiverr is not liable for the outcome of the audit.
  • Not necessarily, but it indicates a high potential for misclassification. You should consult with legal or HR professionals to determine the best course of action, such as adjusting the contract or using an Employer of Record (EOR) service.

Important: Fiverr does not provide specific legal advice regarding your engagement with freelancers. The decision to engage or decline to engage any freelancer remains at your exclusive discretion.

Pro clients: Orders

The complete guide to your Fiverr order: Statuses and process (Pro clients: Orders)

Understanding your order’s status helps you keep track of where a project stands, from the moment it’s placed until it’s officially completed. By checking the status through the order page, you can ensure timely delivery and clear communication with your freelancer.

Order process overview

After you place an order, you need to submit the requirements to the freelancer. Once you submit the requirements, the order process starts, and the freelancer is expected to deliver the work within the specified timeframe.

Once the freelancer delivers, review the delivery and accept it to complete the order. If you have feedback and require changes, you can reject the delivery and request revisions. The freelancer will then re-deliver the revised work.

Before an order is delivered

Before the freelancer sends their first delivery, your order will have one of two statuses:

  • To begin your order, submit the necessary requirements. You’ll see an orange banner on the order page prompting you to reply. The status will show Requirements Needed until you submit.
  • You have 14 days to submit the requirements before the order gets automatically canceled. The orange banner will show the due date for submitting the requirements.
  • If the order gets canceled, you will be refunded to your Fiverr balance.
  • Note: If the freelancer already has enough information to get started, they can skip the requirements step. The status will then move to In Progress automatically.
  • Once you provide the requirements, the order moves to In Progress status. The freelancer is expected to deliver within the specified timeframe, which is visible on the order page.

Order Timeline

Some freelancers use Order Timeline to share a step-by-step plan of their work directly on the order page. When your freelancer sets up a timeline, you can see exactly where the project stands at any point during the order.

What you’ll see

If your freelancer has set up an Order Timeline, you’ll find it in two places on the order page:

  • The timeline section on the right side of the order page, showing all steps and their target dates at a glance.
  • The Activity tab, where each step appears as it’s created or updated.

Each step has a title, description, and target date. As the freelancer progresses through their work, they mark steps as done. The timeline gives you real-time visibility into what’s been completed and what’s coming next.

If a step is delayed

If a step passes its target date without being marked as done, it will be flagged as delayed. You can click Ask for an update next to the delayed step to request a progress update from your freelancer.

Mobile

Order Timeline is view-only on the Fiverr mobile app. You can see the steps but cannot interact with them from mobile.

Reviewing a draft

Before the freelancer sends their final delivery, they may share a draft, a work-in-progress preview that gives you an early look at the project. This is an opportunity to provide feedback and make sure you’re both aligned before the final submission.

When a freelancer shares a draft, you’ll receive a notification and an email. Click View Draft in the email to go directly to the draft.

You can reply to the draft from the order page or your inbox. Clicking Reply from the order page will take you to your inbox. A message will clearly indicate that what you’re viewing is a draft, not the final delivery.

Tip: Drafts don’t change the order status. Files and images shared as a draft are protected with a Fiverr watermark.

After an order has been delivered

Once the freelancer submits their work, the order status updates to Delivered. Their submission is now ready for your review. You have three days to take one of the following actions:

  • Accept the delivery
  • Request revisions
  • Extend the review timeframe

Note: If no action is taken within three days of delivery, the system will automatically complete the order. For Gigs that require shipping, auto-completion takes 14 days.

Accepting the delivery
  • Log in and click Orders.
  • Click on the order title to open the order page.
  • Go to the Delivery tab or scroll down to find the delivery message.
  • Answer the question: Are you pleased with the delivery, and are you ready to accept it?
  • Click Yes to approve the final delivery.
  • Click No, I’m not ready yet if you need a revision or more time to review.
Requesting revisions

If you’re not satisfied with the delivery, click No, I’m not ready yet on the order page. The order status will change to In Revision, indicating you’ve rejected the delivery and the freelancer needs to resubmit based on your feedback.

Once the freelancer resubmits, the status will change from In Revision back to In Progress, and you’ll receive a new delivery to review.

Tip: Communicate the changes you need as clearly as possible. This helps the freelancer understand exactly what’s required and deliver a version that meets your expectations.

Extending the review timeframe

If you need more time to review the delivery, click No, I’m not ready yet and select I need more time to review. You can extend the review period by up to 5 days. The order will remain in Delivered status, and the freelancer won’t need to re-deliver. This is not a revision request.

You can extend the review period more than once. If the delivery isn’t accepted, rejected, or extended further, the system will automatically complete the order once the updated timeframe ends.

Orders requiring attention

If an order runs into issues or a dispute, it will be reflected in the order status. The Fiverr Resolution Center is designed to help you address and resolve disputes independently.

  • The Resolution Center was used to request one of the following: a mutual cancellation, a delivery date extension (submitted by the freelancer), or an update request (submitted by you).
  • The freelancer missed the expected delivery time. You are entitled to cancel your order if there’s no further response from the freelancer.
  • 24 hours have passed since the order was marked as Late. You can cancel the order immediately through the Resolution Center.
  • Your freelancer has 30 days to submit a delivery from the day you placed an order if it’s very late; otherwise, the order will be automatically canceled, and you will be refunded to your Fiverr balance.
  • On the 15th day of this timeframe, you will receive an email with the number of days left.

Learn more with Using the Resolution Center.

A completed order

An order is marked as Complete once the freelancer delivers the work and you accept it. If no action is taken within three days of delivery, the system will automatically complete the order. Once an order is completed, its status cannot be changed or canceled via the Resolution Center.

After accepting the delivery, you can also:

  • Leave a review for the freelancer and the work they did. Learn more with Leaving and managing reviews on Fiverr.
  • Leave a tip as a gesture of appreciation. Visit How do I tip my freelancer? article to learn more.

Viewing & managing orders

You can view and manage your orders on both web and mobile through the Manage orders page. Use the tabs at the top to filter orders by status:

  • ​
    • Active: Active orders where the freelancer works on the delivery.
    • Missing details: Orders where you need to submit the requirements for the freelancer to start the order.
    • Delivered: Delivered orders waiting for you to accept the delivery, or ask for a revision.
    • Completed: Orders that have been delivered by the freelancer and accepted by you.
    • Cancelled: All canceled orders, either by Customer Support or mutually canceled orders.
    • All: Orders in all statuses.
  • ​
    • Updates: Orders with new messages or notifications.
    • Waiting for details: Orders where you need to submit the requirements to the freelancer to start the order.
    • Late deliveries: Late or Very Late orders where the freelancer didn’t deliver on time.
    • Revision requested: Orders where you declined delivery and requested revisions.
    • Completed: Orders that have been delivered by the freelancer and accepted by you.
    • Waiting for rating: Orders where you need to review the delivery.
    • Cancelled: All canceled orders, either by Customer Support or mutually canceled orders.

Extracting delivered files

Delivered files are packaged in a .zip file, which consolidates all deliverables into a single organized folder.

Note: Some mobile devices can’t open .zip files. Please use a computer to unzip them.

- Open the folder where you downloaded the .zip file (typically your Downloads folder).
- Double-click the .zip file. It will automatically decompress into the same folder.
- Open the folder where you downloaded the .zip file (usually your Downloads folder).
- Right-click the .zip file.
- From the menu, select Extract all.
- Select a destination folder and click Extract.

Best practices

  • Review your delivery promptly. The order auto-completes three days after delivery if no action is taken.
  • Use the draft feature to align with your freelancer early, and share feedback before the final delivery to avoid unnecessary revisions.
  • Be specific when requesting revisions. Clear, detailed feedback helps the freelancer deliver exactly what you need.
  • Extend the review period if you need more time, rather than letting the order auto-complete.
  • Communicate through the order page to keep a clear record of all discussions and deliveries.

FAQs

  • The system will automatically complete the order three days after delivery. For Gigs that require shipping, auto-completion takes 14 days.
  • If a step has passed its target date, you’ll see it flagged as delayed on the order page. Click Ask for an update next to the delayed step to request a progress update from your freelancer.
  • No. Once an order is marked as Complete, its status cannot be changed or canceled via the Resolution Center.
  • A draft is a work-in-progress preview shared by the freelancer before the final delivery. It gives you an early look at the project so you can provide feedback. Drafts don’t affect the order status or the freelancer’s stats.
  • Extending the review period gives you more time to evaluate the existing delivery without requiring the freelancer to resubmit. Requesting a revision rejects the current delivery and asks the freelancer to make changes and re-deliver.
  • A Dispute status means the Resolution Center was used, either for a mutual cancellation request, a delivery date extension request from the freelancer, or an update request from you.
  • If your order is Late, you’re entitled to cancel if there’s no further response from the freelancer. If it’s Very Late (24+ hours past Late), you can cancel immediately through the Resolution Center.

Finding talent with Mira (Pro clients: Orders)

Mira introduces Fiverr’s new hiring experience, helping clients find the right qualified talent through a more guided and curated recruiting process, while helping talent focus on opportunities that are a better fit for their skills.

Before you begin

Mira is Fiverr’s AI headhunter. Clients describe what they need, Mira builds a job description, and finds talent that fits, so you spend less time searching and more time choosing. If you’re a talent, Mira sends you job descriptions that match your skills. Both sides spend less time filtering and more time focusing on the right match. Make sure the services you request comply with Fiverr’s Community Standards.

Mira is currently rolling out gradually, so not all users have access yet. If Mira isn’t available to you, it will be soon. You can use Mira on desktop and mobile web; it is not available yet on the iOS or Android apps.

How Mira works

  • As a client, you receive a curated shortlist of talent instead of managing unsolicited outreach.
  • When you start a conversation with Mira, it pulls context from your Fiverr order history and other profile information such as name, currency and timezone, and asks follow-up questions to build a complete job description.
  • Once the job description is ready and you approve it, Mira sends it to eligible talent and asks questions to ensure they are the right fit for you.
  • Mira presents a carefully curated shortlist of top talent cards with recommendations.
  • If your budget is under $250, Mira doesn’t send your job description to talent. Instead, you receive a filtered list of talent based on your job description details.

Generating a job description with Mira

Clients can generate a job description to receive a curated list of hand-picked talent.

  • Go to the home screen or the main menu click on Post a job description using Mira .
  • Start a conversation with Mira in your preferred language and describe the service you need.
  • The job description is always generated in English, even if you chat with Mira in another language.
  • Mira asks follow-up questions until all required fields are complete. It also suggests optional fields to improve your results. Required fields include:
    • Understanding the need
    • Business name
    • Project goals
    • Budget
    • Timeline
    • Search preferences (time zone, location, availability, experience, or language)
  • Other required and optional fields vary by service type. The job description progress bar shows which fields remain.
  • Once all required fields are complete, you can review and edit your job description. You can edit it manually or by asking Mira in the chat.
  • When your job description is ready, you can:
    • Click Let Mira take it from here to send the job description to suitable talent.
    • Click Export to download the job description as a PDF or open it in HTML.

Once you send your job description, you cannot edit or pause it.

Managing your job description

Your job description page shows real-time status updates as talents engage with your job description. Once you receive the curated shortlist of talent, you can:

  • See why each talent is a good fit for your project.
  • Click Compare talent to review all talent side by side.
  • Click Message {talent name} to start a conversation with a talent through the inbox. Your inbox shows a summary of the job description and the full job description as a PDF.

If you are not satisfied with the options you received, click Search Fiverr instead to open Fiverr’s filtered search results based on your job description.

To start a new job description, go to mira.fiverr.com and type your description for Mira to start creating your brief. There is no limit on the number of job descriptions you can send at the same time.

To switch between projects or delete a project:

  • Click your profile image.
  • Choose Your projects.
  • Click the project you want to view, or click Delete (Trash icon) next to the project name to remove it.
Your projects dashboard

When you open Mira, your home screen shows your Suggested projects, Drafts, and Ready projects. To see all your projects in one place, click your profile image and choose Your projects. You can filter by All, In progress, Ready, or Drafts, or use Search projects to find a specific one.

Each project card shows its current status:

  • Draft: A job description you haven’t finished. Open it and answer Mira’s questions to continue.
  • In progress: Mira is searching for talent for your project.
  • Ready: Mira has vetted talent for your project. Click Review talent to see your shortlist. If you’ve already messaged talent, click Open messages to continue the conversation.

Managing your profile

Mira uses information from your Fiverr account such as orders, currency and timezone as well as your profile information on Mira, and previous chats with Mira to personalize your experience. You can view and edit your profile information on Mira at any time.

  • Click your profile image.
  • Choose Your profile.
  • Edit any of the following sections:
    • Personal details: Display name, company, industry, and website.
    • Professional background: Your job title, experience, and the way you approach projects and decisions.
    • About your business: What your business does, who your customers are, and anything that helps freelancers understand your world.
    • Brand and voice: Tone, audience, references, and stylistic preferences, what good work looks like to you.
    • Additional context: Anything else freelancers should know, including past projects, sensitivities, or other context.
    • Your projects with Mira: Once a project’s matches are ready, Mira adds a short summary of it here, so she knows what you have worked on before.
Delete your conversations

To delete all your projects and chat history from Mira:

  • Click your profile image.
  • Choose Your profile.
  • Under Privacy & data, click Delete your conversations.

This will permanently delete your Mira conversation history, including all job descriptions, files, and shortlists. This cannot be undone.

Deleting your Mira data does not delete your Fiverr account or any other information on Fiverr. You can delete a specific project without deleting your account through the Your projects section.

Get notified by SMS

While Mira searches for talent, you can choose to provide your phone number to receive an SMS when your shortlist is ready or when talent sends you a proposal or a question about your brief. Your number is stored separately and used only for Mira updates related to your search.

How this option works

Mira is Fiverr’s AI hiring assistant. When you opt in, we send you text messages about your hiring projects on Mira. For example, we text you when a talent asks you a question or sends you an offer. We also text you a one-time code to confirm your number. We do not send marketing messages through this Program.

  • Where to find this option: Select Get text alerts on Mira’s live search page while a search is in progress. On desktop, the button appears at the bottom center of the page. On mobile browsers, it appears in the search controls menu, next to Stop Mira. This option is not available in the Fiverr mobile apps.
  • How you opt in: On the Mira web app, enter your mobile number, check the consent box, then enter the six-digit code we text to you. Consent is not a condition of any purchase.
  • Message frequency: Message frequency varies depending on your activity in your hiring projects.
  • Cost: Message and data rates may apply. For details about your text plan, contact your wireless carrier.
  • How to stop messages: Reply STOP to any message at any time. We send one message to confirm that you opted out. After that, we send no more messages. To opt in again, reply START.
  • Help: Reply HELP to any message for help, or contact customer support.
  • Carrier liability: Carriers and Fiverr are not liable for any delayed or undelivered messages.
  • Your mobile number: You confirm that you are the account holder of the number you give us, or that you have the account holder’s permission.

These terms and behavior are subject to change.

Privacy

We handle your information carefully and use your phone number only to let you know when your shortlist is ready or when a talent sends you a proposal or the freelancer has a question about your brief. This section explains what information we collect, for what purpose, and how long we keep it.

  • When you opt in, we collect:
    • Your mobile phone number.
    • Your time zone.
    • The date, time, and method of your consent.
    • The consent wording you agreed to.
    • The delivery status of each message we send to you.
  • We use this information only for the purposes of confirming your number, sending you the alerts you asked for, answering your HELP and STOP replies, and keeping a record of your consent. We use your time zone so that we do not text you at night.
  • Your phone number will be deleted within 30 days after you opt in or the last message we send you, whichever happens later. After that, you must opt in again to get text alerts. Record of your consent will be retained for a longer period, as required by applicable laws.
  • We share your phone number only with the SMS provider that delivers the messages for us. The provider cannot use your number for any other purpose.
  • We do not sell or share your SMS opt-in data or personal information with third parties for marketing purposes.
  • No mobile information will be shared with third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes. Text messaging originator opt-in data and consent will not be shared with any third parties.
  • Reply STOP to any message, or turn off text alerts in Mira.
  • To ask us to delete your number now, contact support.

How Mira works for freelancers

  • As talent, you’re matched to job descriptions based on multiple criteria such as previous projects completed on Fiverr and experience level, to find the most suitable fit for each project.
  • You’re notified through the inbox when a job description matching your skills and experience starts, prompting you to respond.
  • When you receive a job description, Mira explains why you’re a good fit and asks you a few questions.
  • Your answers help Mira highlight your expertise when presenting you to the client. Be sure to respond to Mira’s first message within 24 hours to ensure your response rate is not affected.
  • If you have questions about the project, Mira answers based on what it knows about the service and the client. If Mira can’t answer, it sends your question to the client.
  • Once you get a response, reply to Mira to accept or decline being offered to the client; if you decline, Mira may invite another talent.
  • When the job description closes, Mira notifies the relevant talent.
  • Each job description opens a new conversation with Mira in your inbox, rather than appearing on your Brief management page.

No setup required: You don’t need to create a Mira profile, change any settings, or take any action. If you’re a good match for a project, Mira will automatically reach out to you through your Fiverr Inbox when a relevant opportunity becomes available. If you prefer not to receive these messages, simply reply to Mira and ask to opt out.

Order with confidence

Hourly orders for clients (Pro clients: Orders)

Hourly Orders let you pay for work based on the actual time a freelancer spends on your project. This feature gives you greater flexibility and control, especially for evolving or long-term projects.

Overview

The Hourly Work model is suitable for:

  • Projects with evolving or hard-to-define scopes.
  • Long-term or ongoing projects.
  • Projects requiring at least 8 hours of work.

Hourly work is priced based on the actual hours worked, which offers fair payment according to the time and effort put into your project. You can set a weekly hour limit with your freelancer as part of the custom offer, and this limit can be changed or removed anytime from the order page.

Before you begin

  • Search for the service you need in the search bar and then go to the Seller details and filter freelancers by “offer Hourly rate” to compare options.
  • Discuss your project details and agree on a weekly hour limit with your freelancer. The offer, sent to your inbox, will include the service description, the agreed weekly hour limit, and the freelancer’s time estimation for the entire project.
  • Once you accept the custom offer, you will pay a $5 order initiation fee (tax not included), and the freelancer can begin working.

Weekly work & payment process

Your freelancer will log their weekly hours, and you will receive a report for review.

How your freelancer logs hours

Your freelancer must log their weekly hours worked by Sunday (23:59 UTC). For each session of hours added, they are required to provide a detailed description or a supporting file (or both). The supporting file can be the completed work, a screenshot, or a detailed Hourly report from a tracking app.

When you are charged

You are charged every Monday, based on the hours the freelancer logged. Your payment is then securely held in escrow until you approve the report.

Suspended orders

Hourly orders can be suspended if your payment method did not go through. This can occur for various reasons, such as an expired card, insufficient funds, and payment authorization failure. To resolve this, update or replace your payment method in the Billing and Payments section of your account and pay the pending charge by clicking on the Pay Amount Due on the same page or on the Hourly order page. Your Hourly order will then resume.

How to approve the weekly report

By default, the Hourly work approval process is manual. You’ll receive the previous week’s report for review every Monday.

  • You have 7 days to review and manually approve the report after being charged (from Monday to Monday). If no action is taken within 7 days, the report will be auto-approved, and payment will be released to the freelancer. However, the order status will remain paused until you choose to activate it. Until the report is approved, freelancers cannot log new hours for the order. This manual approval is required for the first weekly report of any Hourly order.
  • From the second weekly report onward, you have the option to choose automatic approval. If you select this, you’ll have a 3-day period (Monday to Thursday) for opening a dispute; if it’s not disputed in this window, the week will auto-complete.

Disputing a weekly report

If the work detailed in the weekly report does not meet your expectations, you can dispute it.

  • If your approval process is manual, you have 7 days (Monday to Monday) to open a dispute.

  • If your approval process is automatic, you have a 3-day period (72 hours) (Monday to Thursday) to open a dispute.

  • ​

    • Go to the order page.
    • Click on More actions at the bottom of the order page.
    • Click on Open a dispute.

  • Once you ask for a refund, the freelancer will have up to 48 hours to accept or decline the request.

  • If the freelancer accepts the request or doesn’t respond within 48 hours, you will get the funds immediately. Refunds are added to your Fiverr Balance, or Fiverr Pro Balance if you’re a Pro client, ready for future orders.

  • The cancellation only affects the week, not the whole order: if you wish to receive a refund and stop the order, you need to end the order as well.

  • If you wish to continue working with the freelancer and request a refund only for a week, you can dispute that week without ending the order.

  • See more information on the refund process.

Managing your Hourly order

You have control over your Hourly order at any time from the order page:

  • Change the weekly hour limit.
  • Pause the order with 24 hours’ notice.
  • End the order with 24 hours’ notice.

You can make these changes by clicking the ellipsis button at the top right corner of the order page. If you choose to pause or end the order, the freelancer will have an additional 24 hours to report any final hours worked.

In-progress order feedback

You can leave a review for your freelancer during an in-progress Hourly order if these two conditions are met:

  • At least four weeks of work have been done.
  • The freelancer has reported at least 10 hours of work.

Once you submit a mid-order review, the cycle will begin again. Tips and private feedback are only available when the entire Hourly order is completed.

  • ​
    • All Fiverr Pro Terms of Service and Payment Terms apply.
    • Disputes may only address the hours reported in a weekly report. Fiverr does not guarantee the quality of work and Fiverr’s Customer Support will not accept disputes regarding the quality of services.
    • The refund amount is limited to the number of hours reported by the freelancer.
    • Weekly reports are auto-completed if you don’t ask for a refund within 72 hours from the weekly payment or within 7 days if the Hourly order is in manual approval mode.
    • Clients are strictly prohibited from using a canceled delivery. The freelancer retains all rights to the canceled order.
    • Fiverr reserves the right to determine which orders are eligible, and to exclude instances of abuse, fraud, or any other inappropriate activity.

How order disputes work for clients (Pro clients: Orders)

Managing order disputes is an important part of using Fiverr. You can request to cancel an active order through the Resolution Center when issues arise. This article explains the types of order disputes, how to cancel an order, and what happens after a cancellation. Our goal is to help you complete your project, so whenever possible we look for ways to move your order forward.

Before you begin

  • You can access the Resolution Center from the right side of the order page.
  • The Resolution Center is used for orders that have not yet been completed. If you need to cancel a completed order, contact Customer Support.

Ways to avoid order disputes

An order dispute is a cancellation request you send through the Resolution Center when you want to cancel an order.

Preparation and communication help prevent order disputes:

  • Before placing an order, make sure your project brief is detailed and complete. Discuss everything with the freelancer so they fully understand your needs before work begins.
  • If your needs change during the order, let the freelancer know right away. Clear and timely communication helps avoid misunderstandings and keeps the project on track.
  • Custom Offers allow you to go beyond the packages offered with Gigs and let your freelancer tailor the order to your specific needs. That way, you and the freelancer know what to expect.
  • Revisions can help resolve concerns you may have with the delivery and allow the freelancer to fix them.
  • If your freelancer shares a draft before the final delivery, review it and send your feedback early. A draft is work in progress, and your silence does not mean you approve it.
  • This option removes the pressure to accept the delivery or request a revision within three days. Take as much time as you need to make sure the delivery is what you paid for.
  • Review all delivered files carefully before accepting. If something is not right, request a revision. Accept the delivery only when you are sure it meets your requirements.
  • Partial refunds let you keep your delivery and reach an agreement with the freelancer. Ask the freelancer to send you a request for a partial refund.

Reach out to Customer Support if you need any advice or help with your order.

Learn more with the following articles:

  • The complete guide to your Fiverr order: Statuses and process
  • Partial refunds

Types of order disputes

Fiverr has several types of order disputes, depending on who initiates the request and when.

  • You can request to cancel an active order at any time through the Resolution Center. Once you submit the request, the freelancer has 48 hours to accept or decline. If they do not respond, we cancel the order automatically.
  • If a freelancer requests to cancel, you have 48 hours to respond. If you do not respond within 48 hours, we cancel the order automatically.
  • In some situations, you can cancel an order without approval from the freelancer:
    • Before submitting project requirements: If you placed an order and have not yet submitted your project requirements, you can cancel immediately through the Resolution Center. This option is available only on the Fiverr website, not in the app.
    • Very late delivery: If the freelancer has not delivered and you did not both agree to extend the delivery date, you can cancel without approval after 24 hours past the expected delivery date.

We can cancel an active order when we confirm a violation of our Terms of Service, such as fraud, a fake identity, stolen or non-original work, harassment or discrimination, a false or empty delivery, or a prohibited service.

How to cancel an active order

To access the Resolution Center:

  • Go to your Orders page and select the order you want to resolve, then click View.
  • Click Resolution Center, located on the right side of the page.
  • Select Cancel Order and fill in the reason.
  • Click Send Request.

Learn more with Cancel an order with the Resolution Center.

Canceling an order with an open request

If you want to cancel an order with an open Resolution Center request, you need to withdraw the request first on the Orders page. After withdrawing the request, you can submit a cancellation request.

You cannot open a new dispute request while any of the following actions are in progress:

  • Get an order update.
  • Cancel order.
  • Extend delivery date request (requested by freelancers only).

If you cannot resolve the issue together, contact Customer Support.

Canceling a completed order

If the order is in Completed status, you cannot use the Resolution Center to cancel it. Contact Customer Support for help.

When you contact Customer Support about a completed order, we review the full case before we decide. We start from the position that a completed order is valid, and we look at the original requirements, the delivery, and your conversation with the freelancer. We may contact you and the freelancer to try to resolve the issue first, and we may suggest a partial refund. The more time passes after an order is completed, the more carefully we review the request.

We can cancel an order when there is clear evidence, such as:

  • Missing requirements
  • Corrupted or unusable files
  • A plagiarism report
  • A clear mismatch between the delivery and the Gig or custom offer
  • A violation of our Terms of Service

After your order is canceled

Once your order is successfully canceled, here are a few options to help you move forward:

  • Pick a different freelancer from a personalized recommendations list: We provide you with a personalized list of freelancer recommendations on your Orders page to help you complete your project.
  • Get personalized offers by posting a project brief: Post your project brief and receive tailored offers from relevant freelancers. Review your offers, choose the best fit, and get the results you need.

Keep these points in mind after a cancellation:

  • Delivered work: When an order is canceled, you lose the rights to the delivered work, so you cannot use it.
  • Shared access: If you gave the freelancer access to your accounts, such as your email, website, content management system, or payment details, change your passwords and remove their access.

Fiverr Pro satisfaction guarantee

Fiverr Pro managed services come with a full money-back satisfaction guarantee on eligible orders. If the final delivery does not meet your expectations, you can contact Customer Support to request a refund, if you do so within 14 days of order completion. We credit approved refunds to your Fiverr Pro balance for future orders.

The guarantee covers:

  • Services provided by vetted Pro freelancers
  • Project manager and project planning services
  • Sourcing by a domain expert

It does not apply to hourly orders.

Learn more with Fiverr Pro satisfaction guarantee.

How to find the right freelancers on Fiverr Pro

With thousands of vetted services on Fiverr Pro, finding the perfect match can feel overwhelming. Fiverr Pro makes it simple with two clear paths: Independent browsing if you’d like to explore on your own, or Premium services if you prefer expert guidance and hands-on support.

Independent browsing

Refine your search at your own pace by adjusting filters and comparing the many vetted freelancers and agencies available.

  • Fiverr Pro catalog or full catalog: Search for vetted professionals in the Fiverr Pro catalog or explore the full catalog for a wider selection of talent.
  • Post a project brief: Describe your project and send a brief to receive a curated list of freelancers or custom offers to review and hire.
Fiverr Pro catalog or full catalog

Fiverr Pro is a curated marketplace teeming with highly skilled freelancers, meticulously vetted for their skills.

  • Use the search field on top of your Fiverr Pro homepage to search by relevant keywords and filters.

  • Within the search results, choose your catalog:

  • Pro catalog: Showcases profiles of Vetted Pro freelancers. Fiverr has manually reviewed these freelancers for their professional background, a strong portfolio of high-quality work, and a history of excellent service. It’s the ideal solution for projects where deep expertise and proven reliability are a must, allowing you to hire with complete confidence.

  • Full catalog: Displays services offered by all Fiverr freelancers, including Vetted Pro freelancers, Top Rated freelancers, new freelancers, and everyone in between. Choose this catalog if you want the widest possible selection and want to browse services and reviews to find the best fit.

Post a project brief

Fiverr’s brief creation process uses AI to generate a professional project brief, ensuring your project goals and requirements are clearly conveyed.

  • Access: Go to ‘Post a project brief’ from the top of your Pro homepage.
  • Generate your brief: Write a brief description of your project, including your timeline and budget. Then, click “Generate brief” to have AI create a professional project outline.
  • Post your brief: We’ll connect you with the best freelancers who meet your project’s needs, budget, and requirements. For certain scopes and budgets, you will be able to invite freelancers.
  • Receive offers: Get offers directly to your brief’s page. Compare and choose from all offers in one designated space.
  • Hire freelancers: Once you choose an offer, accept it directly from the offer page and start working on your project.

Learn more by visiting the Post a project brief article.

Premium services

Experience a seamless, expert-led approach to hiring and managing freelancers with Fiverr Pro’s suite of premium services.

  • Freelancer shortlisting via chat: Chat live with Fiverr Pro representatives to get your questions answered and receive a handpicked list of freelancers for your project.
  • Sourcing by domain experts: Hire domain experts to source, vet, and interview top freelancers on your behalf, delivering a comparison report of the best candidates for a flat fee.
  • Project management service: Hire a certified project manager to oversee your entire project end-to-end, from scoping and hiring freelancers to guaranteeing top-quality results.
Freelancer shortlisting via chat

Being a Fiverr Pro client grants you access to our live chat. Once logged in, you can talk to one of our live representatives to receive a shortlist of relevant freelancers. Clients with a Business Success Manager can contact them and receive a shortlist of freelance talent.

  • Access live chatbot: Click the Fiverr icon (fi) in the bottom-right corner of the page.
  • Provide request: Type “looking for a freelancer”, then select your budget and add a brief description of your needs. From there, you’ll be connected to one of our representatives who will assist you further.
Sourcing by domain experts

Sourcing by domain experts: Hire domain experts to source, vet, and interview top freelancers on your behalf, delivering a comparison report of the best candidates for a flat fee.
