Leaving and managing reviews on Fiverr (Pro clients: Orders)

Reviews and ratings are the foundation of a trusted marketplace. They give clients confidence when choosing a freelancer, and help freelancers showcase their work and build a strong reputation. Fiverr uses a two-way feedback system: both the client and the freelancer can leave a review after an order is completed. Reviews are visible to the public only after both parties submit their feedback, or once the review window closes.

Types of reviews

The review system has two types of reviews:

  • Public review: A star rating plus written feedback that appears on the freelancer’s Gig page and profile page, and on the client’s profile page.
  • Private review: An anonymous satisfaction rating submitted by the client. This review is not shared with the freelancer and is used by Fiverr for internal quality measurement only.

Public ratings on a freelancer’s profile reflect activity over the past two years, so they always show current performance rather than a lifetime average.

Before you begin

  • You can only leave a review on a completed or eligible canceled order.
  • The client must submit a public review first — this enables the freelancer to leave their own review.
  • All reviews must come from legitimate purchases made through Fiverr. Reviews from accounts used to artificially boost ratings will result in permanent suspension. Learn more in Fiverr reviews: Content guidelines and removal policy.

How to leave a review

  • As a client, after your order is marked as completed, you will be taken to the public rating page automatically.
    1. Rate the order on three questions:
  • • How would you rate the quality of this delivery?
  • • How was it working with the freelancer?
  • • How would you rate the value for money of this service?
  • 2. After selecting a star rating, choose the checkboxes that best describe your experience.
  • 3. Write a review (minimum 10 characters). You can also approve attaching files from the order at this step. The attached file will be added to the freelancer’s Live Portfolio and showcased as examples of your work.
  • 4. Optionally add a tip for the freelancer.
  • 5. Click Submit.
  • Once a client submits their public review, as a freelancer you will receive a notification. You then have 14 days (or 30 days in certain categories — see Review Windows below) to leave your own review.
    1. Click the notification you receive after the client submits their review.
  • 2. Go to your order page and scroll to the bottom.
  • 3. Rate your experience and leave a comment.
  • 4. Click Send.
  • 5. Once you submit your review, you can see the client’s review and respond publicly.
  • You cannot see the client’s review until after you submit your own, or until the review window closes.
  • Highlighted reviews are short snippets of positive feedback shown on a Gig page. They are selected automatically from recent reviews. Freelancers with a Seller Plus membership can also manually select up to five reviews to highlight.

Please note that Fiverr reserves the right to restrict review capabilities if there is evidence of Terms of Service or Community Standards breaches. If you require further help, our Customer Support team is available via the Contact Us button below.

How long can I leave a review?

  • Both clients and freelancers have 14 days after an order is completed to submit their public review in most categories.
  • The following categories have a 30-day review window:
  • • Programming & Tech
  • • Digital Marketing — SEO, SEM, Local SEO, Video Marketing, and E-Commerce Marketing subcategories
  • Once the window closes, no new reviews can be added to the order.
  • Clients can submit a private review within 60 days of an order being completed. The private review option appears 24 hours after the order is marked completed. If you skip it, the option will no longer be available.

Editing a review

  • Clients can edit their public review from the moment they submit it until it becomes live on Fiverr (i.e., until the freelancer submits their own review, or the review window closes).
  • To edit your review:
    • Go to your order page.
    • Scroll down to the review section.
    • Click Edit review and ratings, make your changes, and save.
  • To give you time to make edits, Fiverr delays the notification asking freelancers to submit their review by 20 minutes. This means you have at least 20 minutes after submitting your review to make changes.
  • Freelancers cannot edit their public review once it has been submitted.

Once both reviews are live, neither party can make further edits.

Responding to a review

After both public reviews are published, freelancers can respond to the client’s review from their order page. The response appears publicly on the Gig page.

  • There is no time limit for adding a response, as long as the Gig is active.
  • If you miss the review window entirely and cannot leave a review, you can still respond to the client’s review.
  • Once published, a response cannot be edited or removed.

Reviews for multi-payment and hourly orders

  • For Subscription orders, each order within a subscription is standalone. You are prompted to leave a review for each individual order within the subscription.
  • For Milestone orders, you leave a review once the final Milestone is completed, or if the remaining Milestones are stopped.
  • For Hourly orders, you can leave a review once the contract is completed. For ongoing weekly orders within a contract, a private review is requested after the first completed weekly order only, not for every weekly order.

Reviews for canceled orders

To maintain a transparent marketplace, clients may leave feedback for orders that were canceled, provided they meet specific criteria. When eligible, clients have a 5-day window to submit their review. After the client provides feedback, the freelancer can share a public response.

  • Reviews on canceled orders are available in these eligible scenarios:
  • • Late delivery: the project is overdue by at least 24 hours.
  • • Lack of communication: the freelancer has not replied to messages for more than 24 hours.
  • • Delivery sent: files were submitted through the system prior to the cancelation request.
  • • Account history: the client has successfully completed one or more previous purchases on the platform.
  • Reviews on canceled orders are excluded in the following scenarios:
  • • New users: the transaction was the client’s first order on Fiverr.
  • • Freelancer profiles: the client also maintains an active freelancer account.
  • • Payment disputes: the order was reversed due to a chargeback.

Reviews on canceled orders are excluded in the following scenarios:

• New users: the transaction was the client’s first order on Fiverr.

• Freelancer profiles: the client also maintains an active freelancer account.

• Payment disputes: the order was reversed due to a chargeback.

Repeat client reviews

Clients who placed multiple orders with the same freelancer can leave the same review they previously left, instead of writing a new one each time.

This option is available if the previous rating was 4+ stars and it’s less than 6 months old.

If the criteria aren’t met, a new review must be written.

  • As a client, once you accept the delivery and complete the order, or if the order is auto-completed, you will be offered the option to keep the previous review or write a new one.
  • As a freelancer, your profile will display the most recent review and have the following indications:
    • Ongoing collaboration: Multiple orders between the users.
    • Number of reviews left by the client: If a client left multiple duplicate reviews, the number will indicate how many.

FAQs

  • Customer Support will only remove reviews following the Fiverr reviews removal policy. You cannot ask another user to remove their review, and you cannot remove your own review once it has been published. If an account is deleted, its reviews are anonymized rather than removed.
  • Once a review is published, it can no longer be edited to ensure the integrity of the rating system. However, clients do have the flexibility to make changes to their feedback within the 14-day review window, provided the freelancer has not yet submitted their own review.
  • Clients may see an option to generate a review draft using AI. This feature uses information from the order and communication to create a starting point. You can edit the AI-generated draft or write your own review from scratch before publishing.
  • The option to leave a review is only available once an order is officially marked as completed. If your order is currently in an active status such as In Progress, In Revision, Late, or Very Late, the review feature is not yet enabled and will only appear after delivery.
  • No. The order must meet the eligibility criteria for a repeat review: the previous rating was 4+ stars, and the order is less than 6 months old.
  • Reviews are generally only possible on orders where a delivery has taken place. In cases where a client purchases the wrong service, fails to provide necessary requirements, or makes an error in ordering, there is typically no delivery, making the order ineligible for review. To prevent these situations, we suggest establishing clear expectations immediately -either before the purchase or as soon as it is made -to confirm that the client’s needs align with your specific expertise and available services.
  • While meeting every client’s expectations is not always achievable, resolving issues through a mutual cancelation can preserve a positive professional relationship. Clients can leave reviews on eligible canceled orders, so maintaining open communication and professionalism throughout the cancelation process is especially important. Many clients value a freelancer’s dedication and transparency during this process. Maintaining a high overall satisfaction rate across your portfolio ensures that occasional disputes will not heavily impact your standing. We encourage you to view all feedback as a valuable tool for refining your service and growing your freelance business.
  • Freelancers do not have the ability to submit a review for the client in this scenario. They do, however, retain the right to provide a public response to any feedback the client leaves regarding the cancelation.
  • To maintain a transparent marketplace, any feedback left for an order that was canceled will be clearly marked with a specific label identifying it as such.

Milestones (Pro clients: Orders)

Break down big projects and stay on track with milestones. Milestones are like checkpoints, helping you and your freelancer clearly define project stages. This ensures everyone’s aligned, progress is easily tracked, and complex tasks become manageable.

In this guide, you’ll discover the key benefits of using milestones, learn how to effectively implement them, and find answers to frequently asked questions.

Milestone benefits

  • Gain clear visibility into your freelancer’s progress with structured milestones. This ensures on-time deliveries, aligns payments with completed work, and simplifies project management with pre-defined deadlines and deliverables.
  • By splitting your project into six sections (and payments), your freelancer will know your expectations and deadlines, with structured updates throughout the process. Any potential confusion or delays can be prevented using milestones, milestone deliveries are always approved by you before the freelancer moves onto the next milestone.
  • Suggestion: Define your revisions per milestone for an even more organized project.
  • Milestones eliminate the need for frequent clarification, ensuring your freelancer understands project details from the start. This minimizes unnecessary communication and streamlines your collaboration.

Using milestones

  • Use this option for complex projects, and approve each project step. Get custom offers from freelancers that include milestones. You’ll be notified with an inbox message when you receive a custom offer. Alternatively, you can contact a particular freelancer and request a custom offer including milestones. You can have up to 6 milestones in a custom offer.
  • Note: Only orders over $100 are eligible for milestones.
  • Find freelancers with Gigs that incorporate milestones. You’ll be able to review a freelancer’s workflow and milestone pricing before placing an order. Understand their work process and know precisely what deliverables to expect, and when. You can have up to 5 milestones with Gig milestones.
  • You’ll see the option to use milestones on a freelancer’s Gig:
  • Note: Only freelancers (with a basic package over $100) in the following subcategories can add Milestones to their Gigs: 3D Product Animation; Business Plans; Producers & Composers; Desktop Applications; and Social Media Marketing.

Note: You have 8 days from the delivery of each milestone to request a revision or accept it. If no action is taken, the order will be stopped and marked as completed. After accepting a delivery and completing a milestone, you have ten days to initiate the next milestone.

FAQs

  • We recommend using milestones for bigger projects to allow for more flexibility in the smaller steps. Milestones offer you a reduced risk, and these per-task payments also give freelancers the incentive to keep up the good work.
  • Get an idea of how it is to work with your potential freelancer:
  • Example 1: Logo design
  • Example 2: Whiteboard & explainers
  • You’ll be charged for the first milestone when you place an order. Once you approve a milestone and initiate the next one, the associated payment will be made.
  • A milestone within an order, or the whole order, can be canceled through the Resolution Center or through Customer Support, for valid reasons.
  • You can contact the freelancer and ask them to send you a custom offer, using milestones.
  • You’ll have 8 days from the delivery of each milestone to request a revision/accept it, and continue to the next one. If you don’t, the order will stop, and be marked as completed.
  • You can add a maximum of 5 milestones per Gig order, and 6 milestones per custom offer. If this is an ongoing service, it may be more suitable for you to use Subscriptions.
  • No, you can choose either subscription or milestones but they can’t be combined and used in the same order.

Partial refunds (Pro clients: Orders)

The partial refund option lets you adjust the payment for an existing order without canceling it entirely. If a project’s scope changes or an issue comes up mid-order, a partial refund allows the freelancer to be compensated for the work they’ve already completed while returning part of the payment to the client.

This article guides you through how partial refunds work, who can request them, and the steps involved.

Overview

Only a freelancer can initiate a partial refund through the Resolution Center on the order page. If you’re a client who’d like a partial refund, reach out to your freelancer via inbox first to agree on an amount.

Here is what you need to know:

  • A partial refund applies to the initial (primary) amount of an active order only.
  • If extras were added after the order was placed, the partial refund covers only the original amount, not the extras.
    • Example: if you paid $50 on the initial order and later added a $10 extra, only the $50 is covered by the partial refund.
  • Partial refunds are processed to the original payment method used to purchase the order. It takes 2-10 days for the refund to complete.
  • Partial refunds on completed orders are also available, but they can only be processed through Customer Support. Contact us to check whether a partial refund is available for a completed order.

Before you begin

Before submitting a partial refund, make sure your order meets all of the following criteria.

Order status & amount

  • The order must be active (not yet completed).
  • The order amount must be over $50.

Refund limits

  • The minimum refund amount is $5.
  • The maximum refund is 60% of the original order price.

Example: a $200 order allows a partial refund of up to $120.

Eligible order types

  • One-time purchase orders are eligible.
  • Milestone orders are eligible, but only for the first milestone. Once the first milestone is marked complete, the option is no longer available.
  • Subscription orders are also eligible.
  • Orders purchased with a promo code, coupon, promotion, or Fiverr Credits are not eligible.

Other conditions

  • Only one partial refund is allowed per order.
  • Once a partial refund is accepted, it cannot be reversed.

How to offer a partial refund for freelancers

We encourage both parties to discuss and agree on an amount before submitting a partial refund request. This helps set clear expectations.

Only freelancers can send a partial refund offer.

- Go to the Resolution Center from the order page.
- Select Offer a partial refund.
- Enter the amount you'd like to refund and add a note explaining the offer to the client. You'll also be asked to select a reason from a dropdown — this is for internal use only and won't be shared with the client.
- Click Send offer.
  • A notification confirms the client has received your offer. If the client doesn’t respond within 3 days, the offer expires automatically. You can withdraw the offer at any time if no agreement is reached on the order page.
  • Note: If the client rejects your delivery before accepting the partial refund offer, you’ll need to resend the delivery once they accept the partial refund so they can review and accept it.
  • Learn more with Using the Resolution Center.
    • Go to the Resolution Center from the order page.
    • Select Offer a partial refund.
    • Select the reason for the refund.
    • Enter the amount and add a note for the client.
    • Tap Send.

How to respond to a partial refund offer for clients

  • You’ll receive an email and a notification on the order page when the freelancer sends an offer.
  • Go to the Activity section of the order page to review the proposed amount and the reason.
  • Accept or decline the offer. You’ll be asked to provide a reason for your decision.

If you don’t respond within 3 days, the offer expires automatically.

Best practices

  • Discuss the scope of work completed before making or requesting a refund offer.
  • Make sure the refund amount reflects the value of the work that was delivered.
  • If you’re a client and you’d like a partial refund, contact your freelancer directly via your inbox.

FAQs

  • The refund is sent to the original payment method used for the order.
  • Yes, the partial refund feature is available through the Fiverr app.
  • If the service fee on the new (lower) price is less than what was originally charged, the difference is refunded to the client. If the new price would result in a higher fee, the difference is not charged.
  • No. Whether the offer is accepted or declined, it won’t affect the freelancer’s order completion rate.
  • The freelancer’s fee is calculated based on the final price after the partial refund is applied.
  • No. Once a partial refund is accepted, no further refund offers can be made on that order.
  • Yes. Partial refunds on completed orders are possible, but they can only be processed through Customer Support.
  • Yes. Orders that have received a partial refund are treated as completed orders, so both parties can leave a review.

Post a project brief: get tailored offers for your project (Pro clients: Orders)

Mira AI Headhunter has fully replaced this Briefs feature. You can still access your previously created project briefs through the Your Briefs entry points from the Avatar menu for the time being. To learn how create a new job description, visit Finding talent with Mira.

Easily generate a professional project brief with the help of our AI assistant. This process ensures all your goals, requirements, and key specifications are clearly articulated and never overlooked. Once your refined brief is ready, simply post it to effortlessly receive tailored offers from the most relevant, qualified freelancers on our platform.

Getting started

This feature is for clients who want to easily find qualified freelancers by posting a project brief. The AI refines your brief, and then a shortlist of matching freelancers is created. You receive tailored offers directly from relevant freelancers, which you can evaluate and choose from.

  • This feature is available on desktop and mobile web, but not on the mobile app.
  • Briefs can only be generated in English. Using other languages will result in an error message.
How to post a brief & get offers?

  • Click Post a brief from the header of your homepage when logged in.

  • Write a short project description, including your timeline & budget. These fields are mandatory.

  • Click Generate brief. AI will convert your description into a professional brief.

  • Review your brief and add any additional information, such as whether it’s a one-time request or an ongoing project, details about the ideal candidate, and screening questions.

  • Now, you have two options:

  • Click Source for me so Fiverr can find and share your brief with the top relevant freelancers. The freelancers that fit your brief’s description, requirements, & budget range will receive your brief, and the results will show you freelancers who either perfectly or partially match your preferences.

  • Alternatively, click Invite freelancers to view a curated list of freelancers who match your request and send the brief yourself.

    • Review the freelancer’s profile for details on their past work and skills. You will see how well the freelancer matches your brief’s requirements.
    • Click Send invitation to request an offer.
    • We recommend inviting several freelancers to increase your chances of receiving tailored offers faster.
Best practices
  • Include recommended details: Adding details attracts the right freelancers, ensures they understand your needs, & leads to a smoother project.
  • Adhere to policies: Your brief and any attached files must comply with Fiverr’s policies and Terms of Service.
  • Avoid sharing sensitive information: Never include contact details, passwords, credit card numbers, Social Security Numbers (SSN), or national identification card numbers.
  • Avoid objectionable content: Never use adult content, hate speech, discrimination, harassment, or any abusive behavior.
How to view your briefs?

Access your briefs by clicking on your profile icon in the top right corner > Your Briefs.

  • This page shows your brief’s title, status, a summary of offers, and the action you can take (e.g., view offers, invite freelancers, or view orders).
  • All offers appear in the Offers tab for your review, so you can easily compare them. You can expect to receive up to 5 tailored offers.
  • Clicking View offer lets you review the details, including a short introduction from the freelancer, pricing, timeline, and included services.
  • If a freelancer needs more details to personalize their offer, you can review their questions and reply directly from the offer page.

Once you select an offer, accept it directly from the offer page. You can accept multiple offers and hire more than one freelancer for your project.

How to edit your briefs?

Once you locate the brief you would like to edit, you can edit the brief by:

  • Select the three-dot (…) menu
  • Choose edit
  • Edit the brief with new information
  • Select “Update brief”

If your brief had no offers, any freelancers who are sent the brief will see the updated version. If the brief had offers, you will need to choose whether you want the updated brief to be sent to other freelancers or not. Once the brief has been approved, your brief will appear in your Briefs page with an “Edited” tag.

- Live - The brief is ready to receive offers from freelancers.
- Inactive - The brief was inactive for 30 days & no freelancers were hired. Once inactive, you cannot send new invitations or receive offers.
- Hired - At least one freelancer was hired for the project.
- Rejected - Your brief was not approved because it violated Fiverr’s Community Standards.
- No invites sent - You received a curated list of freelancers to invite, but haven’t sent any invitations yet.

FAQs

  • It may take freelancers a few hours to review your brief and create a tailored offer. Freelancers receive invites that are valid for 72 hours. After that, they will not be able to respond to your brief.
  • Briefs can get up to 5 tailored offers. This number is influenced by your brief’s details, the freelancer’s availability, the project scope, and whether you invite freelancers.
  • If you’re not getting responses, try submitting a new brief and make sure to follow the AI suggestions to refine your project scope, budget, and timeline. This helps match you with freelancers who are the right fit. You can also contact Customer Support for additional assistance.
  • Yes, you can duplicate an approved brief by going to your Briefs page, locating the brief you’d like to duplicate, choosing the three dots on the right-hand side, and choosing “Duplicate”. Once the brief has been duplicated, you will need to input the budget and timeline before submitting it for review.

Refunds and chargebacks: What to expect (Pro clients: Orders)

When your order is canceled on Fiverr, we credit the funds to your Fiverr balance by default. If you prefer to have the funds returned to your original payment provider instead of keeping them in your account for future purchases, you can request a refund. This guide explains how we handle canceled order funds and walks you through the steps to request a refund back to your payment provider.

Before you begin

  • This article applies to clients.
  • Refund requests are available on iOS and desktop only. We don’t support this on Android.
  • You can only request a refund after an order has been cancelled.
  • We refund your available balance automatically, starting with the oldest refundable funds. This means your refund may go to a different payment method than the one you used for this specific order, and it may arrive as more than one transaction.
  • If you paid in a currency other than US dollars, we process your refund in that same currency and amount.
  • When you cancel an order, we credit the funds to your Fiverr balance by default. This is different from Fiverr credits, which come from promotions, referrals, or compensation. You can request a refund of your Fiverr balance to your payment provider, but you can’t refund or transfer Fiverr credits.
  • If you file a chargeback or claim with your bank or PayPal instead of requesting a refund through Fiverr, the process works differently. See “If you file a chargeback or payment dispute instead” below.

How the refund process works

We don’t automatically process refunds to your payment provider (for example, credit card or PayPal) after you cancel an order.

Once your cancellation is successful, we credit the funds directly to your Fiverr balance. You can see the credited funds next to your profile picture. You can also find them on your account’s balances page, or by clicking the Amount button next to your profile picture.

When you place a new order, we automatically apply any available funds from your Fiverr balance, including funds from a previous cancellation, to the purchase.

Requesting a refund to your payment provider

Once your order is cancelled, you can request a refund to your original payment provider. Click Request a Refund on the Available balances tab.

You may see the funds returned to your payment provider up to 10 days after we process your request.

Refund history

You can view your recent refund requests from the past 30 days. Go to the Balances tab under Billing and payments, then click Refund history to see a detailed timeline.

If you have a Fiverr balance but no refund requests within the last 30 days, the Refund history link doesn’t appear.

Once you submit a refund request, we send you a notification confirming we received it and are processing it.

Refund processing & troubleshooting

When you request a refund, we give you an estimated arrival time. There’s no confirmation showing the refund as successful or completed.

Refunds usually complete within 10 days. Processing time depends on your bank, card issuer, or PayPal.

If your refund fails, it may be because you made your original payment more than 180 days ago, or because your payment method is no longer active. Double-check the date of your original payment and make sure your payment method is still valid.

Once we initiate a refund, we can’t revert it. Contact your payment provider to discuss options for reversing the transaction.

If you file a chargeback or payment dispute

Filing a chargeback or claim with your bank or PayPal is a different path from requesting a refund through Fiverr, and it comes with different rules and a longer timeline. This section explains what to expect if you go that route.

Types of chargebacks and claims

Type

Filed through

What it covers

Credit card chargeback

Your bank or card issuer

Unauthorized charge or service-related reasons

PayPal claim

PayPal

Unauthorized charge or service-related reasons

  • When you file a PayPal claim or a credit card chargeback, we automatically cancel your order and send you an email about the cancellation. We also add a “Dispute with payment provider” warning to your account and email you about it separately. If your case is related to an unauthorized charge, we will also automatically restrict your account .
  • We can’t process a refund through Fiverr for the same order while your case is open, since your payment provider won’t process two refunds for one transaction.
  • Chargebacks and claims can take anywhere from 45 days to three months to resolve, depending on your payment provider. We don’t control this timeline, and we can’t speed it up or make exceptions, regardless of the circumstances.
  • If you’d rather resolve the issue without involving your bank or PayPal, contact us or use the Resolution Center instead of filing the chargeback or claim.
  • If your case was related to an unauthorized charge, we automatically restrict your account while we review it. We review restriction and restoration decisions case by case, based on your account’s history and whether the chargeback has been resolved. Contact us with your order details if you’d like us to review your account.
  • If you reuse the disputed funds on a new order, or request and receive a refund and then file a chargeback on the same funds, we add a debt to your account for the amount involved.

FAQs

  • Most refunds to your card or PayPal complete within 10 days.
  • Not necessarily. We refund your available balance automatically, starting with the oldest refundable funds. This can mean your refund goes to a different payment method you used in the past, or arrives as more than one transaction.
  • Your bank usually routes the refund to the account behind that card, even if the physical card is no longer active. Contact your bank if you don’t see the refund after the standard timeframe.
  • No. Once we initiate a refund, the funds leave Fiverr and we can’t cancel or redirect them.
  • Fiverr credits are non-cash, platform-only credits from promotions, referrals, or compensation. You can use them at checkout, but you can’t withdraw them or send them to your bank, card, or PayPal.
  • Fiverr balance is store credit you may receive from a canceled order, and you can use it on Fiverr or request a refund.
  • A refund is money we return to your original payment method, and it no longer appears in your Fiverr balance once we issue it.
  • This can happen for a few reasons: currency conversion between your payment and your bank statement, spending part of your Fiverr balance before requesting the refund, or paying for your order partly with Fiverr credits, which reverse as credits rather than cash.
  • No. We can only help with payments processed through Fiverr. Contact your payment provider directly to request a reversal or open a dispute for payments made outside the platform.
  • Filing a dispute goes against our Payment Terms. You need to contact your payment provider first. Once it is resolved, contact Support so we can continue to assist.
  • We automatically restrict your account when you file a chargeback or claim related to an unauthorized charge, while we review it. This is meant to protect your account.
  • We review restoration requests on a case by case basis, taking into consideration your account’s history and whether the chargeback is resolved. Contact Support to have your account reviewed.
  • You can wait for your payment provider to resolve the case. Once they close it, we credit any returned funds to your Fiverr balance.
  • For a faster resolution, you can close the dispute with your bank or PayPal and resolve it through Fiverr instead.
  • Your refund may not be able to go back to your original payment method. In some cases, Support can review whether we can move the funds to your Earnings so you can withdraw them instead.
  • If a refund is due while your account is disabled, you can request it from Support.

Searching freelancers and services on Fiverr: A Guide (Pro clients: Orders)

With thousands of services available, you can find exactly what you need on Fiverr in just a few steps. Our search engine helps you narrow your options by category, budget, and delivery time, so you reach the right freelancer faster. If you cannot find a match, you can post a project brief and receive tailored offers, or request a custom quote directly from a freelancer. This guide is for clients who want to search for services and get a quote that fits their project.

Searching for a service

  • Mira is Fiverr’s AI headhunter, designed to create a more guided and curated hiring experience. You describe your project needs, and Mira builds a job description, identifies suitable talent, and presents a shortlist of qualified matches, helping you spend less time searching and focus on choosing the right talent for your project.
  • Learn more about Mira.
    • Enter keywords in the search bar at the top of the homepage and click Search.
    • Even if you are just visiting Fiverr, you can enter the service you are looking for and search without the need to log in.
    • Fiverr suggests popular searches to help you refine your query (e.g., searching “logo” might suggest “logo design”).
  • Categories and subcategories: Use the navigation bar to browse through categories and subcategories related to your project. This helps narrow down your results and find relevant freelancers.
  • Filters: Once you have your search results, use the filters at the top of the page to refine them further. This allows you to filter by factors like budget, delivery time, freelancer level, and more.
  • As you apply filters, you will see them listed above the marketplace. Click the (X) to remove.

Search filters

  • Tailor your Fiverr experience to your liking. Choose your preferred language, explore service options from subscriptions to paid video consultations, and utilize various tools to specify what exactly you want included in your chosen service.
  • Connect with the perfect freelancer. Filter by freelancer tiers reflecting experience, availability, and even spoken language based on their location. Find someone who aligns with your needs and, perhaps, your time zone.
  • Decide your asking price right away. You can set a range based on your specific price point and have the flexibility to adjust it later for specific projects.
  • Whether you need express delivery in 24 hours or a timeline tailored to your project’s complexity, find freelancers who guarantee on-time completion.

More ways to find talent

  • Hire domain experts to source, vet, and interview top freelancers on your behalf, delivering a comparison report of the best candidates for a flat fee.
  • Get started by visiting the Domain Expert Sourcing Landing Page.
  • Do you have a high budget or a complex need, and want to ensure your project is in the right hands? Your most important and urgent projects require time, industry skills, and the right team of freelancers. The goal of our project management service is to help your team or business plan and execute a project end-to-end effortlessly.
  • Learn more about our project management service here.

I found a freelancer I like, what happens next?

We recommend communicating with the freelancer before the purchase, to ensure that all questions, requirements, and concerns are addressed prior to any transaction taking place.

Connect directly with your chosen freelancer to kickstart your project:

  • Get a quote: Communicate with freelancers about your specific delivery timeframe. This helps them provide a tailored quote directly to your inbox.
  • Ask a question: Ask your potential freelancer a question or share your project details (requirements, timeline, budget, scope). The more questions you ask to gather all information, the better suited you’ll be to choose the right freelancer for the job.
  • Book a consultation: Schedule a call with potential freelancers before hiring to align on project goals and specific needs for a smooth collaboration. Learn more about booking a consultation here.

Best practices

  • Communicate with the freelancer before you order to confirm questions, requirements, and concerns. You can click Contact me to send the freelancer a message.
  • Use filters such as budget and delivery time to narrow your results and find the right match faster.
  • If you cannot find the right service, post a project brief to receive tailored offers from relevant freelancers.

FAQs

  • Yes. You can search for services on the homepage even if you are not logged in to Fiverr.
  • No. After a freelancer replies with a quote, you can decline it or continue to order.
  • Apply the filters at the top of your results page. You can set your preferred budget, delivery time, language, location, and other freelancer details to refine your results. Filters vary depending on the Gig category or subcategory.
  • You can post a project brief. Our brief creation process helps you generate a professional project brief with the help of AI, and relevant freelancers send you tailored offers to choose from.

Submitting a brief to connect with a freelancer

A clear project brief is essential for success, as it defines the scope, goals, deliverables, budget, and timeline, ensuring alignment and smooth communication. On Fiverr Pro, you can send a brief directly to the freelancer you want to work with, helping kick off the conversation with clarity from the start.

Professional Briefing tool

  • What it does: Uses AI to help you complete and organize project requirements in seconds that you can send directly to the freelancer from their freelancer page.
  • Why it’s useful: Empowers freelancers with the knowledge necessary to deliver impactful results that meet and exceed expectations from the start.
  • Who it’s for: Fiverr Pro clients looking for an efficient way to communicate with the freelancer.

Before you begin

  • Eligibility: Available for Fiverr Pro clients.
  • Navigation: Accessed by clicking the Contact me button on a freelancer’s profile or Gig page.

Functionality & behavior

  • Instant brief creation: Enter high-level project needs, and the system automatically completes and organizes the brief.
  • Personalized recommendations: The tool incorporates additional details based on the freelancer’s past client experiences to ensure a better match.
  • Brief repurposing: You can reuse your own briefs or those created by your account members across multiple freelancers directly from the Inbox.
  • Professional Briefing vs. Job Post feature: The Personalized Brief feature allows you to send detailed project requirements directly to specific freelancers you’ve already identified, helping start a focused, one-to-one conversation. In contrast, a Job Post is used to create a brief that’s shared with relevant freelancers, who can then reach out to the client to express interest.

How to use the professional briefing tool

  • Go to the freelancer’s profile and click the Contact me button.
  • Describe your needs, including a summary of the project overview, goals, budget, and timeline.
  • Click Generate your brief.
  • Review the AI-generated brief and edit any details as needed.
  • Click Send.

To send a regular message instead of a professional brief to the freelancer, click on Ask a question at the bottom of the window.

How to reuse or manage briefs
  • To reuse a brief: Click Contact me > Create a brief, and select from your or your team’s list of saved briefs to quickly share details with new freelancers.
  • To delete a brief: Click the Trash icon in the lower-right corner of the brief.

FAQs

  • Yes, you and your team are able to view any existing or past briefs created within the Pro account.
  • Previously created briefs can be accessed by clicking the Contact me button and then clicking Create a brief on the message window.
  • Yes, all previously created briefs will appear in each category selection.
  • Reusing professional briefs saves time and ensures consistency when you need to share the same project details with multiple freelancers.

Subscription orders for clients (Pro clients: Orders)

With subscriptions, you can plan ahead and book repeat orders with freelancers you love working with, saving you time on future orders. Working with a freelancer who understands both your needs and brand saves you the hassle of having to place the same order and send requirements every time.

Before you begin

Subscriptions allow you to maintain a long-term working relationship with a freelancer for up to a 6-month period. Depending on the time period chosen, the same order is automatically billed from your saved payment method.

Subscription orders work best for clients who want consistent delivery for recurring projects.

  • Subscriptions are only available in certain subcategories and to select freelancers.
  • Only Gigs with packages exceeding $10 and a maximum of 30 days delivery are eligible.
  • Voice Over Gigs may start their word count at $5.

You cannot use the milestone feature and subscriptions simultaneously within the same order.

How subscriptions work

Each order in a subscription is independent. The next order will begin regardless of the previous one’s status unless the subscription is canceled.

- Default payment method: The method charged will be your default payment method at the time of purchase, which may differ from the original method used.
- Required payment method: Without a saved payment method, the next order can’t be processed.
- Payment notifications: You will receive an email to add a payment method for your next purchase.
- Failed payments: If your payment fails or is paid later than scheduled, the following orders will be pushed to the new billing date.
  • An order can’t be force-started before its scheduled date.
  • Freelancers can offer discounts on upcoming orders when you subscribe to their Gig.
    • Gig packages: Discounts are only available for subscriptions ordered through a Gig package.
    • Application: If offered, the discount is applied from the second order onwards.
    • Visibility: You can see the offered discounts in the “Choose your plan” section.
  • If you need more flexibility than a standard Gig package provides, you can ask your freelancer to create a custom offer.
    • Custom intervals: Through custom offers, freelancers can set any interval, including daily, weekly, biweekly, or monthly.
    • Updating requirements: You can update your requirements for each order as needed. If your requirements change, let the freelancer know at the start of the order; they can charge for extra requirements on the order page if necessary.
    • If you order a subscription via a custom offer, the freelancer cannot offer a subscription discount.

Ordering and cancelling a subscription

- Go to the freelancer's Gig page.
- Navigate to the Choose your plan section.
- Select the subscription period that best suits your needs.
- Review any available discounts and click Order.
  • You can cancel future orders at any time to end your subscription.
    • Navigate to the Order page.
    • Select the Subscription tab.
    • Click the three dots (…) dropdown menu.
    • Select End subscription.
    • In the pop-up window, choose a reason for ending the subscription and confirm.

FAQs

  • Currently, only select freelancers may offer subscriptions. To ensure that you receive a quality experience, freelancers’ eligibility is evaluated according to pre-established criteria that are based on external and internal business metrics, alongside quality metrics.
  • You will be able to communicate any new requirements as needed from the order page. We suggest buying a base package that meets most of your needs and let your freelancer know how your requirements change per order.
  • Gigs can now be offered for up to a 6-month subscription basis.
  • Currently, you can only order a subscription through the Gig page. You can also ask a freelancer to send you a subscriptions custom offer (which is more flexible).
  • Yes, you can cancel future orders.
  • Freelancers will be able to cancel future orders up to 10 days before the next order is meant to start.
  • It’s up to the freelancer to decide if a discount will be offered. If a discount is offered, it will be applied to the second order.
  • Yes, you can update your requirements for each order and adjust your order as needed. Let the freelancer know how your requirements differ from the original order at the start of each order, and they will be able to charge you extra if needed.
  • Currently, subscriptions are only available in certain subcategories, and to selected freelancers.
  • No, you cannot use both the milestone feature and subscriptions simultaneously within the same order.

Using the Resolution Center (Pro clients: Orders)

The Resolution Center is an essential tool that helps you resolve requests and manage active orders with ease. Whether you’re a freelancer dealing with project scope changes or a client seeking updates, this tool provides a streamlined way to address concerns directly with the other party.

Overview

The Resolution Center allows users to resolve order-related inquiries without the need to contact Customer Support. Once a request is submitted, it is sent directly to the other party, who has 48 hours to accept or decline.

Note: You can withdraw your request before it’s accepted or declined.

If the request submitted in the Resolution Center isn’t accepted or declined within 48 hours, the system will automatically accept it.

Before you begin

  • The Resolution Center is unavailable for orders that are already completed or canceled.
  • Orders that are waiting for requirements or are very late (24 hours past the expected delivery time) can be canceled by the client without the freelancer’s approval.
  • We recommend communicating with the other party before opening a request to reach an amicable solution.

How to use the Resolution Center

To access the Resolution Center:

  • Navigate to the Orders section from your dashboard.
  • Select the specific order you want to manage and click View.
  • Click Resolution Center located on the right side of the page.
  • Select the option available to you in the Resolution Center.
  • Fill in the details and submit your request.

Client options

Use these features to stay informed or end a project that no longer meets your needs.

  • If you need to confirm details or check progress before completion, use this option to prompt a response.
    • Select Get an order update from the action menu.
    • Submit your request to the freelancer.
  • If requirements change or expectations aren’t met, you can request an amicable cancellation.
    • Select Cancel order.
    • Add your comments and submit the request.
  • Important: If there is already an open request for a delivery extension or update, you must withdraw it before you can request a cancellation.

Freelancer options

Use these features to maintain your performance metrics and manage client expectations.

  • A delivery date extension allows you to set a new delivery date if you can’t meet the original timeframe.
    • The time is added to the original delivery date, not the current date: Keep this in mind when calculating how much time you will need to deliver.
    • You can add up to 60 days to each request.
  • To request an extension:
    • Click Extend delivery date located under the Deliver now button on the order page.
    • Add how many days you need to deliver.
    • Add a note to the client explaining your decision.
    • Click Send Request.
  • A partial refund is appropriate for changes in project scope, compensation for delays, or minor dissatisfaction.
    • Select Offer a partial refund in the Resolution Center.
    • Enter the amount (up to 60% of the original price).
    • Provide a clear explanation and select a reason from the dropdown menu (this reason remains confidential).
    • Click Send offer.
  • Important: If accepted, your performance metrics are not affected. However, you can’t make further refund requests on the same order.
  • Learn more with Partial refunds.
  • Request this if the project scope has changed significantly or if you are unable to complete the work.
    • Select the reason and provide an explanation.
    • Click Cancel order.
  • Canceled orders can affect your earnings, performance metrics, and search visibility.
  • Learn more with the following Help Center articles:
    • Using the Resolution Center.
    • How disputes work.

FAQs

  • No, requests in the Resolution Center are sent directly to the other party and can be viewed on the Order page. Customer Support is not notified of these requests.
  • If a freelancer is late with their delivery and no mutual agreement was made to extend the delivery date, you can cancel the order 24 hours after the expected delivery time without the freelancer’s approval.
  • No, the Resolution Center is unavailable for orders that have already been completed or canceled.
  • Both freelancers and clients have up to 48 hours to accept or decline a request or cancellation request.
  • You can’t open a new request if there is already an open request for the same order, which addresses issues such as delivery extensions, updates, or cancellations. You must first withdraw the current request on the Orders page, then open a new one.
  • If the client accepts a partial refund offer, the refund is processed, and your order performance metrics will not be affected.
  • No, once a partial refund has been accepted, you can’t request further refunds for that same order. However, if the initial offer for the partial refund was declined, you can send a new one.

Pro clients: Payments & finances

Coupons, promo codes and discounts (Pro clients: Payments & finances)

There are a few different ways to save on Fiverr: freelancer coupons sent directly to you by a freelancer, promo codes issued by Fiverr, and first-time client promotions offered on individual Gigs. This article explains each one and how to use them.

Freelancer coupons

Freelancer coupons are discounts that Seller Plus freelancers send directly to clients they’ve worked with before. There are two types:

  • Repeat client coupons: Sent through Fiverr’s notifications system. Valid for 30 days.

  • Custom offer coupons: Attached to a custom offer. Valid for 24 hours.

  • When a freelancer sends you a repeat client coupon, you’ll receive an email and an in-app notification.

    • Click the email or notification to go to the freelancer’s Gig or profile page.
    • A banner on the page shows your discount.
    • When you place your order, the coupon is automatically applied on the payment page.

  • On the payment page, you can continue and pay with the coupon applied, or choose to remove it. If you remove the coupon, Fiverr will hold onto it so you can use it on a future order.

  • If a freelancer sends you a custom offer with a coupon attached, the discount is applied automatically. All you need to do is accept the offer before it expires (within 24 hours).

Freelancer coupon terms
  • The coupon is personal and non-transferable. Only the client who received it can use it.
  • On Fiverr Pro accounts, only the team member who placed the order can use the coupon; other team members on the same account cannot.
  • Coupons only apply to orders of $15 or more.
    • One coupon per order. You cannot stack coupons.
    • Coupons cannot be combined with Fiverr Credits, promo codes, first-time client promotions, or any other discount.
    • Coupons cannot be used when leaving a tip.
    • For milestone orders, the discount applies to the first milestone only.
    • For subscription orders, the discount applies to the first payment only.
  • If an order placed with a coupon is cancelled for any reason, the coupon becomes invalid and cannot be reused or replaced.

Promo codes

Promo codes are issued by Fiverr as part of promotions and campaigns. If you received a promo code, you can apply it during checkout.

How to apply a promo code
  • Find the Gig you want and go to the Order page.
  • Customize your order and proceed to Payment.
  • In the Summary section, enter your promo code, click Apply, then click Confirm & Pay.

Promo codes must be entered manually. If you don’t click Apply before completing the payment, the code will not be added to your order.

Promo code terms
  • You can only apply one promo code per order. Codes cannot be stacked.
    • Promo codes can only be used when paying with an external payment method, such as a credit card or PayPal.
    • Promo codes cannot be combined with Fiverr Credits. If your Fiverr Balance fully covers the order amount, adding a promo code will produce an error. If your balance only partially covers the order, the discount applies to the remaining amount charged to your card or PayPal.
    • Promo codes must be applied before completing payment. They cannot be added to an order that has already been placed.
  • Individual promo codes may have an expiry date, apply only to certain order types (such as Pro orders), or require a minimum order amount.
  • Check the details of your specific code before using it.
If your promo code isn’t working
  • Make sure you clicked Apply after entering the code. Clicking Confirm & Pay without clicking Apply first will not add the code to your order.
  • This usually means the code was entered incorrectly. Check for extra spaces before or after the code, or missing characters at the end.
  • Promo codes have expiry dates. If your code has passed its expiry, it can no longer be used.
  • To verify if your code expired you can check:
    • The original email or notification you received when the code was issued.
    • The checkout page. If the code is expired, entering it will show an error.
  • If you received a promo code from a site that is not Fiverr, you’ll need to contact that site directly. Fiverr cannot help with codes issued by third-party or affiliate websites.
  • Banners don’t disappear automatically. Click the X on the banner to close it manually.

First-time client promotions

Some freelancers offer a special discount to clients who have never ordered from them before.

  • How to find one: If a freelancer is running a promotion, you’ll see a pop-up on their Gig page showing the discount, expiry date, and any other details.
  • How it’s applied: The discounted price is applied to your order automatically.
  • Eligible orders: Gig orders of $15 or more only. Does not apply to custom offers.
  • Early end: Some promotions may end before their listed expiry date.

First-time client promotions cannot be combined with freelancer coupons, promo codes, or any other discounted rates.

FAQs

  • No. Freelancer coupons and promo codes cannot be combined with each other or with any other discount or promotion.
  • Fiverr will hold onto the coupon so you can use it on a future order before it expires.
  • For freelancer coupons: the coupon becomes invalid and cannot be reused or replaced if an order is cancelled. For promo codes: if your order was cancelled, contact Customer Support, we may be able to assist depending on your eligibility.
  • No. Promo codes must be applied before completing payment. They cannot be added to orders that are already in progress.
  • If your Fiverr Balance covers the full order amount, you won’t be able to add a promo code, it will show an error. If your balance only partially covers the order, the promo code discount applies to the remaining amount you pay with a card or PayPal.
  • No. Only one promo code can be applied per order.
  • Promo codes from third-party or affiliate websites are managed by those sites, not by Fiverr. You’ll need to contact the third-party site directly for help.
  • No. First-time client promotions cannot be combined with freelancer coupons, promo codes, or any other discounted rates.

Deferred payments

Deferred Payments is a credit-based payment method offered through our third-party partner, Balance. This payment method lets you consolidate your business expenses and pay for your orders later, helping you manage complex internal billing processes with a simplified monthly summary.

This payment option is presently limited and is not available to all Fiverr Pro clients within the United States.

Overview

Deferred Payments allows you to make purchases and pay for them 30 days after the month ends. For example, if you purchase a service on June 1st, you will be charged on July 31st.

This feature is designed for businesses in Fiverr Pro that:

  • Prefer fewer billing transactions.
  • Have complex internal approval or payment flows.
  • Do not always have easy access to credit cards or PayPal.

This option is currently available only to Fiverr Pro clients located in the United States who are subscribed to the Advanced plan. For more details, see our guide on the Fiverr Pro Subscription plans.

Before you begin

  • Role Requirements: Only Admin and Billing Managers can initiate the application for a credit line.
  • Requesting this option: To request deferred payments, contact your Business Success Manager.
  • Currency: If your display currency is not USD, the purchase must still be paid in USD.
  • Alternative Payments: You must have at least one alternative payment method saved to your account before you can disable Deferred Payments.

Functionality & behavior

  • Credit Line: Approved accounts receive a credit line of up to $50,000 USD. No hard credit inquiry is performed during the application process.
  • Team Usage: Team members can use this method if an Admin or Billing Manager sets it as the default payment option.
  • Default Status: Once activated, Deferred Payments becomes your default payment method. You can change this in your settings at any time.
  • Invoicing: You will receive one simplified email summary at the beginning of each month containing all invoices from the previous month.
  • Order Cancellations: If an order is canceled before you pay the monthly invoice, the credit is returned to your credit line. If canceled after payment, funds are returned to your Fiverr Pro Balance.

How to use Deferred Payments

Requesting access

  • Click your Profile Picture and select Account plan.
  • Scroll to Explore all Advanced plan features by goals.
  • Under the Payment & savings section, click Contact BSM (Business Success Manager) to request the feature.

Applying for a credit line

  • Once enabled for your account, click your Profile Picture > Billing & payments > Payment methods.
  • Navigate to the Deferred payments section.
  • Click Start application and follow the instructions in the pop-up window.
  • After approval, click Activate deferred payments to begin using the credit line.

Paying your invoices

  • You can pay via the monthly email sent by our partner, Balance, by connecting your account.
  • Alternatively, go to Billing & payments > Payment methods.
  • Click Pay outstanding invoices to be redirected to the payment portal. Payments are typically made via ACH (direct transfer).

Disabling or reactivating

  • To disable: Go to the Payment methods tab, click the 3 dots next to Deferred Payments, and select Disable.
  • To reactivate: Go to the Payment methods tab, click the 3 dots, and select Enable.

Troubleshooting & best practices

  • Application Status: If your application is “Pending,” it is still being reviewed by Balance. If it is “Suspended,” you likely have overdue outstanding invoices that must be paid to restore service.
  • Denied Applications: If your application is denied, you may reapply after a 90-day waiting period.
  • Support: For specific questions regarding your credit line or the Balance portal, contact support@getbalance.com.

The evaluation process utilizes Balance’s services (Balance terms & conditions), and its criteria are subject to change. The decision is dynamic and may be altered based on additional internal factors. No hard inquiry will be conducted during this process.

FAQs

  • You can request this payment method by contacting your Business Success Manager (BSM). This option is currently available for United States-based Fiverr Pro clients who are subscribed to the Advanced plan.
  • After completing the registration, you will receive an activation email from Balance.
  • Your application is approved via Balance. You will receive an activation email from Balance after the review is complete. Balance support: support@getbalance.com.
  • If your credit line application is denied, you must undergo a waiting period before resubmitting.
  • Your credit line application does not involve a hard inquiry. For detailed information, please contact Balance directly.
  • To streamline the process of connecting your bank accounts, we’ve partnered with Plaid, a financial data platform that supports a vast network of US banks. Balance utilizes Plaid’s secure connection to retrieve your bank account information. For a comprehensive list of supported financial institutions, please visit plaid.com. As an alternative, you can manually upload your financial statements for manual processing.
  • The credit amount is determined through an approval process, where you may be granted a credit line of up to $50,000 USD.
  • Balance will send you a monthly email with your invoices at the beginning of each month. You’ll be able to pay them directly through the email by connecting your account. All invoices will be available under the Billing and payments section.
  • Pay your deferred payment invoices through the Balance portal. You can also look for the “Pay outstanding invoices” link under the deferred payments section.

Depositing funds into your Fiverr Pro account

Depositing funds into your Fiverr Pro balance allows you to manage your budget upfront and streamline your team’s purchasing process. This feature helps you avoid multiple small charges on your payment methods and prevents potential payment issues during checkout.

Overview

Fiverr Pro admins and billing managers can deposit funds directly into a shared team balance. These funds are used to pay for orders placed by the team, ensuring a smoother procurement workflow.

  • What it does: Allows you to pre-fund your account using credit cards or bank transfers.
  • Why it’s useful: Consolidates payments into larger, manageable deposits and ensures funds are ready for immediate project starts.
  • Who it’s for: This payment option is exclusively for Fiverr Pro admins and billing managers.

Before you begin

  • Eligibility: You must be an admin or have admin billing capabilities to make deposits.
  • Minimum amount: The minimum deposit amount is $1,000 USD or the equivalent in your local currency.
  • Account activity: Funds become unavailable if an account remains inactive for 2 years and 9 months. If this occurs, contact Customer Support to retrieve the funds.

Functionality & behavior

When you deposit funds, they are held in your Fiverr Pro balance until they are used for a purchase.

  • Fees & taxes: We do not charge a service fee for making a deposit, and no government taxes are taken from the deposit amount. However, we do not cover external fees charged by your bank, and currency exchange fees apply if you deposit in a currency other than USD.
  • Receipts vs. Invoices: We issue a proforma receipt for the deposit itself. Official invoices are issued for each individual order purchase per request.
  • Manual Review: Bank and wire transfers require our payments team’s manual review before the funds appear in your balance.

Deposit method comparison

Feature

Credit Card

Bank/Wire Transfer

Processing Time

Immediate

3–5 business days

Maximum Limit

May be limited by your bank

No maximum limit

Confirmation

Immediate update in the balance

Email confirmation sent after processing

Availability

Availability depends on your global location.

Available options depend on your global location and selected currency:

  • USA (USD): Automated Clearing House (ACH)
  • Eurozone (EUR): Single Euro Payments Area (SEPA)
  • UK (GBP): Bankers Automated Clearing Services (BACS)
  • Worldwide (USD): SWIFT wire transfer

How to deposit funds

  • Go to the Billing & payments page.
  • Select the Deposit funds option.
  • Enter the amount you wish to deposit (minimum $1,000 USD).
  • Select your preferred deposit method:
    • Credit Card: Enter your card details and click Make a deposit. Your balance will update immediately.
    • Bank/Wire Transfer: Enter your business name, website, contact person, and email address. Click Next to view the bank details.
  • If using a bank transfer, complete the transaction through your bank using the provided details.

Best practices

  • Add your email: Always provide your email address during the bank transfer process to ensure you receive your transfer confirmation and bank details.
  • Check local support: Ensure your chosen transfer method (like ACH in the USA or SEPA in the Eurozone) matches your business location to avoid delays.
  • Plan ahead: Since wire transfers can take up to 5 business days, make deposits well in advance of urgent project deadlines.

FAQs

  • Eligibility for credit card deposits is determined by automated security requirements to prevent fraud. If the option is not visible, please use the available bank or wire transfer methods.
  • No, PayPal is currently not available for direct deposits into the Fiverr Pro balance.
  • If your funds have not appeared after 5 business days, please contact Customer Support with your proof of payment for review.

Downloading, updating, and troubleshooting your Fiverr invoices (Pro clients: Payments & finances)

We automatically issue an invoice for every paid order, so you can track your purchases and, depending on your country, use them for tax and accounting purposes. There is nothing you need to set up; your invoices are ready to download as soon as an order is paid. This article explains who receives invoices, what they include, how to download them, and how to solve common access issues.

Before you begin

  • Clients receive an invoice for every payment they make. Freelancers, see Who receives invoices below for details on what applies to you.
  • Invoices can only be downloaded from the Fiverr website on a desktop or laptop. They are not available in the mobile app.
  • You can find your invoices under your profile image > Billing and Payments > Billing History.
  • On Fiverr Pro and organization accounts, only Admins and Billing Managers can access and download invoices.
  • No invoice is issued for orders paid entirely with Fiverr Credits, referral funds, funds added by Fiverr, deposits, or promotional funds.

Who receives invoices

  • Clients receive an invoice for every payment they make on Fiverr, and a credit invoice is issued for order cancellations.
  • Freelancers do not receive invoices for completed orders (see Earnings documents for freelancers for tax documentation), but do receive invoices for Fiverr services they pay for, such as Seller Plus and Fiverr Ads.
  • We do not issue invoices for the percentage deducted from your earnings. This commission is automatically withheld before your revenue is released.

Leaving or not leaving a tip does not affect invoice availability. If a payment was billed, its invoice appears in your Billing History.

Types of invoices

We issue original invoices, credit invoices, and receipts.

Document

When it is issued

Invoice

We issue this to you each time you make a payment. Invoice numbers start with FI.

Credit invoice

We issue this to you when an order is canceled, including partial refunds. Credit invoice numbers start with FC and include a reference to the original invoice number.

Receipt

We issue this when you deposit funds into your Pro account. Receipts are issued for Fiverr Pro only. Receipts include the transfer method used, the date of deposit, and the total amount.

  • Multiple payments: We issue an invoice for each payment. If you paid for an order, then added extras, and then added a tip, you will receive three invoices, one for each transaction.
  • Split payments: If you pay with multiple payment methods, for example a Fiverr balance supplemented with a credit card, the invoice lists the payment methods used.
  • Israeli tax invoices: These are the same as regular invoices but also contain the ITA allocation number generated by the Israel Tax Authority, as required by law.

Funds credited to your Fiverr balance before January 1, 2019, do not have a credit invoice.

What your invoice includes

  • The date the invoice was issued.
  • A clickable order number.
  • The name of the service, the quantity, each unit’s price, and the total amount.
  • The payment methods used. Only the payment method’s name is shown, for example credit card or PayPal. The last four digits of a card are never shown.
  • A tax disclaimer, if relevant.
  • Your billing information. By default, all document types include your username and country. To include your full name, company name, complete address, and tax ID, add those details to your billing info page.
  • For Hourly orders, the number of hours worked. Hourly orders require billing information to be filled out before payment.

Invoice currency

  • The currency shown on the invoice is the one used to pay for your order.
  • Purchases made with earned revenue are invoiced in USD.
  • For Fiverr Pro balance deposits, the receipt is in the original deposit currency, and invoices for purchases made with that balance are issued in USD.
  • You cannot change the currency in invoices that have already been issued. If you update your currency selection, the new currency appears only on future invoices.

To update your currency selection:

  • Log in and go to your profile picture.
  • Click the currency icon (USD$) and select your preferred currency.

How to download your invoices

  • Log in to your account on a desktop browser.
  • Click your profile image > Billing and Payments.
  • Open the Billing History tab to see all paid orders.
  • Click PDF next to the relevant invoice to download it.

You can also:

  • Filter or search your invoices.
  • Select multiple invoices using the checkboxes, then download a CSV report or a ZIP file of PDFs.
  • Access your Billing History from the order page by clicking View billing history.

We cannot combine multiple invoices into a single PDF file.

Invoices issued before May 2021

Invoices issued before May 2021 are not available to download online. To obtain an earlier invoice, contact Customer Support.

Get your invoices by email

On your billing information page, check the box at the bottom to automatically receive your invoices by email. The email contains a link to the invoice, not an attachment.

If a download link sent by email has expired, you can always re-download the invoice from Billing and Payments > Billing History.

Updating your billing information

  • Go to your Billing information page.

  • Update your full name, address, country, and, if relevant, your company name and tax ID.

  • You will be prompted to add your billing information when making your first order on Fiverr. You can also add or edit it on the checkout page using the Add details button before paying.

  • Only new invoices include your updated billing information. Previously issued invoices remain unchanged.

  • If you need an existing invoice updated with your new billing details, first update your billing information, then contact Customer Support with the FI invoice number you want to change. Credit invoices (FC) cannot be reissued.

  • You cannot customize invoice content. You cannot add, remove, or change the service name, currency, or other details.

Why your billing information is important

Taxes, where relevant, are applied based on the billing information you’ve entered, since tax rates depend on your location. For details on how taxes are calculated for your region, see Taxes on purchases.

Requesting a VAT refund

If you are a freelancer based in Israel, you can request a VAT refund from Fiverr (MaaM tax refund).

To request a VAT refund:

  • Issue a tax invoice to Fiverr that includes the following information:
    • Date
    • Invoice number
    • Amount withdrawn, in ILS, or in both ILS and USD. VAT refunds are processed in ILS only, so the currency on the invoice must match.
    • The USD to ILS exchange rate used, since the platform operates in USD
    • The order numbers the invoice covers
    • The amount reflecting earnings before taxes withheld by the Fiverr platform
    • 17% VAT added on top of the withdrawal amount
    • Digital signature (optional)
    • Valid withheld tax document and Bookkeeping Certificate
    • Bank details confirmed in English
  • Send the invoice to support@fiverr.com, or mail it to Fiverr International Ltd., 8 Kaplan Street, Tel Aviv 6473409, Israel.
  • Submit the following supporting documents:
    • אישור ניכוי מס במקור (approval for withholding tax)
    • A copy of a check, or an official bank confirmation that the account exists
    • אישור על ניהול ספרים (approval of bookkeeping)
  • These documents can be copies. You do not need to send originals.

We send refunded VAT by wire transfer.

Note: This process is only available to freelancers based in Israel. Fiverr does not issue VAT refunds to freelancers outside Israel.

Troubleshooting invoice access

If you see access errors, blank pages, or files that will not download, check the following:

  • Check the following account and permissions issues:
    • Confirm you are logged in to the correct Fiverr account.
    • If you see a permission or authorization error on a Pro account, you are likely not the Admin or Billing Manager. Ask your Admin to assign you the Billing Manager role.
    • If your Billing History is empty and you only offer services on Fiverr, this is expected. Only payments generate invoices.
  • Check the following browser and device issues:
    • Use a desktop or laptop. The mobile app does not support downloading invoices.
    • Disable VPNs, ad blockers, and browser extensions.
    • Try an incognito or private window.
    • Clear your browser cache and cookies, then retry.
    • Try another browser or another device, and a different internet connection if possible.
  • Check the following billing settings and order status issues:
    • Make sure your billing information is completed in Billing and Payments > Billing settings.
    • Verify the order was placed and paid. If there is no completed charge, no invoice is generated.
    • If your invoices were reissued after updating your billing details, download the updated versions directly from Billing History.
  • If you are still stuck, contact Customer Support and include:
    • Your Fiverr username and registered email.
    • The order number.
    • The amount, currency, and charge date.
    • A screenshot or screen recording of the error, preferably from an incognito window.
