Fixing a failed or duplicate payment (Pro clients: Payments & finances)

If your payment fails or you notice you were charged more than once, this article explains why it might have happened and what you can do about it. You’ll find common reasons payments fail, steps to resolve them, and what to do if you’re charged twice.

Before you begin

  • This applies to any payment on Fiverr, whether you’re paying for an order, a subscription, or another purchase.
  • If you plan to contact us about a failed or duplicate payment, have your account email, payment method details, and Fiverr order number ready. This speeds up the process.

Reasons your payment might fail

  • If a card payment doesn’t go through, your bank may show a temporary pending charge from the authorization request. We cancel this authorization on our end, and your bank releases the funds back to your card, usually within 2 to 7 days. This isn’t a refund, since we never charged you, it’s your bank releasing funds it had reserved.
  • If a PayPal payment doesn’t go through, PayPal releases the funds it held for the transaction. Contact PayPal directly if you need more details.
  • This is the most common reason a payment fails.
  • Your card issuer or bank may not support international payments, may not support your card type, or may flag the transaction as suspicious because it’s going to a company in another country.
  • A mistyped card number, expiration date, security code, or billing ZIP code stops the payment from going through.
  • Some transactions require an extra security step, called 3D Secure, that your bank adds to confirm it’s really you. If you don’t complete this step, the payment won’t go through.
  • If you try to pay more than once in a short time, we, or your bank, may treat the extra attempts as duplicates and decline them.

We can’t troubleshoot issues on your bank’s side. If your bank declines a payment, contact them directly for details.

What to do if your payment fails

  • Double-check your card number, expiration date, security code, and ZIP code, if required.
  • Confirm your card is valid and hasn’t expired.
  • Make sure you haven’t exceeded your card’s limit.
  • Contact your bank to confirm you can make payments to international companies.

Troubleshooting payment issues

  • If you paid by credit card, contact your credit card company to check for issues with your account.
  • If you paid by PayPal, contact PayPal to ask why the payment failed.
  • If you used a credit card, try PayPal instead. If you used PayPal, try a credit card that isn’t linked to the same bank.
  • If you only tried once, try again. Start the checkout process from the beginning. Don’t click your browser’s back button or refresh the page.

If you’ve tried all of these options and your payment still doesn’t go through, contact Customer Support.

What to do if you were charged twice

A payment can go through more than once because:

  • Your connection may have dropped during checkout, or you clicked your browser’s back button or refreshed the page. Avoid doing this during checkout.
  • You clicked the payment button more than once. When this happens, the payment processor sometimes approves multiple attempts, which charges your card twice.

If you were billed more than once, contact Customer Support. To speed up the process, have the following ready:

  • Have the following ready:
    • Your username and email
    • PayPal transaction ID
    • Amount of the purchase
    • If two orders were created, the Fiverr order number, starting with “FO,” or a note that no order was created.
  • Have the following ready:
    • Your username and email
    • First 6 digits of the card
    • Last 4 digits of the card
    • Amount and date of the purchase
    • If two orders were created, the Fiverr order number, starting with “FO,” or a note that no order was created.

For the full payment flow, including service fees and split payments, see Paying for orders, extras, or custom offers.

FAQs

  • When a card payment fails, we cancel the authorization. Your bank still shows this as pending until it releases the funds, usually within 2 to 7 days.
  • Double-check your card details, confirm your card hasn’t expired or exceeded its limit, and try a different payment method. If it still doesn’t work, contact Customer Support.
  • Contact Customer Support with your payment details and Fiverr order number, so we can look into it.
  • Yes. If you tried a credit card, try PayPal. If you tried PayPal, use a credit card that isn’t linked to the same bank.
  • To learn more about the payment methods Fiverr accepts, see Payment methods.

Managing payments and billing

Whether you’ve just kicked off your business or you’re scaling up, streamline all your Fiverr projects, teamwork, and finances into one productive workspace using Fiverr Pro.

Administration

On the Administration tab from the profile drop-down menu, the admin has access to their admin panel where they can see the following options: ‘Billing and payments’, ‘Policies’, ‘Account members’, and ‘Business details’.

They also have the option to:

  • Add an account name
  • Switch or cancel your Fiverr Pro plan

Clicking on “Business details” allows the admin to:

  • Add a business logo (public)
  • Add a business name (public)
  • Write “About your business”
  • Provide details about their organization type, business stage, number of employees, business industry, and business website.

Administrators can change this information at any time. Billing managers have access to invoicing (billing history and billing info tab) and to the Payment methods tab from their profile drop-down menu > Billing and payments.

Learn more about the admin role with Admins: Member account management and about member roles with Account Members.

Adding billing information

For Admins, to access your billing information:

  • Click on your profile picture > Administration> Billing and payments > Billing information.
  • Scroll to the bottom and complete the details required.

For Billing managers, to access your billing information:

  • Log in, click on your profile picture > Billing and payments > Billing information.
  • Scroll to the bottom and complete the required details.

Billing information from your check-out page

  1. Admins and billing managers have the option to add/edit the current billing information of the account from the checkout page itself.

  2. Members of an account that does not have billing information filled out will be prompted to send a request to the admin during the checkout process to have them complete the billing information section before the payment.

Billing page

Administrators can access their billing information, including their billing history, information, and payment methods from the drop-down menu under their profile picture. On the billing page, admins have access to the financial part of the account with billing information, billing history, and payment methods:

Billing history tab

In the billing history tab, you have the following options:

  • View the billing history
  • Options to sort by date, transaction, service, account member, currency, invoice, receipt, or order number
  • Download a PDF or a report of all or selected invoices

In the billing information tab, you have the option to:

  • Under billing information, admins and billing managers will be able to update the necessary billing details (name, business name, address, VAT number) for their invoices.

Adding a payment method

Payment methods tab

For admins, to access your payment methods and ongoing payments tab:

  • Click on your profile picture > Administration> Billing and payments > Payment method.
  • Scroll to the bottom and complete the required details.

For billing managers, to access your Payment method and ongoing payments tab:

  • Log in, click on your profile picture > Billing and payments > Payment method.
  • Scroll to the bottom and complete the required details.

Note: If no card is associated with the Pro account when a member tries to pay, the administrator will receive a notification that they are required to add a payment method. After they add the payment method, the member will receive another notification directing them to the checkout page so they can make the payment.

What is a service fee?

At checkout, a service fee is included to cover Fiverr’s administrative costs. You’ll be able to see and approve the final amount before you pay. This fee applies to every payment you make, so if your order involves multiple transactions like adding extras or tipping, each will have its own service fee. The standard service fee is 5.5% of the purchase price, and a $3.50 fee is added to orders under $200.

For more information, please refer back to our Payment Terms.

Ongoing payments tab

The administrator and billing manager can view their hourly and subscription payments along with the ability to view the following:

  • Service type: Hourly or subscription
  • Start date
  • The payment method attached to the ongoing payment
  • The currency used for payment
  • Payment status. (active or inactive)

Adding funds to your account balance

Add a deposit

For admins, to add a deposit:

  • Log in, click on your profile picture > Administrator > Billing and payments > Payment methods.
  • The administrator or billing manager can add deposits to their account balance by clicking on the + Deposit funds button.

For billing managers, to add a deposit:

  • Log in, click on your profile picture > Billing and payments > Payment methods.
  • The administrator or billing manager can add deposits to their account balance by clicking on the + Deposit funds button.

Note: The minimum is $1000 USD or the equivalent in non-USD currency.

Add a credit card

For admins to add a credit card:

  • Log in > click on your profile picture > Administrations > Billing and payments > Payment methods.
  • If previously defined, your saved credit card will be displayed. If not, click “Add a Payment method”, and enter your credit card details.
  • A window will pop up where you can select credit/debit card and enter the credit card details.

For billing managers, to add a credit card:

  • Log in > click on your profile picture > Billing and payments > Payment methods.
  • If previously defined, your saved credit card will be displayed. If not, click Add a Payment method, and enter your credit card details.
  • A window will pop up where you can select credit/debit card and enter the credit card details.

The administrator has the option to add a credit card and set the default payment on the checkout page by choosing the credit card and debit card option under Payment options.

Administrators can save their PayPal from the checkout page or from the Billing and payments > Payment methods page:

  • Click on + Add a new payment method.
  • A window will appear, prompting you to select a payment method. Choose “PayPal” from the list.
  • After selecting “PayPal”, you will be asked to provide your account details. If your PayPal account is not yet linked to a credit card, you’ll be guided to connect one during this process.
  • Upon completion, a new window will open, enabling you to save this and any additional payment methods for future transactions.

Note: Once a payment method is added by an administrator or billing manager, all members can use it.

Removing a saved payment method

Administrators and billing managers can manage saved payment methods by clicking on the three dots next to each method. From the menu, they can set a payment method as the default payment or remove it. This applies to all payment methods.

Order policy

Admins can create invite policies for all member roles who want to invite other members to the account.

  1. Setting up an order approval policy so orders over a decided amount require Admin approval

  2. Making a direct deposit to ensure only the deposited amount gets used (this is more fit for clients that are high spenders, setting up an order policy on your first offer)

Learn more with Admins: Member account management.

To add an order approval policy

  1. Log in > Click on your profile picture > Administration > Policies > Add Policy.

  2. Select the settings for the order approval:

  • Who it applies to
  • Billing manager or member
  • The order amount that requires admin approval
  • Additional message (optional)
  1. Click Create policy.
Order request and policies management

Once the admin has created the policy, they can view each member’s order requests and request history.

Members
Admins

If a member attempts to place an order that requires approval:

A pop-up window will appear, explaining to them that they’ll need to submit a request for approval of that order, and that they will not be able to place the order.

  1. When a member orders, the admins will receive a notification to approve or deny the request.

  2. Admins will then be notified that the order requires approval, and will be taken to the check-out page to review and complete the payment.

FAQs

  • What are my charges, and when are they applied?
  • You are only charged when you or one of your members places an order. No other charges are made when creating your Fiverr Pro account.
  • How do I keep activities between my Fiverr Pro account and my personal account separate?
  • Once your account becomes a Fiverr Pro account, you will no longer be able to place personal orders. To place personal orders, you would need to create a separate Fiverr account. However, if you merge your personal and Pro account, and you have pre-existing orders, you will see them under the orders menu under your profile picture or orders from your top dashboard.
  • Note: Members will be able to see high-level details on orders made with the Fiverr Pro account. Only you will have access to your personal order details.
  • Who can use the card I added?
  • Only the members you choose to invite to your account can use the payment card saved.
  • Can I set a limit for the amount spent by my Pro members?
  • You can set up an order policy, which requires Pro members to request authorization for all orders placed with the shared payment method, or request authorization for orders above a certain amount.
  • This is dependent on how you determine your settings in this section.
  • Who can see my billing information?
  • The billing information is visible only to the administrator and billing manager. The billing information will be used to create invoices on orders made with the Pro saved payment method and will be sent to the admin’s registered email address.
  • Can I use alternative payment methods for my Pro account (other than a credit card)?
  • Yes, you can add funds to your account (as described above). Please keep in mind that PayPal is available for orders, but isn’t supported for deposits.
  • How long does it take for my funds to appear in my account?
  • Usually, 3-5 business days, and is largely dependent on your bank. Fiverr Pro will deposit the account as soon as the funds are received.
  • How can my account use the saved payment card?
  • During the process of placing an order, members will reach the payment page and will be able to pay with the default payment method.
  • How can I receive invoices for my Fiverr Pro account?
  • An invoice is sent to the admin’s email address for every order using the business’s saved payment card. If you would like to get invoices with your business billing information, complete the details required under the billing information tab.If you are not the admin or billing manager of the account, please contact them to have them update the billing information
  • Why was my account balance used and not my other method of payment?
  • Account balance with funds to cover the amount of the order will always be used first before allowing a different method of payment.
  • Am I able to use PayPal?
  • Yes, PayPal is now available for Fiverr Pro.
  • Keep in mind that even though members might be able to see the PayPal option, only admins and billing managers are able to use this payment method. Learn more with PayPal.
  • Can I use the transferred funds for a single order?
  • Yes, you can use the transferred funds for your business needs as you see fit.
  • Will I still get invoices for the orders or only for the initial transfer?
  • You will get a receipt for your initial deposit and you will also receive an invoice for each order placed. This will be delivered through Fiverr consistent with all invoices. For more information, please see our article Settings, Payments & Billing.
  • Note: Only admins and billing managers have access to invoices, even if the member placed the order. If you are a member of a Fiverr Pro account, please ask the admin to send you the invoice you require or ask to be made a billing manager.
  • Who on the account receives the invoices?
  • The administrator and billing manager have the option to view and download invoices in bulk from the billing history tab.
  • What currency will appear on the invoice?
  • The invoice will show the currency that was used to make the payment.
  • Can I get the money back from my Pro balance?
  • Yes, however, any transfer costs incurred will be paid by the member.
  • Who can see the amount’s payment method and who is authorized to change it?
  • The administrator and billing manager can see the payment method and make changes to it.
  • Who can see the account’s balance and where does it appear?
  • Currently, the administrator can see the balance on the dashboard or under payment methods. The rest of the members can see this information on the checkout page.

Paying for orders, extras, or custom offers (Pro clients: Payments & finances)

When you order a service, add an extra, or accept a custom offer on Fiverr, you choose from several payment options and see exactly what you’ll pay before you confirm. This article walks you through the payment steps for a new order, an extra, a custom offer, and a subscription, so you know what to expect at checkout. It also covers how payments work behind the scenes, including service fees, split payments, and extra security checks.

Before you begin

You need a payment method available in your country. See Payment methods for the full list of options and where they’re available.

Some countries require extra information during checkout:

  • United States: zip code
  • Canada: billing information
  • Brazil: CNPJ number for businesses, or CPF number for individuals
  • Philippines: PSN (Philippine Identification System) number
  • India: PAN (Permanent Account Number)

If you’re paying for a subscription or another recurring program, you need to agree to automatic monthly renewal before you can complete the purchase.

How payments work for orders, extras, and custom offers

  • We add a service fee to your total at checkout to cover our administrative costs. You can review and approve this fee before you pay. The standard service fee is 5.5% of your purchase amount, and we add a $3.50 fee to orders under $200. Every payment you make carries its own service fee, so if your order involves multiple transactions, such as an extra or a tip, each one has a separate fee.
  • For some transactions, we may ask you to verify your payment with an extra security step. If this happens, choose to receive a verification code by phone or email, enter the code, and confirm it to complete your order.
  • You can combine Fiverr Credits, your Fiverr Balance, or your earnings with a payment provider to pay for an order. You cannot use more than one card in a single transaction, but you can use different cards for separate orders.
  • After your first payment for a subscription or recurring program, we use that same payment method for future payments, even if you have a different default payment method saved on your account.
  • Learn more about Subscription orders for clients.
  • If you’re using a custom offer or Gig package with milestones, we charge you for each milestone separately as you approve it and move to the next one. See Milestones for how milestone orders work.

Payment methods vary by country and device. See Payment methods for the full list of what’s available to you.

Sending a request to order

Some Gigs require you to send a request before you can place an order. If a Gig has this option, you’ll see a Request to order button instead of Continue on the Gig page.

  • Click Request to order on the Gig page.
  • Write a message describing your project and attach any relevant files.
  • Submit your request.

We send you a confirmation and show you the freelancer’s average response time. Once the freelancer approves your request, you can continue to payment.

Request to order isn’t available on all Gigs. If you don’t see this button, you can order directly, or message the freelancer with questions before you order. Repeat clients and clients who already received a custom offer from the freelancer can sometimes order directly without sending a request.

How to pay for an order

  • Once you find the service you want to order, click Continue.
  • Customize your order to fit your needs. You can add extra services or increase the quantity of what you’re ordering.
  • Click Continue. You’ll go to the payment options page, where you can choose your payment method. If you have a discount code, enter it here. On the right side of the page, you’ll see a breakdown of the price, taxes, and fees.
  • Click Confirm & pay. We’ll charge you and create your order page.

Increasing the quantity of your order doesn’t automatically adjust the delivery time frame. If you need to order a larger quantity, contact the freelancer to adjust the delivery time before you complete your purchase.

How to pay for an extra on an ongoing order

  • Go to your orders page, then click the order you want to add an extra to.
  • Open the order page.
  • You’ll find the available extras in both the Activity and Details tabs. Click + Add on the services you want to add.
  • Click Confirm order to purchase the extra.

Extras may change your order’s delivery time. Some extras, such as fast delivery, are unavailable after you place the main order. Others can only be purchased once per order, while some can be purchased multiple times.

How to pay for a custom offer

When a freelancer sends you a custom offer or a quote, click the button to complete the purchase.

If you’re purchasing the offer through an active order page, we credit the funds to that order. If it’s a new offer, we create a new order page.

How to pay for a subscription

Subscriptions are billed monthly. You can cancel anytime, but the cancellation takes effect at the end of your current billing cycle.

When you subscribe, mark the checkbox confirming that you understand your payment renews automatically every month.

This applies to Seller Plus, Team accounts, and other subscription orders.

How to pay for services on the mobile app

You can pay for services on the Fiverr mobile app using any of your available payment methods. See Payment methods for the full list of what’s available on mobile.

After your first purchase, we save your payment method so you don’t need to enter your details again for future orders.

Troubleshooting & best practices

If your payment doesn’t go through, see Payment troubleshooting for steps to resolve common payment issues.

FAQs, client

  • The service fee covers Fiverr’s administrative costs. It’s 5.5% of your purchase amount, plus $3.50 for orders under $200. You can review it before you confirm payment.
  • Yes. You can combine Fiverr Credits, your Fiverr Balance, or your earnings with a payment provider. You cannot use more than one card in a single transaction.
  • For some transactions, we ask you to complete an extra security step. Choose to receive a verification code by phone or email, then enter it to continue.
  • Depending on your country, yes. See Before you begin for the countries that require extra information at checkout.

FAQs, freelancer

This article covers the client payment flow. Freelancers don’t need to complete these steps to receive payment for their orders.

Price upfront: Clear and predictable pricing (Pro clients: Payments & finances)

Enjoy a more predictable shopping experience with transparent pricing that shows you exactly what you’ll pay from the start. We want to make your experience on Fiverr as transparent and reliable as possible. To help you browse with confidence, we have updated how prices are displayed in select regions so that the amount you see is the amount you pay.

Overview

Price upfront is a display enhancement that shows the final total price of a service before you reach the checkout page. This means the price you see while browsing now includes Fiverr service fees.

You will see the total cost of a service earlier in your journey, instead of at the last step of your purchase. When comparing different Gigs, the process is easier because all costs are already included in the listed price.

How does upfront pricing work?

When browsing Fiverr from certain regions, the price shown on Gig listings, search results, and custom offers is the “all-in” price. The amount includes the base service price plus Fiverr service.

While browsing or before pre-checkout, you will see short tooltips or messaging explaining that the price includes all required fees. The price you see while browsing matches what you pay at checkout.

Important: Prices in search results are rounded up. However, you will see the exact price once you enter the Gig page or go through the checkout process.

What this means for freelancers

If you are a freelancer, this update only changes how total prices are displayed to certain clients in certain regions.

  • How much you earn on each Gig does not change.
  • You continue to set your own Gig or hourly prices.
  • Your recommendation algorithm and ranking are not affected.
  • No action is required from you; Fiverr handles the calculation automatically based on the client’s location

All freelancers in specific regions are shown using the same price logic, ensuring a level playing field.

FAQs

  • No, because fees are now included earlier, the initial price may appear higher than before. However, since all Gigs in the applicable regions follow the same rules, the marketplace remains fair and competitive. Clients benefit from knowing the real cost immediately, which helps reduce drop-off at checkout.
  • No. This is strictly a display change and does not impact the recommendation algorithm or how Gigs are ranked in search results.

Refunds and chargebacks: What to expect (Pro clients: Payments & finances)

When your order is canceled on Fiverr, we credit the funds to your Fiverr balance by default. If you prefer to have the funds returned to your original payment provider instead of keeping them in your account for future purchases, you can request a refund. This guide explains how we handle canceled order funds and walks you through the steps to request a refund back to your payment provider.

Before you begin

  • This article applies to clients.
  • Refund requests are available on iOS and desktop only. We don’t support this on Android.
  • You can only request a refund after an order has been cancelled.
  • We refund your available balance automatically, starting with the oldest refundable funds. This means your refund may go to a different payment method than the one you used for this specific order, and it may arrive as more than one transaction.
  • If you paid in a currency other than US dollars, we process your refund in that same currency and amount.
  • When you cancel an order, we credit the funds to your Fiverr balance by default. This is different from Fiverr credits, which come from promotions, referrals, or compensation. You can request a refund of your Fiverr balance to your payment provider, but you can’t refund or transfer Fiverr credits.
  • If you file a chargeback or claim with your bank or PayPal instead of requesting a refund through Fiverr, the process works differently. See “If you file a chargeback or payment dispute instead” below.

How the refund process works

We don’t automatically process refunds to your payment provider (for example, credit card or PayPal) after you cancel an order.

Once your cancellation is successful, we credit the funds directly to your Fiverr balance. You can see the credited funds next to your profile picture. You can also find them on your account’s balances page, or by clicking the Amount button next to your profile picture.

When you place a new order, we automatically apply any available funds from your Fiverr balance, including funds from a previous cancellation, to the purchase.

Requesting a refund to your payment provider

Once your order is cancelled, you can request a refund to your original payment provider. Click Request a Refund on the Available balances tab.

You may see the funds returned to your payment provider up to 10 days after we process your request.

Refund history

You can view your recent refund requests from the past 30 days. Go to the Balances tab under Billing and payments, then click Refund history to see a detailed timeline.

If you have a Fiverr balance but no refund requests within the last 30 days, the Refund history link doesn’t appear.

Once you submit a refund request, we send you a notification confirming we received it and are processing it.

Refund processing & troubleshooting

When you request a refund, we give you an estimated arrival time. There’s no confirmation showing the refund as successful or completed.

Refunds usually complete within 10 days. Processing time depends on your bank, card issuer, or PayPal.

If your refund fails, it may be because you made your original payment more than 180 days ago, or because your payment method is no longer active. Double-check the date of your original payment and make sure your payment method is still valid.

Once we initiate a refund, we can’t revert it. Contact your payment provider to discuss options for reversing the transaction.

If you file a chargeback or payment dispute

Filing a chargeback or claim with your bank or PayPal is a different path from requesting a refund through Fiverr, and it comes with different rules and a longer timeline. This section explains what to expect if you go that route.

Types of chargebacks and claims

Type

Filed through

What it covers

Credit card chargeback

Your bank or card issuer

Unauthorized charge or service-related reasons

PayPal claim

PayPal

Unauthorized charge or service-related reasons

  • When you file a PayPal claim or a credit card chargeback, we automatically cancel your order and send you an email about the cancellation. We also add a “Dispute with payment provider” warning to your account and email you about it separately. If your case is related to an unauthorized charge, we will also automatically restrict your account .
  • We can’t process a refund through Fiverr for the same order while your case is open, since your payment provider won’t process two refunds for one transaction.
  • Chargebacks and claims can take anywhere from 45 days to three months to resolve, depending on your payment provider. We don’t control this timeline, and we can’t speed it up or make exceptions, regardless of the circumstances.
  • If you’d rather resolve the issue without involving your bank or PayPal, contact us or use the Resolution Center instead of filing the chargeback or claim.
  • If your case was related to an unauthorized charge, we automatically restrict your account while we review it. We review restriction and restoration decisions case by case, based on your account’s history and whether the chargeback has been resolved. Contact us with your order details if you’d like us to review your account.
  • If you reuse the disputed funds on a new order, or request and receive a refund and then file a chargeback on the same funds, we add a debt to your account for the amount involved.

FAQs

  • Most refunds to your card or PayPal complete within 10 days.
  • Not necessarily. We refund your available balance automatically, starting with the oldest refundable funds. This can mean your refund goes to a different payment method you used in the past, or arrives as more than one transaction.
  • Your bank usually routes the refund to the account behind that card, even if the physical card is no longer active. Contact your bank if you don’t see the refund after the standard timeframe.
  • No. Once we initiate a refund, the funds leave Fiverr and we can’t cancel or redirect them.
  • Fiverr credits are non-cash, platform-only credits from promotions, referrals, or compensation. You can use them at checkout, but you can’t withdraw them or send them to your bank, card, or PayPal.
  • Fiverr balance is store credit you may receive from a canceled order, and you can use it on Fiverr or request a refund.
  • A refund is money we return to your original payment method, and it no longer appears in your Fiverr balance once we issue it.
  • This can happen for a few reasons: currency conversion between your payment and your bank statement, spending part of your Fiverr balance before requesting the refund, or paying for your order partly with Fiverr credits, which reverse as credits rather than cash.
  • No. We can only help with payments processed through Fiverr. Contact your payment provider directly to request a reversal or open a dispute for payments made outside the platform.
  • Filing a dispute goes against our Payment Terms. You need to contact your payment provider first. Once it is resolved, contact Support so we can continue to assist.
  • We automatically restrict your account when you file a chargeback or claim related to an unauthorized charge, while we review it. This is meant to protect your account.
  • We review restoration requests on a case by case basis, taking into consideration your account’s history and whether the chargeback is resolved. Contact Support to have your account reviewed.
  • You can wait for your payment provider to resolve the case. Once they close it, we credit any returned funds to your Fiverr balance.
  • For a faster resolution, you can close the dispute with your bank or PayPal and resolve it through Fiverr instead.
  • Your refund may not be able to go back to your original payment method. In some cases, Support can review whether we can move the funds to your Earnings so you can withdraw them instead.
  • If a refund is due while your account is disabled, you can request it from Support.

Taxes on purchases (Pro clients: Payments & finances)

Overview

When purchasing services on Fiverr, clients may be charged with indirect taxes (for example, Sales tax, VAT, or GST) depending on their location and the applicable local laws. These taxes are in addition to the original service price.

We clearly display all applicable fees and taxes on the final checkout page, allowing you to approve the total amount charged before payment. The specific taxes charged are also clearly displayed on your invoices. Any taxes we collect are forwarded to the relevant tax authorities and are clearly displayed on your invoices.

We are unable to accommodate users’ exemptions from state sales/use taxes on orders. Taxes charged cannot be refunded by Fiverr and must be claimed back through the local tax authorities (when applicable). If you have a purchase exempt from taxation, contact your tax advisor for the best method to handle any refund of taxes paid.

Subscription services are subject to applicable taxes.

How to add your billing & tax information

To ensure we charge the correct taxes and that you receive accurate invoices, please update your billing details before completing your purchase.

  • Go to Profile picture Billing & Payments.
  • Click Billing information.
  • Fill in the required fields.
  • To receive invoices at your registered email address, check the box in the billing section. If you wish to receive your invoices at an email other than the one registered on your account, enter the email address at the bottom of the page.

If no billing information is listed, the invoice will be issued with the account’s username only.

Countries where clients pay indirect taxes

In certain countries, we are required to collect taxes (such as VAT or GST) on purchases made by clients unless a valid tax identification number is provided.

The specific tax rate and requirements for each country are outlined below.

- For clients in Australia, we charge 10% GST on services purchased, unless you provide a valid Australian Business Number (ABN) and confirm you are registered for GST.
- Your ABN is an 11-digit number.
- If you do not provide your valid ABN and confirm your GST registration, we will charge GST.
- For clients in Canada, we charge GST/HST & QST on digital services purchased. We must collect the tax from the relevant users according to their province or territory.
- If you enter a valid GST/HST ID, you will be exempt from paying federal taxes.
- If you are a Quebec user and enter a valid QST ID, you will be exempt from paying QST.
- For clients in Chile, we charge 19% VAT on goods and services purchased.
- If you are registered for VAT, provide your valid VAT ID and acknowledge that you're registered for VAT to avoid being charged VAT.
- Your VAT ID is 9 characters (an 8-digit serial number and a 1-digit verification character, which is a number 0–9 or the letter “K”).
- For clients in Colombia, we charge 19% VAT on goods and services purchased.
- If you are registered for VAT, provide your valid VAT ID and acknowledge that you're registered for VAT to avoid being charged VAT.
- Your VAT ID may have 9 or 10 alphanumeric characters, starting with a number and potentially ending with a letter (for example, 01234567A or 012345678A).
- For clients in India, we charge 18% GST on goods and services purchased.
- If you are registered for GST, provide your valid GSTIN number and acknowledge that you're registered for GST to avoid being charged.
- For clients in Israel, we charge 18% VAT on goods and services purchased.
- If you have a valid Israeli VAT ID number and are eligible for a tax refund, you may submit Fiverr's invoice to the Israeli Tax Authorities.
- If you do not have a VAT ID number, consult with your local tax authorities to claim back these funds.
- For clients in Kenya, we charge 16% VAT on goods and services purchased.
- If you are registered for VAT, provide your valid VAT ID and acknowledge that you're registered for VAT to avoid being charged.
- For clients in Mexico, we charge 16% VAT on goods and services purchased.
- VAT is calculated on the total of the platform’s 20% commission on the total order amount and the service fee (paid by the client).
- For clients in New Zealand, we charge 15% GST on goods and services purchased.
- If you are registered for GST, provide a valid GST ID and acknowledge that you are registered for GST.
- For clients in Nigeria, we charge 7.5% VAT on goods and services purchased.
- For clients in Norway, we charge 25% VAT on goods and services purchased.
- If you are registered for VAT, provide your valid VAT ID and acknowledge that you're registered for VAT to avoid being charged VAT.
- Your Norwegian organization number is a 9-digit number (for example, 123456789).
- For clients in Russia, we charge 22% VAT on goods and services purchased.
- For clients in Singapore, we charge 9% GST on goods and services purchased.
- If you are registered for GST, provide your valid GST ID and acknowledge that you're registered for GST to avoid being charged GST.
- Your GST registration number is a unique 10-character tax ID consisting of numbers and letters.
- For clients in South Africa, we charge 15% VAT on goods and services purchased.
- VAT is calculated on the total of the platform’s 20% commission on the total order amount and the service fee (paid by the client).
- For clients in South Korea, we charge 10% VAT on goods and services purchased.
- If you are registered for VAT, provide your valid VAT ID and acknowledge that you're registered for VAT to avoid being charged VAT.
- Your VAT ID is a 10-digit numeric code.
- For clients in Taiwan, we charge 5% VAT on goods and services purchased.
- If you are registered for VAT, provide your valid VAT ID (BAN - Business Administration Number) and acknowledge that you're registered for VAT to avoid being charged.
- Your VAT ID registration number is a 8-digit numeric code.
- Fiverr will issue an Electronic Government Uniform Invoice (eGUI) as required by law. A notification will be sent to the email address associated with your Fiverr account indicating the eGUI is ready for download at the Taiwan Ministry of Finance [e-Invoice Platform](https://www.einvoice.nat.gov.tw/).
- For clients in Thailand, we charge 7% VAT on goods and services purchased.
- If you are registered for VAT, provide your valid VAT ID and acknowledge that you're registered for VAT to avoid being charged VAT.
- Your VAT ID is a 13-digit numeric code.
- For clients located in Turkey, we charge 20% VAT on goods and services purchased.
- If you are registered for VAT, provide your valid VAT ID (VKN - Vergi Kimlik Numarası) and acknowledge that you're registered for VAT to avoid being charged.
- Your VAT ID registration number is a 10-digit numeric code.
- For clients in Ukraine, we charge 20% VAT on goods and services purchased.
- If you are registered for VAT, provide your valid VAT ID and acknowledge that you're registered for VAT to avoid being charged VAT.
- Your VAT registration number is a unique 12-digit numeric code (for example, 123456789123).
- For clients in the UAE, we charge 5% VAT on goods and services purchased.
- VAT is calculated on the total of the platform’s 20% commission on the total order amount and the service fee (paid by the client).
- Due to US tax laws, if you are a client in the US, you may need to pay state Sales Tax for services bought on Fiverr.
- You may be required to fill in your ZIP Code at checkout and see a new pricing component on your payment page.
- The Sales Tax will be calculated according to your billing address, the relevant state tax laws, and the type of service you are purchasing.
- Not all states tax the same services, and not all states have the same rates.
  • The tax is applied only in certain states in the US:

Tipping your freelancer (Pro clients: Payments & finances)

A tip is a way to show extra appreciation when a freelancer has gone above and beyond.

On Fiverr, you can leave a tip for a freelancer after your order is complete; it goes directly to them as a separate payment. This article goes through the entire tipping process.

When can I leave a tip?

You can tip your freelancer once the order is marked as complete. The tipping window is open for 30 days after completion, after which the Tip Now option will no longer be available. In some cases, the tipping option may not appear due to internal guardrails.

The Tip Now option appears:

  • On web: After you leave a review
  • On the Fiverr app: Immediately after order completion, no review required
  • For Hourly orders: Once the contract is completed and a review is added
  • For Milestone orders: Once all milestones are completed and a review is added

If the 30-day window has passed, you can still show your appreciation by contacting your freelancer via your inbox and asking them to create a custom offer for a new order in the amount you’d like to tip. When doing this, make sure to clarify within the order that it is intended as a tip to avoid any confusion.

How much can I tip?

  • Minimum tip: $5
  • For orders below $25: you can tip up to $25
  • For orders $25 or more: you can tip up to 100% of the order value

How does payment work?

When you click Tip Now, funds are deducted from your Fiverr Balance first. If your balance is insufficient, a payment window will open so you can complete the transaction using another payment method.

Tips are charged with Fiverr’s standard service fee. They are treated as separate transactions, so they generate a separate invoice.

Frequently asked questions

  • Check the following: the order must be marked as complete, on web you must leave a review first before the tip option appears, and the 30-day tipping window must not have passed.
  • On the Fiverr website, yes, you need to leave a review before the Tip Now option appears. On the Fiverr app, you can tip without leaving a review.
  • Tips follow the standard 14-day clearance period before the funds become available in the freelancer’s account. This clearance period is separate from the original order.
  • Yes. Tips are charged with Fiverr’s standard service fee, the same as regular orders.
  • Yes. For Hourly orders, you can tip once the contract is completed and you have added a review. For Milestone orders, you can tip once all milestones are completed and you have added a review.

Using your local currency for purchases (Pro clients: Payments & finances)

Depending on where you are in the world, Fiverr displays various global currencies. While the initial currency you see is dependent on your location, you can always change the currency displayed easily and conveniently.

Display currency

To change your display currency:
  • Click on your profile picture, and on the drop-down menu, you will see a language and currency just beneath Billing and payments.
  • From the drop-down menu, choose your preferred language.
  • The same process applies to picking your preferred currency.
  • Once you have chosen your preferred language and currency, the page will reload and automatically reflect your selection.

Changing your currency

When you purchase a Gig, you will be charged according to the display currency that you have chosen. To change your display currency please click on your profile picture and select the “language and currency” menu. Pick your preferred language and currency from the drop-down menu.

  • If the display currency you choose isn’t supported by our payment processor, you will be charged in U.S. dollars.
  • If you would like to view your balance in U.S. dollars and are currently viewing Fiverr in your local currency, place your mouse over your balance amount next to your username.
  • If your display currency is the Israeli New Shekel (ILS), credit card payments will be made in U.S. dollars.

  • Yes, your refund will be processed in the same currency, and of course, the same amount, as used in your initial payment.

This increase may also include conversion fees. But as buyers, you will always have the option to pay in US$ by changing your selected displayed currency.

Your account balance and billing history page (Pro clients: Payments & finances)

Fiverr keeps a record of every transaction so you can track your payments, cancellations, and deposits in one place. Your billing history page lets you view and download invoices, and your Fiverr Balance gives you a clear picture of your earnings, reimbursements, and Fiverr Credits.

Before you begin

  • For Fiverr Pro accounts, only the account admin and billing managers can access the billing history page and download invoices.
  • Invoices are not issued for orders paid exclusively with Fiverr Credits, as Fiverr Credits are not equivalent to any currency.
  • Keep your billing information current before placing an order.

Getting your invoices

All invoices are available on your billing history page. You can view, filter, and download them at any time.

How to view your invoices
  • Go to your Profile picture.
  • Select Billing and payments.
  • Select the Billing history page.
  • Filter or search your invoices.
  • Select invoices using the checkboxes.
  • Choose Download a CSV report or a zip of PDF files to download multiple invoices. You can also download invoices individually.
Invoices via email

To receive invoices by email, select the checkbox at the bottom of the page. If you want invoices sent to a different email address than the one registered on your account, a new field appears where you can enter the preferred address.

Invoices from customer support

If an invoice is not available for download, contact customer support using the Contact us tab. To help process your request, provide:

  • Your order number(s)
  • The timeframe (for example, April 2021)
  • Your original invoice number

If you are using a Pro account and you are not the admin or billing manager of your account, you will not have access to the invoice or invoice number. The admin or billing manager must contact customer support directly using the Contact us tab.

Adding your billing information

To receive invoices with your business or personal billing information, complete the details under the Billing information tab. Keeping this information current ensures your invoices reflect the correct details for your account or business.

Billing information is visible only to the account admin and billing manager. This information is used to create invoices for orders made with the Pro saved payment method, and it is sent to the admin’s registered email address.

For more information about managing your payment methods, see Payment Methods.

Your Fiverr Balance

Your Fiverr Balance is always visible at the top of your account, next to your profile picture. Use it to track earnings, reimbursements, Fiverr Credits, and more.

To see a detailed breakdown, go to Profile picture > Billing and payments > Available Balances.

Balance data is updated every few minutes to keep the information current. Your balance includes the following:

  • From canceled orders: Funds credited back to your account for canceled orders.
  • Fiverr Credits: Credits are applied automatically when you pay for orders. Check expiry dates so you do not miss out. Select Earn Fiverr Credits to refer a friend to Fiverr and earn credits.
  • Earnings: Earnings from sales. This balance can be withdrawn from your Earnings page or used for orders. Visit your Earnings page for a detailed breakdown.

Fiverr Credits expire three months from the date they are received. Once used, credits may not be returned to your account even if your order is canceled. Fiverr Credits can only be used to order Gigs on Fiverr and are not eligible for withdrawal or transfer to a payment provider account. When available, your Fiverr funds and credits are used as your primary payment method for new orders. Fiverr Credits are subject to the terms and conditions of Fiverr’s Referral Program.

Learn more: Fiverr’s Payments Terms & Conditions

Academic and workplace dishonesty on Fiverr (Pro clients: Trust & Safety)

This article aims to clarify what constitutes “academic and workplace dishonesty” while guiding you on handling users engaged in such services.

Overview

As stated in Fiverr’s Community Standards, Fiverr strictly prohibits any form of academic or workplace dishonesty, including the commissioning of work that will be presented as the individual’s own effort. To that extent, Fiverr does not allow any services that offer to complete tasks—such as homework or job screening assignments—that are expected to be fulfilled without assistance from external sources.

AI-generated content editing vs. Academic rewriting

Rewriting academic work (e.g., dissertations, theses) is prohibited. However, editing AI-generated content for clarity, style, or grammar is allowed as long as the core ideas remain unchanged. Services involving AI content refinement are distinct from academic rewriting and must maintain academic integrity.

See the AI-content editing section in the Fiverr catalog.

Prohibiting services related to academic and workplace dishonesty, including completing assignments or providing false academic or job credentials, is crucial to Fiverr for several reasons:

  • It ensures that the value of education is maintained, promoting a fair environment where individuals are assessed based on their genuine efforts and capabilities.
  • Academic institutions are esteemed for their commitment to knowledge, research, and learning. Allowing services that promote academic dishonesty can tarnish the reputation of these institutions and disrupt public trust in the value of education.
  • Assignments, exams, and other academic or job-related tasks are designed to promote learning and skill development. Bypassing these activities through external services undermines educational and workplace processes, hindering the growth of essential skills and knowledge.
  • Academic and workplace assessments are meant to evaluate an individual’s understanding and mastery of a subject. Using external services to complete assignments or exams misrepresents one’s capabilities and compromises the fairness of the evaluation process.
  • It ensures that academic and workplace achievements and qualifications are accurately represented, maintaining the trust and credibility of educational and workplace systems.
  • Completing assignments independently fosters a sense of personal responsibility and accountability. It encourages individuals to take ownership of their education or job and actively engage in the learning process.

We expect our users to follow the honor code or policy of their academic institution or workplace when requesting an academic or job-related service.

Clients:
  • You can order tutoring services from a freelancer to enhance your knowledge in a specific subject.
  • You can share a completed document—such as a project paper, essay, or dissertation—for proofreading by a freelancer.
  • Don’t request a service that would contribute to or complete an assignment that is expected to be completed without assistance, including homework, completion of exams or tests, writing dissertations, theses, research papers, research proposals, job application assignments, or assignments on any academic subject.
  • Don’t ask freelancers to perform academic institution application services, such as writing university or college applications or statements of purpose. (Proofreading or guidance through the application process is allowed.)
Freelancers:
  • If a client requests a service related to academic dishonesty or homework:
    • Do inform them that the requested service is strictly prohibited on Fiverr.
    • Do offer an alternative (if it’s within your scope of services), such as online tutoring for the specific subject or proofreading of completed work.
  • If you encounter behavior or content violating this policy, please report it.
  • Don’t offer or agree to provide any assignment expected to be completed without assistance, including homework, completion of exams or tests, writing dissertations, theses, research papers, research proposals, job application assignments, or assignments on any academic subject.
  • Don’t offer or agree to provide academic institution application services, such as writing university or college applications or statements of purpose. However, proofreading and guidance through the application process are allowed.

Any violation of this policy may lead to an account warning and potential suspension of your account. For more details on how we enforce policies.

AI services guidelines (Pro clients: Trust & Safety)

Therefore, to ensure respect for others’ rights and to avoid any breach of Fiverr’s policies, it is imperative to adhere to the following guidelines:
    • Do not offer or request the use of a voice that you do not have the right to use. For instance, services offering to create music based on a known singer’s voice or offering to clone a celebrity’s voice are prohibited on the platform.
    • Do not offer or request the commission of a deep fake or the creation of any other content solely aimed at misleading others and/or spreading misinformation.

Before engaging in any of the above described activities, you must make sure you adhere to Fiverr’s policies and to the following guidelines:

Avoiding spam and staying safe on Fiverr (Pro clients: Trust & Safety)

Maintaining a safe and trustworthy Fiverr community requires vigilance. This guide highlights potential cyberthreats and how to avoid them, helping you protect yourself and your account.

Spam: unwanted messages, phishing attempts, and malware

A general definition of “spam” is any type of unsolicited messaging activity, often sent to multiple recipients. On Fiverr, spam falls into three main categories:

  • Unwanted offers or solicitations that aim to drive traffic to a Fiverr page or an external website.

  • Example: Hey! Check out this amazing new service I’m offering on Fiverr! You won’t find a better deal. Click this link to get started: [link].

  • Deceptive attempts to steal personal data like credit card information, passwords, and other sensitive details.

  • Examples: Messages that falsely claim to be from Fiverr but have small inconsistencies, like a misspelled name (e.g., Fivver, Feverr) or a suspicious domain (.ru, .so). These may also include links or QR codes.

  • Note that it’s normal for clients to ask about your professional background, like certifications or experience, before placing an order. Sharing this is generally safe, but avoid including sensitive personal details (such as your ID, phone number, or address).

  • Malware, short for ‘malicious software,’ is designed to infiltrate your computer and gain unauthorized access.

  • Examples: Messages with unfamiliar links or attachments, These could look like casual messages or be related to discounts, prizes, or special offers.

  • Fiverr will never request your email, login credentials, or payment info in order to process a payment.

  • .

  • Hello 👋

  • I’m a recruiter from _____, I’m sorry I had to text you this way, I checked your profile and got to notice you will be perfect for our pending freelance job.

  • Briefly, the Projects are different pages with same price of $25 per page, we hope to hire you!

  • If you are interested kindly reach our manager on Telegram (@name). He will direct you on the Project.

  • We hope to hear from you soon.

  • Thank you 😊

If you receive messages like the examples above, please report them.

How to report messages or mark them as spam

Spam messages won’t affect your response rate, as long as you report them as spam within 24 hours from when they were sent. Learn more with Everything you need to know about response time and rate.

Your account safety and data privacy are top priorities for us at Fiverr. Fiverr uses antivirus software that scans all files; however if you identify something suspicious, you can mark messages as spam or report them. These reports are reviewed by our Trust & Safety team.

    1. Open the conversation containing the suspicious message.
  • 2. Click the three dots (⋯) next to the message.
  • 3. Select Mark as Spam from the dropdown menu.
  • 4. A confirmation window will appear. Click Submit to confirm.
    1. Open the conversation containing the message you wish to report.
  • 2. Click the three dots (⋯) next to the message.
  • 3. Select Report from the dropdown menu.
  • 4. Choose the reason for your report from the list provided.
  • 5. Click Next.
  • 6. You will have the option to block the user from interacting with you in the future. Select your preference.
  • 7. Click Submit to finalize the report.
  • Learn how to report inappropriate content or behavior with Reporting content or behavior on Fiverr.
    1. Open the conversation containing the suspicious message.
  • 2. Press and hold the message within the conversation.
  • 3. Tap Report Spam from the options that appear.
  • There are two methods for blocking a user on the mobile app.
  • Method 1: from the inbox
    1. Go to your Inbox and locate the message from the user you wish to block.
  • 2. Press and hold the message.
  • 3. Tap Block from the menu that appears.

How to spot and avoid phishing attempts

Fiverr employees on Fiverr

Fiverr representatives may contact you via inbox, but they will never suggest you scan a QR code, ask you to verify your account using a credit card, or request personal information. To recognize an official Fiverr employee account, look for the Fiverr logo and the words “official Fiverr employee”.

Ways to protect yourself from phishing
  • Fiverr alerts you when it’s your first conversation with a user. Use this cue to stay cautious, avoid sharing sensitive info, and don’t click suspicious links.
  • Be cautious when clicking a link or scanning a QR code, which redirects you to a different login page.
  • Always check links before clicking by hovering your mouse over the link and looking at the URL which it redirects to (seen at the bottom of the browser).
  • Only use your account details (password and security questions) on the Fiverr.com sign in modal or settings page.
  • Report unsolicited messages (e.g., promotional, phishing, malware) by clicking “Report an Issue.”
  • Avoid interacting with suspicious messages, such as:
    • Potentially harmful content (malware, phishing, etc.)
    • Messages promoting services, requesting donations, or free work.
    • Automated mass messages or irrelevant inquiries.
    • Requests for guidance on becoming a freelancer.
    • Requests for your email address, login credentials, or payment details for processing payments.
  • The Fiverr site will always have an “https” prefix (or a lock icon) at the beginning of its website address (URL). - Please note that there is no ‘https’ or lock icon

Protect your computer from malware

  • Keep your antivirus software up to date.
  • Adjust your settings and firewall to prevent unauthorized installations and connections.
  • Back up your files.
  • Use strong, varying passwords for websites you access.
  • Never click on suspicious links or open unsolicited files.
  • Manually access Fiverr by opening a new window if you’re unsure about a link.

While Fiverr takes the security of its community very seriously, neither Fiverr nor any person associated with Fiverr makes any warranty or representation with respect to third parties’ acts or omissions. If you have transferred funds and believe it was part of a scam, we strongly recommend contacting your payment provider immediately to cancel the transaction. Fiverr will not be responsible or liable for any unauthorized access, breach of firewalls or other hacking by third parties.

This article aims to increase awareness within our community. For more information on staying safe, please refer to our Community Standards and Stay protected: Fiverr’s off-platform policy. For more tips on keeping your account safe or to report an issue, feel free to contact our Customer Support team.

For more on this policy and best practices for staying safe from spam and phishing, see a helpful video here.

Digital Services Act (DSA) Overview (Pro clients: Trust & Safety)

The Digital Services Act (DSA) is a European Union regulation designed to make online platforms safer, more transparent, and more accountable. Fiverr is committed to complying with the DSA to protect your rights and maintain a trustworthy marketplace. This article explains what the DSA is, what Fiverr is doing to comply, and what these mean for you as a freelancer or client.

What is the DSA?

The DSA is an EU regulation that applies to online platforms such as marketplaces, social networks, and content-sharing platforms. The goal of the DSA is to create a safer digital environment that protects the fundamental rights of all digital service users. The regulation also includes two key areas:

  • The DSA requires platforms to provide clear mechanisms for reporting potentially illegal content and violations of Terms of Service, and to review and address valid reports in accordance with applicable laws. This includes content such as terrorist content, child sexual abuse material, counterfeit goods, and other forms of illegal content.
  • The DSA requires platforms to provide users with clear information about how their services operate, including their terms and conditions, content moderation practices, and certain aspects of content recommendation and advertising systems. The goal is to help users better understand how content is presented, how platform rules are enforced, and what options are available to them. Platforms must also give users clear information about terms and conditions and content policies.

How Fiverr complies with the DSA

We have made the following changes to our processes, policies, and products:

  • We updated the registration process for new freelancers to verify freelancers who identify as businesses before their profiles appear in our catalog.
  • We are continuously developing resources to increase transparency and inform users about how content moderation and platform operations work.
  • We improved reporting processes and tools for addressing illegal content, harassment, and violations of our Terms of Service, and established an appeals mechanism.

What the DSA means for you

Enhanced identity verification

The DSA requires that freelancers who use Fiverr as a business complete identity verification. This applies to all registered freelancers, whether inside or outside the EU, because our goal is to protect all clients. Completing verification keeps your profile visible to clients in the EU.

For details on how to complete the verification process, see Personal & business information verification.

Platform safety & trust

The DSA strengthens platform safety by introducing reporting tools to help combat harmful content. You can use these tools to report content or behavior that violates our policies.

For details on how to report content or behavior, see Reporting content or behavior on Fiverr.

FAQs

  • All new freelancers on Fiverr must comply with DSA requirements. Existing freelancers who choose not to comply will not be visible and won’t be able to sell to clients in the EU.
  • According to the DSA, only traders have to go through verification. If you’re a trader and you do not complete the verification process, your freelancer profile and Gigs will not be visible to clients in the EU.
  • It depends on your status. If you selected that Fiverr is not your primary job or profession, you can update your status in your profile settings. If you are using Fiverr as your primary job or profession, you must contact Fiverr Customer Support to update your information.
  • Only if you identify as a business freelancer. After confirming your status, you will be asked whether your business is registered and, if so, to provide a business registration number. This number may also be referred to by different names depending on your country, including:
    • Entity number or ID
    • Business number or ID
    • Department number or ID
    • Company number
    • Incorporation number
    • Filing number
    • Document number
    • Control number
    • Organization number
    • Charter number
    • License number
    • Registry number
  • To find out what applies in your country, contact your local government authority or a legal counsel.
  • Yes. Even if you have already completed ID verification, you must still complete the personal and business information verification process required by the DSA.

Summary

The DSA is a key EU regulation that makes online platforms safer and more transparent for everyone. Fiverr supports these goals and has updated our processes to comply. Completing identity verification and using our reporting tools helps keep the Fiverr marketplace trustworthy for all freelancers and clients.

Fiverr reviews: Content guidelines and removal policy (Pro clients: Trust & Safety)

At Fiverr, we believe that transparency and trust are the cornerstones of a thriving marketplace. Reviews are a vital tool for our community, helping clients make informed decisions and allowing freelancers to showcase their hard-earned expertise.

To maintain the integrity of our feedback system, all users must adhere to the following policies. This ensures that every review is an authentic reflection of a genuine service and a professional interaction.

Leaving a review: Best practices

Whether you’re a client or a freelancer, thoughtful and fair feedback makes a real impact.

  • What to do
    • Be specific and constructive
    • Share clear details about your experience: what went well and what could be improved.
    • Focus on the service provided
    • Keep your review relevant to the order, communication, delivery, and overall experience.
    • Be honest and balanced
    • Highlight both strengths and areas for improvement when relevant.
    • Keep it respectful and professional
    • Use appropriate language and aim to be helpful rather than emotional.
  • What to avoid
    • Including personal or sensitive information
    • Don’t share private details such as contact information, payment details, or external links.
    • Using offensive or abusive language
    • Reviews should remain respectful at all times.
    • Making irrelevant comments
    • Avoid discussing topics unrelated to the order or experience.
    • Posting misleading or exaggerated claims
    • Reviews should reflect your genuine experience.

Feedback manipulation

Feedback manipulation is any attempt to artificially influence a user’s review, rating, or reputation. This includes pressure, coercion, incentives, or coordinated activity intended to affect feedback outcomes. Such conduct undermines trust in the marketplace and is strictly prohibited.

  • Soliciting changes: Do not ask a client to edit, change, or remove a review after it has been published.
  • Conditional deliverables and coercion: Do not withhold or condition bonus content, final files, future discounts, delivery, or a refund on receiving a specific review or rating outcome.
  • Emotional manipulation: Do not use guilt, personal hardship, or emotional appeals to influence a client’s feedback.
  • Unprofessional communication: Do not use hostile, derogatory, or disrespectful language in any communication related to feedback or service quality.
  • Feedback boosting: Do not ask friends, family members, or fake accounts to purchase services for the purpose of leaving positive reviews.
  • Incentivization: Do not offer discounts, freebies, or refunds in exchange for a positive review.
  • Review exchanges: Do not coordinate with another user to purchase each other’s services in order to trade reviews.

Managing client reviews as a freelancer

Handling reviews, both positive and negative, is an important part of building your reputation. A thoughtful approach helps you maintain trust and demonstrate professionalism to future clients.

The public response option for freelancers

Freelancers can respond publicly to client reviews. This allows you to share your perspective, clarify details, and show potential clients how you handle challenges. Your response is visible alongside the original review.

If you disagree with a review, a public response is the most effective way to address it.

  • Be objective: Focus on the facts of the order and delivery.
  • Be professional: Keep your tone respectful and constructive; this reflects your business.
Maintaining strong feedback over time

Building a positive review profile starts with consistent, high-quality service and communication.

  • Focus on quality: Deliver high-quality work and communicate clearly throughout the project.
  • Encourage constructive feedback: Reviews should be honest, professional, and reflect the actual experience.
  • Use gentle reminders: You may politely remind clients that leaving a review is optional, as long as it is done without pressure.

Pro-Tip: Focus on the service, not the rating. Instead of saying, “Please give me 5 stars,” try: “I value your feedback! Please let me know how I did on this project.”

Reviews removal

To ensure reviews remain honest, authentic, and trustworthy reflections of users’ professional experiences, we intervene only in limited circumstances where a review clearly violates our Terms of Service or Community Standards.

Before submitting a request
  • Requests for review removal must be submitted to Customer Support from the account that posted the review. No exceptions.
  • Reviews are not removed solely because a user disagrees with them or considers them unfair, unprofessional, or inaccurate.
  • Requests for review removal should be submitted only where valid grounds exist under this policy.
When will we take action?

We may remove reviews for several reasons, such as:

  • Policy violations: Any review that is inconsistent with our Terms of Service.
  • Abusive or harmful content: Profanity, hate speech, discriminatory remarks, or defamatory statements directed at an individual or group rather than at the work performed.
  • Private information: Sharing real names, emails, phone numbers, or other personal and sensitive private information.
  • Extortion: Reviews left as a threat to extract more work or money outside the original scope.
  • Irrelevant review content: Reviews that clearly concern Fiverr, the platform experience, or issues unrelated to the freelancer’s service or delivered work.
  • Chargebacks: Reviews on an order may be removed when a client submits a chargeback for reasons unrelated to the quality or delivery of the freelancer’s work.
