A guide to responsible digital creation (Pro clients: Trust & Safety)

Introduction

Whether you’re building an online presence, creating music, or crafting visual art, it’s important to understand the rules of ethical and lawful creativity. This article is based on Fiverr’s Community Standards, to provide more details on this complex field, while fostering fairness and respect for all parties involved.

Understanding Third-Party Rights

As stated in Fiverr’s Community Standards, a third party is a company or person, other than Fiverr, that is indirectly involved in the services users offer or request. In the digital marketplace, respecting the rights of others is crucial in maintaining trust within our community, while safeguarding the integrity of the final results.

Therefore, we require that users respect the broader Internet community and follow the Terms of Service (TOS) of other platforms and companies.

Adhering to Licensed Material and Beyond

Using external elements like images, music, or themes, can add flavor to your creative mix. However, transparency is key. You must clearly state that you are using third-party content and cannot claim it as your own. Carefully review the terms of any external elements and verify that your license for this third-party work includes the necessary permissions to be used by someone else.

- Be aware of any IP rights related to external components: Before integrating third-party elements, get to know the terms of their licenses. This helps prevent unintentional missteps in respecting [intellectual property](https://www.fiverr.com/community/standards/intellectual-property).
- Be transparent in your communication: If your creation involves external elements, be upfront. Share this information and clarify any associated costs to avoid potential misunderstandings with the clients.
- For instance, if you offer development services for Shopify or WordPress, and use licensed themes, make sure your Gig clearly states that the service includes elements from third-party websites. Consider adding an extra cost in the Gig extras section.
- Be proactive: Understand the origins of integrated elements. During order requirements discussions with freelancers, make sure to clearly discuss the usage of licensed materials. Ask if they have the necessary permissions for themes or any other content they plan to incorporate into your project.
- Provide your own components: If you have unique elements to include, inform the freelancer. This ensures your project is created using materials you already own, eliminating potential licensing conflicts.

General Guidelines

  • Always check for potential IP rights: Even freely-available content on the Internet may have copyright restrictions. A simple but powerful rule of thumb is to assume that all content has some kind of IP protection unless proven otherwise.
  • Keeping a record: When collaborating or using external content, maintain a record. This documentation can serve as proof of your right to use the material if any questions arise.

By fostering a culture of transparency and respect for copyright, licensing, and third-party rights, we contribute to a thriving and lawful digital marketplace. Our freelancers and clients play a crucial role in ensuring that the creative process is not only exciting, but also guided by legality and mutual respect.

How we enforce policies (Pro clients: Trust & Safety)

Our Community Standards and Terms of Service outline what is and isn’t allowed on Fiverr. These policies were created to ensure a safe, respectful, and trustworthy environment for everyone.

While we actively monitor the platform by automated and human review, or with a combination of technology and human moderation, depending on the individual case, we strongly encourage our community to use our reporting tools if they encounter content or behavior that violates our policies.

What happens if a user violates Fiverr policies?

Depending on the severity or repetitive nature of the policy violation, we may take a range of enforcement actions, including, but not limited to, the removal of content or permanent suspension of the account.

When an account is reported, the account holder is notified of the reason for the removal, along with information on the appeal process.

Gig Removal

A Gig may be removed when the services offered are not allowed under Fiverr’s Community Standards and Terms of Service.

What happens when a Gig is removed?

  • The account owner will receive a notification that the Gig was removed, along with the relevant information.
  • The Gig will no longer be available on Fiverr. Once a Gig is removed, the account owner will no longer be able to access its content or use it to create future Gigs.

If an account receives two Gig removals within 60 days, and at least 24 hours have passed between the removals, the account may also receive an account warning.

Account warnings

You may receive a warning if you breach Fiverr’s policies or if a violation is reported on your account. Warnings are sent to the email address linked to your account and expire after 90 days. Their purpose is to explain our policies and help you avoid future violations. What happens when your account receives a warning?

Warning

What happens

First warning (up to two warnings for different violations)

You’ll be informed of the specific violation and reminded of Fiverr’s policies.

Second warning for the same violation, or three warnings for different violations

Your account will be suspended.

Note: Warnings don’t limit your account activity, but they can affect your status in Fiverr’s level system.

Account restriction

An account may be restricted as an intermediate action before permanent suspension.

What happens when an account is restricted?

  • Account owners will receive a notification detailing the specific violation and the restriction of their account.
  • During the next 60 days, the user will still be able to communicate with existing clients via the active order page and access any available or pending clearance funds for withdrawal.
  • After the 60-day period, the account will be permanently suspended.

Account Ineligible to Sell

Your account may lose eligibility to sell for several reasons, including offering prohibited services, operating multiple accounts, using methods to hide your online identity or location, or engaging in activities previously associated with fraudulent behavior on Fiverr. These actions violate Fiverr’s Community Standards and Terms of Service.

Please note that we understand freelancers may work from different locations, and logging in from various places alone does not trigger a flag.

What happens when an account becomes non-eligible to sell?

  • You will no longer be able to offer services on Fiverr.
  • You will still be able to complete any active orders.
  • You can continue using Fiverr as a Client.

Account suspension

An account may be permanently suspended for one of the following reasons:

  • Two warnings for the same violation.
  • Three warnings for three different violations.
  • A severe breach of Fiverr policies (illegal activity, hate speech, discrimination, adult or other inappropriate services or activity, etc.)

What happens when an account is suspended?

  • Accounts are suspended when there has been a severe breach of Fiverr policies, misuse of our reporting tools mechanism, or when an account receives multiple warnings (two warnings for the same violation or three warnings for different violations).
  • Account owners are not able to log into suspended accounts.

Freelancers

  • If there are funds available in the account, the freelancer is required to wait 90 days to make a withdrawal.
  • If there are open orders, the freelancer will be given limited access to be able to complete those orders.

Clients

  • If the account has a Fiverr balance with available funds, there will be an immediate refund.

What if I don’t agree with a decision?

Whether you submitted a report or you are the account holder, you have the right to appeal a decision. Appeals can be made in the form of a complaint with Customer Support, and must be made within 6 months from the receipt of the notification. See “How to appeal a decision” for more information on the appeal process.

Our commitment to the Fiverr community

When evaluating potentially harmful content or activity, we are committed to consistency and transparency. To that end, we will continue to update the Fiverr community with any changes to our processes for enforcing our policies.

ID verification: Data protection and usage (Pro clients: Trust & Safety)

We handle your ID information carefully and only use it to verify your account and to create a safe and secure marketplace. This article explains what to expect when we ask you to verify your identity with an official government ID, including how we protect that information, why we collect it, and how long we keep it.

Who this applies to

Fiverr may ask any freelancer to verify their identity with an official government ID. When we ask you to complete ID verification, this article explains how we handle that information.

Data privacy and security

We take the security of the site and your information seriously. We use industry-standard technologies and internal procedures to prevent unauthorized access to your data.

Learn more in our Privacy Policy.

Why we collect and use your ID information

We collect and process ID cards to help build a trustworthy marketplace and enforce our Terms of Service. This process allows us to:

  • Improve trust in the marketplace and service quality
  • Secure our platform and prevent fraud, for example, freelancers misrepresenting themselves
  • Recover hijacked accounts and confirm ownership of freelancer accounts
  • Enforce Fiverr’s Terms of Service
  • Confirm that users are at least 18 years old
  • Confirm that users comply with applicable laws

The importance of ID verification

ID verification helps us maintain high security standards for you and the rest of the Fiverr community.

We do not use your identification card for any other purpose, including marketing, and we do not share it with other users. We keep the copy of your identification card only for as long as required for these safety purposes.

Learn more in our Privacy Policy, which governs how we process ID verification data. If you believe your ID is not necessary for these purposes, open a Customer Support ticket using the Contact us tab at the bottom of the page.

How long we keep your data

We keep the copy of your identification document for 30 days and your selfie for 60 days. After this period, we retain only your name, date of birth, gender, hashed ID number, document type, and document country.

The copy of your identification document and the personal information you provided when performing the ID verification process are kept in order to verify your account or the identity you reported to us, and create a safe and secure marketplace for our community.

Learn more in our Privacy Policy.

You can ask us to delete this information at any time. In some cases, this may restrict your account. Contact our Customer Support team using the Contact us tab at the bottom of the page if you have questions.

Summary

ID verification helps us build a safer marketplace, while keeping your personal data secure and retained only as long as necessary.

Navigating Fiverr as a minor: How to stay safe and compliant (Pro clients: Trust & Safety)

Fiverr is committed to providing a secure and professional environment for all members of our community. The minors policy aims to protect younger users (individuals under 18) from potential risks and ensure Fiverr remains a trusted space for professional business activities.

Key aspects of Fiverr’s minor policy

Fiverr aims to safeguard minors from potential exploitation, inappropriate interactions, and the challenges of managing financial transactions at a young age.

  • To ensure the safety of all users, we do not allow minors under the age of 18 to create accounts or offer services unless the account is owned by a parent or legal guardian with their appropriate permission.
  • Additionally, users under the age of 13 are strictly prohibited from using Fiverr.
  • It must always be clear that the minor is not operating independently but under the direct supervision of a responsible adult.

Parent/guardian-owned account guidelines

Minors aged 13 to 18 may use the platform only through an account owned by a parent or guardian, which must adhere to the following rules:

  • Ensure your profile picture is professional and does not depict a child.
  • Update your profile description to explain that the account is owned by a parent or legal guardian, including the following statement: The service is provided by a minor under an account owned by the parents of {minor’s name} and managed by them.
  • The above statement should be added to any active Gig description.

ID verification process

As a standard procedure, you may be asked to undergo an ID verification process. In such cases, the account owner is the one required to upload the official documents. This means that if a minor is using their parent’s account, it is the parent (the account owner) who must complete the verification process.

Services involving minors

Certain services may require the participation of minors, such as voiceover work, acting, and similar roles. Freelancers providing these services involving minors must adhere to specific guidelines:

  • If a minor is involved in creation (e.g., featured in photography for kids’ products), it must be evident from the Gig description that the minor’s participation is required.
  • Both parents and freelancers working with minors must follow local child labor laws and regulations when offering services that involve minors.
  • Certain services involving minors are not allowed on Fiverr due to ethical, safety, and legal considerations, including but not limited to:
    • Dance lessons
    • Modeling
    • Greeting cards and videos
    • “Your message on” services (personalized content featuring minors)

No sexually explicit content featuring minors

Fiverr strictly prohibits any sexually explicit content involving minors. This includes, but is not limited to:

  • NSFW or lewd illustrations and voiceovers
  • Erotic stories or content
  • Lolicon (loli), shotacon (shota), or similar content
  • Deepfake content
  • Any sexually explicit or suggestive imagery involving minors, including AI-generated images

Content that exploits or sexually suggests minors, whether real or fictional, is not allowed. We also prohibit content that depicts minors in violent or exploitative ways.

Should you encounter a user requesting services of this nature, please report it to us without delay. We will also promptly report any Child Sexual Abuse Material (CSAM) to the National Center for Missing and Exploited Children, who collaborate with law enforcement agencies worldwide.

FAQs

  • The account owner, who must be a parent or legal guardian, is responsible for submitting their own details and documentation.
  • Contact Customer Support for guidance on how to comply with Fiverr’s policies and continue your activity.
  • Contact Customer Support for assistance.
  • Reach out to Customer Support to re-verify your account and update ownership.
  • ID verification is required. Your account will remain restricted until you provide the necessary documentation.

Our guiding principles

  • Every interaction, whether in a message, a review, or a collaboration-should begin and end with basic human decency. We stand against all forms of harassment, bullying, or targeted hostility. Respect is not optional; it’s the foundation of a strong and vibrant community.
  • We are committed to protecting the physical, emotional, and digital safety of our users. This includes preventing threats, hate speech, exploitation, and any form of violence. Fiverr is a space where everyone should feel secure expressing themselves, sharing work, and building relationships.
  • Trust grows through honesty. We expect our community to represent themselves truthfully, whether it’s through their profile, the services they offer, or the feedback they provide. Misleading claims, impersonation, or manipulative behavior damage the fabric of the marketplace.
  • Fiverr thrives when competition is healthy and based on merit. Practices like plagiarism, artificial inflation of reviews, or misuse of the platform for unethical purposes are not acceptable. We expect all users to act with fairness, respect intellectual property, and follow community norms.
  • Our marketplace is open to people from every walk of life. Discrimination-based on race, nationality, gender, identity, ability, religion, or any other factor-has no place here. We encourage language, design, and interactions that welcome diverse experiences and perspectives, making Fiverr a place where everyone belongs.
A living framework for a global marketplace

As Fiverr continues to grow, so do the complexities of how people work together. The digital world is evolving, and with it come new opportunities-as well as new risks. Issues like misinformation, harmful AI-generated content, impersonation, and the misuse of communication tools require vigilance and shared responsibility. Our Community Standards are designed to grow alongside the challenges and innovations of today’s professional landscape. They’re not just about protecting users-they’re about enabling creativity, building trust, and ensuring that Fiverr remains a dynamic, ethical, and empowering place to connect and create.

These standards are more than rules-they’re our shared values in action. They’ll continue to grow alongside our community, ensuring Fiverr remains a trusted place to create, connect, and thrive together. If you see something that doesn’t align, please use our reporting tools, as we all play a part in maintaining the culture we value.

Integrity & authenticity

In order to maintain a safe, respectful, fair, and trustworthy marketplace, Fiverr is taking proactive steps to prevent any abusive practices that may undermine the integrity of our platform or the authenticity of our users.

Any activity aimed to deliberately manipulate the platform tools and features will lead to permanent suspension of user accounts involved in such behavior.

Account integrity
  • In order to buy and/or sell services on Fiverr you may have only one account. Creating multiple accounts on Fiverr can be misleading to other users and is considered a manipulation of our system. Any violation of this policy can lead to permanent suspension of the account(s) involved in this activity.
  • This policy applies to individual user accounts. The only exception is the ability to maintain both a seller account and an additional “seat” within the framework of one Team Account.
  • It is prohibited to open multiple accounts on Fiverr in order to (including but not limited to):
    • Gain a competitive advantage
    • Harass or mislead other users through messaging and/or ordering systems
    • Engage in any fraudulent activity
    • Abuse the Fiverr Referral program
    • Bypass a restriction, or permanent suspension of a previous account
    • Violate Fiverr’s Terms of Service and/or our Community Standards in any other way and/or manipulate the system
  • Do not share your authentic credentials (personal email, payment information, phone number) that could be used to create multiple accounts on your behalf.
  • We do not allow accounts to pose as another person or entity in a misleading manner.
  • It is prohibited to:
    • Use a fake name, gender, photo, or any fictional or false biographical details in your user profile
    • Present a fake document(s) if asked to verify your identity
    • Use AI-generated imagery/video to create or verify an account on Fiverr, with the purpose of impersonating another person, or misrepresenting yourself
    • Impersonate other people by creating or using an account that deliberately misrepresents your identity, with the intention to mislead or deceive others
    • Use automated programs and tools to misrepresent your actual location
    • Create a Fiverr profile with your personal information/credentials for anyone other than yourself
  • Do not share your authentic credentials (personal email, payment information, phone number) that could be used to create fake accounts on your behalf. Fiverr reserves the right to permanently suspend accounts which represent a fake identity.
  • Misrepresentation is defined as fraudulent, negligent, or innocent misstatements, or an incomplete statement of a material fact.
  • It is prohibited to:
    • Write misleading content in your profile description, profession profile, skills section, professional background, and/or education
    • Use a Fiverr freelancer badge or level in your profile and any Gig component to misrepresent your current status. However, you may include them if they accurately reflect your level.
    • Copy Gig descriptions, packages, and/or other content from another user’s Gig listing, their profile page or profession profile
    • Raise the price of your Gig service in personal messages before or after purchase. Bait-and-switch marketing is not permitted.
    • Have someone else represent you in your Gig, or profession profile, without clearly stating who they are. Post content you do not have the right to use in a Gig description, user profile and/or profession profile.
    • Use ‘Fiverr’ in any part of your username or display name, or impersonate our employees with the intention to deceive and mislead users, or conduct other prohibited activities
Inauthentic behavior
  • We define spam on Fiverr as a messaging activity that is unwanted, repeatedly occurring, and disruptive to the recipient’s experience. Spam can take many forms ranging from unwanted offers to commercially-motivated solicitations that aim to drive traffic or attention to websites, products, and services outside of Fiverr.
  • Do not:
    • Abuse our communication tools to send unsolicited or deceptive messages
    • Distribute malware, phishing, or other potentially harmful content through Fiverr communication tools
    • Use any artificial tools and/or automated processes (through software, scripts, bots, or any other means) to send mass messages
    • Contact Fiverr users with offers, questions, suggestions, or anything unrelated to their Gigs, requests, or orders
    • Ask other users to guide you on how to start selling on Fiverr through Fiverr communication tools
    • Send direct messages to promote your services or specific Gigs to clients
    • Ask for donations or free work
  • Not only does this activity undermine the integrity of our platform, it also violates the privacy of our members and is potentially harmful. If you encounter spam, please report it.
  • Reviews provided by buyers are an essential part of Fiverr’s rating system. They reflect the quality of service provided by freelancers, their professional skills and experience, and overall client satisfaction. It is therefore important that reviews remain authentic and reliable in order to maintain a trusted and credible marketplace.
  • Do not:
    • Maliciously manipulate the review system in any way to create an inauthentic impression of a freelancer, a client, or the genuine service experience
    • Purchase or sell a service with the sole intent of falsely increasing ratings and/or levels
    • Seek to influence a client to edit, remove, or improve a review, including by asking for a 5-star review or more positive review than they are willing to provide
    • Withhold delivery of a service, or any information required to complete it, in order to obtain favorable reviews
    • Seek to influence a freelancer to deliver free extras or make changes not included in the order by threatening to leave a negative review
    • Buy, trade, solicit, or otherwise obtain feedback for yourself by any means, including through third parties, arranged transactions, or purchases made from multiple accounts, in order to artificially inflate your rating
    • Misuse review reports or submit requests for review removal without clear grounds under Fiverr’s policies
  • Attempts to manipulate the review system, whether directly or indirectly, are prohibited and may result in immediate permanent suspension of any related accounts.
  • Should you suspect review manipulation or any other violations of these policies, please report it.
  • On Fiverr, we value each and every one of our community members and aim to maintain a respectful, inclusive, and safe environment for everyone. We encourage our community to use our reporting tools when encountering anything that is unacceptable.
  • However, we ask you not to misuse these tools in ways that result in unfounded complaints.
  • Do not:
    • Abuse Fiverr’s reporting tools, customer support tickets, or appeals processes by making false, malicious, or unjustified reports
    • Submit repeated reports on the same issue without allowing our Trust and Safety team adequate time to respond
    • Falsely categorize reports or submit misleading or fabricated evidence
    • Engage in mass reporting of content without valid reasons or use reports as a means to harm other users
    • Exploit the reporting system to gain a competitive advantage, such as falsely reporting competitors’ services or actions with the intent to damage their business
    • Use multiple accounts or automate the submission of reports in an attempt to circumvent our processes
  • Fiverr reserves the right to withdraw multiple invalid reports and flag accounts involved in such activity.
  • With the Fiverr Referral program, you can earn rewards for yourself and your friends who sign up to Fiverr per your invitation. Referral program abuse might occur when a group of accounts created for the sole purpose of system manipulation, refers to each other to gain a referral bonus.
  • Do not:
    • Create fake accounts in order to gain referral credit
    • Attempt to manipulate or exploit the current referral program
  • Fiverr reserves the right to permanently suspend accounts which are involved in violation of Referral program rules.
  • Any improper behavior aiming to manipulate Fiverr platform tools and systems does not align with Fiverr values and harms the entire Fiverr community. To create a fair and respectable marketplace, we ask that you do not attempt to subvert our policies which have been put in place to protect platform and marketplace trust and quality.
  • This includes, but is not limited to:
    • Excessive cancellations practice
    • Using the delivery button to send an incomplete, partial, or empty delivery
    • Sending multiple requests on the same issue without allowing for a response from our Customer Support team
  • Any attempts to access the platform through unauthorized methods, affect and manipulate the Fiverr ranking system, send artificial web traffic to Gigs, offer to sell/buy Fiverr accounts, scrape data from the platform, or undermine the security and integrity of our marketplace in any way are strictly prohibited.

Illegal & prohibited services

Fiverr is an open marketplace where users can offer and request a wide range of services. To maintain a safe and trusted environment, certain types of services are not allowed on the platform. Some services may expose users or third parties to serious risks, including financial, privacy, legal, or to safety-related harms. Other services are incompatible with the standards and values that help preserve a high-quality, trustworthy marketplace experience.

Illegal services

We require our users to abide by all applicable laws and regulations. Users may not offer or request services related to illegal activity, or ones that promote, approve, or enable any unlawful behavior. Fiverr reserves the right to permanently suspend user accounts involved in violation of this policy.

To protect our community, Fiverr is committed to enforcing its policies against illegal activity and behavior on the platform. If you encounter content that appears to violate this policy, please report it.

Please note that Fiverr reserves the right to report illegal activity to law enforcement authorities.

Prohibited services

Some services may not be illegal under applicable law, but are still prohibited on Fiverr because they create unacceptable risks for users, third parties, or the marketplace. These restrictions are intended to help prevent harm and abuse, and to protect user safety, trust, and marketplace integrity.

  • Services that promote, coordinate, support, or facilitate violence, extremism, terrorism, or the making, use, sale, or trade of prohibited or dangerous goods are not allowed. These services may contribute to real-world harm, unlawful activity, and public safety threats, and can put individuals, communities, and the platform at significant risk.
  • Services that exploit individuals or facilitate trafficking, coercion, or abuse are strictly prohibited. Fiverr does not allow services that endanger human dignity, safety, or autonomy, contribute to the exploitation of vulnerable individuals, or place minors at risk.
  • Minors require enhanced protection, and services that exploit, sexualize or endanger minors or their identity, likeness, age, or perceived age are not allowed.
  • Services involving sexual activity, sexual exploitation, or sexually explicit interactions are not permitted. These services can create safety, consent, and exploitation risks, and are not compatible with the standards of the marketplace.
  • Services involving therapy, medical care, or psychological treatment are not allowed on Fiverr. These services can create serious health and safety risks, and typically require professional oversight, licensing, and a duty of care.
  • Services that promote hate, degrade protected groups, or target individuals or communities for abuse are prohibited. This includes services that encourage discrimination, dehumanization, harassment, or other forms of targeted harm.
  • Services that are intended to damage, disrupt, disable, or interfere with people, property, websites, platforms, accounts, or online systems are prohibited. This includes services that involve hacking, bypassing protections, gaining unauthorized access, or creating, distributing, or enabling malicious tools. Such services can compromise security, invade privacy, disrupt digital or physical environments, and expose users and third parties to serious harm.
  • Services involving the creation, alteration, or falsification of government, legal, financial, or any other official documents are not allowed. These services can enable fraud, deception, and other unlawful activity, and may cause significant harm to individuals, institutions, or public systems.
  • Services that require professional qualifications, licenses, or authorizations may not be offered without the appropriate credentials, as unqualified professional representation can expose clients to legal, financial, health, and other personal risks.
  • Services that create deceptive, misleading, or non-consensual synthetic or manipulated content (deepfakes) are prohibited. These services can mislead audiences and cause reputational, emotional, or other harms to individuals and communities.
  • Services that create or distribute misinformation, conspiracy-based content, or other harmful deceptive content are not allowed. These services can mislead users, erode trust, and contribute to social, civic, or personal harm.
  • Services that sell personal data, scrape private information, or extract contact details without authorization are not allowed. These services can violate privacy, expose individuals to misuse or exploitation, and undermine user safety and trust.
  • Fiverr does not permit services that violate the intellectual property rights of individuals or businesses, as they may misuse the work or brand identity of others and create legal, financial, and trust-related risks for the marketplace and its users.
  • Read more about services that may violate intellectual property rights.
  • For more information please see Fiverr’s Guide to Responsible Digital Creation.
  • Services that may expose users to financial harm, fraud, or unsafe financial activity are prohibited. This includes services that involve access to another person’s financial accounts or sensitive financial information, as well as deceptive, abusive, or unsafe activity related to digital assets, cryptocurrency, credit, loans, currency exchange, or trading.
  • Fiverr prohibits services that promise guaranteed results or specific personal or financial outcomes that are not reasonably within a seller’s control. These services can mislead users, distort expectations, and increase the risk of financial, reputational, emotional, or other harm, both on Fiverr and in external markets. They may also undermine trust and informed decision-making.
  • Services that violate, facilitate the violation of, or encourage circumvention of third-party terms are prohibited. This includes services that expose users or others to legal, contractual, or platform-related risks.
  • Services that create fake reviews or use deceptive methods to generate artificial traffic, engagement, or inflated performance signals are not allowed. These services distort trust signals, undermine fair competition, and mislead users and third parties.
  • Services that support academic cheating or dishonest job-related conduct are prohibited. Fiverr does not allow services that misrepresent a person’s work, qualifications, knowledge, or abilities in contexts where independent effort or truthful representation is expected.
  • Read more about Academic and workplace dishonesty services.
  • Fiverr’s marketplace and service catalog may evolve over time in response to changes in user needs, market developments, product scope, legal considerations, and risk. As a result, certain service types may no longer be supported on the platform, even where they are not otherwise described in detail in this policy.

The examples above are not exhaustive. Fiverr may update what is considered an illegal or prohibited service from time to time. We may also take action where conduct violates the intent of this policy, including in response to emerging threats or harms that are not explicitly described above. These restrictions apply regardless of whether a service is created, delivered, or facilitated by a person, through automation, or with the use of AI tools.

For more detailed guidance on the types of services that are not allowed on Fiverr, please refer to our Prohibited Services Help Center article, which provides additional explanations and examples.

Objectionable content & user safety

  • Fiverr prohibits adult and sexually explicit content of any kind. If detected or reported, such content will be removed and participants may be permanently suspended from the marketplace. Our policies apply to all user-generated content (UGC), including Gigs, deliveries, portfolios, Gig videos, etc., and applies to any content depicting nudity, or sexually-graphic, violent, or humiliating actions or scenes. This includes AI-generated photographic or animated content.
  • Do not offer, agree to provide, or ask for:
    • Nude or adult-related images or videos
    • Sex or sexual partners
    • Sex chats or sexual conversations
    • Non-consensual content of any kind
    • Sextortion practices (e.g. threatening to share private sexual content for blackmail)
    • Child or child-like sexual content
    • Sexual violence or denigration
    • Sexually charged modeling
    • The execution of fetish scenarios
    • Content that depicts explicit sexual activity, unless the conditions for “documentary exception,” listed below, are met
  • Any of the above, whether real or AI-generated, are prohibited.
  • Sexually-explicit content featuring minors and content that seeks to sexually exploit minors, including AI-generated content, is strictly prohibited on Fiverr. This content, legally referred to as Child Sexual Abuse Material (CSAM), will be immediately reported, along with those who post such content, to the National Center for Missing and Exploited Children, who work with global law enforcement agencies.
  • Fiverr may use broad discretion when removing content that includes or depicts minors. User accounts involved in violation of this policy can be permanently suspended.
  • Documentary exception
  • Fiverr will allow nudity when the primary purpose is educational, scientific, or artistic, and it isn’t gratuitous. For example, a video edit ordered by a midwife depicting proper breastfeeding technique would be appropriate, while creating a video with clips from the same film but used out of context for the purpose of sexual gratification, would not. Out-of-context nudity from indigenous communities, protests, medical procedures, childbirth, artistic performances, breastfeeding or like, may not meet our documentary exception.
  • Fiverr defines hate speech as content which is intended to incite violence or hatred against a person or group of people, based on their real or perceived characteristics, which may include race, skin color, ethnicity, sexual identity, gender identity, marital status, religion, age, or disability.
  • Hate speech may also appear in the form of threatening, derogatory, and dehumanizing language, usage of ethnic or racial slurs, or as content that glorifies or supports hateful narratives and behavior.
  • Fiverr is committed to moving swiftly and decisively to investigate conduct that has been flagged and/or reported to us as hate speech, and will respond in a manner that is consistent with both our Terms of Service and the values of the company. We take hate speech violations very seriously, and may exercise broad discretion when taking action against any users or content that violate this policy.
  • Do not:
    • Use violent and/or dehumanizing speech against a person or group of people based on their real or perceived race, ethnicity, skin color, sexual identity, gender identity, marital status, religion, age, or disability
    • Use ethnic or racial slurs
    • Use hate speech towards another community member(s), group of people, Fiverr’s Customer Support representatives, or Fiverr as a company
    • Offer, agree to provide, or ask for content related to hate speech
    • Express support or glorify hate groups, its members, their actions, or any of their shared ideologies
    • Upload or share any content on the Fiverr platform (including but not limited to a profile page, Gig description, profession page, portfolio project, forum thread, message, brief, etc.) which depicts hate imagery, including hate symbols related to these groups like swastikas, hand symbols, or numbers known to reference hateful or discriminatory ideologies
  • We do allow users to offer or ask for related content that is intended to contribute to the research or raise awareness of hate speech, or to the prevention of hate speech practices.
  • Fiverr considers any unfair or unequal treatment of a person or group of people based on real or perceived characteristics, such as race, skin color, ethnicity, sexual identity, gender identity, marital status, religion, age, or disability, to be discrimination.
  • Similarly, if individual traits or characteristics unrelated to the service influence preferential treatment that potentially deprives others of opportunities on the platform, this preference could also be seen as discriminatory.
  • Do not:
    • Express unwillingness to interact and/or work with a person or a group of people based on real or perceived characteristics, such as race, skin color, ethnicity, sexual identity, gender identity, marital status, religion, age, or disability
    • Offer, agree to provide, or ask for any content that expresses or supports discriminatory ideas, groups who espouse these ideas, members of such groups, or any actions which share and glorify such ideologies
  • Should you encounter behavior or content that appears to violate this policy, please report it. Fiverr will investigate claims of discrimination on a case-by-case basis, and accounts involved in violation of this policy might be permanently suspended.
  • Fiverr prohibits any and all behavior and/or communication on the platform that is inappropriate and could be considered harassment. This includes, but is not limited to:
    • Bullying
    • Sexual advances
    • Offensive comments/conduct
    • Discrimination based on real or perceived characteristics, including race, skin color, ethnicity, sexual identity, gender identity, marital status, religion, age, or disability
  • When communicating on Fiverr, do not:
    • Solicit any sexual interaction
    • Ask inappropriate personal questions
    • Make sexual advances or sexual innuendos
    • Use profane, lewd, or derogatory terms
    • Use offensive or culturally inappropriate/insensitive language
    • Distribute harassing or disturbing materials
  • Additionally, freelancers are strictly prohibited from disclosing clients’ data, including any personal data, to third parties (unless agreed otherwise with the client). Any breach of confidentiality or privacy may lead to the permanent suspension of accounts involved.
  • Should you encounter behavior that appears to violate this policy, please report it.
  • At Fiverr, we care deeply about the safety of our community. To that end, users should not offer, agree to provide, or ask for any content that portrays, glorifies, or promotes suicide and/or other acts of self-harm, including eating disorders.
  • If someone you’re communicating with expresses suicidal thoughts or is engaging in any form of self-harm, we encourage you to contact local authorities immediately and report this.
  • If you are going through an emotionally-challenging time or struggling with thoughts of suicide or self-harm, we urge you to seek immediate assistance.

Violence and unlawful behavior

  • Prioritizing the safety of our community means taking all threats of violence seriously. This includes proactively mitigating any potential risk of harm to our community or those outside the platform. We will consider language and context to ascertain credible threats and take appropriate action against those who violate this policy. We may also notify law enforcement authorities in cases of imminent threat to life or safety of persons.
  • Incitement means encouraging or asking other people to engage in unlawful conduct. Be aware that inciting others to commit a crime may be a crime in itself, regardless of the outcome of the request. Other unlawful behaviors include the glorification of violence, which is often demonstrated through celebration, or praising/condoning violence. All of these actions are strictly prohibited on Fiverr.
  • Do not:
    • Threaten violence against another community member(s), group of people, Fiverr employees, or Fiverr as a company
    • Make any statements of intent to inflict physical harm towards an individual, group, or animals (ex. murders, mass shootings, animal sacrifice, spells/sorcery which intend to cause harm, etc.)
    • Make any statements or share imagery that encourages or incites others to inflict such harm or advocates violence (ex. approval of genocide, support for terrorism, etc.)
    • Share hate symbols like swastikas, hand symbols, or numbers known to reference violent ideologies, etc.
    • Offer, agree to provide, or ask for any content that threatens, glorifies, promotes, or expresses support for acts of violence against individuals, groups, or the general public
    • Urge, provoke someone (through requests or instructions) to break the law or engage in activities of questionable legality
  • On Fiverr, we do not allow content or activities which are directly or indirectly affiliated with, praise, support, or represent dangerous organizations, their members, their actions, or their shared ideologies. Such organizations often use digital platforms to spread their agenda, proliferate messages of hate, and indoctrinate new members to join their cause.
  • This includes, but is not limited to:
    • International and domestic terror organizations
    • Criminal organizations and violent groups
    • Extremist organizations and individuals
    • Hate/conspiracy groups
  • Fiverr reserves the right to permanently suspend user accounts involved in violation of this policy.
  • Do not:
    • Promote or glorify violence, hateful activity, dangerous propaganda, or conspiracy theories
    • Express support for or glorify dangerous organizations, their members, their actions, or their shared ideologies
    • Offer, agree to provide, or ask for services related to activities of dangerous groups and/or their members or shared ideologies
    • Offer, agree to provide, or ask for services which promote violence, conspiracy theories, propaganda, or supports/advocates for the activity of the above organizations
  • We do allow users to offer or ask for related services that are intended to contribute to:
    • The research of dangerous groups and organizations
    • The prevention of terror, extremists, and criminal activity
  • Misinformation is false or inaccurate information that is spread either accidentally or with the deliberate intent to mislead or deceive others (disinformation). Given the potential harm misinformation can cause to individuals and the general public, Fiverr will promptly address any efforts to spread misinformation through the platform and/or to the general public. User accounts which violate this policy will be permanently suspended from the platform.
  • When information is developed and presented in the form of an authentic news article or story, with the intent to mislead or disseminate propaganda, this is considered fake news.
  • Do not offer, agree to provide, or ask for services that create, promote, or distribute misinformation or fake news, including political content.
  • This extends to services that use generative AI tools and/or programs to create, promote, or distribute such content, and includes, but is not limited to the following for the purposes of spreading misinformation at scale:
    • Deepfakes, in the form of video, photo, or audio recordings
    • Automated processes (software, scripts, bots, etc.)
  • We do allow users to offer or ask for related services that are intended to contribute to:
    • The research of propaganda and misinformation techniques
    • The prevention of creation and distribution of misinformation and fake news
  • On Fiverr, we are committed to fostering a community that values diversity, open discussion, and the free exchange of ideas. To uphold these principles and maintain a safe and trustworthy environment for all users, we strictly prohibit any attempts to use the Fiverr marketplace to undermine elections and civic integrity.
  • Election interference is defined as any attempt to interfere with the voting process or to destabilize and undermine public faith in free and fair elections.
  • Do not:
    • Offer, agree to provide, or ask for services interfering with elections or other democratic processes
    • Share misleading information about procedures in election processes
    • Incite the disruption, destruction of procedures and/or election infrastructure, or promote violent behavior and threats
    • Create fake accounts to misrepresent an affiliation, or share content that falsely represents an affiliation, to a candidate, elected official, political party, or government entity
    • Use generative AI tools and/or programs to create or promote content which, in any of the above forms, is intended to undermine an election or other democratic process
  • We do allow users to offer or ask for related services that are intended to be represented as caricature, satire, parody, or meme.

Intellectual property

  • Fiverr is serious about protecting intellectual property (IP) rights and respects the IP rights of third parties. To this end, we provide necessary mechanisms for intellectual property rights protection.
  • Since the content uploaded to Fiverr’s platform by our users is User Generated Content (UGC), we created and implemented special flows to report intellectual property rights violations (copyright and trademark).
  • Once a report of all relevant information is received from a rights holder or authorized representative (“reporter”), we will remove or disable access to content that engages in:
    • Copyright infringement
    • Trademark infringement
  • Fiverr reserves the right to request additional information from a reporter, such as proof of ownership or other documentation.
  • In accordance with various laws, and our commitment to protect the work of our creative community, Fiverr does not permit any service that violates the intellectual property (IP) rights of individuals and/or businesses, and will take measures against those who provide or request such services, and so help to protect our creative community.
  • Do not offer, agree to provide, or ask for services such as:
    • Services related to copying or distribution of copyrighted material (digital piracy), such as creating torrent websites, developing platforms for streaming movies and TV shows, selling access to any streaming service account, etc.
    • Services involving hacked or cracked software products (programs, apps, themes, templates, games, etc).
    • Services which are aimed to intentionally remove the watermark or copyright mark without the owner’s consent or permission.
  • Fiverr reserves the right to permanently suspend accounts which are involved in infringement of intellectual property rights.
  • Fiverr values individuals’ hard work and creativity. As a platform that supports designers, artists, writers, and creatives around the world, it is essential that original work is presented and delivered at all times. We will take swift and serious action against any non-original work being sent and/or delivered as original work.
  • The following standards refer to Gig listings, portfolio projects and delivered orders in the Graphics & Design and Photography categories on Fiverr:
  • Do not portray, sell, or deliver others’ work as your own.
  • Unique concept and publication
    • If working with existing creative elements, designers must implement these elements in a unique way to create a new design concept.
    • Delivered work must be customized and unique, meaning the design has not been previously published online or offline and has been invented for the first time.
  • Gig images and portfolio projects
    • Any designs or photographs featured in Gig images and portfolio projects must be the seller’s original work, but can be work previously published on the designer’s websites or social media.
    • To use a design or photograph from an order delivered on Fiverr, the designer must have consent from the client who placed the order.
  • Elements that can be similar
    • Generic shapes: Ex. Points, lines, squares, ellipsoids, cones, etc.
    • Functional designs: Ex. A circle, a diamond, a heart, ears on a tiger, wheels on a car, green color to convey environmental responsibility, etc.
    • Elements not eligible for copyright protection, such as:
      • Short phrases like “Show me the money” or “Beam me up”
      • Facts and theories like scientific facts or the quantum theory
      • Abstract ideas, but not the way an idea is expressed. For example, the basic plot of comics can be an idea but not the way the designer expressed that idea
      • Materials commonly found in a work of a particular type, ex. the presence of castles, knights, and dragons in a medieval story; certain elements and details of creative content that are customary or considered necessary to a particular genre
  • Stock image and template policy
  • Make sure to have all required licenses for using the stock image or template in your delivery.
  • Stock images
    • All stock images must be from authorized agencies.
    • Don’t deliver or post stock images “as is”.
    • Stock images can be used in a transformative way as a part of your delivery.
  • Templates
    • If you start your design work with a template, be sure that your final, delivered design is significantly different from the template design, with a new look and feel, a unique concept, and/or transformative use.
    • You are permitted to provide a service that relies on templates found online, but this must be specified in your Gig.
    • Freelancers who heavily rely on templates in their design work will not be eligible for special seller programs on Fiverr, ex. Fiverr Pro.
  • At Fiverr, we are committed to fostering a community of responsible digital creators. Creations on Fiverr might often involve third-party services or products that are meant to be used by third-party platforms (for example, social media networks, other online marketplaces, or AI-powered content creation services). In such cases, we ask our users to adhere to the following guidelines:
  • Respect for third-party rights
  • Users should respect the rights of third parties, both within and outside of the Fiverr community. If you know that your activity or delivery on Fiverr relies on other platforms or companies, you must follow their terms of service (ToS) and other applicable policies (for example, their privacy policy or intellectual property policy).
  • Transparency
  • When utilizing external elements, users must be transparent about their use of third-party content, including the rights they have with respect to such content. Misrepresentation is strictly prohibited. Users must verify that their licenses for third-party work include the necessary permissions.
  • Mutual respect
  • Freelancers are encouraged to communicate transparently about the use of external elements in their creations, especially in Gigs. For clients who request deliveries involving third parties, we encourage being proactive in understanding the origins of integrated elements during order requirements or other discussions with freelancers, to ensure that their order does not violate any rights.
  • Intellectual property protection
  • Users are expected to respect intellectual property (IP) rights, including copyright and trademark protections, even when content is freely available, and to maintain a record when collaborating or using external content. Deliveries created on Fiverr should not violate the IP of others. Where applicable, users should provide relevant licenses or permissions to verify pertinent rights.
  • By adhering to these guidelines, users can contribute to a thriving and lawful digital marketplace, ensuring that the creative process is grounded in legality, transparency, and mutual respect.
  • For more information, see Fiverr’s Guide to Responsible Digital Creation.
  • The difference between incorporating other freelancers’ work in your delivery and profit arbitrage
  • Other freelancers’ work can be used in your delivery when you have the rights to use it, and it’s used as an element of your own delivery.
  • It cannot be used as your own delivery when you are reselling it “as is” with no significant added value or transformative use, under the misconception that it is your original work, and in order to gain profit from price differences. That is called profit arbitrage and it is not permitted on Fiverr.
  • Examples of other freelancers’ work that you can use (if you have the rights to reuse it):
    • Designs as backgrounds for music videos
    • Images for websites or presentations
    • Music beds for explainer videos

Minors policy

Fiverr’s Terms of Service require that all users be at least 18 years of age and of legal age to form a binding contract. Users under 18 and at least 13 years of age are permitted to use the site only through an account owned by their parent or legal guardian with their permission. Those under the age of 13 are not permitted to use the site.

Services involving minors

Some Gigs on Fiverr involve minors’ participation in the service.

  • In cases where the minor is the primary service provider (for example, child voice over), the owner of the account must be the minor’s parent or legal guardian. When this is the case, it must be clearly stated in the Gig components and profile description.
  • In cases where the minor is involved in the service creation process (for example, photography for children’s products) it must be clear from the nature of the service that participation of minors is required.

Parents or legal guardians, and freelancers who work with minors when providing their services, are required to follow all local child labor laws and regulations.

Users under 18 may not take part in providing the following services on Fiverr: dance lessons, modeling, greeting cards & videos, and “your message on”.

No sexually explicit content featuring minors

We do not allow sexually explicit content featuring minors or content that seeks to sexually exploit minors, including but not limited to:

  • NSFW/lewd illustrations and voiceovers
  • erotic stories
  • lolicon (or loli), shotacon (or shota) voice overs or anime illustrations
  • deepfakes
  • any sexually explicit child-like imagery, including those generated by AI tools and programs

We also prohibit depicting and describing minors in a way which could be considered sexually suggestive in nature, violent, or exploitative. Fiverr may use broad discretion when removing content that includes or depicts minors. User accounts involved in violation of this policy can be permanently suspended.

We immediately report Child Sexual Abuse Material (CSAM) to the National Center for Missing and Exploited Children, who work with global law enforcement agencies.

AI-generated content

Fiverr embraces new technology and allows the use of generative artificial intelligence (AI) tools to create content.

While user expectations continue to evolve with the increasing prevalence of generative-AI tools, freelancers who use these tools to generate content and/or deliver services must uphold Fiverr’s core values, including marketplace integrity and professional standards.

AI tools may be used to assist freelancers in completing their work, but they are not a substitute for the freelancer’s own skill, effort and judgment. Freelancers are accountable for the final work they deliver and must ensure that any AI-generated or AI-assisted work is high-quality, original, and meaningfully refined and customized to the client’s specific requirements. Misrepresenting the use of AI tools is a breach of trust and a failure to meet Fiverr’s marketplace integrity and quality standards.

Users must comply with Fiverr’s policies, with particular emphasis on the following guidelines:

AI tools may not be used to spread misinformation, create or distribute non-consensual content, create deepfakes in any form, including photo, video, or audio, or create fake accounts.

Freelancers must also:

  • Ensure they have all necessary rights to the content they create, including copyright(s), trademark(s), and licenses (where required).
  • Comply with the respective application, tool, and/or program’s terms of service and all applicable regulations, such as data protection, privacy, and consumer rights laws.
  • Offer high-quality, customized work for each order. AI-generated or AI-assisted content must be meaningfully refined and tailored to the client’s specific requirements and intended use. Freelancers must not deliver generic, unmodified, or reused AI-generated output.
  • Own the final delivered work and be fully accountable for any error or inaccuracy, regardless of the use of AI tools. Failure to meet Fiverr’s AI quality standards may result in order cancellation and a refund to the client.

Any content found to infringe or violate intellectual property, applicable law, or Fiverr’s Community Standards will be removed from the platform, and the freelancer’s account may be permanently suspended.

If you suspect any misuse or unethical behavior related to generative AI usage, please report it.

These policies and guidelines will be updated to align with developing trends and usage in generative AI.

For additional information, best practices, and practical guidance on responsible use of generative AI on Fiverr, please refer to our dedicated Help Center article.

Off-Platform policy

At Fiverr, we are committed to maintain a secure, transparent, and trustworthy community. To protect both clients and freelancers, all transactions must occur within the Fiverr platform. This allows us to provide comprehensive safeguards, including secure payments, dispute resolution, community guidelines, and fraud prevention.

Stay protected

Conducting business on Fiverr increases your visibility and credibility as a freelancer. By using Fiverr’s tools, you can build long-term relationships with repeat clients and secure larger, higher-value orders. To support seamless communication, Fiverr offers built-in tools like video calls, which help freelancers align with their clients’ needs and provide the best possible order experience.

Engaging outside of Fiverr increases the risk of:

  • Fraud and scams: Off-platform transactions make it easier for bad actors to deceive clients or freelancers.
  • Breaches of privacy: Personal and financial information shared outside of Fiverr lacks adequate protection.
  • Limited recourse: If an issue arises (cancellations, disputes, etc.), Fiverr cannot intervene or protect users conducting business outside the platform.

By keeping your business activity on Fiverr, you are protected by our security measures and ensuring that your account and business transactions remain safe.

Conducting business off-platform

It is prohibited to:

  • Offer or accept payments outside of Fiverr: All payments must be processed through Fiverr to ensure full protection.
  • Propose or agree to bypass Fiverr’s payment system: Soliciting or engaging in off-platform transactions with Fiverr users is not allowed.
  • Direct clients or freelancers to external platforms: This includes suggesting alternative payment systems and external contracts.
  • Share personal contact details: Do not share email addresses, phone numbers, or third-party messaging apps with the sole purpose of conducting business off-platform.

Conducting business off-platform directly violates Fiverr’s Terms of Service. This includes breaching the payment agreement, which encompasses Fiverr’s service fees. User accounts involved in violation of this policy risk permanent suspension of their accounts.

To help maintain a safe and transparent marketplace, we encourage users to report any attempts of taking business off the platform. Submitted reports will go directly to Fiverr’s Trust & Safety team for a thorough review.

For more details on acceptable practices and best communication methods, please refer to our Help Center article.

Taking business off-platform

Unprofessional behavior

Unresponsiveness to clients

Please communicate proactively with your clients to keep them informed throughout the order process.

Our messaging system is built to facilitate active orders and genuine project discussions. Using it to cold-message or spam other users with promotions for your Gigs degrades the user experience and is not tolerated on Fiverr.

As a responsible global platform, Fiverr requires its users to respect the broader internet community. Offering or requesting work that breaches the rules of external platforms, companies, or tools compromises our ethical standards.
